meta.title: How DMSO Heals the Brain and Transforms Neurology
meta.description: The extensive evidence behind DMSO's ability to treat 'incurable' neurological diseases — and how to use it
meta.label: 修复大脑与改变神经学

content.en: # How DMSO Heals the Brain and Transforms Neurology
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）如何修复大脑并改变神经学领域

content.en: The extensive evidence behind DMSO's ability to treat 'incurable' neurological diseases — and how to use it
content.cn: 关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够治疗“不治之症”的神经系统疾病这一观点的丰富证据——以及其使用方法

content.en: **Story at a Glance:故事概要：**

- **DMSO is an “umbrella remedy” capable of treating a wide range of challenging ailments due to its combination of therapeutic properties (e.g., improving circulation, reducing inflammation, protecting cells from a myriad of otherwise lethal stressors, and reviving dying cells).
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是一种“万能疗法”，由于其兼具多种治疗特性（例如：改善血液循环、减轻炎症、保护细胞免受各种原本致命的应激因素的伤害，以及复苏濒死细胞），因此能够治疗多种棘手的疾病。**

content.en: - **These properties make DMSO uniquely suited to treat “incurable” neurological disorders, and in conjunction with forgotten research on the effects of microcirculatory impairments, reshape our understanding of the causes of neurological (and psychiatric) diseases.
content.cn: 这些特性使二甲基亚砜（DMSO）特别适合用于治疗“无法治愈”的神经系统疾病；再加上关于微循环障碍影响的那些被遗忘的研究，这些发现正在重塑我们对神经系统（及精神）疾病病因的理解。**

content.en: - **DMSO has shown remarkable promise for cognitive impairment, brain fog, and memory loss from a wide range of causes (e.g., aging, vascular disease, anesthesia, post-COVID or pharmaceutical poisoning), along with improving sleep quality and dream vividness — often by resolving the pain, breathing difficulties, or neurological conditions (e.g., restless leg syndrome) that were preventing restorative sleep.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在改善由多种原因（例如衰老、血管疾病、麻醉、新冠肺炎后遗症或药物中毒）导致的认知功能障碍、脑雾和记忆力减退方面展现出显著的潜力，同时还能改善睡眠质量和梦境的生动性——这通常是通过缓解阻碍恢复性睡眠的疼痛、呼吸困难或神经系统疾病（例如不宁腿综合征）来实现的。**

content.en: - **Extensive data supports DMSO’s use for the major neurodegenerative diseases — including Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, ALS, Huntington’s, and multiple sclerosis — and protein misfolding diseases such as prion disorders and Niemann-Pick disease, where DMSO’s ability to act as a chemical chaperone (stabilizing proteins and dissolving toxic aggregates) and augment cranial drainage is particularly relevant.
content.cn: 大量数据表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可用于治疗主要的神经退行性疾病——包括帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、亨廷顿病和多发性硬化症——以及蛋白质错误折叠类疾病，如朊病毒病和尼曼-皮克病。在这些疾病中，DMSO作为化学伴侣（稳定蛋白质并溶解有毒聚集物）以及促进颅内引流的能力尤为重要。**

content.en: - **Numerous psychiatric conditions (e.g., schizophrenia, depression, anxiety, and PTSD) have responded to DMSO, as have seizures and epilepsy, movement disorders, encephalitis, myasthenia gravis, and hydrocephalus.
content.cn: 许多精神疾病（例如精神分裂症、抑郁症、焦虑症和创伤后应激障碍）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有反应，癫痫发作、癫痫、运动障碍、脑炎、重症肌无力及脑积水也是如此。**

content.en: - **DMSO has also produced striking developmental improvements in children with Down syndrome across multiple clinical studies, along with many other neurodevelopmental disorders.
content.cn: 在多项临床研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）不仅对唐氏综合征患儿，而且对许多其他神经发育障碍患儿，都产生了显著的发育改善效果。**

content.en: - **This article will synopsize the extensive data demonstrating DMSO’s efficacy for CNS neurological diseases (approximately 2000 studies and 200 pertinent reader testimonials), share pertinent (non-DMSO) discoveries we’ve made about neurological diseases over the years, and then conclude with practical guidance on DMSO protocols and complementary approaches that also aid in the treatment of common neurological disorders.
content.cn: 本文将概述大量证明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对中枢神经系统（CNS）神经系统疾病疗效的数据（约2000项研究和200则相关读者反馈），分享我们多年来在神经系统疾病领域所获得的相关（非DMSO）研究成果，最后就DMSO治疗方案以及有助于治疗常见神经系统疾病的辅助疗法提供实用指导。**

content.en: DMSO has remarkable therapeutic utility across a wide range of challenging conditions yet is largely unknown. Recognizing this, I spent the last two years compiling the data which shows DMSO treats a wide array of conditions including [lung issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-heals-the-lungs-and-cures-chronic-35a) (e.g. COPD and Asthma), [skin issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-revolutionizes-skin-care-and) (including hair loss), [many different types of pain](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for), [arthritis](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune), [tissue injury](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) (e.g., sprains or burns), [eye issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-heals-the-eyes-and-transforms) (e.g., vision loss or dry eyes), [autoimmune disorders](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-treats-incurable-autoimmune), [dental issues](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-cures-eye-ear-nose-throat), [gastrointestinal diseases](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-heals-the-gut-and-cures), [infections](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-transforms-the-treatment-of), and [cancers](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms) (along with how DMSO’s efficacy can be further enhanced by [combining it with pharmaceuticals](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/therapeutic-dmso-combinations-revolutionize) or [natural therapies](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-mixtures-transform-natural-medicine)).
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在治疗多种棘手疾病方面具有显著的疗效，却鲜为人知。意识到这一点，我在过去两年里整理了相关数据，这些数据表明DMSO可治疗多种疾病，包括肺部疾病（如 慢性阻塞性肺病和哮喘）、皮肤问题（包括脱发）、多种类型的疼痛、关节炎、组织损伤（例如扭伤或烧伤）、眼部问题（例如视力丧失或干眼症）、自身免疫性疾病、牙科问题、胃肠道疾病、感染以及癌症（同时还包括如何通过将二甲基亚砜与药物或天然疗法结合使用来进一步增强其疗效）。

content.cn: 由于上述每篇文章都援引了数千项被遗忘的研究，有力地论证了尝试使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的必要性，因此这些文章累计获得了数百万次浏览量，且数千名读者（目前已超过6000人）向我反馈称，他们在应对的众多病症上都出现了好转，其中许多案例不仅彻底改变了他们的生活，还与1980年这档新闻节目中报道的情况相吻合：

content.en: More importantly, much in the same way Mike Wallace successfully revived interest in DMSO in 1980 after the FDA successfully spent two decades largely burying it, this series has again created a renewed interest in one of the most accessible and effective remedies available to us.
content.cn: 更重要的是，正如迈克·华莱士在1980年成功重新唤起了人们对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的兴趣——此前美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）花了二十年时间将其基本扼杀——本系列节目再次激发了人们对目前我们所能获得的最易获取且最有效的疗法之一的兴趣。

content.en: Since DMSO is particularly well-suited to treating neurological diseases (which often “nothing can be done about”), some of the most profound stories I’ve received related to neurological diseases. Likewise, consider this conversation I had a few days ago with James Miller MD, a physician, who inspired by the results reported here, began using it in a large number of his patients, and frequently seeing astonishing results he was initially left in disbelief by.
content.cn: 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）特别适合治疗神经系统疾病（这类疾病往往被认为“无计可施”），我收到的最令人震撼的故事中，有不少都与神经系统疾病有关。同样，不妨看看我几天前与詹姆斯·米勒医生（James Miller MD）的一段对话。这位医生受到本文所报道结果的启发，开始将其应用于大量患者身上，并频繁观察到令人惊叹的效果——起初他甚至对此难以置信。

content.cn: 最后，对于那些正在寻找二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使用方案和建议的朋友，相关内容可在本文末尾找到（建议您先阅读全文，以便更好地理解这些说明）。

content.en: Cellular Protection
content.cn: 细胞保护

content.en: DMSO is well-known for protecting cells from many otherwise deadly stressors. For example, it prevents freezing damage to cells, which made modern cryopreservation (cryomedicine) possible, and extensive research shows that this protective effect works across nearly every type of tissue (along with repeatedly saving [human fingers](https://archive.org/details/persecuteddrugst00mcgr) and animal ears or limbs <sup data-ref="1">1</sup>, <sup data-ref="2">2</sup>, <sup data-ref="3">3</sup> from being lost to frostbite). As the cells of the nervous system are particularly sensitive to injury (and often unable to heal from it), DMSO’s protective qualities are particularly useful for it. Core mechanisms of protection include:
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以能保护细胞免受许多原本致命的应激因素侵害而闻名。例如，它能防止细胞因冻伤而受损，这使得现代冷冻保存（冷冻医学）成为可能；大量研究表明，这种保护作用几乎适用于所有类型的组织（此外，它还多次成功挽救了因冻伤而濒临截肢的人类手指以及动物的耳朵或四肢 <sup data-ref="1">1</sup> <sup data-ref="2">2</sup> <sup data-ref="3">3</sup> ）。 由于神经系统的细胞对损伤特别敏感（且往往无法自行愈合），DMSO的保护特性对神经系统尤为有益。其核心保护机制包括：

content.en: •Reducing oxidative stress <sup data-ref="4">4</sup>, <sup data-ref="5">5</sup>, <sup data-ref="6">6</sup>, <sup data-ref="7">7</sup> and neutralizing harmful free radicals <sup data-ref="8">8</sup>, <sup data-ref="9">9</sup>, <sup data-ref="10">10</sup> (e.g., those caused by radiation like hydroxyl) through scavenging charged ions (e.g., H <sup>+</sup>) and forming protective DMSO radicals (along with [decreasing lipofuscin formation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6717089/) in human glial cells, reducing the cumulative oxidative damage that drives cellular aging). In hippocampal slices DMSO also counteracted this oxidative stress,<sup data-ref="11">11</sup>, <sup data-ref="12">12</sup> and in cerebellar granule neurons, this prevented oxidative stress-induced apoptosis and cell death by reducing early mitochondrial impairment and DNA fragmentation <sup data-ref="13">13</sup>, <sup data-ref="14">14</sup> (with similar benefits also being seen when DMSO was combined with CDK and G9a inhibitors <sup data-ref="15">15</sup>, <sup data-ref="16">16</sup>**).** Trace amounts of DMSO also protect plants from [ozone gas injury](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0261219482900461) and [counteract](https://www.translationalres.com/article/0022-2143\(87\)90291-5/abstract) reactive hypochlorous acid, superoxide, and hydrogen peroxide (while simultaneously [working synergistically with oxidative therapies](https://www.translationalres.com/article/0022-2143\(87\)90291-5/abstract) and [not impairing neutrophil viability](https://www.translationalres.com/article/0022-2143\(87\)90291-5/abstract)).
content.cn: •减轻氧化应激 <sup data-ref="15">15</sup> <sup data-ref="16">16</sup> <sup data-ref="10">10</sup> <sup data-ref="7">7</sup> 并中和有害自由基 <sup data-ref="15">15</sup> <sup data-ref="16">16</sup> <sup data-ref="10">10</sup> （例如由辐射产生的羟基自由基）通过清除带电离子（例如 H <sup>+</sup> ）并形成具有保护作用的 DMSO 自由基（同时减少人类胶质细胞中脂褐素的形成，从而减轻导致细胞衰老的累积性氧化损伤）。 在海马切片中，DMSO同样能抵消这种氧化应激， <sup data-ref="15">15</sup> <sup data-ref="16">16</sup> 而在小脑颗粒神经元中，它通过减轻早期线粒体功能障碍和DNA碎片化，从而防止了氧化应激诱导的凋亡和细胞死亡 <sup data-ref="15">15</sup> <sup data-ref="16">16</sup> （当DMSO与CDK和G9a抑制剂联合使用时，也观察到了类似的益处 <sup data-ref="15">15</sup> <sup data-ref="16">16</sup> ）。微量DMSO还能保护植物免受臭氧气体的伤害，并抵消次氯酸、超氧阴离子和过氧化氢的活性（同时与氧化疗法产生协同作用，且不影响中性粒细胞的存活能力）。

content.en: •Increasing the production of ATP in cells, and facilitating producing it when energy production has been compromised (e.g., minute concentrations of DMSO, as [low as 0.000025–0.25](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2772822/) %, [have been shown](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17853437/) to increase cellular metabolism such as by shunting metabolites from glycolysis to the mitochondrial Krebs cycle [or to make](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/001457939181302O) a part of the mitochondria able to synthesize ATP without the rest of the mitochondria being present <sup data-ref="17">17</sup>, <sup data-ref="18">18</sup>, <sup data-ref="19">19</sup>, <sup data-ref="20">20</sup>, <sup data-ref="21">21</sup>). DMSO [also prevented](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15128398/) hydroxyl radical-induced mitochondrial aconitase inactivation, ATP depletion, and neuronal damage. Furthermore, [DMSO increased the metabolism of pyruvate and glucose in brain slices](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/jnr.21477), [protected mice](https://accp1.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/j.1552-4604.1974.tb01410.x?sid=nlm%3Apubmed) from otherwise lethal nitrogen asphyxiation, and [in a study](https://www.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2004&filename=ZYYB200406004&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=OF4-H1Rs87yHUHqTY1149E_GToeFtthdft5agj8O-lsbgCF6S8UrkmXW6EHX5YRw) where mice were decapitated, DMSO prolonged how long the mice continued to gasp (breathe) and hence how long brain function continued.
content.cn: •增加细胞内ATP的生成，并在能量生成受阻时促进其生成（例如，浓度低至0.000025–0.25%的极低浓度，已被证明能增强细胞代谢，例如将代谢物从糖酵解分流至线粒体三羧酸循环，或使部分线粒体在没有其余线粒体存在的情况下仍能合成ATP <sup data-ref="17">17</sup> <sup data-ref="18">18</sup> <sup data-ref="19">19</sup> <sup data-ref="20">20</sup> <sup data-ref="21">21</sup> ）。 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能防止羟基自由基诱导的线粒体琥珀酸脱氢酶失活、ATP耗竭以及神经元损伤。此外，DMSO能增加脑切片中丙酮酸和葡萄糖的代谢，保护小鼠免受原本致命的氮气窒息，并且在一项对小鼠进行断头实验的研究中，DMSO延长了小鼠持续喘息（呼吸）的时间，从而延长了脑功能的维持时间。

content.en: *Note: many animal studies are exceedingly cruel and not something I support; however, as they have been done, I felt it was important to share the knowledge certain DMSO ones provided so it would not be necessary to repeat them to acquire that data.
content.cn: 注：许多动物实验极其残忍，我并不支持；然而，既然这些实验已经进行过，我认为分享某些二甲基亚砜（DMSO）相关实验所提供的知识非常重要，这样就无需为了获取这些数据而重复进行这些实验。*

content.en: • [Protecting cells from dying once the blood supply is cut off](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-could-save-millions-from-brain) (a key reason why so many readers [have been able to avoid permanent disability from a stroke](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-could-save-millions-from-brain)), including by [preventing the rapid influx of calcium or sodium ions](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/236711/) that frequently triggers apoptosis (cell death), and [reducing the activity of caspase proteins](https://www.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=YXZS201803007&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=XFUqin0vdg1XTt10BS7MiqK2x7yeqLvuwSA5zWqmZF3HFO6DLjsK87DmMWtrFer8) (which trigger cell death) in the liver, heart, and airway epithelial cells.
content.cn: • 在血液供应中断后保护细胞免于死亡（这是许多读者能够避免因中风而导致永久性残疾的关键原因之一），包括阻止常会引发凋亡（细胞死亡）的钙离子或钠离子快速涌入，以及降低肝脏、心脏和气道上皮细胞中半胱天冬酶（会引发细胞死亡）的活性。

content.en: *Note: <sup>⬖</sup> designates natural substances used in conjunction with DMSO.
content.cn: 注： <sup>⬖</sup> 表示与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）配合使用的天然物质。*

content.en: These properties hence allow DMSO to:
content.cn: 因此，这些特性使得二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够：

content.en: •Protect neurons throughout the brain (e.g., in the hippocampus) from a wide range of excitotoxins—which are well-recognized as a common cause of neurodegeneration,<sup data-ref="22">22</sup>, <sup data-ref="23">23</sup>, <sup data-ref="24">24</sup>, <sup data-ref="25">25</sup>, <sup data-ref="26">26</sup>, <sup data-ref="27">27</sup>, <sup data-ref="28">28</sup>, <sup data-ref="29">29</sup>, <sup data-ref="30">30</sup>, <sup data-ref="31">31</sup>70026-x) (e.g., in [one study](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2000&filename=NTYX200004015&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=-7lUokkrr3zS2q7euecv89wKzv8nOpV5-d1b54faJQ9w89ApCfRuWkHGHN4dIe2f) DMSO restored 66.7-76.1% of normal electrical activity following glutamate toxicity), and to enhance the protective effects of other protective agents (e.g., [syringaresinol](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201902&filename=1019846099.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=U-KcbD8iI-mtiNSOJOo4Hs4r7nNJYRRteKVXAv1bxtlRc3zYJyu6c7TLPZ9wc8jr),<sup>⬖</sup> [isoquinolinesulfonamides](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0024320596001440), [curcumin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFD1214&filename=1014310674.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=wor5KuE7ARGPbmo2hNYqqPARhBxpB9YY65l-JDqvAGNt5q3Kp4e_ISztFvYZgTK8) <sup>⬖</sup> and [ginkgo biloba](https://europepmc.org/article/med/21162271) <sup>⬖</sup>).<sup data-ref="32">32</sup>, <sup data-ref="33">33</sup>, <sup data-ref="34">34</sup>, <sup data-ref="35">35</sup>, <sup data-ref="36">36</sup>, <sup data-ref="37">37</sup>
content.cn: •保护整个大脑（例如海马体）中的神经元免受各种兴奋性毒素的侵害——这些毒素已被公认为神经退行性变的常见病因， <sup data-ref="32">32</sup> <sup data-ref="33">33</sup> <sup data-ref="34">34</sup> <sup data-ref="35">35</sup> <sup data-ref="36">36</sup> <sup data-ref="37">37</sup> <sup data-ref="28">28</sup> <sup data-ref="29">29</sup> <sup data-ref="30">30</sup> <sup data-ref="31">31</sup> （例如，在一项研究中，二甲基亚砜在谷氨酸毒性后恢复了66.7%至76.1%的正常电活动），并能增强其他保护剂的保护作用（例如，丁香苯酚、 <sup>⬖</sup> 异喹啉磺酰胺类、姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和银杏叶 <sup>⬖</sup> ）的保护作用。 <sup data-ref="32">32</sup> <sup data-ref="33">33</sup> <sup data-ref="34">34</sup> <sup data-ref="35">35</sup> <sup data-ref="36">36</sup> <sup data-ref="37">37</sup>

[melatonin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29325994/),*<sup>⬖</sup> *[baicalin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38503930/),*<sup>⬖</sup> *[butein](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahKPh4pLJjKNZawg6MgtM29q_EUIqaK-zzwFTcQuwRwhqUU1VZRCgxdrYyIMpKlRgNrXTyoFIga3KXaVDfxU_P6qmnqF2oabEqfQ5c73qp68BkepKVLOjYKqfrswU8v2_PxB5x43TnM7PV-Rf0DG144o_ayoKHEY0k5DLyBX5G14ER5qIZgPuiet&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN)*,<sup>⬖</sup> , [various Chinese medicinals](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVBq18XcKYQGGb38G1PueqVVXAuatjMc4ckZUVlDY1P4XG7ts0EEkDInZIf3OE64bGb3bDBDv_SzgCGLPEXgNT2-heYTTjrejIsHo6h1PCekkEbB8UOqKbNZd5hrPPCOQknk0Se4N_j1kYaXP8LUQVpcw_4gufxuE6f21CzV6VHV2ht1YE-HRv75&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), content.cn: 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通常与其他神经保护剂联合使用，例如姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 、褪黑素、 <sup>⬖</sup> 黄芩苷、 <sup>⬖</sup> 黄芩素、 <sup>⬖</sup> 淫羊藿苷、 <sup>⬖</sup> 柚皮苷、 <sup>⬖</sup> 4-PBA、BPV(phen)，以及各种中药、亚硝酮化合物和辣椒素衍生物 <sup>⬖</sup> （即在上述研究中，这些组合既能减轻神经炎症、氧化应激、内质网应激和细胞凋亡，又能增强神经元细胞的线粒体功能和自噬）。

content.en: •In carbon monoxide poisoned rats, [reducing cerebral](https://eajem.com/articles/the-ameliorative-effects-of-ethyl-pyruvate-and-dimethyl-sulfoxide-on-ischemic-tissue-injury-in-experimental-carbon-monoxide-intoxication/doi/eajem.galenos.2019.20438) neuronal alteration and degenerative rate, along with total cardiac injury score (and also reducing liver injury if combined with ethyl pyruvate).<sup data-ref="38">38</sup>, <sup data-ref="39">39</sup> [Glibenclamide](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017716228.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=dJZo7VpnW95uN4qwY79yIiMGmfmVDqu5ybiGFzOegwvoLekZbSRqUeeyKQY9isgo) further improved neurological deficit scores, reduced neural cell breakdown (NSE and S-100β) and reduced inflammatory TNF-α and IL-8 levels. Lastly, DMSO’s antioxidant properties have been proposed to confer a potential neuroprotective role in carbon monoxide poisoning.<sup data-ref="40">40</sup>, <sup data-ref="41">41</sup>
content.cn: •在一氧化碳中毒的大鼠模型中，可减轻脑神经元病变和退化速率，并降低心脏损伤总评分（若与乙基丙酮酸联合使用，还可减轻肝脏损伤）。 <sup data-ref="40">40</sup> <sup data-ref="41">41</sup> 格列本脲进一步改善了神经功能缺损评分，减少了神经细胞损伤（NSE 和 S-100β），并降低了炎症因子 TNF-α 和 IL-8 的水平。最后，有研究提出二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的抗氧化特性可能在一氧化碳中毒中发挥潜在的神经保护作用。 <sup data-ref="40">40</sup> <sup data-ref="41">41</sup>

content.en: •Protect normal cells against chemotherapies such as preventing brain injury, oxidative stress, inflammation and neuronal death from cyclophosphamide (in combination with [Scenedesmus obliquus](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36585479/) <sup>⬖</sup>), cisplatin (alone or in combination with DMFM) <sup data-ref="42">42</sup>, <sup data-ref="43">43</sup>, <sup data-ref="44">44</sup> and doxorubicin ([where in combination with curcumin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVD_NfUhuEAQNROLXUhKSj3PQQzRnVaolElkImfWxvPj5B4s-b9G4mUGYcIJU_V-OI1-EkvZzQ0OotuIyj4-P6WeDWTQQuRB2VVCoOd9kBdrNC6D85O7QvbiK_6YzCFKGjQk9YAJo-rfBT30NbgAo8JqDuwIlkGJqCZFvRx9cn7W4NtgaD9xiqmr&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> prevented “chemobrain”).
content.cn: •保护正常细胞免受化疗药物的影响，例如预防环磷酰胺（与斜丝石松 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用）、顺铂 （单独使用或与DMFM联合使用） <sup data-ref="42">42</sup> <sup data-ref="43">43</sup> <sup data-ref="44">44</sup> 以及阿霉素（其中与姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用可预防“化疗脑”）。

or PAS-Na or a FTO inhibitor),<sup data-ref="53">53</sup>, <sup data-ref="53">53</sup>, <sup data-ref="54">54</sup>, <sup data-ref="55">55</sup> toxic doses of lithium ([in combination with content.cn: •预防由多种金属（如铅（单独使用或与胸腺喹酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用） <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="54">54</sup> 、铝（单独使用或与GSK-3β、 3MA或丹曲林） <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="54">54</sup> <sup data-ref="55">55</sup> 、镉、汞（与褪黑素 <sup>⬖</sup> 或姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用）， <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> 锰的毒性形式（单独使用或与NAC、PAS-Na或FTO抑制剂联合使用）， <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="53">53</sup> <sup data-ref="54">54</sup> <sup data-ref="55">55</sup> 毒性剂量的锂（与姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用）以及砷（与3-MA联合使用）， 锌纳米颗粒（与槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用）、氯化钴（与姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用）和氟化物（与 M3OMG 联合使用），以及硫乙酰胺。

content.en: *Note: neuroprotective effects from DMSO in those studies included reductions in oxidative stress, neuronal cell death, calcium dysregulation, intracellular calcium release, birth defects, and histopathological brain damage.
content.cn: 注：在这些研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的神经保护作用包括减轻氧化应激、神经元细胞死亡、钙调节紊乱、细胞内钙释放、出生缺陷以及脑组织病理学损伤。*

content.en: •Protect animals from organophosphates, including otherwise lethal doses of nerve gas <sup data-ref="56">56</sup>, <sup data-ref="57">57</sup>, <sup data-ref="58">58</sup>, <sup data-ref="59">59</sup>, <sup data-ref="60">60</sup>, <sup data-ref="61">61</sup> (or to enhance the efficacy of antidotes and reduce brain damage <sup data-ref="62">62</sup>, <sup data-ref="63">63</sup>, <sup data-ref="64">64</sup>) and to treat snakebites and their associated swelling in humans, cats, horses and dogs.<sup data-ref="65">65</sup>, <sup data-ref="66">66</sup>, <sup data-ref="67">67</sup>, <sup data-ref="68">68</sup>, <sup data-ref="69">69</sup>, <sup data-ref="70">70</sup> Similarly, [in two horses swarmed](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20203551253) by African bees, IV DMSO as part of a combination protocol was able to reverse the severe neurological impairment created by the bee venom within five hours.
content.cn: •保护动物免受有机磷化合物的危害，包括通常会致死的剂量的神经毒气 <sup data-ref="65">65</sup> <sup data-ref="66">66</sup> <sup data-ref="67">67</sup> <sup data-ref="68">68</sup> <sup data-ref="69">69</sup> <sup data-ref="70">70</sup> （或增强解毒剂的疗效并减轻脑损伤 <sup data-ref="65">65</sup> <sup data-ref="66">66</sup> <sup data-ref="67">67</sup> ），以及治疗人类、猫、马和狗的蛇咬伤及其伴随的肿胀。 <sup data-ref="65">65</sup> <sup data-ref="66">66</sup> <sup data-ref="67">67</sup> <sup data-ref="68">68</sup> <sup data-ref="69">69</sup> <sup data-ref="70">70</sup> 同样，在两匹被非洲蜜蜂围攻的马身上，作为联合治疗方案的一部分，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在五小时内成功逆转了蜂毒引起的严重神经功能障碍。

content.en: •In mice and rats, oxidative stress and neurotoxicity (e.g., in the hippocampus) from a variety of agents has been counteracted by DMSO in combination with another therapeutic agent: ethanol (nimodipine, DAPT or MSM),<sup data-ref="71">71</sup>, <sup data-ref="72">72</sup>, <sup data-ref="73">73</sup> methamphetamine ([curcumin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33819551/) <sup>⬖</sup>) mold aflatoxin (in combination with extracts of Chelidonium majus <sup>⬖</sup> or artichokes <sup>⬖</sup>),<sup data-ref="74">74</sup>, <sup data-ref="75">75</sup> liquid petroleum gas poisoning (a p38MAPK [inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2012&filename=ZFSJ201203020&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=rlGSk1PkvcLzFcBr_yxOYN0c_xXIxrw7dokO3KlbMjvki1bTdgqXtQ07DEzcKobw)), diethyl phthalate and bisphenol S ([vanillic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39415675/) <sup>⬖</sup>), thrombin ([estrogen](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2023&filename=XZYX201506004&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=vy13_Kw_y2jEvFU--iUIqBhQscd0Ar9wJ25-avvl-ezFNkUEmyuJM-3bxZ28qVwr)), trimethyltin ([carvacrol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39066592/) <sup>⬖</sup>), tunicamycin ([4-PBA](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2019&filename=ZBLS201812019&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=rdBahBQiDCfIUQ_Trj_kc0gdIA31VouCNbAydtd-63W3b3jW6yfsg079rGzOfTBR)) chlorpyrifos ([niosomal hesperidin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38225079/) <sup>⬖</sup> or [taxifolin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201702&filename=1017173309.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=cyROd-zibM-coSPdGUoU734JSnx_t15Quq3VW-V__L49ekVjIcxJVDODO46SXNqd) <sup>⬖</sup>) fipronil ([malvidin hydrochloride](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40888371/) <sup>⬖</sup>), thapsigargin ([Activin A](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2017&filename=1017152168.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=qnRNFHgn41FDRQU1AC0AmQXFHQccUGg790wcnqgMCC9O-_oiknbLFHmxNubzBAzB)). Likewise, [melatonin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34658357/) <sup>⬖</sup> mitigated PBDE-47 (fire retardant) neurotoxicity in PC12 cells.
content.cn: •在小鼠和大鼠身上，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与另一种治疗药物——乙醇（尼莫地平、DAPT 或 MSM）联合使用，可抵消多种致病因子引起的氧化应激和神经毒性（例如在海马体中）， <sup data-ref="74">74</sup> <sup data-ref="75">75</sup> <sup data-ref="73">73</sup> 甲基苯丙胺（姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> ）、霉菌黄曲霉毒素（与大蓟 <sup>⬖</sup> 或洋蓟 <sup>⬖</sup> 提取物联合使用）， <sup data-ref="74">74</sup> <sup data-ref="75">75</sup> 液化石油气中毒（一种 p38MAPK 抑制剂）、邻苯二甲酸二乙酯和双酚 S（香草酸 <sup>⬖</sup> ）、凝血酶（雌激素）、三甲基锡（百里香酚 <sup>⬖</sup> ）、 筒菌素（4-PBA）、氯吡里磷（尼奥索体橙皮苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 或紫杉醇 <sup>⬖</sup> ）、卡利库林A（褪黑素 <sup>⬖</sup> ）、氟虫腈（盐酸紫红素 <sup>⬖</sup> ）、塔普西加林 （活化素A）。同样，褪黑素 <sup>⬖</sup> 减轻了PBDE-47（阻燃剂）对PC12细胞的神经毒性。

content.en: *Note: high-dose ivermectin causes neurotoxicity, limiting its use at higher doses. [In one reported case](https://europepmc.org/article/med/2370228), IV DMSO facilitated a full neurologic recovery in a comatose dog that had ingested a toxic dose of ivermectin paste.
content.cn: 注：大剂量的伊维菌素会引起神经毒性，因此限制了其大剂量的使用。据报道，在一例病例中，对误食了毒性剂量伊维菌素软膏而陷入昏迷的犬只，通过静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使其神经功能完全恢复。*

content.en: Likewise DMSO also protects cells from a variety of harmful non-chemical stressors by:
content.cn: 同样，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能通过以下方式保护细胞免受各种有害的非化学应激因子的影响：

content.en: •Protecting cells (including in a prophylactic manner) from being damaged by (often otherwise fatal) radiation exposures.<sup data-ref="76">76</sup>, <sup data-ref="77">77</sup>, <sup data-ref="78">78</sup>, <sup data-ref="79">79</sup>, <sup data-ref="80">80</sup> For example, [DMSO prevented](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21116101/) X-ray and gamma ray DNA damage to hamster ovary cells, fruit flies and cerebral organoids (e.g., by accelerating DNA repair),<sup data-ref="81">81</sup>, <sup data-ref="82">82</sup>, <sup data-ref="83">83</sup>, <sup data-ref="84">84</sup> and [to preven](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18979315/) t the harmful (bystander) signals irradiated cells emit in their vicinity [from damaging non-radiated cells](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9748497/) along with protecting certain bacteria from x-ray exposure.<sup data-ref="85">85</sup>, <sup data-ref="78">78</sup>, <sup data-ref="86">86</sup> Likewise, DMSO has been repeatedly shown to reduce chromosome damage from radiation <sup data-ref="87">87</sup>, <sup data-ref="88">88</sup> and prevent radiation [from creating harmful free radicals](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9748497/). As such, DMSO has been shown to protect animals (e.g., mice, rabbits, dogs and monkeys) from often otherwise lethal doses of radiation, and prevent radiation tissue damage (e.g., to the bone marrow, intestinal lining, stem cells, eyes or skin),<sup data-ref="89">89</sup>, <sup data-ref="90">90</sup>, <sup data-ref="90">90</sup>, <sup data-ref="90">90</sup>, <sup data-ref="91">91</sup>, <sup data-ref="92">92</sup>, <sup data-ref="93">93</sup> and, due to it preventing radiation damage in non-cancerous cells, DMSO has been [extensively used as complementary cancer treatment](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms).
content.cn: •保护细胞（包括作为预防措施）免受（通常会致命的）辐射暴露造成的损伤。 <sup data-ref="89">89</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="91">91</sup> 例如，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可防止X射线和γ射线对仓鼠卵巢细胞、果蝇及脑类器官造成DNA损伤（例如通过加速DNA修复）， <sup data-ref="89">89</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> 并能阻止受辐射细胞在其周围释放的有害（旁观者）信号对未受辐射细胞造成损害，同时还能保护某些细菌免受X射线照射。 <sup data-ref="89">89</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> 同样，已有大量研究表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能减轻辐射引起的染色体损伤 <sup data-ref="89">89</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> ，并防止辐射产生有害的自由基。 因此，研究表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够保护动物（例如小鼠、兔子、狗和猴子）免受通常会致命的辐射剂量的伤害，并防止辐射对组织（例如骨髓、肠道内壁、干细胞、眼睛或皮肤）造成损伤， <sup data-ref="89">89</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="90">90</sup> <sup data-ref="91">91</sup> <sup data-ref="92">92</sup> <sup data-ref="93">93</sup> 并且，由于它能防止非癌细胞受到辐射损伤，二甲基亚砜已被广泛用作癌症的辅助治疗手段。

content.en: *Note: DMSO has been combined with many other substances to protect animals from radiation damage such as [astragaloside-IV](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201902&filename=1019874319.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=MYt6_9wpx0TZi1rMWbWQ9RQMnCmYU6rX_-LJgN0MyMATAYWO_rYOdxVbEHi8Scbs)* <sup>⬖</sup> *(preventing neuronal senescence), rapamycin (repeatedly preventing X-ray induced malformations of cortical development in rat offspring) <sup data-ref="94">94</sup>, <sup data-ref="95">95</sup> thymoquinone* <sup>⬖</sup> *([reducing brain peroxynitrite](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0944711313004327)) or a [glycogen synthase kinase-3β inhibitor](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24969790/) (preventing brain tissue necrosis).*
content.cn: 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已与许多其他物质联合使用，以保护动物免受辐射损伤，例如黄芪苷IV <sup>⬖</sup> （可预防神经元衰老）、雷帕霉素（多次被证实可预防X射线诱导的大鼠后代皮质发育畸形） <sup data-ref="94">94</sup> <sup data-ref="95">95</sup> 胸腺呋喃酮 <sup>⬖</sup> （降低脑内过氧化亚硝酸盐水平）或糖原合酶激酶-3β抑制剂（预防脑组织坏死）。

content.en: • [Preserving the function of nerve fibers](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C44&q=PROTECTIVE+EFFECT+OF+0.1+MM+DMSO+ON+BIOELECTRICAL+ACTIVITY+OF+A+GROUP+NERVE-FIBERS+UNDER+INFLUENCE+OF+UV-RADIATION&btnG=) exposed to UV radiation.
content.cn: • 维持暴露于紫外线辐射下的神经纤维的功能。

content.en: •Treating a wide variety of burns (detailed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-revolutionizes-skin-care-and)) and [protecting the brain from heat damage](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19644196/) (along with the previously mentioned cold injuries).
content.cn: •治疗各种烧伤（详见此处），并保护大脑免受热损伤（以及前文提到的冻伤）。

content.en: • [Protecting cells from osmotic stress and dehydration](https://www.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2014&filename=GDNY201406014&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=rZ6DpLSZYBfEH5c8X07bklkSKX_yE8yNblqMAmD7IXkg1cKcQ9uR00QWn7w0hzAo) (and [in combination with nimodipine](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6272420//), protect neural cells from osmotic shock while inducing neurite growth).
content.cn: • 保护细胞免受渗透应激和脱水的影响（并与尼莫地平联合使用时，既能保护神经细胞免受渗透性休克的影响，又能促进神经突生长）。

content.en: • [Protecting glial cells](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1055553/) from being destroyed by sonic disruption via an ultrasonic vibrator (78% vs. 13% survival), and [in conjunction with a TRPV4 antagonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1015961591.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=gHhcphGUevgZ7k1sVPR_0qzjqObzKzJHcYP6jGXfJXJhMSWXN9bcAvQ_RcJAsjo6), protect hippocampal neurons and microglia from infrasound-induced (16Hz/130dB) apoptosis.
content.cn: • 通过超声振动器防止胶质细胞因超声破坏而受损（存活率分别为78%和13%），并结合TRPV4拮抗剂，保护海马神经元和小胶质细胞免受次声（16Hz/130dB）诱导的凋亡。

content.en: • [Preventing the dramatic increase](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25754967/) in germ cell death, lifespan shortening, and oxidative stress caused by strong static magnetic fields and likewise [preventing similar harm](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20083204305) from continual exposure to electrically generated air ions.
content.cn: • 防止强静磁场导致的生殖细胞死亡急剧增加、寿命缩短及氧化应激，并同样防止因持续暴露于电产生的空气离子而造成的类似伤害。

content.en: • [In combination with curcumin](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/15368378.2024.2315214),<sup>⬖</sup> protect fetal brain, kidney, and liver from damage caused by low-frequency electromagnetic field (EMF) exposure during pregnancy.
content.cn: • 与姜黄素联合使用， <sup>⬖</sup> 可保护胎儿的大脑、肾脏和肝脏免受孕期低频电磁场（EMF）暴露造成的损害。

content.en: DMSO Safety
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的安全性

content.en: Every substance has an effective dose (how much elicits a therapeutic effect) and a toxic dose (how much elicits a harmful effect) with the balance between these two often deciding the value of a therapy (e.g., mercury partially treated syphilis but for centuries caused far more harm than good due to its severe neurotoxicity, and while often effective, certain modern therapies such as chemotherapy cause a lot of issues due to their toxic doses being so close to the therapeutic doses they are routinely prescribed for). Further complicating this, there is often no “correct” dose for everyone, so standardized ones are chosen which work for the majority of the population (which leads to sensitive patients those doses are too high for being routinely injured and then gaslighted by the medical system).
content.cn: 每种物质都有一个有效剂量（能产生治疗效果的剂量）和一个毒性剂量（会产生有害影响的剂量），这两者之间的平衡往往决定了某种疗法的价值（例如，汞虽然能部分治疗梅毒，但由于其严重的神经毒性，几个世纪以来造成的危害远大于益处；而尽管某些现代疗法（如化疗）通常有效， 某些现代疗法（如化疗）却因其毒性剂量与常规处方的治疗剂量过于接近，而引发诸多问题）。更复杂的是，往往并不存在适用于所有人的“正确”剂量，因此通常会选择对大多数人群有效的标准化剂量（这导致对药物敏感的患者因剂量过高而经常受到伤害，随后又被医疗体系“精神操控”）。

content.en: For this reason, I try to utilize therapies with a very wide therapeutic window (meaning the effective dose is much lower than the toxic one), but even in those cases, I still sometimes encounter patients who react to these “safe” doses and need much lower ones.
content.cn: 正因如此，我尽量选用治疗窗非常宽的疗法（即有效剂量远低于毒性剂量），但即便如此，我有时仍会遇到对这些“安全”剂量产生反应的患者，他们需要更低的剂量。

content.en: In the case of DMSO, what has been striking to me is how wide its therapeutic window is (demonstrated by the fact it has an extremely high, [“practically non-toxic” LD50](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety) and that rather than harm cells, it will protect them from a wide range of otherwise lethal stressors). Given this and how rapidly DMSO distributes and dilutes in the body, outside of animal experiments [where large amounts of DMSO are injected](https://selcukmedj.org/the-evaluation-of-the-metabolic-toxicity-dimethylsulfoxide-at-different-organ-level-en-6578/), it is extremely unlikely DMSO can reach a toxic dose (so even in [a human safety study where extreme doses were used for a prolonged period,](https://web.archive.org/web/20220813175742/http://chiropracticcorona.net/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/The-Human-Toxicology-Of-Dimethyl-Sulfoxide.pdf) no issues occurred).
content.cn: 就二甲基亚砜（DMSO）而言，令我印象深刻的是其治疗窗口之宽（这体现在其半数致死量（LD50）极高，几乎“无毒”，而且它不仅不会损害细胞，反而能保护细胞免受各种原本会致命的应激因素的伤害）。 鉴于此，加之二甲基亚砜在体内分布和稀释的速度极快，除动物实验中注射大量二甲基亚砜的情况外，二甲基亚砜达到毒性剂量的可能性极低（因此，即使在人类安全性研究中，长期使用极高剂量，也未出现任何问题）。

content.en: That said, with (clean) DMSO, the following issues do exist:
content.cn: 话虽如此，使用（纯净的）二甲基亚砜（DMSO）时，确实存在以下问题：

content.en: 1. Excessive DMSO commonly creates temporary itching and irritation on the skin. This can be avoided by using lower topical concentrations or [a natural agent](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-mixtures-transform-natural-medicine) which prevents DMSO’s irritation—but nonetheless still routinely happens due to users using excessive doses.
content.cn: 过量的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通常会导致皮肤出现暂时性的瘙痒和刺激。通过使用较低浓度的外用制剂，或采用能防止DMSO引起刺激的天然成分，可以避免这种情况——但尽管如此，由于使用者剂量过大，这种情况仍时有发生。

content.en: 2. In some individuals, DMSO will create an unpleasant odor (which [often can be addressed through one of the methods detailed](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-does-dmso-make-some-people-smell) **[here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-does-dmso-make-some-people-smell)**).
content.cn: 对于某些人来说，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会产生难闻的气味（通常可通过本文中详细介绍的方法之一加以解决）。

content.en: 3. A small number of people (one estimate pegged it at 1 in 2000) are allergic to DMSO. For this reason, it is advised to use topical DMSO first, ascertain if you are having an allergic reaction (rather than a typical skin irritation) and if so, back off, and absolutely avoid systemic applications (e.g., oral).
content.cn: 极少数人（据一项估计，比例约为2000分之1）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）过敏。因此，建议先使用外用DMSO，以确认是否出现过敏反应（而非典型的皮肤刺激）；若出现过敏反应，应立即停止使用，并绝对避免全身性给药（例如口服）。

content.en: 4. DMSO can bring toxic substances into the body, and in the early days of DMSO, [there were rare reports](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C26&q=Dimethyl+sulfoxide+%28DMSO%29--a+unique+therapeutic+entity&btnG=) of people becoming ill for a few days after having both DMSO and (now banned) pesticides contact their skin (along with [one person who had a nicotine overdose](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C33&q=Rapid+development+of+severe+nicotine+toxicity+following+dermal+exposure+to+a+nicotine%2FDMSO+solution&btnG=)). For this reason, it is generally advised to always wash your skin (with water) after applying DMSO (that has had time to dry), and in modern times, I have not come across reports of this being an issue.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可能会将有毒物质带入体内，在DMSO应用的早期，曾有极少数报告称，当DMSO与（现已禁用的）农药同时接触皮肤后，有人会出现持续数天的不适症状（此外还有一人因尼古丁过量而发病）。 因此，通常建议在使用DMSO（待其充分干燥后）后务必用清水清洗皮肤；而在现代，我尚未见到有关此问题的报道。

content.en: 5. DMSO will effectively transport allergens into the skin (leading to it being periodically used to patch test allergens). As some people are allergic to seemingly safe natural substances, this can occasionally cause issues (e.g., in the one report I received, hives followed a DMSO arnica preparation—as a surprising number of people are allergic to arnica).
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能有效将过敏原输送至皮肤（因此它常被用于过敏原斑贴试验）。由于有些人会对看似安全的天然物质过敏，这偶尔会引发问题（例如，在我收到的一份报告中，使用二甲基亚砜制备的 Arnica 制剂后出现了荨麻疹——因为对 Arnica 过敏的人数出乎意料地多）。

content.en: 6. All anti-coagulants carry the risk of excessive bleeding. Since DMSO uses a different method of anti-coagulation, this risk is much smaller, but still possible (e.g., three readers shared it seemed like their nosebleeds increased, and I’ve found [one serious reaction in a case report](https://casereports.bmj.com/content/14/2/e240371.abstract)).
content.cn: 所有抗凝剂都存在出血过多的风险。由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）采用的抗凝机制不同，这种风险要小得多，但仍然可能发生（例如，有三位读者反映他们似乎鼻出血的次数增加了，而且我在一份病例报告中发现了一例严重的不良反应）。

content.en: 7. One of DMSO’s greatest uses is it potentiating medications, but this also means it can increase their toxicity (even though, as the previous section shows, DMSO frequently counteracts toxicity). This has primarily been observed with alcohol, barbiturates, and to a lesser extent benzodiazepines (e.g., [one cat study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/684752/) found adding diazepam to harmless IV DMSO caused fatal hypotension and ventricular fibrillation) but modern reports also exist of it increasing the frequency of side effects from more toxic medications (e.g., chemotherapy and fluoroquinolones). A major question is if this is also an issue with anticoagulants, as limited data and a lack of adverse reports suggest it is not, but simultaneously, due to the theoretical risk, we always advise patients to carefully monitor their blood coagulation (which is typically done for anticoagulant regimens). For all of these reasons, it is typically advised to take DMSO at least two hours away from pharmaceutical medications as this minimizes the potential for adverse potentiation.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）最重要的用途之一是增强药物的疗效，但这也意味着它可能会增加药物的毒性（尽管如前一节所示，DMSO通常能抵消毒性）。 这一现象主要见于酒精、巴比妥类药物，以及在较小程度上见于苯二氮䓬类药物（例如，一项猫类研究发现，将地西泮添加到无害的静脉注射二甲基亚砜中会导致致命性低血压和室性心动过速），但也有现代报告指出，它会增加毒性更强的药物（例如化疗药物和氟喹诺酮类药物）的副作用发生频率。 一个主要问题是，抗凝剂是否也存在这一风险。虽然有限的数据和缺乏不良反应报告表明情况并非如此，但同时，鉴于理论上的风险，我们始终建议患者密切监测其血液凝固情况（这通常是抗凝治疗方案中的常规操作）。基于所有这些原因，通常建议在服用药物后至少间隔两小时再服用二甲基亚砜，以最大限度地降低潜在的不良协同作用。

content.en: *Note: the issues with DMSO and alcohol are discussed in more detail [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/therapeutic-dmso-combinations-revolutionize).
content.cn: 注：关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和酒精的问题，此处有更详细的讨论。*

content.en: 8. In sensitive patients, temporary reactions to DMSO (e.g., headaches) can occur with excessive doses. I have also received two reports of extraordinarily sensitive patients (due to longstanding toxicity burdens) who became worse after DMSO due to it mobilizing stored toxins.
content.cn: 对于敏感患者，过量使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可能会引发暂时性反应（例如头痛）。我还收到过两份报告，涉及两名因长期积累的毒性负担而极其敏感的患者，他们在使用二甲基亚砜后病情恶化，原因是该药物调动了体内积存的毒素。

content.en: 9. Over weeks, inhaling high doses of DMSO [was found to harm rabbits](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/5340064/), so for this reason, DMSO researchers ([except for one successful ARDS study](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-heals-the-lungs-and-cures-chronic-35a)) avoided studying nebulized DMSO. Modern DMSO users, however, made the logical extrapolation to start nebulizing DMSO, and found significant benefit from it (e.g., [remarkable results with COPD](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-heals-the-lungs-and-cures-chronic-35a)). Those who investigated this concluded a theoretical risk (they’d never observed) existed of nebulized DMSO neutralizing surfactant and collapsing the lung, so they cautioned against higher doses (which will also leach plastic from most nebulizers). Presently, one person (patient of a colleague) has had this happen to them (who due to their body type was already at high risk of a pneumothorax), but outside of that, a lot of people have successfully nebulized DMSO at much higher doses than we’d use without issue.
content.cn: 研究发现，数周内吸入高剂量的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会对兔子造成伤害，因此，DMSO研究人员（除一项成功的急性呼吸窘迫综合征\[ARDS\]研究外）避免研究雾化DMSO。 然而，现代二甲基亚砜使用者通过合乎逻辑的推断开始使用雾化二甲基亚砜，并从中获得了显著益处（例如，在慢性阻塞性肺病治疗中取得了显著成效）。对此进行研究的人士得出结论：理论上存在一种风险（尽管他们从未观察到过），即雾化二甲基亚砜可能中和肺表面活性物质并导致肺萎陷，因此他们警告不要使用过高剂量（过高剂量还会导致大多数雾化器中的塑料被浸出）。 目前，仅有一人（一位同事的患者）曾发生过这种情况（该患者因体质原因原本就面临较高的气胸风险），但除此之外，许多人在使用远高于我们通常剂量的DMSO进行雾化治疗时，均未出现任何问题。

content.en: 10. Similar concerns also existed with pregnancy as after injecting high doses of DMSO into or near fetuses was seen to cause developmental damage, very little research was conducted in this area (despite those doses being impossible to reach with standard DMSO uses). Fortunately, large numbers of pregnant and breast feeding parents having used DMSO without issue.
content.cn: 关于怀孕方面也存在类似的担忧，因为有研究发现，向胎儿体内或其附近注射高剂量的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会导致发育损伤，但该领域的研究却寥寥无几（尽管在标准二甲基亚砜使用情况下，根本无法达到如此高的剂量）。幸运的是，大量怀孕和哺乳期的父母在使用二甲基亚砜后均未出现任何问题。

content.en: *Note: in a future article I will compile all the research which has been done. Presently, the most definitive (but still not definitive) study showing DMSO safety in pregnant mothers is [this one](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/14534371/).
content.cn: 注：在今后的文章中，我将汇总所有已开展的研究。目前，最具有说服力（但仍非最终定论）的、证明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对孕妇安全的研究是这一项。*

content.en: 11. When cells are exposed to high concentrations of DMSO for prolonged periods (which are impossible to reach in the body), cellular and microcellular injury will occur. Of note, the toxic DMSO thresholds for cancer cells are much lower than normal cells, which is likely one reason why [DMSO is an excellent tool for cancer](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/hundreds-of-studies-show-dmso-transforms).
content.cn: 当细胞长期暴露于高浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中时（这种浓度在体内根本无法达到），就会发生细胞和微细胞损伤。值得注意的是，二甲基亚砜对癌细胞的毒性阈值远低于正常细胞，这很可能是二甲基亚砜成为抗癌良药的原因之一。

content.en: Because of the previous, virtually every study I’ve read which utilized DMSO did not report adverse effects from DMSO, serious adverse reports from DMSO are extraordinarily rare, and in almost all instances, those resulted from IV DMSO which was given in conjunction with an embolization agent or stem cells (whereas the much rarer ones from IV DMSO alone typically reversed once the infusion stopped <sup data-ref="96">96</sup>,<sup data-ref="97">97</sup>). As some of these were quite concerning, and did not match what we’d ever seen from IV DMSO ([such as in this comprehensive safety study in monkeys](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/15287398109529957) or what I’d seen reported by countless practitioners using IV DMSO), I spent a while looking into this and concluded:
content.cn: 鉴于上述情况，我阅读过的几乎所有使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的研究均未报告DMSO引起的不良反应；关于DMSO的严重不良反应报告极为罕见，且在几乎所有情况下，这些不良反应均源于静脉注射DMSO时与栓塞剂或干细胞联合使用（而仅使用静脉注射DMSO所致的不良反应更为罕见，且通常在停止输注后即可逆转 <sup data-ref="96">96</sup> ， <sup data-ref="97">97</sup> ）。由于其中部分案例令人相当担忧，且与我们以往观察到的静脉注射DMSO情况不符（例如这项针对猴子的全面安全性研究，或是无数使用静脉注射DMSO的临床医生所报告的情况），我花了一段时间对此进行调查，并得出以下结论：

content.en: •The liquid embolic agents have independent toxicity and may sometimes travel and accidentally obstruct other parts of the circulation (as many of the reports seem to indicate this had happened, and once I checked, product warning labels acknowledged this).
content.cn: •液体栓塞剂本身具有毒性，有时可能会随血液流动，意外阻塞循环系统的其他部位（许多报告似乎都表明曾发生过这种情况，而且经我核实后发现，产品警示标签上也承认了这一点）。

content.en: •Many of the patients who receive IV DMSO stem cells are extremely fragile cancer patients (who went through high dose chemo), and hence are more likely to react to therapies, especially a higher doses. Likewise, [one study found](https://ru.dgb.unam.mx/items/87bb700e-4bf4-450c-b3fb-b67e60661d19) while dogs generally did not have issues with DMSO, those with chronic kidney disease did from higher IV doses.
content.cn: •许多接受二甲基亚砜（DMSO）静脉注射干细胞治疗的患者都是身体极度虚弱的癌症患者（曾接受过大剂量化疗），因此更容易对治疗产生反应，尤其是大剂量治疗。同样，一项研究发现，虽然狗通常不会对二甲基亚砜产生不良反应，但患有慢性肾病的狗在接受大剂量静脉注射后会出现不良反应。

content.en: •Due to DMSO’s safety, very high IV doses are used. These are often sufficient to create an osmotic shock which will rupture the weakest membranes (e.g., hemolysis is a common complication of higher IV DMSO doses, and [in this horse study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0737080606814486?via%3Dihub), was seen alongside significant—but temporary—symptoms when 40% DMSO at ten times the normal dose was rapidly infused into horses).
content.cn: •由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的安全性，常采用极高的静脉注射剂量。这些剂量通常足以引发渗透性休克，从而导致最脆弱的细胞膜破裂（例如，溶血是高剂量静脉注射DMSO的常见并发症；在这项针对马的研究中，当向马快速输注剂量为正常剂量10倍的40%二甲基亚砜溶液时，除出现显著但暂时的症状外，还观察到了溶血现象）。

content.en: •The concentrations used for the previous applications are sufficient to leach phthalates from IV tubing. Phalates in turn can cause heart arrhythmias and [one DMSO doctor found](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-forgotten-cancer-cure-hiding) this was an issue with DMSO injected into the bladder until he switched to different tubing.
content.cn: •前几项应用中使用的浓度足以使邻苯二甲酸酯从静脉输液管中析出。邻苯二甲酸酯进而可能导致心律失常；一位使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的医生曾发现，将二甲基亚砜注入膀胱时会出现这一问题，直到他更换了输液管才得以解决。

content.en: •Since DMSO increases parasympathetic activity through cholinesterase inhibition, it can slow the heart rate, particularly if a large amount of it suddenly reaches the heart, so while it [typically does not alter cardiac rhythm](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6576725/) and has been observed [to normalize the reactivity of the autonomic nervous system](https://www.babyblog.ru/user/svetilein/3165985), at high doses it can be arrhythmic (e.g., a 1-3% DMSO slightly increased the heart rate,<sup data-ref="98">98</sup>, <sup data-ref="99">99</sup> while 6-10% significantly decreased it but could be reversed with atropine <sup data-ref="98">98</sup>, <sup data-ref="99">99</sup>).
content.cn: •由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过抑制胆碱酯酶来增强副交感神经活动，因此它会减缓心率，尤其是当大量DMSO突然进入心脏时。虽然它通常不会改变心律，且观察到其能使自主神经系统的反应性恢复正常，但在高剂量下可能会引起心律失常（例如，1-3%的DMSO会轻微增加心率， <sup data-ref="98">98</sup> <sup data-ref="99">99</sup> 而6%-10%的浓度则会显著降低心率，但可通过阿托品逆转 <sup data-ref="98">98</sup> <sup data-ref="99">99</sup> ）。

content.en: •While practitioners (in recent days and throughout the DMSO literature) using much higher IV DMSO doses than we do do not appear to have run into issues, significant care in identifying appropriate IV DMSO dosing is likely warranted.
content.cn: •尽管（近期及所有关于二甲基亚砜的文献中）那些采用远高于我们剂量的静脉注射二甲基亚砜的临床医生似乎并未遇到问题，但在确定合适的静脉注射二甲基亚砜剂量时，仍应格外谨慎。

content.en: Lastly, due to DMSO’s widely recognized safety and negligible toxicity and ability to rapidly transport substances throughout the body, it is often used as an “inert” ingredient to deliver other pharmaceuticals and as a solvent or vehicle to facilitate evaluating the biological effects of large numbers of substances (as without being dissolved or transported, it is often impossible to test them).
content.cn: 最后，由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的安全性广受认可、毒性微乎其微，且能够快速将物质输送到全身各处，因此它常被用作“惰性”成分来输送其他药物，并作为溶剂或载体，以促进对大量物质的生物学效应进行评估（因为如果这些物质无法被溶解或输送，通常就无法对其进行测试）。

content.en: *Note: in addition to testing therapeutic effects, DMSO will also be used to deliver a harmful agent to trigger a disease* <sup data-ref="100">100</sup>, <sup data-ref="101">101</sup>, <sup data-ref="102">102</sup>, <sup data-ref="103">103</sup>, <sup data-ref="104">104</sup>, <sup data-ref="105">105</sup>, <sup data-ref="106">106</sup>, <sup data-ref="107">107</sup>, <sup data-ref="108">108</sup>, <sup data-ref="109">109</sup>, <sup data-ref="110">110</sup>, <sup data-ref="111">111</sup>, <sup data-ref="112">112</sup> *(which makes it very time consuming to filter out therapeutically relevant DMSO studies) or to evaluate a therapy’s mechanism of action by seeing if the specific inhibitor DMSO delivers blocks the therapy’s efficacy (e.g., many Chinese acupuncture studies like this exist* <sup data-ref="111">111</sup>, <sup data-ref="113">113</sup>, <sup data-ref="114">114</sup>, <sup data-ref="115">115</sup>, <sup data-ref="116">116</sup>, <sup data-ref="117">117</sup>, <sup data-ref="118">118</sup>, <sup data-ref="119">119</sup>*).*
content.cn: 注：除了测试治疗效果外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还将被用于输送致病因子以诱发疾病 <sup data-ref="111">111</sup> <sup data-ref="113">113</sup> <sup data-ref="114">114</sup> <sup data-ref="115">115</sup> <sup data-ref="116">116</sup> <sup data-ref="117">117</sup> <sup data-ref="118">118</sup> <sup data-ref="119">119</sup> <sup data-ref="108">108</sup> <sup data-ref="109">109</sup> <sup data-ref="110">110</sup> <sup data-ref="111">111</sup> <sup data-ref="112">112</sup> （这使得筛选出与治疗相关的二甲基亚砜研究非常耗时），或者通过观察二甲基亚砜所递送的特定抑制剂是否会阻断疗法的疗效，从而评估该疗法的作用机制（例如， 此类中国针灸研究比比皆是 <sup data-ref="111">111</sup> <sup data-ref="113">113</sup> <sup data-ref="114">114</sup> <sup data-ref="115">115</sup> <sup data-ref="116">116</sup> <sup data-ref="117">117</sup> <sup data-ref="118">118</sup> <sup data-ref="119">119</sup> ）。

content.en: As similar benefits are seen with many different therapies combined with DMSO (that DMSO alone would cause), this has led me to conclude:
content.cn: 由于许多不同的疗法与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用时，都能观察到类似的疗效（这些疗效仅靠DMSO本身也能产生），这使我得出以下结论：

content.en: •The toxicity of many toxins has been underestimated due to DMSO’s protective effects counteracting them (something also recognized by a few neurology researchers).
content.cn: •由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的保护作用能抵消其毒性，许多毒素的毒性一直被低估（这一点也得到了一些神经学研究人员的认可）。

content.en: •A key reason benefits seen in pre-clinical studies do not appear in clinical ones (an extraordinarily common problem in scientific research) is because DMSO is no longer being used—particularly since I occasionally find studies where DMSO alone, rather than simply being the control, is also tested against saline, and in a significant number of those DMSO alone had a therapeutic effect.
content.cn: •临床前研究中观察到的疗效在临床研究中未见显现（这是科学研究中极其常见的问题）的一个关键原因在于，研究中不再使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）——尤其是因为我偶尔会发现一些研究，其中二甲基亚砜不仅作为对照组，还单独与生理盐水进行了对比试验，而在相当一部分此类研究中，单独使用二甲基亚砜也显示出了治疗效果。

content.en: Lastly, in writing this article, I have tried to condense thousands of pertinent studies into something feasible for everyone to read, while also ensuring that this forgotten literature remains available to researchers and authors wishing to advance this work. In that, I made the decision to include the combination studies, both because they illustrate the common benefits DMSO provides with these agents across a vast swath of neurological conditions and because combination can often enhance the efficacy of DMSO (detailed extensively [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-mixtures-transform-natural-medicine)), hence providing additional ideas for individuals struggling with the neurodegenerative diseases covered here. As such, anytime an agent with a therapeutic effect is mentioned in this article **assume that it was combined with DMSO**. Additionally, if that agent was a natural therapy (e.g., herb, nutraceutical or botanical extract), to help you, as mentioned before, I have marked it with a <sup>⬖</sup>.
content.cn: 最后，在撰写本文时，我试图将数千项相关研究浓缩成一篇人人都能读懂的文章，同时确保这些被遗忘的文献仍可供希望推进该领域研究的研究人员和作者查阅。 基于此，我决定将联合用药研究纳入其中，一方面是因为这些研究展示了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与这些药物在广泛的神经系统疾病中产生的协同益处；另一方面，联合用药往往能增强DMSO的疗效（详见此处），从而为饱受本文所述神经退行性疾病困扰的患者提供更多思路。因此，凡是本文中提及具有治疗效果的药物，请默认其已与DMSO联合使用。 此外，如果该药物属于天然疗法（例如草药、营养保健品或植物提取物），为了方便您识别，如前所述，我已用 <sup>⬖</sup> 标记。

content.en: Causes of Disease
content.cn: 疾病的原因

content.en: When trying to understand a disease, two different lenses exist for interpreting it. One, the (favored) reductionist perspective tries to break it down to its tiniest parts, and through understanding them understand the disease. The other, the holistic one, sees the specific disease as a gear in a much larger system, and tries to see what systemic process is giving rise to the issues at hand.
content.cn: 在试图理解一种疾病时，存在两种不同的解读视角。其一，即（更受青睐的）还原论视角，试图将疾病分解为最微小的组成部分，并通过理解这些组成部分来理解疾病本身。其二，即整体论视角，将特定疾病视为一个更大系统中的一个齿轮，并试图探究是何种系统性过程导致了当前的问题。

content.en: Since Descartes’ seminal work on reasoning in 1637 (~400 years ago), our culture has embraced the reductionist model and through it, created countless scientific innovations which have transformed society, such as numerous medical innovations that identified the discrete cause of a life-threatening condition and provided a cure so it was no longer fatal.
content.cn: 自笛卡尔于1637年（约400年前）发表那部关于推理的开创性著作以来，我们的文化便采纳了还原论模型，并借此创造了无数改变社会的科学创新，例如众多医学创新——这些创新不仅查明了危及生命的疾病的具体病因，还提供了相应的治疗方法，使这些疾病不再致命。

content.en: Unfortunately, while reductionistic approaches are often excellent for acute life-threatening illnesses, they often only identify the downstream concrete effects of the illness rather than the upstream process which gave rise to the illness (hence making the therapies chosen typically be symptom managing ones rather than curative). Because of this, modern medicine is often characterized as being “excellent for emergencies but terrible for chronic illness.” Likewise, a longstanding joke with neurology is that **neurologists are excellent at diagnosing neurological diseases, but not very good at actually treating them** (although recently there has been some progress on the therapeutic end).
content.cn: 遗憾的是，虽然还原论方法在治疗急性危及生命的疾病时往往效果极佳，但它们通常只能识别出疾病的下游具体表现，而无法追溯导致疾病的上游病理过程（因此所选疗法通常只是症状管理，而非根治）。正因如此，现代医学常被评价为“急症治疗效果极佳，但慢性病治疗效果极差”。 同样，神经学界流传着一个老笑话：神经科医生虽然擅长诊断神经系统疾病，但在实际治疗方面却并不擅长（尽管最近在治疗方面已取得了一些进展）。

content.en: *Note: alternatively, one can argue our biochemistry-focused form of medicine (which tries to identify a specific molecular target for each disease) exists because this allows an almost infinite number of patentable therapies to be made for each illness, whereas were systemic remedies to be utilized that could treat a myriad of illnesses (e.g., [umbrella therapies](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-are-umbrella-therapies-and-why) or ones [based on biophysics](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/regenerative-medicine-and-the-cell-6c5)), it would no longer be possible to have a lucrative business model which patents each disease.
content.cn: 注：另一方面，也可以认为，我们这种以生物化学为中心的医学模式（试图为每种疾病确定一个具体的分子靶点）之所以存在，是因为这使得针对每种疾病都能开发出数量几乎无限的可申请专利的疗法；而如果采用能够治疗多种疾病的系统性疗法（例如“伞式疗法”或基于生物物理学的疗法），那么就无法再维持那种针对每种疾病分别申请专利的盈利性商业模式了。*

content.en: In contrast, I see many illnesses as being a manifestation of an underlying disease process within the body, and in many cases, believe the specific disease that arises is largely a product of where that disease process landed in the individual’s body (e.g., it was very common that COVID-19 vaccine injuries affected a previously weakened or injured area of the body, which is part of why the condition had so many different symptoms).
content.cn: 相比之下，我认为许多疾病是体内潜在病理过程的一种表现，而且在许多情况下，我认为出现的具体疾病在很大程度上取决于该病理过程在个体体内具体作用于何处（例如，新冠疫苗不良反应通常会影响身体中原本就虚弱或受损的部位，这也是该病症会出现如此多种不同症状的原因之一）。

content.en: Unfortunately, while this perspective is often necessary to solve an illness, it is diametrically opposed not only to how our society teaches us to think, but also the human ego, as reductionist frameworks offer the comforting illusion of certainty and control, whereas holistic perspectives require us to tolerate ambiguity and unpredictability so we can see beyond the parts and grasp the broader whole—and unfortunately, the human ego will go to great lengths to feel like it is in control.
content.cn: 遗憾的是，尽管这种视角对于治愈疾病往往必不可少，但它不仅与我们社会所倡导的思维方式背道而驰，也与人类的自我意识截然相反——因为还原论框架提供了确定性和可控性的慰藉性幻觉，而整体论视角则要求我们容忍模糊性和不可预测性，从而能够超越局部，把握更广阔的整体；而遗憾的是，人类的自我意识会不惜一切代价来维持那种掌控感。

content.en: The Sequence of Disease
content.cn: 疾病的进程

content.en: Over the years, I have noticed a recurring pattern that characterizes many of the diseases I encounter:
content.cn: 这些年来，我注意到一种反复出现的模式，这是我所遇到的许多疾病的共同特征：

content.en: - Something shocks the system, or a recurring issue eventually affects the body to an extent which exceeds its compensatory capacity.
content.cn: 某种因素对机体造成冲击，或者某个反复出现的问题最终对身体造成的影响超出了其代偿能力。

content.en: - The body (or a part of it) enters a state of shock and partially or fully shuts down.
content.cn: 身体（或其某一部分）进入休克状态，并部分或完全停止运作。

content.en: - The natural healing capacity of the body is unable [to resolve this shutdown](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-do-cells-turning-off-underlie), and the issue becomes chronic.
content.cn: 人体的自然自愈能力无法解决这种功能停滞，从而导致该问题演变为慢性病。

content.en: - The [shutdown](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-do-cells-turning-off-underlie) causes other things in the body connected to it to go haywire and creates additional issues.
content.cn: 这种功能停滞会导致体内与其相关的其他功能紊乱，并引发更多问题。

content.en: Because of this, my approach frequently is to:
content.cn: 正因如此，我通常的做法是：

content.en: - First identify where the actual issue is and the underlying issue that precipitated it.
content.cn: 首先，要确定实际问题所在，以及引发该问题的根本原因。

content.en: - Then treat the underlying issue which caused the problem.
content.cn: 然后解决导致该问题的根本原因。

content.en: - See if that resolves the shutdown, and if not provide a regenerative therapy which wakes the tissue back up (which I discussed extensively in [the cell danger response series](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-do-cells-turning-off-underlie)).
content.cn: 看看这样是否能解决组织功能停滞的问题；如果不行，则提供一种能唤醒组织功能的再生疗法（我在“细胞危险反应”系列中对此进行了详细讨论）。

content.en: - For any problems that remain, treat the underlying issue which predisposed that area to being affected by the systemic process.
content.cn: 对于任何残留的问题，应针对导致该部位易受全身性病理过程影响的根本原因进行治疗。

content.en: - See what issues remain in the other parts of the body which were connected to the core problem and deal with those.
content.cn: 查看身体其他部位是否还存在与核心问题相关的其他问题，并加以处理。

content.en: *Note: in other cases, the situation is much simpler and I just focus on a therapy for where the actual issue is.
content.cn: 注：在其他情况下，情况要简单得多，我只需针对实际问题所在之处进行治疗即可。*

content.en: Because of this framework, I’ve put a lot of thought into what creates the shocks that initially shut the system down (e.g., an infection, prolonged stress, poor sleep, significant injury or tissue compression) and tried to discern why some people’s bodies can quickly shrug off those insults and the damage they create, while in others they become lodged and quickly become permanent.
content.cn: 基于这一框架，我深入思考了导致系统最初瘫痪的各种冲击因素（例如感染、长期压力、睡眠不足、严重损伤或组织受压），并试图弄清楚：为什么有些人的身体能够迅速摆脱这些伤害及其造成的损害，而对另一些人来说，这些伤害却会滞留体内并迅速演变为永久性损伤。

content.en: From this, I’ve gradually come to the perspective that circulation is key, and that once circulation shuts down, areas of the body not only become “shocked,” but the body loses its inherent ability to reassert a state of health following the shocks it encounters. As such, I see many diseases and disease processes (e.g., inflammation) not as independent entities, but rather as consequences of poor circulation (and likewise recognize that the underlying reason why many different disease processes create similar symptoms is because they all impair circulation).
content.cn: 由此，我逐渐形成了一种观点：循环是关键，一旦循环停止，身体的某些部位不仅会陷入“休克”状态，而且身体还会丧失在遭遇休克后重新恢复健康状态的固有能力。 因此，我将许多疾病和病理过程（例如炎症）视为血液循环不良的后果，而非独立存在的实体（同样地，我也认识到，许多不同的病理过程会产生相似症状的根本原因，在于它们都会损害血液循环）。

content.en: *Note: within many schools of natural healing, nutritional deficiencies are identified as a root cause of illness to be treated with sufficient supplementation. My own experience (mirrored in some studies) has been that those illnesses often also resolve when circulation is restored to the affected area. Put differently, while raising the nutrient levels in the blood that reaches the area could solve the issue, those nutrients could also be obtained in sufficient amounts by increasing the amount of blood which reaches the area.
content.cn: 注：在许多自然疗法学派中，营养缺乏被视为疾病的根本原因，需通过充分补充营养来治疗。根据我个人的经验（某些研究也印证了这一点），当受影响部位的血液循环恢复正常时，这些疾病往往也会随之痊愈。换言之，虽然提高流向该部位的血液中的营养水平可以解决问题，但通过增加流向该部位的血流量，同样可以获得足量的营养。*

content.en: My focus on circulation in part results from how often I see it quickly produce dramatic effects for patients, in part because of how often I now identify pertinent circulatory obstructions, and because the individuals who pioneered this perspective provided one of the most illuminating models of disease I’d come across. Briefly:
content.cn: 我之所以关注循环系统，一方面是因为我经常看到它能迅速为患者带来显著效果，另一方面是因为我现在经常能发现相关的循环阻塞，此外，正是那些开创这一视角的先驱们，为我提供了迄今为止所见过的最具启发性的疾病模型之一。简而言之：

content.en: •Building on work that came before him, in the 1940s to 1960s, Melvin Knisely elucidated that “blood sludging” (blood cells clumping together) underlay many illnesses, particularly hospitalizing ones as this generally reduced blood flow and eliminated microcirculation in vessels the clumped blood cells were too large to fit through. Key discoveries included burns, blood infections like malaria and cancer causing significant blood sludging (which then systemically affected the body) a few therapies (e.g., low molecular weight dextran and hydroxychloroquine) alleviating sludging, and by using a microscope to view vessels in the eye, it was possible to non-invasively assess how “sludged” the blood throughout the body was (whereas while sludging could be assessed in blood taken out of the body with live blood cell analysis or the ESR rate, it was not as accurate because the clumping behavior of blood always changed once it left the body).
content.cn: •在继承前人研究成果的基础上，梅尔文·克尼塞利（Melvin Knisely）于20世纪40年代至60年代阐明，“血液淤积”（即血细胞凝集）是许多疾病（尤其是需要住院治疗的疾病）的根本原因，因为这通常会减少血流，并导致血管中的微循环中断——由于凝集的血细胞体积过大，无法通过这些血管。 关键发现包括：烧伤、疟疾等血液感染以及癌症会引起显著的血液淤泥化（进而对全身产生影响）；少数疗法（如低分子量右旋糖酐和羟氯喹）可缓解淤泥化；通过显微镜观察眼部血管，可以无创地评估全身血液的“淤泥化”程度 （虽然可以通过活血细胞分析或红细胞沉降率（ESR）来评估体外血液的淤泥化程度，但这种方法并不够准确，因为血液一旦离开体内，其凝集行为就会发生变化）。

content.en: •In Chinese medicine, numerous “disease patterns” exist to explain what is causing a specific illness. One of these, “blood stasis” (which I still need to write an article on) perfectly matches blood sludging, and interestingly, [after the mass adoption of the smallpox vaccine](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-can-the-smallpox-vaccines-teach), blood stasis more and more [came to be seen as the primary cause of most illness](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-can-the-smallpox-vaccines-teach). Notably, many diagnostic signs have been developed by Chinese medicine for blood stasis which have significant value in identifying “blood sludging.”
content.cn: •在中医学中，存在许多“病证”来解释特定疾病的成因。 其中之一便是“瘀血”（关于这一点我尚需另撰文章），它与“血液淤滞”完全吻合；有趣的是，在天花疫苗被广泛采用之后，“瘀血”逐渐被视为大多数疾病的主要病因。值得注意的是，中医针对“瘀血”总结出了许多诊断征象，这些征象在识别“血液淤滞”方面具有重要价值。

content.en: •While Knisely could tell blood sludging was a core cause of illness and that specific things triggered it (e.g., excessive heat or cold), he could not determine why it occurred [and postulated](https://time.com/archive/6823957/medicine-sludged-blood/) it might be due to a sticky coating on the cells (not found in normal blood) that was tentatively identified as a protein.
content.cn: •虽然克尼塞利能够判断血液淤滞是疾病的核心病因，并且某些特定因素会引发这一现象（例如过热或过冷），但他无法确定其发生的原因，并推测这可能是由于细胞表面附着了一层粘性物质（正常血液中不存在）所致，该物质被初步鉴定为一种蛋白质。

content.en: •In the 1960s, Thomas Riddick, an engineer and chemist who regularly worked with colloidal solutions to thicken or thin them (e.g., clays need to be thinned to flow through pipes while sewage needs to be thickened so its waste matter clumps together and settles to the bottom) concluded his heart issues (which at the time were “incurable”) might be due to his blood being “too thick” and tried using the same agents he used to disperse industrial colloids on his body—which worked. This led to him concluding the primary variable he adjusted, zeta potential (the electrical repulsion between colloidal particles which allows them to resist agglomerating forces in a liquid system pushing them together) might underlie many different diseases and was the factor responsible for the blood sludging observed by Knisely. As such, he extensively studied it (e.g., with microscopes aimed at the eyes that filtered the heat from his incandescent bulb so exposed blood would not begin to sludge) and amongst other things concluded aluminum was extremely dangerous because its strong positive charge made it the ion most capable of disrupting zeta potential, that people with poor zeta potential were at high risk of heart attacks, and that bacterial and viral infections would consistently worsen the zeta potential of the body (hence making them most severely afflict the elderly as zeta potential worsens with age).
content.cn: •20世纪60年代，工程师兼化学家托马斯·里迪克经常处理胶体溶液，以调节其浓稠度（例如，粘土需要稀释才能通过管道，而污水则需要增稠，以便废物聚集成团并沉降到底部）。他推断自己当时被认为“无法治愈”的心脏问题，可能是因为血液 “过于粘稠”，于是尝试将他用于分散工业胶体的相同制剂应用于自身——结果奏效了。这使他得出结论：他所调整的主要变量——zeta电位（即胶体颗粒之间的静电排斥力，这种力使它们能够抵抗液体系统中促使颗粒聚合的力）——可能与许多不同疾病有关，并且正是导致克尼塞利所观察到的血液“淤泥化”现象的元凶。 因此，他对此进行了广泛研究（例如，将显微镜对准眼睛，并过滤白炽灯泡散发的热量，以免暴露的血液开始变稠），并得出多项结论：铝极其危险，因为其强烈的正电荷使其成为最能破坏zeta电位的离子；zeta电位较差的人患心脏病发作的风险很高；细菌和病毒感染会持续恶化人体的zeta电位 （因此，由于zeta电位会随年龄增长而恶化，这些感染对老年人的危害最为严重）。

content.en: •A doctor with an incurable heart condition discovered Riddick’s work, and after it fixed his heart issues, discovered that with his patients restoring zeta potential was miraculous for a few other diseases including dementia.
content.cn: •一位患有无法治愈的心脏病的医生发现了里迪克的研究成果，在该疗法治愈了他的心脏问题后，他发现，对于包括痴呆症在内的其他几种疾病，帮助患者恢复泽塔电位也具有奇效。

content.en: •Canadian neurologist Andrew Moulden realized that he frequently saw children develop clinical signs of strokes after vaccination, and that more severe signs correlated to developmental disability following vaccination ([mirroring a century of published case reports](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-forgotten-history-of-neurological) of cranial nerve issues accompanying vaccine encephalitis and those same deficits later being routinely observed in autistic children). Moulden then concluded that vaccines were causing microstrokes throughout the body due to zeta potential-disrupting agents in vaccines (e.g., aluminum) clumping blood cells together and because during an inflammatory response, larger white blood cells will obstruct the microcirculation (all of which was too small to detect with radiologic imaging and is a major reason why diagnostic tests cannot identify many chronic neurological conditions). He also concluded that the characteristic microstrokes he saw resulted from them being in parts of the brain with weaker blood supplies, and they hence served as indicators brain damage was also silently occurring in other parts of the brain being affected by these microstrokes. Finally, like those before him, he highlighted this could be caused by other things like infections, but emphasized it was a far more frequent problem with vaccination.
content.cn: •加拿大神经科医生安德鲁·莫尔登（Andrew Moulden）发现，他经常看到儿童在接种疫苗后出现中风的临床症状，且症状越严重，就越与接种疫苗后的发育障碍相关（这与过去一个世纪发表的病例报告相吻合——这些报告显示，疫苗性脑炎常伴有颅神经问题，而此类功能缺损后来在自闭症儿童中也被常规观察到）。 莫尔登据此得出结论：疫苗中的zeta电位干扰剂（如铝）会使血细胞凝集，同时在炎症反应过程中，较大的白细胞会阻塞微循环，从而导致疫苗在全身引发微小中风（这些病变均过于微小，无法通过放射学成像检测，这也是诊断测试无法识别许多慢性神经系统疾病的主要原因）。 他还指出，他所观察到的这些特征性微中风发生在脑部供血较弱的区域，因此可作为指标，表明受这些微中风影响的脑部其他区域也在悄然发生脑损伤。最后，与此前研究者一样，他强调虽然感染等其他因素也可能导致此类情况，但疫苗接种引发该问题的频率要高得多。

content.en: •Numerous doctors (myself included) independently realized that this process likely affected every fluid in the body as they are all colloids, and that many of the conditions ascribed to blood sludging (e.g., Chinese medicine links blood stasis to autoimmunity) likely resulted from obstructions in other fluids like the lymphatics.
content.cn: •许多医生（包括我在内）独立意识到，这一过程很可能影响了体内的所有体液，因为它们都是胶体；而且，许多被归因于“血液淤滞”的病症（例如，中医将血瘀与自身免疫性疾病联系起来），很可能源于淋巴液等其他体液中的阻塞。

content.en: •In December 2019, based on reports on anonymous message boards online, I became very concerned COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2) would turn into a global catastrophe (in part because of how it behaved, and in part because every authority downplayed it, whereas typically far more minor and relatively inconsequential pandemics would be hyped up to an absurd degree). As such, from the start, I corresponded with everyone I knew treating the disease, and quickly noticed it had some very odd characteristics suggesting significant zeta potential disruptions throughout the body. As colleagues who had treated SARS-CoV-1 did not notice those features of the disease, I hypothesized there was likely a protein on the outside of the virus which carried a very strong charge density not present in SARS-CoV-1, and after teaching myself how to do the analysis, realized the spike protein fit the bill.
content.cn: •2019年12月，根据网上匿名论坛上的报道，我开始非常担心新冠肺炎（SARS-CoV-2）会演变成一场全球性灾难（部分原因在于该病毒的表现特征，部分原因在于各相关机构都对其轻描淡写，而通常情况下，那些远比它轻微且相对无足轻重的疫情却会被炒作成荒谬的程度）。 因此，从一开始，我就与所有我认识的、正在治疗该疾病的同行保持联系，并很快注意到该疾病具有一些非常奇特的特征，这些特征表明全身范围内的泽塔电位发生了显著紊乱。 由于曾治疗过SARS-CoV-1的同事们并未注意到该疾病的这些特征，我推测病毒表面可能存在一种蛋白质，其携带的电荷密度非常强，而SARS-CoV-1中并不具备这种特性；在自学了分析方法后，我意识到刺突蛋白正是符合这一特征的。

content.en: As such, particularly after the vaccine hit the market, my interest in understanding zeta potential greatly increased and a key goal of this newsletter has been to empower people to treat zeta potential (which is essentially done by eliminating strong positive ions and supplementing with strong negative ions) as it transforms so many different areas of medicine and health.
content.cn: 因此，特别是在疫苗上市之后，我对了解ζ电位的兴趣大大增强，而本通讯的一个主要目标，就是帮助人们掌握如何调节ζ电位（这本质上是通过消除强正离子并补充强负离子来实现的），因为它正在改变医学和健康领域的许多不同方面。

content.en: Note: the zeta potential topic (along with supporting references) is discussed in much greater detail [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-vaccine-injuries-reveal-about).
content.cn: 注：关于zeta电位的主题（以及相关参考文献），在此处有更详细的讨论。*

content.en: However, I also must disclose I do not believe zeta potential is the only factor which causes blood sludging; rather I’ve focused on it because it is simply the easiest one to understand and rapidly treat (e.g., I believe there is a great deal we still do not understand how blood and fluids behave in the body—evidenced by things like [forgotten Russian research](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-the-heart-controls-exactly-where) which shows blood travels through the body in spiraling vortexes the heart directs so vascular resistance is reduced and specific types of blood can arrive where they are needed).
content.cn: 不过，我也必须说明，我不认为zeta电位是导致血液淤积的唯一因素； 而是因为它最容易理解且能快速治疗，所以我才将注意力集中在此（例如，我认为关于血液和体液在体内的行为方式，我们仍有许多不了解之处——被遗忘的俄罗斯研究就证明了这一点，该研究表明血液在心脏的引导下以螺旋涡流的形式在体内流动，从而降低血管阻力，并使特定类型的血液能够到达所需部位）。

content.en: DMSO and Neurological Disorders
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜与神经系统疾病

content.en: DMSO has many qualities which allow it to treat a wide variety of diseases including:
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有多种特性，使其能够治疗多种疾病，包括：

content.en: •It increasing circulation.
content.cn: •它能促进血液循环。

content.en: •It accelerating the healing of injured tissue (which I currently believe results from it improving circulation and it stabilizing the gels needed for the initial healing process).
content.cn: •它能加速受损组织的愈合（我目前认为这是因为它能改善血液循环，并稳定初期愈合过程所需的凝胶）。

content.en: •It awakening dormant cells that are trapped in [the cell danger response](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/regenerative-medicine-and-the-cell-6c5).
content.cn: •它能唤醒那些被困在细胞危险应答中的休眠细胞。

content.en: •It being a potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent.
content.cn: •它是一种强效的抗氧化剂和抗炎剂。

content.en: •It increasing parasympathetic tone (due to [it being an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for)) and it sedating dysfunctional neural circuits (allowing them to reset).
content.cn: •它能增强副交感神经张力（因为它是一种乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂），并能抑制功能失调的神经回路（使其得以重置）。

content.en: •It effectively reducing pain (in part [by it blocking pain transmission](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for) and it [relaxing the musculature](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for)).
content.cn: •它能有效缓解疼痛（部分原因是它能阻断疼痛传导并放松肌肉）。

content.en: •It protecting cells and tissue from a wide variety of injurious and lethal stressors.
content.cn: •它能保护细胞和组织免受各种有害和致命应激因素的侵害。

content.en: •It being a potent delivery system for other therapeutic substances that are mixed with it (particularly in topical applications).
content.cn: •它能作为一种高效的给药系统，将其他与之混合的治疗性物质输送至体内（特别是在局部应用中）。

content.en: Of these, I believe the first three (circulatory improvement, tissue regeneration, and resetting the cell danger response—and possibly DMSO’s anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant properties) are particularly important for neurological disorders (which DMSO has long been recognized for treating) as:
content.cn: 其中，我认为前三个作用（改善血液循环、组织再生以及重置细胞危险反应——此外可能还包括二甲基亚砜的抗炎和抗氧化特性）对于神经系统疾病（二甲基亚砜在治疗此类疾病方面早已广受认可）尤为重要，因为：

content.en: •Nervous system tissue has the highest energy demand in the body and is the most sensitive to its blood supply being reduced (e.g., functions of the nervous system will often immediately “turn off” once their blood supply is interrupted).
content.cn: •神经系统组织是人体中能量需求最高的组织，也是对血液供应减少最敏感的组织（例如，一旦血液供应中断，神经系统的功能往往会立即“停止”）。

content.en: •Nervous system tissue is particularly vulnerable to interruptions in blood supply, and once this occurs, will often be stuck in a dormant “ [penumbra](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-could-save-millions-from-brain) ” state like [the cell danger response](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-do-cells-turning-off-underlie) (after which the tissue eventually dies). Furthermore, the brain and spinal cord are among the tissues most resistant to healing and regeneration in the entire body.
content.cn: •神经系统组织对血液供应中断尤为敏感，一旦发生这种情况，往往会陷入类似“细胞危险反应”的休眠“半暗带”状态（随后该组织最终会坏死）。此外，大脑和脊髓是全身中愈合和再生能力最弱的组织之一。

content.en: •Because so much of life depends upon a functioning nervous system, partial losses of function due to either of the previous create immediate noticeable consequences for the individual (whereas partial losses of function in the internal organs may not even be noticed without lab work).
content.cn: •由于生命活动的很大一部分依赖于正常运作的神经系统，因此由上述任一原因导致的功能部分丧失，会立即对个体产生明显的影响（而内脏器官的功能部分丧失，若不进行实验室检查，甚至可能不会被察觉）。

content.en: Given all of this, I ***assumed*** that DMSO had to improve zeta potential, as while it has many proven anti-clotting properties (discussed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-could-save-millions-from-brain)), many of the changes it created were identical to what would result from an improvement of microperfusion via a spacing out of red blood cells.
content.cn: 鉴于以上种种，我推测二甲基亚砜（DMSO）必然能改善ζ电位，因为尽管它具有许多已证实的抗凝血特性（详见此处），但它所引发的许多变化，与通过使红细胞间距增大从而改善微灌注所产生的结果完全一致。

content.en: However, when I reviewed the literature, I discovered DMSO (due to it carrying a neutral charge) does not improve red blood cell zeta potential, and if anything, [slightly worsens it](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/001122408390069X). Likewise, [DMSO is inherently viscous](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0144861799000788) (thick), increases the viscosity of water by structuring it <sup data-ref="120">120</sup>, <sup data-ref="121">121</sup>, <sup data-ref="122">122</sup> (which can be seen when the two mix together).
content.cn: 然而，在查阅文献时，我发现二甲基亚砜（DMSO）（由于其电荷为中性）并不能改善红细胞的ζ电位，甚至可能使其略有恶化。 同样，二甲基亚砜本身具有粘稠性（质地浓稠），会通过重排水分子结构来增加水的粘度 <sup data-ref="120">120</sup> <sup data-ref="121">121</sup> <sup data-ref="122">122</sup> （当二者混合时即可观察到这一现象）。

content.en: *Note: this exothermic structuring is why DMSO will create heat when it mixes with water.
content.cn: 注：正是这种放热反应，导致二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与水混合时会产生热量。*

content.en: However, DMSO formulations have low viscosity,<sup data-ref="123">123</sup>, <sup data-ref="124">124</sup>, <sup data-ref="125">125</sup>, <sup data-ref="126">126</sup>, <sup data-ref="127">127</sup>, <sup data-ref="128">128</sup>, <sup data-ref="129">129</sup> (or [become negatively charged](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/zaryad-chastits-i-yavlenie-elektroforeza-v-dispersnyh-sistemah-na-osnove-nitroproizvodnyh-dihlorbenzofuroksana) when prepared in DMSO), DMSO [decreases the viscosity of bulk hydrophobic ions](https://hrcak.srce.hr/169469) and most importantly, [reduces blood cell aggregation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12027383/) (blood sludging) and [blood viscosity](https://www.cheezhengchem.com/blog/what-are-the-effects-of-pharmaceutical-dmso-on-blood-circulation-2081783.html) which I believe is due to:
content.cn: 然而，DMSO制剂的粘度较低， <sup data-ref="123">123</sup> <sup data-ref="124">124</sup> <sup data-ref="125">125</sup> <sup data-ref="126">126</sup> <sup data-ref="127">127</sup> <sup data-ref="128">128</sup> <sup data-ref="129">129</sup> （或在DMSO中配制时会带负电荷）， DMSO 会降低体相疏水离子的粘度，最重要的是，它能减少血细胞聚集（血液泥化）并降低血液粘度，我认为这主要是由于：

content.en: 1. It behaving as a gel stabilizing (promoting) agent, which thereby forms water barriers between particles preventing them from aggregating (along with it making [biomolecules like urea switch from opposing to supporting gel formation](https://www.mdpi.com/2310-2861/4/4/81)).
content.cn: 它作为一种凝胶稳定剂（促进剂）发挥作用，从而在颗粒之间形成水障，防止颗粒聚集（同时使尿素等生物分子从阻碍凝胶形成转变为促进凝胶形成）。

content.en: 2. DMSO reducing the attractive forces between red blood cells Knisely identified (e.g., by neutralizing aggregating proteins), thereby allowing the existing zeta potential to become able to disperse the blood cells.
content.cn: DMSO 通过（例如中和聚集蛋白）减弱了 Knisely 所发现的红细胞之间的吸引力，从而使现有的ζ电位能够使红细胞分散开来。

content.en: 3. It likewise counteracting the agglomerating factors seen in pathologic states which otherwise cause blood cells to clump together. For example:
content.cn: 它同样能对抗病理状态下出现的促凝集因子，这些因子若不加以抑制，会导致血细胞相互凝集。例如：

content.en: •DMSO (3%), by lowering blood cell viscosity (and increasing molecular mobility) completely prevented [S. aureus](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/izmenenie-adgezii-s-aureus-kak-faktora-vosstanovleniya-regeneratornoy-aktivnosti-pri-zazhivlenii-gnoynyh-ran) from adhering to red blood cells (which if adhered would then cause blood cells to clump together).
content.cn: •DMSO（3%）通过降低血细胞粘度（并提高分子移动性），完全阻止了金黄色葡萄球菌附着于红细胞（若附着，将导致血细胞凝集）。

content.en: • [When DMSO](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015650253.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=R5AdAw99fHu5vkrwQgpa1-mM4hiQKFlZ7ZP-X--PC8lKfMOBI4pWdD4VxmBvebqz) was mixed with LPS (to model sepsis), rather than increase viscosity (which is a key issue in sepsis), blood viscosity decreased, and further decreased once resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> was also added.
content.cn: • 当二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与脂多糖（LPS）混合（以模拟脓毒症）时，血液粘度非但没有增加（这是脓毒症的一个关键问题），反而降低了；而一旦再加入白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> ，血液粘度进一步降低。

content.en: • [In cancer, DMSO](https://europepmc.org/article/med/6192810) prevented the reduction in zeta potential (and mobility) which would otherwise occur in macrophages.
content.cn: • 在癌症模型中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）阻止了巨噬细胞中本会发生的ζ电位（及迁移能力）下降。

content.en: • [Prevented positive ions](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S002197970300242X) from disrupting the zeta potential of negatively charged laponite.
content.cn: • 防止正离子破坏带负电的拉波尼特的zeta电位。

content.en: • [When exposed to radiation](https://www.osti.gov/etdeweb/biblio/10191351) (gamma rays), lens proteins from the eye would aggregate and the viscosity would increase; DMSO prevented this.
content.cn: • 当暴露于辐射（γ射线）时，眼球晶状体中的蛋白质会发生聚集，粘度随之增加；而二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可防止这种情况发生。

content.en: • [To establish a foothold](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0008621507004144?via%3Dihub) in the lungs, bacteria which often colonize cystic fibrosis patients release cepacian, a polysaccharide which forms thick biofilms in the lungs’ (already thick) mucus, making it much harder for cystic fibrosis patients to breathe. DMSO in turn has been shown in laboratory studies to disrupt cepacian aggregates and halve their viscosity (which may partly explain why [one physician shared](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/134517046) their cystic fibrosis patient had life-changing improvements after DMSO).
