Furthermore, [DMSO in combination with ivacaftor](https://www.proquest.com/openview/6ed1e04ef70d8900cda2531f045ebc34/1?pq-origsite=gscholar&cbl=40575) (a key medication used for CF) was found to reduce the viscosity of cigarette smoke-thickened lung mucus.
content.cn: • 为了在肺部立足，常在囊性纤维化患者体内定植的细菌会释放一种名为“塞帕西安”（cepacian）的多糖，该物质会在肺部（原本就已粘稠）的黏液中形成厚实的生物膜，从而使囊性纤维化患者的呼吸变得异常困难。 实验室研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够破坏塞帕西安聚集体，并使其粘度降低一半（这或许部分解释了为何有位医生提到，其囊性纤维化患者在使用DMSO后获得了改变人生的改善）。此外，研究还发现，二甲基亚砜与伊瓦卡夫特（一种用于治疗囊性纤维化的关键药物）联合使用，可降低因吸烟而增稠的肺部粘液的粘度。

content.en: All of this was best demonstrated by a remarkable 2009 study <sup data-ref="130">130</sup>, <sup data-ref="131">131</sup> by a team of Georgian researchers studying the effects of hyperthermia (a cancer treatment) on the brain as unlike the rest of the body, the brain and spinal cord are known to begin being injured by higher temperatures, with neurologic dysfunction beginning at 40-41°C and histological thermal damage (e.g., coagulative necrosis) occurring in primates after an hour of 44°C (which is why 43°C for 60 minutes is often considered the safety limit for hyperthermia treatment).
content.cn: 2009年，格鲁吉亚研究团队进行的一项引人注目的研究 <sup data-ref="130">130</sup> <sup data-ref="131">131</sup> 对此进行了最充分的论证。该研究探讨了热疗（一种癌症治疗方法）对大脑的影响，因为与身体其他部位不同， 众所周知，大脑和脊髓会因温度升高而开始受损：神经功能障碍在40-41°C时便会出现，而灵长类动物在44°C环境下暴露一小时后，便会出现组织学上的热损伤（例如凝固性坏死）（这也是为什么43°C持续60分钟通常被视为热疗的安全极限）。

content.en: That study directly heated the CSF of rats, and then directly assessed the resulting blood flow changes in the brain and the lesions which followed, finding:
content.cn: 该研究直接对大鼠的脑脊液进行加热，随后直接评估了由此引发的大脑血流变化及随之出现的病变，结果发现：

content.en: •Increasing heat caused increasing degrees of microclotting (mirroring Knisely and Riddick’s observations), corresponding losses of blood flow, and brain tissue damage from that loss of blood flow.
content.cn: •温度升高导致微血栓形成程度加剧（这与Knisely和Riddick的观察结果一致），随之而来的是血流减少，以及由此引发的脑组织损伤。

content.en: •DMSO counteracted all of these effects, preserving blood flow and brain tissue, while in contrast high molecular weight dextran (a substance Knisely used to induce blood sludging) worsened the sludging and brain damage—hence demonstrating why blood sludging can cause so many nervous system disorders, and why DMSO is able to antidote it.
content.cn: •二甲基亚砜（DMSO）抵消了所有这些影响，维持了血流和脑组织的功能；相比之下，高分子量右旋糖酐（Knisely用来诱导血液泥化的一种物质）却加剧了血液泥化和脑损伤——这从而证明了为何血液泥化会引发如此多的神经系统疾病，以及为何二甲基亚砜能够对其起到解毒作用。

content.en: *Note: these results also make a strong case for using DMSO to mitigate the adverse effects of heat stroke and high fevers.
content.cn: 注：这些研究结果也为使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）来缓解中暑和高烧的不良影响提供了有力依据。*

content.en: Additionally, DMSO has also been shown:
content.cn: 此外，研究还表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有以下作用：

content.en: • [In rat intestinal](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2537035/) microcirculation, to reduce chemoattractant-induced leukocyte adherence (but not rolling velocity and flux), thereby counteracting the inflammatory microstroke-producing process Moulden had discovered of large white blood cells obstructing the smaller blood vessels.
content.cn: • 在大鼠肠道微循环中，减少趋化因子诱导的白细胞黏附（但不影响其滚动速度和通量），从而抵消莫尔登所发现的、由大白细胞阻塞小血管而引发的、导致微小脑卒中的炎症过程。

content.en: • In microlymphatic vessels of intact rat mesentery to consistently stimulate phasic contractions, increasing the proportion of vessels exhibiting spontaneous phasic contractions from a baseline of 26–42% to 43–59%, while roughly doubling the contraction rate from ~11 to 25 per minute. As these contractions drive lymph flow, lymph velocity increased markedly — roughly doubling in 100% of vessels (via speckle-interferometry) and showing 40-100% increased movement in 60–64% of vessels (via direct microscopy) — thereby stimulating the drainage function of the lymph microcirculation. DMSO also completely removed the bacterial staphylococcal toxin’s lymphoconstrictive effects (which could progress to obliteration of microvessels), normalized lymphangion drainage, and attenuated the toxin’s overall lethal impact. Lastly, the Russian researchers who discovered this also found exposure greater than 15 minutes to 30% DMSO would induce lymphostasis in 20–40% of the vessels (concentrations that could never be reached in a patient using DMSO).<sup data-ref="132">132</sup>, <sup data-ref="133">133</sup>, <sup data-ref="134">134</sup>, <sup data-ref="135">135</sup>
content.cn: • 在完整大鼠肠系膜的微淋巴管中，持续刺激节律性收缩，使表现出自发节律性收缩的血管比例从基线的26%–42%升至43%–59%，同时收缩率从每分钟约11次增至25次，大致翻了一番。 由于这些收缩能驱动淋巴流动，淋巴流速显著增加——100%的血管中流速大约翻了一番（通过斑点干涉法测得），60–64%的血管中淋巴流动增加了40–100%（通过直接显微镜观察）——从而刺激了淋巴微循环的引流功能。 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还完全消除了金黄色葡萄球菌毒素的淋巴管收缩效应（该效应可能进展为微血管闭塞），使淋巴窦引流恢复正常，并减轻了该毒素的整体致死影响。 最后，发现这一现象的俄罗斯研究人员还发现，接触30% DMSO超过15分钟会在20–40%的血管中诱发淋巴淤滞（这种浓度在患者使用DMSO时绝不可能达到）。 <sup data-ref="132">132</sup> <sup data-ref="133">133</sup> <sup data-ref="134">134</sup> <sup data-ref="135">135</sup>

content.en: •To increase lymphatic circulation across numerous contexts — including resolving lymphostasis [in Kaposi’s sarcoma patients](https://almclinmed.ru/jour/article/view/192/193) and [in 115 patients with purulent wounds](https://goslasmed.elpub.ru/jour/article/viewFile/156/157), facilitating lymphatic drainage ([with electrical stimulation and hyaluronic acid](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=37521559)), increasing [renal microcirculation and lymph flow](http://science.sgmu.ru/system/files/diss/121/diss_suldina_antonina_petrovna.pdf), increasing [lymph flow in osteoarthritis](https://elibrary.ru/download/elibrary_42534824_17622811.pdf#page=167), dose-dependently increasing lymphatic flow (as [the solvent for intravenous Daflon](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2632644/)), facilitating the growth of new lymphatic vessels ([with 13-cis retinoic acid](https://journals.lww.com/prsgo/fulltext/2021/10001/13_cis_retinoic_acid_activates_regenerative.210.aspx)), and treating post-mastectomy lymphedema (per multiple guidelines, studies and reviews <sup data-ref="136">136</sup>, <sup data-ref="137">137</sup>, <sup data-ref="138">138</sup>). Additionally, [a Russian detoxificatio](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=46317234) n patent first stimulated interstitial humoral transport and lymphatic drainage by applying DMSO combined with a proteolytic enzyme to the feet and then 30-60 minutes later, filtered the blood with plasmapheresis.
content.cn: •在多种情况下促进淋巴循环——包括缓解卡波西肉瘤患者和115例化脓性创面患者的淋巴淤滞，促进淋巴引流（通过电刺激和透明质酸），增强肾微循环和淋巴流量，增加骨关节炎患者的淋巴流量， 以剂量依赖性方式增加淋巴流量（作为静脉注射达福隆的溶剂）、促进新淋巴管生长（配合13-顺式视黄酸），以及治疗乳腺切除术后淋巴水肿（依据多项指南、研究和综述 <sup data-ref="136">136</sup> <sup data-ref="137">137</sup> <sup data-ref="138">138</sup> ）。 此外，一项俄罗斯排毒专利首先通过将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与蛋白水解酶混合涂抹于足部，从而刺激间质体液运输和淋巴引流，随后在30-60分钟后，通过血浆置换术对血液进行过滤。

content.en: *Note: DMSO is also used to directly deliver topical or injected therapies into the lymphatic system <sup data-ref="139">139</sup>, <sup data-ref="140">140</sup>, <sup data-ref="141">141</sup>, <sup data-ref="142">142</sup>, <sup data-ref="143">143</sup>, <sup data-ref="144">144</sup>, <sup data-ref="145">145</sup>, <sup data-ref="146">146</sup> and to treat a wide range of lymphadenitis (e.g., from the BCG vaccine,<sup data-ref="147">147</sup>, <sup data-ref="148">148</sup>, <sup data-ref="149">149</sup>, <sup data-ref="150">150</sup>, <sup data-ref="151">151</sup>, <sup data-ref="152">152</sup>, <sup data-ref="153">153</sup>, <sup data-ref="154">154</sup>, <sup data-ref="155">155</sup>, <sup data-ref="156">156</sup> tuberculosis,<sup data-ref="157">157</sup>, <sup data-ref="158">158</sup> [hemorrhagic erysipelas](https://journals.eco-vector.com/kazanmedj/article/view/90950), [Post-COVID MIS-C](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/multisistemnyy-vospalitelnyy-sindrom-u-detey-i-podrostkov-vremenno-assotsiirovannyy-s-covid-19-klinicheskie-i-laboratornye), [tonsillitis](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/sovremennye-vozzreniya-na-mezhdistsiplinarnyy-podhod-k-reabilitatsii-bolnyh-s-respiratornym-sindromom), and bacterial infections which hospitalized 61 children <sup data-ref="159">159</sup>, <sup data-ref="160">160</sup>).
content.cn: 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还用于将局部或注射疗法直接输送至淋巴系统 <sup data-ref="159">159</sup> <sup data-ref="160">160</sup> <sup data-ref="149">149</sup> <sup data-ref="150">150</sup> <sup data-ref="151">151</sup> <sup data-ref="152">152</sup> <sup data-ref="153">153</sup> <sup data-ref="154">154</sup> ，并用于治疗各种淋巴结炎（例如由卡介苗引起的淋巴结炎， <sup data-ref="159">159</sup> <sup data-ref="160">160</sup> <sup data-ref="149">149</sup> <sup data-ref="150">150</sup> <sup data-ref="151">151</sup> <sup data-ref="152">152</sup> <sup data-ref="153">153</sup> <sup data-ref="154">154</sup> <sup data-ref="155">155</sup> <sup data-ref="156">156</sup> 结核病、 <sup data-ref="159">159</sup> <sup data-ref="160">160</sup> 出血性丹毒、新冠后综合征（MIS-C）、扁桃体炎以及导致61名儿童住院的细菌感染 <sup data-ref="159">159</sup> <sup data-ref="160">160</sup> ）。*

content.en: Lastly, a common side effect of IV DMSO is osmotic hemolysis, which predominantly affects aged blood cells (the spleen will eventually eliminate). Aged blood cells are well recognized to be much more prone to agglutinating and clumping (in part because red blood cells lose their negative charge with age) and as such, circulation will improve with their loss. This helps to explain [Jack De La Torre’s observation](https://www.amazon.com/Dimethyl-Sulfoxide-DMSO-Trauma-Disease/dp/1498714676) with boluses of IV DMSO in brain injured patients:
content.cn: 最后，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的一个常见副作用是渗透性溶血，这主要影响老化的血细胞（脾脏最终会将其清除）。 众所周知，老化的血细胞更容易发生凝集和结块（部分原因是红细胞随着年龄增长会失去负电荷），因此，随着这些细胞的清除，血液循环将得到改善。这有助于解释杰克·德拉托雷（Jack De La Torre）在脑损伤患者中使用静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO） bolus 治疗时所观察到的现象：

content.en: Also, hematuria from red cell osmotic hemolysis was seen in all patients only after the initial loading dose of DMSO. Hematuria was seen to stabilize after subsequent doses of DMSO. The loading DMSO dose has no other consequences other than lowering the hematocrit about 25%, a temporary reaction **that paradoxically lowers blood viscosity and vascular resistance while increasing cerebral blood flow**.
content.cn: 此外，所有患者仅在首次服用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）负荷剂量后，才出现由红细胞渗透性溶血引起的血尿。随后服用DMSO后，血尿情况趋于稳定。DMSO负荷剂量除使血细胞比容降低约25%外，不会引起其他后果；这种暂时性反应会悖论性地降低血液黏度和血管阻力，同时增加脑血流量。

content.en: DMSO and the Blood-Brain Barrier
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜与血脑屏障

content.en: In tandem with increasing circulation, DMSO rapidly spreads through the body, and [within 5 minutes](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/5232278/) of going on the skin it can be found in the blood, [within 30 minutes](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/5232277/) can be found throughout the organs, and [within an hour](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1967.tb34869.x), the bones—but simultaneously, [does not accumulate within the body](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9469349/) after prolonged use (e.g., 85% is excreted unchanged in the urine [within 24 hours](https://cdnsciencepub.com/doi/abs/10.1139/y67-056)) and virtually none remains by a week after administration.<sup data-ref="161">161</sup>, <sup data-ref="162">162</sup>, <sup data-ref="163">163</sup>
content.cn: 随着血液循环的增强，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会迅速在体内扩散：涂抹于皮肤后5分钟内即可进入血液，30分钟内可分布至各器官，1小时内可到达骨骼——但与此同时，长期使用后它不会在体内积聚（例如，85%会在24小时内以原形经尿液排出），且给药一周后体内几乎不再残留。 <sup data-ref="161">161</sup> <sup data-ref="162">162</sup> <sup data-ref="163">163</sup>

content.en: Additionally, studies in mice and rats have shown that DMSO at 10–15% concentrations reversibly opens the blood-brain barrier (BBB), allowing proteins like horseradish peroxidase (HRP), [many drugs](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26344358/) including pemoline, [ketoconazole](https://journals.asm.org/doi/abs/10.1128/aac.30.4.617) (with brain concentrations increasing 9-fold), or the Parkinson’s medication L-dopa (increasing dopamine levels in the tubero-infundibular and neostriatal areas **and further potentiated** when combined with carbidopa), drug carrying lysosomes, and amino acids like tyrosine to reach brain tissue in higher amounts than without DMSO.<sup data-ref="164">164</sup>, <sup data-ref="165">165</sup>, <sup data-ref="165">165</sup>, <sup data-ref="166">166</sup>, <sup data-ref="167">167</sup>, <sup data-ref="168">168</sup>, <sup data-ref="169">169</sup>, <sup data-ref="170">170</sup>, <sup data-ref="171">171</sup>, <sup data-ref="166">166</sup>, <sup data-ref="172">172</sup>, <sup data-ref="173">173</sup>, <sup data-ref="174">174</sup>, <sup data-ref="175">175</sup>, <sup data-ref="176">176</sup>, <sup data-ref="168">168</sup>, <sup data-ref="177">177</sup>, <sup data-ref="178">178</sup>, <sup data-ref="179">179</sup>, <sup data-ref="180">180</sup>
content.cn: 此外，针对小鼠和大鼠的研究表明，浓度为10%–15%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可可逆性地打开血脑屏障（BBB），从而使辣根过氧化物酶（HRP）等蛋白质，以及包括培莫林、 酮康唑（其脑内浓度可增加9倍），或帕金森病药物左旋多巴（可提高结节漏斗区和新纹状体区域的多巴胺水平，并与卡比多巴联用时效果进一步增强）等药物，以及载药溶酶体和酪氨酸等氨基酸，以比未使用DMSO时更高的浓度进入脑组织。 <sup data-ref="164">164</sup> <sup data-ref="165">165</sup> <sup data-ref="165">165</sup> <sup data-ref="166">166</sup> <sup data-ref="167">167</sup> <sup data-ref="168">168</sup> <sup data-ref="169">169</sup> <sup data-ref="170">170</sup> <sup data-ref="171">171</sup> <sup data-ref="166">166</sup> <sup data-ref="172">172</sup> <sup data-ref="173">173</sup> <sup data-ref="174">174</sup> <sup data-ref="175">175</sup> <sup data-ref="176">176</sup> <sup data-ref="168">168</sup> <sup data-ref="177">177</sup> <sup data-ref="178">178</sup> <sup data-ref="179">179</sup> <sup data-ref="180">180</sup>

content.en: DMSO also increased the transfer of amino acids across the subarachnoid space into underlying cortical tissue [by approximately 57%](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1665888/), and in neonatal chicks, IV DMSO increased brain concentrations of adrenaline and noradrenaline by approximately 35–39% and intensified their central effects.**<sup data-ref="181">181</sup>, <sup data-ref="182">182</sup>** Similarly, in dogs, IV DMSO at escalating infusion rates reached a CSF concentration [roughly half the corresponding plasma concentration](https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/ac60236a039), confirming a (slower) penetration across the BBB into the CNS. This ability to facilitate drug delivery to the brain underpins DMSO’s therapeutic potential for neurological disorders (e.g., Parkinson’s) and has led to DMSO being grouped with mannitol as [a clinical agent for enhancing brain drug delivery](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3008754/). Likewise DMSO has been incorporated into brain-targeting nanoparticle formulations, such as glucose-mediated poloxamer micelles, which showed significantly higher transport across a BBB model than ordinary micelles.<sup data-ref="183">183</sup>, <sup data-ref="184">184</sup>
content.cn: DMSO 还使氨基酸通过蛛网膜下腔向下层皮质组织的转运增加了约 57%；在新生雏鸡中，静脉注射 DMSO 使脑内肾上腺素和去甲肾上腺素的浓度提高了约 35%–39%，并增强了它们的中枢作用。 <sup data-ref="183">183</sup> <sup data-ref="184">184</sup> 同样，在犬类身上，以递增的输注速率静脉注射DMSO后，其脑脊液浓度约为相应血浆浓度的二分之一，这证实了DMSO通过血脑屏障进入中枢神经系统的渗透速度较慢。 这种促进药物向大脑输送的能力，奠定了二甲基亚砜在神经系统疾病（如帕金森病）治疗中的潜力，并使其与甘露醇一同被归类为增强脑部药物输送的临床制剂。同样，二甲基亚砜已被纳入脑靶向纳米颗粒制剂中，例如葡萄糖介导的聚氧乙烯聚氧丙烯醚微乳液，其在血脑屏障模型中的转运效率显著高于普通微乳液。 <sup data-ref="183">183</sup> <sup data-ref="184">184</sup>

content.en: *Note: there are mixed results on DMSO temporarily opening the BBB (e.g., these eight studies found it did not,<sup data-ref="185">185</sup>, <sup data-ref="186">186</sup>, <sup data-ref="187">187</sup>, <sup data-ref="188">188</sup>, <sup data-ref="189">189</sup>, <sup data-ref="190">190</sup>, <sup data-ref="191">191</sup>, <sup data-ref="192">192</sup> [this one](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10458656/) found that opening the BBB required 1% or greater DMSO, [another found](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF01951995) it had minimal effect on dopamine transport) these found the opening was also problematic,<sup data-ref="193">193</sup>, <sup data-ref="194">194</sup> while in rats and rabbits DMSO infusions into the carotids did not harm the BBB, arteries or brain <sup data-ref="195">195</sup>, <sup data-ref="196">196</sup> and [a 1985 veterinary review](https://avmajournals.avma.org/view/journals/javma/185/10/javma.1984.185.10.1217.xml) likewise noted DMSO allows some substances but not others to cross the BBB.
content.cn: 注： 关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能否暂时打开血脑屏障（BBB）的研究结果不一（例如，这八项研究发现它无法打开血脑屏障， <sup data-ref="195">195</sup> <sup data-ref="196">196</sup> <sup data-ref="187">187</sup> <sup data-ref="188">188</sup> <sup data-ref="189">189</sup> <sup data-ref="190">190</sup> <sup data-ref="191">191</sup> <sup data-ref="192">192</sup> ；这项研究发现，要打开血脑屏障需要1%或更高浓度的DMSO， 另一项研究则发现其对多巴胺转运的影响微乎其微），这些研究还发现血脑屏障的开放也存在问题， <sup data-ref="195">195</sup> <sup data-ref="196">196</sup> 而在大鼠和兔子身上，将二甲基亚砜注入颈动脉并未损害血脑屏障、动脉或大脑 <sup data-ref="195">195</sup> <sup data-ref="196">196</sup> ，且1985年的一篇兽医学综述同样指出，二甲基亚砜允许某些物质穿过血脑屏障，而其他物质则不能。

content.en: *In mouse MRI studies, DMSO accumulated at 1.5-fold higher concentrations in glioblastomas than in normal brain tissue with 2.2-fold longer washout, creating clear tumor "hotspots." Unlike toxic gadolinium contrast, DMSO freely crossed the intact blood-brain barrier, enabling visualization of low-grade tumors invisible to conventional MRI — and during chemotherapy, reductions in DMSO retention signaled treatment response earlier than volumetric MRI changes.<sup data-ref="197">197</sup>, <sup data-ref="198">198</sup>, <sup data-ref="199">199</sup>, <sup data-ref="200">200</sup>, <sup data-ref="201">201</sup>, <sup data-ref="202">202</sup> DMSO has also been shown to enhance light penetration into brain tissue, improving optical diagnostic techniques relevant to certain neurologic disorders.<sup data-ref="203">203</sup>, <sup data-ref="204">204</sup>
content.cn: 在小鼠MRI研究中，DMSO在胶质母细胞瘤中的积累浓度比正常脑组织高出1.5倍，且清除时间延长了2.2倍，从而形成了明显的肿瘤“热点”。 与有毒的钆造影剂不同，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能自由穿过完整的血脑屏障，从而使常规MRI无法显示的低级别肿瘤得以显影——在化疗期间，DMSO滞留量的减少比体积MRI的变化更早地提示了治疗反应。 <sup data-ref="203">203</sup> <sup data-ref="204">204</sup> <sup data-ref="199">199</sup> <sup data-ref="200">200</sup> <sup data-ref="201">201</sup> <sup data-ref="202">202</sup> 研究还表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能增强光线穿透脑组织的能力，从而改善与某些神经系统疾病相关的光学诊断技术。 <sup data-ref="203">203</sup> <sup data-ref="204">204</sup>

content.en: DMSO and Psychiatric Conditions
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜与精神疾病

content.en: Two of the most common complaints about psychiatry are that its (highly toxic) drugs do not treat the underlying illness—requiring lifelong symptom management—and that real biological issues (e.g., COVID vaccine injuries) are routinely misdiagnosed as primary psychiatric disorders. Both problems stem from the erroneous assumption that most psychiatric conditions originate purely in the mind, when in reality many have a clear biological (neurological) basis.
content.cn: 关于精神病学最常见的两项批评是：其（毒性极强的）药物无法治愈根本疾病——导致患者需要终身控制症状——以及真正的生物学问题（例如新冠疫苗导致的伤害）经常被误诊为原发性精神障碍。这两个问题都源于一种错误的假设，即认为大多数精神疾病纯粹源于心理因素，而实际上许多精神疾病都有明确的生物学（神经学）基础。

content.en: My perspective resulted from repeatedly observing psychiatric symptoms emerge after brain injuries and from seeing medical therapies that restore brain health also improve psychiatric issues. For example, one of my favorite therapies, [ultraviolet blood irradiation](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-century-of-evidence-putting-light) works by improving circulation, reducing inflammation, and reawakening dormant cells— **all of which DMSO also does**. Because these processes underlie so many diseases, much in the same way [a large body of literature](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-century-of-evidence-putting-light) supports UVBI’s efficacy across a wide range of conditions, including psychiatric ones, the same also holds true for DMSO (which I will show throughout this article).
content.cn: 我的这一观点源于反复观察到脑损伤后会出现精神症状，以及发现能够恢复大脑健康的医疗疗法也能改善精神问题。 例如，我最推崇的疗法之一——紫外线血液照射疗法（UVBI），其作用机制在于改善血液循环、减轻炎症并唤醒休眠细胞——而二甲基亚砜（DMSO）同样具备这些功效。由于这些生理过程是许多疾病的根本原因，正如大量文献所证实的那样，紫外线血液照射疗法（UVBI）对包括精神疾病在内的多种病症均有效，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）同样具备这一特性（我将在本文中逐步论证这一点）。

content.en: In the process of unearthing every DMSO paper in existence, I uncovered a Russian team (at the *Institute of Higher Nervous Activity and Neurophysiology of the Russian Academy of Sciences*) which produced some of the best evidence I’ve come across for this theory.<sup data-ref="205">205</sup>, <sup data-ref="206">206</sup>, <sup data-ref="207">207</sup>, <sup data-ref="208">208</sup>, <sup data-ref="209">209</sup>, <sup data-ref="210">210</sup>, <sup data-ref="211">211</sup>, <sup data-ref="212">212</sup>
content.cn: 在梳理所有现存关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的论文的过程中，我发现了一个俄罗斯研究团队（隶属于俄罗斯科学院高级神经活动与神经生理学研究所），他们提供的证据是我迄今为止在该理论研究中见过的最有力的证据之一。 <sup data-ref="205">205</sup> <sup data-ref="206">206</sup> <sup data-ref="207">207</sup> <sup data-ref="208">208</sup> <sup data-ref="209">209</sup> <sup data-ref="210">210</sup> <sup data-ref="211">211</sup> <sup data-ref="212">212</sup>

content.en: Briefly, in their effort to find a biologic cause of psychiatric conditions (which have a wide variety of seemingly unrelated causes), they discovered that the chronic stress which causes psychiatric disorders is accompanied by impaired circulation to the brain which sets off a variety of degenerative processes, especially once the individual’s ability to compensate for acute short-term stress is overwhelmed by chronic sustained stress.
content.cn: 简而言之，在试图寻找精神疾病的生物学成因（这些疾病成因多种多样，且看似互不相关）的过程中，他们发现，导致精神疾病的慢性压力会伴随脑部血液循环障碍，从而引发一系列退行性病变，尤其是当个体应对急性短期压力的补偿能力被慢性持续压力所压倒时。

content.en: To study this, they repeatedly induced neurosis in animals using prolonged stressors (white noise, light flashes, and electric shocks over 3+ weeks), then using biomicroscopy (cranial window) and hydrogen clearance, they directly measured blood flow in the territory of the middle cerebral artery, and finally, they directly examined the brains.
content.cn: 为了研究这一问题，他们通过持续数周以上的应激刺激（白噪声、闪光和电击）反复诱导动物出现神经症，随后利用生物显微镜（颅窗）和氢清除法直接测量了中大脑动脉供血区的血流情况，最后直接对大脑进行了检查。

content.en: *Note: [neurosis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neurosis) (невроз) is an outdated psychiatric term. In this Soviet-era context, it describes a breakdown of higher nervous activity caused by chronic stress that overwhelms the person’s coping ability. Modern equivalents include Generalized Anxiety Disorder, mixed depressive and anxiety disorder (ICD-11), neurasthenia, and adjustment disorder with anxious or depressed mood.
content.cn: 注：神经症（невроз）是一个过时的精神病学术语。在苏联时期的语境下，它指由慢性压力导致的高级神经活动紊乱，这种压力超出了个体的应对能力。现代的对应概念包括广泛性焦虑障碍、混合型抑郁焦虑障碍（ICD-11）、神经衰弱，以及伴有焦虑或抑郁情绪的适应障碍。*
From this they found:由此，他们发现：

content.en: •The brain normally receives 5–7 times higher blood flow per gram of tissue than most other organs due to its exceptional energy demands. Acute stress typically causes a short-term increase in cerebral blood flow, but prolonged chronic stress (leading to neurosis) produces a sustained decrease that persists 4–6 weeks after the stressor ends. This reduction causes circulatory hypoxia, elevated brain lactate, decreased caspase-3 and Na,K-ATPase activity, impaired mitochondrial respiration (including reduced succinate dehydrogenase and NADH dehydrogenase activity), and increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) production (and in animals unable to adapt by shifting from succinic acid <sup>⬖</sup> to NADH oxidation, stress resistance is markedly reduced). The resulting hypoxia also increases cytochrome oxidase activity (by 35–40%) and triggers mitochondrial biogenesis, followed by ROS triggered lipid peroxidation (LPO).<sup data-ref="212">212</sup>, <sup data-ref="213">213</sup>, <sup data-ref="214">214</sup>, <sup data-ref="215">215</sup> *Note: the brain is particularly vulnerable to this cascade due to its exceptionally high metabolic rate and oxygen demand, as well as its high content of (oxidizable) polyunsaturated fatty acids in cell membranes.*
content.cn: •由于大脑对能量的需求极为旺盛，其每克组织所获得的血流量通常比大多数其他器官高出5至7倍。急性应激通常会导致脑血流量短期增加，但长期慢性应激（导致神经症）则会引起脑血流量持续下降，且这种下降在应激源消除后仍会持续4至6周。 这种减少会导致循环性缺氧、脑内乳酸水平升高、caspase-3和钠钾-ATP酶活性降低、线粒体呼吸功能受损（包括琥珀酸脱氢酶和NADH脱氢酶活性降低），以及活性氧（ROS）生成增加（对于无法通过从琥珀酸氧化转向NADH氧化来适应的动物，其抗应激能力会显著降低）。 由此导致的缺氧还会增加细胞色素氧化酶活性（提高35–40%）并触发线粒体生物发生，随后由活性氧引发脂质过氧化（LPO）。 <sup data-ref="212">212</sup> <sup data-ref="213">213</sup> <sup data-ref="214">214</sup> <sup data-ref="215">215</sup> 注：由于大脑的新陈代谢率和氧气需求极高，且细胞膜中含有大量（易氧化）的多不饱和脂肪酸，因此大脑对这一级联反应尤为敏感。

content.en: •In the early stages of neurosis, acute stress, a nonspecific protective response, inhibits LPO, accumulates readily oxidized phospholipids, decreases cholesterol content, and increases superoxide-scavenging activity (partly from stress hormones acting as radical scavengers). With continued chronic stress, this protective phase is overwhelmed, leading to activation of free-radical lipid oxidation, progressive phospholipid depletion, cholesterol accumulation, and [an increased in oxidized proteins](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=9227126). These biphasic membrane changes initially increase resistance to further peroxidation but ultimately render membranes more vulnerable as stress continues.<sup data-ref="216">216</sup>, <sup data-ref="217">217</sup>, <sup data-ref="213">213</sup>, <sup data-ref="213">213</sup> *Note: [this biphasic pattern](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=31343885) was also observed in women with dysmenorrhea (after 12 hours of pain, plasma levels of Schiff’s bases were reduced by almost two-thirds whereas after 12-24 hours it was nearly double from control values).*
content.cn: •在神经症的早期阶段，急性应激会引发一种非特异性保护反应，该反应可抑制脂质过氧化（LPO），导致易氧化磷脂的积累，降低胆固醇含量，并增强超氧阴离子清除活性（部分源于应激激素作为自由基清除剂的作用）。 随着慢性应激的持续，这种保护性阶段被压倒，导致自由基脂质氧化被激活、磷脂逐渐耗竭、胆固醇积累以及氧化蛋白水平升高。这些双相膜变化最初会增强对进一步过氧化的抵抗力，但随着应激的持续，最终会使膜变得更加脆弱。 <sup data-ref="216">216</sup> <sup data-ref="217">217</sup> <sup data-ref="213">213</sup> <sup data-ref="213">213</sup> 注：这种双相模式也在痛经女性中被观察到（疼痛12小时后，血浆中席夫碱的水平降低了近三分之二，而在12-24小时后，其水平几乎是对照组值的两倍）。

content.en: *•* The later adaptations to chronic stress are more specific and membrane and free-radical changes often show interhemispheric asymmetry varying by behavioral type. For example, in acute stress, animals with high emotional reactivity and emotional resonance shift toward balanced or right-dominant LPO (as do stress sensitive rats that excel with mazes), while low-reactivity animals have more LPO on the left (as do stress resistant rats that are not good with mazes).
content.cn: •对慢性应激的后期适应反应更为特异，且膜和自由基的变化通常表现出半球间的不对称性，这种不对称性会因行为类型而异。 例如，在急性应激情况下，情绪反应性高且情绪共鸣强的动物其LPO会向平衡状态或右侧占优状态转变（在迷宫测试中表现优异的应激敏感大鼠亦是如此），而情绪反应性低的动物则左侧LPO更为显著（在迷宫测试中表现不佳的应激耐受大鼠亦是如此）。

content.en: •These molecular changes are accompanied by clear physiological disturbances: elevated and fluctuating systolic blood pressure, disruption and reduction of local cerebral blood flow, loss of functional specificity (**equalization of blood flow across brain structures**), and a behavioral shift toward passive-defensive behavior. As stress and sympathetic hyperactivity can cause these autonomic disturbances, the researchers concluded that the resulting restriction of cerebral blood flow contributed to many symptoms seen in neurosis.
content.cn: •这些分子变化伴随着明显的生理紊乱：收缩压升高且波动，局部脑血流紊乱和减少，功能特异性丧失（脑内各结构间的血流趋于均衡），以及行为模式向被动防御型转变。由于应激和交感神经亢奋会引起这些自主神经紊乱，研究人员得出结论：由此导致的脑血流受限是神经症中许多症状的成因之一。

content.en: *Note: one of my favorite modalities ([neural therapy](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/regenerative-medicine-and-the-cell-6c5)) works by neutralizing autonomic disturbances and frequently produces rapid, dramatic responses in complex illnesses — which I believe relates to the pathological process described by the Russian researchers.
content.cn: 注：我最喜欢的治疗方法之一（神经疗法）通过中和自主神经紊乱来发挥作用，在治疗复杂疾病时往往能产生迅速而显著的疗效——我认为这与俄罗斯研究人员所描述的病理过程有关。*

content.en: • [They also found that](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=14947341) local norepinephrine release within the lateral hypothalamus functions as part of a depressor system that helps normalize elevated blood pressure. During acute stress, the speed of return to baseline blood pressure depended on the strength of this local noradrenergic response in the lateral hypothalamus. As such, when this mechanism is impaired, repeated stress can lead to prolonged hemodynamic instability, which over time, can contribute to dysregulation of cerebral autoregulation and sustained reductions in cerebral blood flow (which then damages the hypothalamus, creating a downward spiral into chronic illness).
content.cn: • 他们还发现，下丘脑外侧区域内去甲肾上腺素的局部释放是降压系统的一部分，有助于将升高的血压恢复至正常水平。 在急性应激期间，血压恢复至基线水平的速度取决于下丘脑外侧区这种局部去甲肾上腺素能反应的强度。因此，当该机制受损时，反复的应激会导致血流动力学不稳定状态持续，随着时间推移，这可能导致脑自动调节功能紊乱以及脑血流量持续减少（进而损害下丘脑，形成导致慢性疾病的恶性循环）。

content.en: *Note: most chronically elevated blood pressure has no known cause. This framework potentially explains a key unrecognized cause (along with another reason why restoring [zeta potential](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-do-all-vaccines-cause-harm) will [improve blood pressure](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/unmasking-the-great-blood-pressure), as doing so will restore blood flow to the hypothalamus). Additionally, I should note that certain holistic healers have reported significant success in treating excessive sympathetic activity by addressing hypothalamic function.
content.cn: 注：大多数慢性高血压的病因尚不明确。这一理论框架或许能解释一个关键的、尚未被认知的病因（同时也解释了为何恢复ζ电位能改善血压——因为这样做将恢复下丘脑的血流）。此外，我还应指出，某些整体疗法从业者报告称，通过调节下丘脑功能，在治疗交感神经活动亢进方面取得了显著成效。*

content.en: •Normal cerebral blood flow is approximately 50 ml/100 g/min; **in chronic neurosis it falls below 30**. Cerebral vessels also lose autoregulatory capacity: after bilateral carotid occlusion, normal animals show universal arterial dilation, whereas neurosis animals exhibit mixed arterial and venous responses (e.g., in arterioles 54% dilated, 21% constricted, 25% had no change) with frequent spastic contractions, bottle-shaped deformations, interrupted flow and perverted pial vascular reactions, **resulting** **in a relative equalization of blood flow rate across all studied structures** (indicating a loss of functional specificity—which I consider to have immense clinical significance as a few healing traditions associate this circulatory shift with approaching death).
content.cn: •正常脑血流量约为50毫升/100克/分钟；在慢性神经症患者中，该数值会降至30以下。脑血管还会丧失自动调节能力：在双侧颈动脉阻断后，正常动物会出现普遍的动脉扩张，而神经症动物则表现出动脉和静脉反应并存的现象（例如，小动脉中54%扩张、21%收缩、 25%无变化），并伴有频繁的痉挛性收缩、瓶状变形、血流中断以及软脑膜血管反应异常，导致所有研究结构的血流速率相对趋于一致（表明功能特异性丧失——我认为这具有巨大的临床意义，因为少数传统疗法将这种循环变化与临终状态相关联）。

content.en: *Note: [in many cases](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=31009298), cerebral hemodynamics never fully recover after the chronic stress period.
content.cn: 注：在许多情况下，慢性应激期过后，脑血流动力学状况往往无法完全恢复。*

content.en: •These hemodynamic changes parallel the homogenization of EEG activity seen in neurosis. Biomicroscopy confirmed microstructural disturbances consistent with hypoxia, including perivascular and pericellular edema, tortuous vessels, dark neurons, acidophilic cells, [microglial proliferation](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=19002403), and [hippocampal damage](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=12901837) (especially shrunken soma, altered nuclei, and corkscrew dendrites in CA3; 2.7–7.1% cell loss in CA1—approaching the threshold for cognitive impairment and dementia).
content.cn: •这些血流动力学变化与神经症中观察到的脑电图活动均质化现象相一致。 生物显微镜检查证实了与缺氧相符的微结构紊乱，包括血管周围和细胞周围水肿、血管迂曲、神经元变暗、嗜酸性细胞、小胶质细胞增生以及海马损伤（尤其是CA3区细胞体萎缩、细胞核形态改变和螺旋状树突；CA1区细胞丢失率为2.7%–7.1%——接近认知障碍和痴呆的阈值）。

content.en: •The process selectively damages [brain β-adrenoreceptors](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00850903) (which for about a week showed decreased receptor affinity that was compensated for by an increased receptor number, with the elevated receptor density persisting after three weeks), [the sensorimotor cortex](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=19002403) (layer V), and [the hippocampus](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=19002403) (in the pyramidal layer, [particularly at the CA3 field](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=12901837)).
content.cn: •该过程会选择性地损伤大脑的β-肾上腺素受体（约一周内，这些受体的亲和力有所下降，但通过受体数量的增加得到了补偿，且受体密度升高在三周后仍持续存在）、感觉运动皮层（第五层）以及海马体（位于锥体细胞层，特别是在CA3区）。

content.en: •Three stages of the general adaptation syndrome were identified in the chronic emotional-painful stress model: (1) initial search for optimal functioning with residual visceral defects, fear-dominant behavior, and labile blood pressure, lasting a week; (2) partial autonomic stabilization but ongoing phospholipid depletion (“local wear”); (3) exhaustion with breakdown of autonomic regulation, LPO activation, and profound membrane disruption across neurons, glia, and synapses, contributing to the breakdown of higher nervous activity, which they described as “pathological adaptation with a high structural price.”
content.cn: •在慢性情绪性疼痛应激模型中，识别出一般适应综合征的三个阶段：(1) 初期寻求最佳功能状态，伴有残留的内脏功能缺陷、以恐惧为主导的行为以及血压波动，持续一周；(2) 自主神经部分稳定，但磷脂持续耗竭（“局部磨损”）； （3）衰竭阶段，表现为自主神经调节功能崩溃、脂质过氧化（LPO）激活，以及神经元、胶质细胞和突触间广泛的膜结构破坏，进而导致高级神经活动崩溃，研究者将其描述为“代价高昂的病理性适应”。
They then:随后，他们：

content.en: •Emphasized that an individual’s internal reaction to stressors rather than the stressor is pivotal (“...*it does not matter what facts are reported to us — what is important is how we react to them; that is the main question* ”) and linked it to the observation that many illnesses resulting from chronic psychoemotional stress are characterized by autonomic (vascular) disorders, hypoxic states, and serious disturbances in metabolic processes, often manifesting as autonomic/vascular dysregulation, hypoxia, and metabolic disturbances.
content.cn: •强调了个人对压力源的内在反应，而非压力源本身，才是关键（“……“无论向我们报告了什么事实都无关紧要——重要的是我们如何应对它们；这才是关键问题”），并将这一观点与以下观察结果联系起来：许多由慢性心理情绪压力引起的疾病，其特征表现为自主神经（血管）功能紊乱、缺氧状态以及代谢过程的严重紊乱，通常表现为自主神经/血管功能失调、缺氧和代谢紊乱。

content.en: *Note: the **non-English speaker** who coined the medical concept of stress later [stated he used the wrong word and meant to use the word strain](https://www.huffpost.com/entry/why-hans-selye-who-popularized-the-term-stress-should_b_585be61ce4b014e7c72eda8f) (how a system deforms in response to stress).
content.cn: 注：那位提出“应力”这一医学概念的非英语母语者后来表示，他当时用错了词，本意是想用“应变”一词（指系统在受力作用下发生变形的情况）。*

content.en: •Noted that, while many individuals reach full neurosis, far more are in a pre-neurotic stage of significant strain without complete decompensation and would greatly benefit from therapeutic interventions early in their disease process.
content.cn: •指出，虽然许多人会发展为完全的神经症，但更多人处于神经症前期，虽承受着显著的心理压力，但尚未完全失调，若能在疾病进程的早期接受治疗干预，将大有裨益。

content.en: •Highlighted that the effects of chronic stress they observed were similar to those seen after [strokes](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=14996162), [heart attacks](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=14996162), or t [raumatic brain injury](https://viewer.rsl.ru/ru/rsl01000079210?page=1&rotate=0&theme=white), and in many cases, they successfully used the same therapies for both (e.g., [panthenol](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=15315978) <sup>⬖</sup>).
content.cn: •研究人员强调，他们观察到的慢性压力所产生的影响与中风、心脏病发作或创伤性脑损伤后出现的影响相似，而且在许多情况下，他们成功地将相同的疗法同时应用于这两种情况（例如，泛醇 <sup>⬖</sup> ）。
To address neurosis:应对神经症：

content.en: •The researchers first used agents with antihypoxic and antioxidant properties (e.g., [carnosine](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00833785),<sup>⬖</sup> [substance P](https://www.elibrary.ru/download/elibrary_220872_43863656.htm), phenosan K, or synthetic phenolic antioxidants <sup data-ref="215">215</sup>, <sup data-ref="218">218</sup>) and found these interventions both prevented and effectively treated experimental neurosis in animals (whereas untreated animals consistently developed neurosis and showed poor recovery).
content.cn: •研究人员首先使用了具有抗缺氧和抗氧化特性的物质（例如，肌肽、 <sup>⬖</sup> substance P、phenosan K 或合成酚类抗氧化剂 <sup data-ref="215">215</sup> <sup data-ref="218">218</sup> ），并发现这些干预措施既能预防又能有效治疗动物实验中的神经症（而未经治疗的动物则会一致性地出现神经症，且恢复情况不佳）。

content.en: *Note: other agents like [panthenol](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=19002403)* <sup>⬖</sup> *only gave temporary improvements. Additionally, they also had significant success with alcohol (a hydroxyl scavenger), providing a novel explanation for why alcohol offers some relief from chronic depression. Notably, chronic stress decreased brain Na,K-ATPase activity (as detailed above), and [a separate study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0021925817442980) on brain Na,K-ATPase found that while both DMSO and ethanol scavenge hydroxyl radicals, ethanol further destabilizes the enzyme whereas DMSO stabilizes it — potentially explaining why DMSO provides lasting benefit where alcohol only temporarily palliates (while in parallel, Riddick found alcohol increased blood sludging).*
content.cn: 注：其他成分（如泛醇 <sup>⬖</sup> ）仅能带来暂时性的改善。此外，他们还发现酒精（一种羟基自由基清除剂）也取得了显著成效，这为酒精为何能对慢性抑郁症起到一定缓解作用提供了一种新颖的解释。 值得注意的是，慢性压力会降低大脑中钠钾-ATP酶的活性（如上所述），而另一项关于大脑钠钾-ATP酶的研究发现：虽然二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和乙醇都能清除羟基自由基，但乙醇会进一步破坏该酶的稳定性，而二甲基亚砜则能稳定该酶——这或许可以解释为何二甲基亚砜能带来持久益处，而酒精仅能暂时缓解症状（与此同时，里迪克发现酒精会加剧血液粘稠度）。

content.en: After testing multiple agents, [the researchers achieved strong success with negative ion therapy](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=14943196) (which has a pronounced antihypoxic effect). When present during acute stress (e.g., immobilization), negative ions completely prevented the pathologic brain changes in all animals — regardless of behavioral type — including preservation of oxidative enzyme activity in the sensorimotor cortex and normalization of behavioral and autonomic parameters (heart rate, blood pressure, and breathing). Similar protective effects were observed with succinic acid <sup>⬖</sup> (30 mg/kg orally daily for 8 days), which [they also found](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=13274758) preserved orienting behavior after a heart attack. Notably, rats with an active behavioral type showed greater natural resistance to cerebral hypoxia, exhibiting faster increases in local cerebral blood flow and brain oxygen tension during stress.
content.cn: 在测试了多种药物后，研究人员发现负离子疗法（具有显著的抗缺氧作用）取得了显著成效。在急性应激（如束缚）期间使用负离子，无论行为类型如何，都能完全防止所有动物出现病理性的脑部变化——包括维持感觉运动皮层的抗氧化酶活性，以及使行为和自主神经参数（心率、血压和呼吸）恢复正常。 琥珀酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （每日口服30毫克/千克，连续8天）也表现出类似的保护作用，研究人员还发现，该物质在心肌梗死后能维持定向行为。值得注意的是，表现为活跃行为类型的大鼠对脑缺氧具有更强的天然抵抗力，在应激期间，其局部脑血流量和脑氧分压的上升速度更快。

content.en: *Note: positive ions in the air [have been extensively linked to psychiatric conditions](https://archive.org/details/ioneffecthowaire00soyk). I believe this is because positive ions [impair zeta potential](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-vaccine-injuries-reveal-about) and hence [reduce cerebral microcirculation](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-vaccine-injuries-reveal-about) (whereas negative ions restore it).
content.cn: 注：空气中的正离子已被广泛认为与精神疾病有关。我认为这是因为正离子会损害zeta电位，从而降低脑部微循环（而负离子则能恢复这种微循环）。*

content.en: They eventually had the greatest success by combining oral DMSO (a potent hydroxyl scavenger) with vitamin E <sup>⬖</sup> (alpha-tocopherol**)**, finding the efficacy of this combination exceeded them being given separately (e.g., [for autonomic or behavioral issues](https://europepmc.org/article/med/3188649)). They attributed this to DMSO enhancing vitamin E <sup>⬖</sup> ’s antioxidant capacity as DMSO could rapidly deliver it to cell membranes before it had lost its antioxidant capacity from reacting with other substances in the body ([supported by it](https://europepmc.org/article/med/3188649) reducing free radical oxidation products, raising superoxide scavenging activity in the brain and blood serum, raising brain phospholipid content and normalizing brain cholesterol content). Finally, in 1999, they shared these results had begun being replicated in government sanctioned clinical trials at the Moscow Medical Academy.
content.cn: 他们最终通过将口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO，一种强效羟基自由基清除剂）与维生素E <sup>⬖</sup> （α-生育酚）结合使用，取得了最佳效果，发现这种组合的疗效优于单独使用（例如，针对自主神经或行为问题）。 他们将这一现象归因于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）增强了维生素E <sup>⬖</sup> 的抗氧化能力——因为DMSO能够迅速将其输送至细胞膜，从而避免其在与体内其他物质发生反应后失去抗氧化能力（这一结论得到了以下证据的支持：它能减少自由基氧化产物，提高大脑和血清中的超氧化物清除活性，增加大脑磷脂含量，并使大脑胆固醇含量恢复正常）。 最终，在1999年，他们透露这些结果已在莫斯科医学院经政府批准的临床试验中开始得到验证。

content.en: While much could be said about their research, one of the key lessons I received was one of the clearest mechanistic explanations I’ve encountered for what adaptogens actually do (a term applied to many natural products) as the agents which effectively counteracted the entire stress process were explicitly characterized by the researchers as “adaptogens.”
content.cn: 虽然关于他们的研究可以谈论很多，但我从中获得的一个关键启示，是我迄今为止所见过的关于适应原（这一术语常用于指代许多天然产物）实际作用机制的最清晰的解释之一——因为研究人员明确将那些能够有效对抗整个应激过程的物质归类为“适应原”。

content.en: *Note: to compile the above summary and accurately represent their findings, I read through over 50 papers (many of which omitted key details) and did my best to integrate their findings with current physiologic science.
content.cn: 注：为了编写上述总结并准确反映这些研究成果，我通读了50余篇论文（其中许多省略了关键细节），并尽我所能将这些研究成果与当前的生理学研究相结合。*

content.en: With this understanding (and a further exploration of the importance of circulatory drainage which will be discussed in the Multiple Sclerosis section), let’s now examine how these properties allow DMSO to affect a wide range of neurological and psychiatric disorders.
content.cn: 基于这一认识（以及对循环引流重要性的进一步探讨——相关内容将在“多发性硬化症”一节中讨论），让我们现在来探讨这些特性如何使二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对各种神经系统和精神疾病产生影响。

content.en: Parkinson’s Disease
content.cn: 帕金森病

content.en: Parkinson’s disease results from the progressive loss of dopamine-producing neurons in the substantia nigra. Research in this field was revolutionized in the early 1980s when recreational drug users who injected a badly synthesized synthetic heroin rapidly developed severe Parkinson’s-like symptoms due to it being contaminated with MPTP, an agent whose active metabolite (MPP+) specifically targeted those neurons, making it possible to reliably model Parkinson’s in laboratory animals. This was followed by the realization that one herbicide (paraquat) was very similar to MPP+, another pesticide (rotenone) also causing similar damage to neurons, a variety of pesticides being linked to a higher risk of Parkinson’s (such as organophosphates), and 6-OHDA also being able to reliably create Parkinson’s.
content.cn: 帕金森病是由黑质中产生多巴胺的神经元逐渐丧失引起的。20世纪80年代初，该领域的研究发生了革命性变化：当时，一些娱乐性毒品使用者注射了合成工艺粗糙的合成海洛因后，迅速出现了严重的帕金森样症状，原因是该毒品被MPTP污染——这种物质的活性代谢物（MPP+）会特异性地作用于这些神经元，从而使得在实验动物身上可靠地模拟帕金森病成为可能。 随后人们发现，一种除草剂（百草枯）与MPP+非常相似；另一种农药（罗腾酮）也会对神经元造成类似损害；多种农药（如有机磷农药）与帕金森病风险升高有关；此外，6-OHDA也能可靠地诱发帕金森病。

content.en: *Note: one of the major challenges with glyphosate (Roundup) is that while it is toxic, the herbicides it largely replaced like paraquat are more toxic.
content.cn: 注：草甘膦（Roundup）面临的一大挑战在于，虽然它本身具有毒性，但它所取代的大部分除草剂（如百草枯）毒性更大。*

content.en: Numerous studies have shown that DMSO directly counteracts the neurotoxicity of these Parkinson’s-producing agents (e.g., in the organophosphate studies mentioned previously, DMSO repeatedly reduced mortality, accelerated organophosphate detoxification, and protected neuromuscular function). Most remarkably, [a case-control study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8170560/) of young-onset Parkinson’s disease (63 cases, 68 controls) found that individuals with Parkinson’s were one tenth as likely to have been exposed to DMSO as normal controls, suggesting DMSO exposure is associated with a roughly 10-fold reduction in disease risk (and hence may be protective against it). In contrast, the same study found insecticide exposure increased risk nearly 6-fold, fumigated housing over 5-fold, and herbicide exposure over 3-fold — results consistent with the extensive epidemiological literature linking pesticide exposure to Parkinson’s.
content.cn: 大量研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能直接抵消这些诱发帕金森病的物质的神经毒性（例如，在前文提到的有机磷研究中，DMSO多次降低了死亡率，加速了有机磷的解毒，并保护了神经肌肉功能）。 最引人注目的是，一项针对早发性帕金森病（63例病例，68例对照）的病例对照研究发现，帕金森病患者接触二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的概率仅为正常对照组的十分之一，这表明接触二甲基亚砜可使患病风险降低约10倍（因此可能具有预防作用）。 相比之下，同一项研究发现，接触杀虫剂会使患病风险增加近6倍，居住在经过熏蒸处理的房屋中会增加5倍以上，接触除草剂则会增加3倍以上——这些结果与大量将农药暴露与帕金森病联系起来的流行病学文献一致。

content.en: *Note: this study also found smoking was associated with reduced PD risk, a finding that aligns with decades of epidemiological evidence linking nicotine exposure to lower PD incidence, lending credibility to the study’s methodology.
content.cn: 注：该研究还发现，吸烟与帕金森病（PD）风险降低有关，这一发现与数十年来将尼古丁暴露与较低的帕金森病发病率联系起来的流行病学证据相一致，从而增强了该研究方法论的可信度。*

content.en: DMSO has directly demonstrated neuroprotective effects in multiple Parkinson’s models. In animals, DMSO suppressed hydroxyl radical-induced nigrostriatal injury from MPTP,<sup data-ref="219">219</sup>, <sup data-ref="220">220</sup>, <sup data-ref="221">221</sup>, <sup data-ref="222">222</sup> and in rotenone-induced Parkinson’s rats, [DMSO improved hippocampal CA1 and CA3 neuron morphology](https://pharmacophorejournal.com/article/effects-of-dimethyl-sulfoxide-on-hippocampal-activity-in-a-rotenone-induced-rat-model-of-parkinsonr-bdmvggfdf16zv1v), restoring pyramidal cells and Nissl bodies damaged by rotenone and normalizing their electrical activity. [DMSO also protected astrocytes from MPP+-induced toxicity](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9586799/) by reducing lipid peroxidation and metabolic impairment, [protected glial glutamine synthetase](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8833226/) from MPP+-induced hydroxyl radical damage, [protected human SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells from 6-OHDA-induced cytotoxicity](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7059360/), and [reduced both lipid peroxidation and protein carbonyl formation](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1056871910001620) in rat brain homogenates from ferrous chloride or hydrogen peroxide, and separately reduced hydroxyl radical production during 6-OHDA autoxidation and the formation of hydroxylated dopamine products.<sup data-ref="223">223</sup>, <sup data-ref="224">224</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已在多种帕金森病模型中直接展现出神经保护作用。 在动物实验中，DMSO抑制了MPTP诱导的羟基自由基所致黑质纹状体损伤， <sup data-ref="223">223</sup> <sup data-ref="224">224</sup> <sup data-ref="221">221</sup> <sup data-ref="222">222</sup> 而在罗腾酮诱导的帕金森病大鼠模型中，DMSO改善了海马CA1和CA3区神经元的形态，修复了受罗腾酮损伤的锥体细胞和尼氏小体，并使其电活动恢复正常。 二甲基亚砜还能通过减少脂质过氧化和代谢障碍，保护星形胶质细胞免受MPP+诱导的毒性；保护胶质细胞的谷氨酰胺合成酶免受MPP+诱导的羟基自由基损伤；保护人SH-SY5Y神经母细胞瘤细胞免受6-OHDA诱导的细胞毒性；并减少氯化亚铁或过氧化氢在大鼠脑匀浆中引起的脂质过氧化和蛋白质羰基的形成， 此外，它还能分别抑制6-OHDA自氧化过程中羟基自由基的产生以及羟基化多巴胺产物的形成。 <sup data-ref="223">223</sup> <sup data-ref="224">224</sup>

content.en: *Note: [in one mouse study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3489911/), intraperitoneal DMSO did not protect against MPTP-induced dopamine depletion, indicating its neuroprotective effects may depend on the route, timing, or dose of administration.
content.cn: 注：在一项小鼠研究中，腹腔注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）未能预防MPTP诱导的多巴胺耗竭，这表明其神经保护作用可能取决于给药途径、时间或剂量。*

content.en: Interestingly, DMS (DMSO’s naturally occurring, odor-producing metabolite) at near-physiological concentrations also protected neurons against both 6-OHDA and MPP+-induced apoptosis, with this effect being dependent upon MsrA (the enzyme that converts DMS to DMSO), suggesting the endogenous DMS-DMSO cycle functions as part of the body’s natural antioxidant defense against dopaminergic neurodegeneration.<sup data-ref="225">225</sup>, <sup data-ref="226">226</sup> This, in turn, raises an interesting conundrum as I have received a few reports of Parkinson’s patients who had dramatic responses to DMSO who then stopped due to the odor impeding sexual relations with their spouse, and my first thought was to recommend a low odor DMSO formulation (discussed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-does-dmso-make-some-people-smell)), but if DMS plays a key therapeutic role in Parkinson’s disease, that approach may not be viable.
content.cn: 有趣的是， 在接近生理浓度的条件下，DMS（DMSO的一种天然产生的、具有气味代谢产物）也能保护神经元免受6-OHDA和MPP+诱导的凋亡，且这种效应依赖于MsrA（将DMS转化为DMSO的酶），这表明内源性DMS-DMSO循环作为机体对抗多巴胺能神经退行性变的天然抗氧化防御机制的一部分发挥着作用。 <sup data-ref="225">225</sup> <sup data-ref="226">226</sup> 这反过来又引发了一个有趣的难题：我曾收到几份关于帕金森病患者的报告，他们对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）反应显著，但随后因气味影响与配偶的性生活而停药。我的第一反应是推荐一种低气味的二甲基亚砜制剂（详见此处）， 但如果二甲基亚砜在帕金森病治疗中确实发挥着关键作用，这种做法可能并不可行。

content.en: *Note: [that study](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9sxxlkkbz5NwnDlTEYxlyHWfS-iTkfMxP9YIES1tnTfbIUSpbfxCILKHII4rsCADs_-Go_aAGMWd9DiQaeMoOAVF3VRS51Ymishdsl-BwS6FYjteTrtVLidAVQnqheIlaXrnpPcNQk6apyu5qFuRXBPBjc9tRYDHwSCRwfq-ZTEb_lBFnANcsDr511-8vCa0jN_50Zyg3XM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) also found DMS protected against H₂O₂-induced lipid peroxidation and antimycin A generated superoxide production.
content.cn: 注：该研究还发现，DMS能抑制H₂O₂诱导的脂质过氧化以及抗霉素A产生的超氧化物。*

content.en: Additionally, [DMSO reversed rotenone’s complete blockade of microtubule assembly from purified tubulin in vitro](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/568944/) — a finding with direct relevance to Parkinson’s, as microtubule disruption impairs axonal transport and contributes to dopaminergic neuron death. Likewise, [a Russian physical therapy monograph](https://fiziosfera.ru/userfiles/modules/FilesInProduct/files/%D0%9A%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F%20%D1%84%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%8F%20%D0%B2%20%D0%BD%D0%B5%D0%B2%D1%80%D0%BE%D0%BB%D0%BE%D0%B3%D0%B8%D0%B8_3948.pdf) recommended topical DMSO novocaine compresses for neurological conditions including Parkinson’s, and [a patent](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=48380782) proposed DMSO as a transdermal enhancer for a botulinum toxin patch to treat the spasticity associated with Parkinson’s, cerebral palsy, dystonia, and multiple sclerosis.
content.cn: 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）逆转了罗特酮对体外纯化微管蛋白微管组装的完全阻断——这一发现与帕金森病直接相关，因为微管结构的破坏会阻碍轴突运输，并导致多巴胺能神经元死亡。 同样，一份俄罗斯物理治疗专著建议对包括帕金森病在内的神经系统疾病采用局部DMSO-诺卡因湿敷疗法；还有一项专利提议将DMSO用作肉毒杆菌毒素贴片的经皮吸收增强剂，以治疗帕金森病、脑瘫、肌张力障碍和多发性硬化症相关的痉挛。

content.en: *Note: a large number of studies (which will be discussed later in this series) show DMSO stabilizes microtubules and likely accounts for some of its neuroprotective qualities.
content.cn: 注：大量研究（本系列后续将对此进行讨论）表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能稳定微管，这很可能就是其部分神经保护作用的来源。*

content.en: A vast number of agents in combination with DMSO have also shown therapeutic benefit in Parkinson’s models.
content.cn: 大量与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物在帕金森病模型中也显示出治疗效果。

content.en: Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> protected nigral dopaminergic neurons, reduced iNOS and glial activation, and upregulated neuroprotective pathways (IGF-1/Akt/FoxO3a).<sup data-ref="227">227</sup>, <sup data-ref="228">228</sup>
content.cn: 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 保护了黑质多巴胺能神经元，降低了iNOS水平和胶质细胞活化程度，并上调了神经保护通路（IGF-1/Akt/FoxO3a）。 <sup data-ref="227">227</sup> <sup data-ref="228">228</sup>

content.en: Paeoniflorin <sup>⬖</sup> repeatedly reduced α-synuclein expression, decreased Lewy body formation, and protected dopaminergic neurons across multiple studies.<sup data-ref="229">229</sup>, <sup data-ref="230">230</sup> It also inhibited microglial overactivation, increased BDNF and GDNF secretion, and promoted neural stem cell differentiation into dopaminergic neurons.<sup data-ref="231">231</sup>
content.cn: 多项研究表明，芍药苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 能反复降低α-突触核蛋白的表达，减少路易小体的形成，并保护多巴胺能神经元。 <sup data-ref="231">231</sup> <sup data-ref="230">230</sup> 此外，它还能抑制小胶质细胞过度活化，增加脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）和胶质细胞源性神经营养因子（GDNF）的分泌，并促进神经干细胞分化为多巴胺能神经元。 <sup data-ref="231">231</sup>

content.en: [Icariside II](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202102&filename=1018838444.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=881T22K5spNvWy1dCmAS5EmMEv1KEu4GrZnn5ChGaw93N0wKALLE24TYznY1UIw6) <sup>⬖</sup> induced human amniotic mesenchymal stem cells to differentiate into dopaminergic neuron-like cells (optimal at 3–10 μmol/L via PI3K signaling). [In another protocol](https://assets-eu.researchsquare.com/files/pex-954/v1/1697c37e-ef06-48f9-a1b0-875e3681e1fa.pdf) DMSO helped differentiate iPSCs into dopaminergic progenitors for PD stem cell therapy.
content.cn: 伊卡里西德 II <sup>⬖</sup> 可诱导人羊膜间充质干细胞分化为多巴胺能神经元样细胞（通过 PI3K 信号通路，3–10 μmol/L 浓度下效果最佳）。在另一项实验方案中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有助于将诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）分化为多巴胺能前体细胞，用于帕金森病（PD）的干细胞治疗。

content.en: Ginsenosides Rg1 <sup>⬖</sup> and Rg3 <sup>⬖</sup> both significantly attenuated dopaminergic neuron loss, neuroinflammation, and α-synuclein accumulation.<sup data-ref="232">232</sup>, <sup data-ref="233">233</sup>, <sup data-ref="234">234</sup>, <sup data-ref="235">235</sup>
content.cn: 人参皂苷Rg1 <sup>⬖</sup> 和Rg3 <sup>⬖</sup> 均显著减轻了多巴胺能神经元丢失、神经炎症以及α-突触核蛋白的积累。 <sup data-ref="232">232</sup> <sup data-ref="233">233</sup> <sup data-ref="234">234</sup> <sup data-ref="235">235</sup>

content.en: [Geniposide](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2018&filename=1018088637.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=QGsGSIUP79OR5EQ7hKiSRr3aEK9ZU2RKivkkowDoQiDNq5Fe-laxKh6JozjGqeXF) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced α-synuclein levels and prevented dopaminergic neuron loss by modulating the miR-21/LAMP2A axis, while ginkgolide B <sup>⬖</sup> similarly reduced α-synuclein expression via the related miR-207/LAMP2A pathway.<sup data-ref="236">236</sup>, <sup data-ref="237">237</sup> [Ambroxol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxmMuN3bnVT1Wr7oCjlFuNwgc55JAWxxqyzlu4b7niddHVPhF6f0NlgbyjaSxyAat2nc-mfox7hTL6dceeB9aNige37zWlHEoxDUGsn2zGgepZ_STDO0PqVYCCB_2fka174WSFFixbHwBfgnBb4DE-p0QhXqGlMETR6HPGXAOr_KiEdDlHrX6xOX&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) increased β-glucocerebrosidase activity and reduced α-synuclein oligomer levels, restoring cell viability and mitochondrial function in dopaminergic neurons. [Polyphenols](https://docs.lib.purdue.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1847&context=jpur) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced seeded α-synuclein aggregation via NRF2-mediated antioxidant responses. [Carnosic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27091487/) <sup>⬖</sup> attenuated 6-OHDA neurotoxicity by upregulating parkin and restoring proteasomal clearance of ubiquitinated proteins in cellular and animal PD models.
content.cn: 吉诺苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过调节 miR-21/LAMP2A 轴降低了 α-突触核蛋白水平并预防了多巴胺能神经元的丧失，而银杏内酯 B <sup>⬖</sup> 则通过相关的 miR-207/LAMP2A 通路以类似方式降低了 α-突触核蛋白的表达。 <sup data-ref="236">236</sup> <sup data-ref="237">237</sup> 氨溴索可提高β-葡萄糖脑苷酶活性并降低α-突触核蛋白寡聚体水平，从而恢复多巴胺能神经元的细胞存活率和线粒体功能。多酚类物质 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过NRF2介导的抗氧化反应，抑制了种子诱导的α-突触核蛋白聚集。 肉豆蔻酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过上调帕金蛋白（parkin）并恢复细胞和动物帕金森病模型中泛素化蛋白的蛋白酶体清除，减轻了 6-OHDA 引起的神经毒性。

content.en: [L-sulforaphane](https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0021907) <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO activated the NRF2 pathway in Parkinson’s disease patient-derived cells, restoring their deficient glutathione levels — one of the only studies using actual patient cells.
content.cn: 溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的L-硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 在帕金森病患者来源的细胞中激活了NRF2通路，恢复了其不足的谷胱甘肽水平——这是为数不多的几项使用真实患者细胞的研究之一。

content.en: [Most uniquely](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36345707/), NAMI-A — a low-toxicity ruthenium-DMSO complex — inhibited α-synuclein aggregation and membrane interactions with submicromolar affinity, disassembled pre-formed fibrils, abolished α-synuclein cytotoxicity toward neuronal cells, and mitigated neurodegeneration and motor impairments in a rat Parkinson’s model, providing a novel basis for designing ruthenium-DMSO complexes that target α-synuclein-driven pathology through a mechanism distinct from organic agents.
content.cn: 最独特的是，NAMI-A——一种低毒性的钌-二甲基亚砜（DMSO）配合物——以亚微摩尔级亲和力抑制了α-突触核蛋白的聚集及其与细胞膜的相互作用，解体了已形成的纤维束， 消除了α-突触核蛋白对神经元的细胞毒性，并在大鼠帕金森病模型中减轻了神经退行性变和运动功能障碍，为设计钌-二甲基亚砜（DMSO）配合物提供了新的依据，该配合物通过有别于有机药物的机制，针对由α-突触核蛋白驱动的病理过程发挥作用。

content.en: In MPTP models, [tanshinone IIA](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015016473.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=CvbzrFv9jWaUa3d3hrV_7OiXlSJ_K4_ML-8OURFj9asCbBcPv9dfGhmS0CPdA66C) <sup>⬖</sup> preserved approximately 75% of dopaminergic neurons while reducing microglial activation; [tetramethylpyrazine](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015961316.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=wWNGgSFI3oDCN59-4MBrG-aCvh6XG353tpE-CkDzLFDjwDeFVDwiaGSs-uLQD_r-) <sup>⬖</sup> prevented motor deficits and neuron loss via the Nrf2 pathway; [6-Hydroxy-1H-indazole](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1016013364.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=HWF6eLpdu0iX8hjeAJjPJ3sp3Wjrn7I89azGyPpt2AMzLTlNZCrRo-BHJBgVod1W) protected 90-93% of dopaminergic neurons from death; [baicalein](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUoWvPCoM4TwmH89poz5Cp_59Yr0xFM3wiCia-26KtipoYAmKwdVGmZYFzojiRCdTCzSI3f8FlTQH9u_gsIao2ktxLXQUdUC7mV2XtKdgGNd2eSnW0viL7BN17hQZ2W1nkFSk6CYVtGpHNv1k-wCDQ2CRvqqAb413n-81HsERpMzgp1TJ3scvun8&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently reduced rotation behavior (a key indicator of motor impairment), neuroinflammation, and dopaminergic neuron apoptosis via Wnt/β-catenin; [neferine](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUoqZwkuFRL150MYc7m0XMwMpaxWyj3-i_WkSLBJzqAckO26_C_q7KpvUb7CmeDj_gkYYjLFVYXgTuxegubvT1VDADAXz8eQjprPozDng-AeOJ_0LurEoLBYbMDG5jxTnGH4wOj7nS7Sw_iF_EuH_CRaDaJJUo1blh6IsPb1QCljjOuPC2xTuqkaS5LCcCZutBo=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> improved mouse motor disorders and reduced neuroinflammation and α-synuclein in the substantia nigra; [SB239063](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2014&filename=SJJP201403014&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=g6UVH0Q2VjO20P5Hmj0hH6pDoP6XNH4JsYiNYhw8Zr-bOeCm1f55LBvjzULleZYz) (a p38 MAPK inhibitor) protected TH-positive neurons; [NESS 0327](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcvzSHEphHHmKStTXGZGL5S0N5kISQmqZyz0b5nBaXncR-QDjMcWazZp1qbwwLYlbZTyZ88L7DSV6n61c7y3EVTYz7ma4-Dh8t5Z6GBqua8IrPQIepME48lZ7okQXg1ghG0_ndMg8fDSqFUrapQA5dn2ACPbfM7XE1aOCCXII70hKK0DnEOjdgcj&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (a CB1 receptor antagonist) ameliorated motor deficits; [novel c-Abl kinase inhibitors](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVCADlpGyCW3g_OPYlRjwWuVUYns08Z2AJWcuLVik2DlW3tAytx5QZg7cxH_qHot6w7a3T06CMBUCSWwostCpZKXcNzUD8ftgfPs07asDo6fnu0aEsbE4eM9Z0QpHTPtzxOcZ0cXolpzULKtJH1Qm8UFVMJ0BVgH51fGAFIi-UjX2v83HULnfvHVxLg296YC8-Q=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) outperformed nilotinib in blocking MPP+-induced apoptosis; [GW5074](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1517/13543784.2011.550874) prevented TH-positive neuron loss in mice genetically engineered to have PD. In nigrostriatal pathway injury mice, both ERK inhibition ([U0126](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27402431/)) and PDGFRα inhibition ([AG1296](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tcTPr29AdaOrQcQ0Bxqn1bbGhwN1WaUyUpUpmmTiwSPSy8hu4G9xUB1-VzlADAkMb52NHZ1P7NzoQNhyZmZ62UqYZROctjBzQ8wvvk5XrNBd8F37dCPSJvXOsYUhU2mAFaLtB59H4pCKN08Qelf-YjP_PPnVCkPqZkRuDcJ2bmOMKIfp7Q4o_oK&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN)) reduced glial activation and scarring, with U0126 also improving long-term neurobehavioral outcomes.
content.cn: 在MPTP模型中，丹参酮IIA <sup>⬖</sup> 在抑制小胶质细胞活化的同时，保留了约75%的多巴胺能神经元；四甲基吡嗪 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过Nrf2通路预防了运动功能障碍和神经元丢失； 6-羟基-1H-吲唑保护了90%-93%的多巴胺能神经元免于死亡；黄芩素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过Wnt/β-catenin通路，以剂量依赖性方式减轻了旋转行为（运动功能障碍的关键指标）、神经炎症以及多巴胺能神经元凋亡； 内费林 <sup>⬖</sup> 改善了小鼠的运动障碍，并减少了黑质中的神经炎症和α-突触核蛋白； SB239063（一种p38 MAPK抑制剂）保护了TH阳性神经元；NESS 0327（一种CB1受体拮抗剂）改善了运动功能缺陷；新型c-Abl激酶抑制剂在阻断MPP+诱导的凋亡方面优于尼洛替尼；GW5074防止了基因工程帕金森病小鼠中TH阳性神经元的丢失。 在黑质纹状体通路受损的小鼠模型中，ERK抑制剂（U0126）和PDGFRα抑制剂（AG1296）均能减轻胶质细胞活化和瘢痕形成，其中U0126还改善了长期神经行为预后。

content.en: [In LPS-induced PD mice](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxm-VtYiFfNzUfFthbBM4nn00dQNz-bEWGhWV3m_Jdp0Kye1z2qGac6r6GyteFv-RNRVxPI7GB0I6hSN76FQgra2u8pDwwNAbq4Rs5LtgpxSBiRCv8psyiJJW3SoqLjC-M-AsbKpNS7IclEB5IER2jhwzoHl1CDZg3cOTdpAIi-ZXRMWrlgjrBmo&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), pazopanib protected dopaminergic neurons by suppressing TNF-α, PGE2, and IL-6 via MEK4-JNK-AP-1 signaling, while rapamycin reduced neuroinflammation by enhancing microglial lipid metabolism.
content.cn: 在LPS诱导的帕金森病小鼠模型中，帕唑帕尼通过MEK4-JNK-AP-1信号通路抑制TNF-α、PGE2和IL-6的表达，从而保护多巴胺能神经元；而雷帕霉素则通过增强小胶质细胞的脂质代谢来减轻神经炎症。

content.en: [NBP](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD2012&filename=1012014494.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=1hJe_sD648M_lZe7UHXFO9DhuexH_nWva1QSxjdVsh5Jce-xeGbEnOFwCGl27vs8) (a Chinese stroke medication) rescued dopaminergic neurons by 30% and striatal dopamine terminals by 49%. [Carvacrol](https://openurl.ebsco.com/EPDB%3Agcd%3A1%3A8016561/detailv2?sid=ebsco%3Aplink%3Ascholar&id=ebsco%3Agcd%3A162489143&crl=c&link_origin=scholar.google.com) <sup>⬖</sup> (found in oregano and thyme oils) was neuroprotective via TRPC1 inhibition in dopaminergic neurons and TRPA1 activation in astrocytes. [Dasatinib and resveratrol](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Vadivelan-Ramachandran-3/publication/343736156_BEHAVIORAL_STUDIES_OF_DASATINIB_AND_RESVERATROL_IN_ROTENONE_INDUCED_PARKINSON'S_RAT_MODEL/links/5f3cb394299bf13404cedf14/BEHAVIORAL-STUDIES-OF-DASATINIB-AND-RESVERATROL-IN-ROTENONE-INDUCED-PARKINSONS-RAT-MODEL.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> in combination improved learning, memory, motor coordination, and reduced anxiety. [MOTS-c <sup>⬖</sup> improved motor function](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=hmNf6PfbaBsOoMOeglpI6LPtKK-gnx0YOcpFfQXqMa_s8abj9qz0QpBfF-xTJR1t5-MUALWomusWTJ-mSFiZ_sLdGPK7duYBiNnuDl3P7TMLzp8XsL4EKnz6KqedsLIaIt01IGhIaS8NK78r3qu2E7gRgsXBbFUjCtpb0Uh83eV-nsFSkmaLGM_ZUoUMm90vM5Ye0Oicy24=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), reversed TH-positive neuron loss, and activated the Nrf2/Keap1 antioxidant pathway in rotenone PD rats. [Puerarin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201401&filename=1014028577.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=KnndMPn2rQQPacaKqhQWi6niUBB79ncIhVRDSkgob9sCDUcU34LMCkeOGxX3-Dgs) <sup>⬖</sup> mitigated rotation behavior and upregulated DAT, VMAT2, and TH in rotenone PD rats. [A caspase inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201402&filename=1014267315.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=l0TBNXaSXNDhuGjq-F6uWldsiK6kRz1kapzYAbJDfvt9Ql0YWCMTijha4VaLwJp5) reduced neuron loss and improved rotation behavior in 6-OHDA rats, though blocking apoptosis triggered compensatory glial necroptosis.
content.cn: NBP（一种中国的中风药物）使多巴胺能神经元的存活率提高了30%，纹状体多巴胺突触末梢的存活率提高了49%。百里香酚 <sup>⬖</sup> （存在于牛至和百里香精油中）通过抑制多巴胺能神经元中的TRPC1通道以及激活星形胶质细胞中的TRPA1通道，发挥了神经保护作用。 达沙替尼与白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合应用可改善学习、记忆和运动协调能力，并减轻焦虑。MOTS-c <sup>⬖</sup> 可改善罗滕酮诱导的帕金森病大鼠的运动功能，逆转TH阳性神经元的丢失，并激活Nrf2/Keap1抗氧化通路。 葛根素 <sup>⬖</sup> 减轻了罗腾酮诱导的帕金森病大鼠的旋转行为，并上调了DAT、VMAT2和TH的表达。一种半胱天冬酶抑制剂减少了6-OHDA大鼠的神经元丢失并改善了其旋转行为，尽管阻断凋亡会触发补偿性胶质细胞坏死性凋亡。

content.en: Shuimuheningfang <sup>⬖</sup> improved motor and non-motor symptoms in 80 PD patients and reduced α-synuclein in model mice,<sup data-ref="238">238</sup>, <sup data-ref="239">239</sup> while [Compound Dihuang Granules](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahK05boSOXUwuZljcD9aq9NUry95t0S92UN3iO5KQFJjibk-bCPiBPzCQ7UX0ETIlB4v-ZCfp3F2FInAQK7hjMCurTApT6f89K9lKvek8Holbcl_12Vrd6CdUYQDa03EQrkzf23NtzZPpcjHd8yjwtx7THDJHu5-qpkVTVseajIDXHawCHSF0YjtRKBXa0FmVeM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (with a JNK inhibitor) reduced rotation behavior and protected dopaminergic neurons in 6-OHDA rats.
content.cn: 水母宁方 <sup>⬖</sup> 改善了 80 名帕金森病患者的运动和非运动症状，并降低了模型小鼠体内的 α-突触核蛋白水平， <sup data-ref="238">238</sup> <sup data-ref="239">239</sup> 而二黄颗粒 <sup>⬖</sup> （含 JNK 抑制剂）则减少了 6-OHDA 大鼠的旋转行为，并保护了多巴胺能神经元。

content.en: [In C. elegans PD models](https://opendata.uni-halle.de/bitstream/1981185920/103152/1/Dissertation_MLU_2022_SaierChristina.pdf), olive leaf extract <sup>⬖</sup> strongly protected dopaminergic neurons from 6-OHDA toxicity (up to ~56% less degeneration), while oleuropein,<sup>⬖</sup> oleanolic acid,<sup>⬖</sup> tyrosol,<sup>⬖</sup> 3-hydroxytyrosol,<sup>⬖</sup> saffron,<sup>⬖</sup> Polygonum multiflorum,<sup>⬖</sup> and Ziziphus jujuba <sup>⬖</sup> each also provided significant protection.
content.cn: 在秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）帕金森病（PD）模型中，橄榄叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 能显著保护多巴胺能神经元免受 6-OHDA 的毒性作用（退化程度降低高达约 56%），而橄榄苦苷、 <sup>⬖</sup> 熊果酸、 <sup>⬖</sup> 酪醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 3-羟基酪醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 藏红花、 <sup>⬖</sup> 何首乌、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及枣 <sup>⬖</sup> 均提供了显著的保护作用。

content.cn: 在帕金森病（PD）模型中表现出神经保护作用的其他物质还包括瓜拉纳 <sup>⬖</sup> （在SH-SY5Y细胞中对抗罗腾酮）、 南极磷虾油 <sup>⬖</sup> （改善斑马鱼的运动能力并促进多巴胺能神经元功能）、叶黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> （以剂量依赖性方式改善大鼠的认知和运动功能）、内生真菌来源的细胞松弛素化合物（对抗MPP+）、丝光豆提取物、 <sup>⬖</sup> 吡唑酸、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及木酮酯衍生物 <sup>⬖</sup> （对抗6-OHDA或活性氧介导的损伤）， 丁酸钠 <sup>⬖</sup> （一种组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂，可通过表观遗传机制恢复多巴胺转运体和VMAT2的表达，对抗罗腾酮和MPP+），全孕烷醇酮（通过BDNF和CaMKIIδ3促进TH阳性细胞再生，对抗6-OHDA），韦德洛内酮 <sup>⬖</sup> （上调了帕金森病相关神经保护蛋白DJ-1/PARK7的表达）、德美沙多明（通过ERK1/2介导的组蛋白乙酰化发挥神经保护作用），以及7,8-二羟基黄酮、 <sup>⬖</sup> 虫草素 <sup>⬖</sup> （在PC12细胞中对抗罗腾酮）， AMG9810（一种TRPV1拮抗剂，可减轻运动功能障碍，但长期使用会损害认知功能）、胰岛素联合TLR4抑制剂TAK242（可改善6-OHDA大鼠的运动表现并使α-突触核蛋白水平恢复正常）、卡塔波尔 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低α-突触核蛋白水平并改善线粒体功能，对抗罗腾酮）、染料木黄酮、 <sup>⬖</sup> 桃荷四物汤、 <sup>⬖</sup> 川芎化合物、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及黑种草脂肪酸。 <sup>⬖</sup>

content.en: Since paraquat and other herbicides are among the strongest environmental risk factors for Parkinson’s, it is also noteworthy that DMSO has been shown across multiple studies to scavenge the hydroxyl radicals generated by paraquat,<sup data-ref="240">240</sup>, <sup data-ref="241">241</sup>, <sup data-ref="242">242</sup>, <sup data-ref="243">243</sup> including [direct evidence](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7705301/) from rats of DMSO intercepting paraquat-generated hydroxyl radicals via Fenton-like chemistry, and [in bacterial biosensor assays](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=40808369), DMSO scavenges up to 96% of the superoxide radicals generated by paraquat. DMSO has also been shown [to be directly neuroprotective against paraquat in cultured striatal cells](https://repository.kulib.kyoto-u.ac.jp/server/api/core/bitstreams/d511606c-2371-47c7-81dd-32b831570c26/content), [suppress paraquat-induced inflammatory signaling](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8142610/) (e.g., IL-8 and neutrophil chemotactic activity), and [protect DNA from paraquat-induced mutagenesis](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7687022/) — providing a potential mechanistic explanation for the epidemiological finding that DMSO exposure is inversely associated with Parkinson’s risk. Additionally, [myrtenol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39806385/),<sup>⬖</sup> [andrographolide](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxlGpgZ-m1FZaz0u8TaZL987_qv3d3wol4l0f42fGMjR0Z1e5w0vJACfkdhcTno6OY2ORLvQEG7DfWBFLcDGE2XjOGw1dUZK-BSQQsMa9U8HyRRIQtK3yeX32a6FHrikb1vVe3lBVsAYjARUJMdgaxsrtF3fFzuxlhJXNPFF21qYx0OAZ7KqtIPH&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (via Nrf2/HO-1), [VPA](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202001&filename=1019892158.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=fs5iraizR_lGP_r5DAJoVDHwij1nfJOhtNOiYw_sP7y7-P1PNfFWuOWJdm2GGmAe) (an HDAC inhibitor), [chymostatin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28940034/), [propofol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=BJYX201411023&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=wh1YGWcAIEkKPxMxwfxtdehCaE9Q2TtSFILKgSKJPEym2UBy2dFZzRhOagzuS6mU) and [resveratrol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD2011&filename=2010240065.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=pupFayGrUVWRKbzlsGXSyKxshr16K5h8HC6qBwv5Vhna203pmNGHK1gGfaCSxGXV) <sup>⬖</sup> each combined with DMSO to counteract paraquat-induced toxicity and oxidative stress across various tissue models.
content.cn: 鉴于百草枯和其他除草剂是导致帕金森病的最强环境风险因素之一，值得注意的是，多项研究表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够清除百草枯产生的水氧自由基， <sup data-ref="240">240</sup> <sup data-ref="241">241</sup> <sup data-ref="242">242</sup> <sup data-ref="243">243</sup> 其中包括来自大鼠实验的直接证据，表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可通过芬顿反应（Fenton-like chemistry）拦截百草枯产生的羟基自由基；而在细菌生物传感器实验中，DMSO可清除高达96%的百草枯产生的超氧阴离子自由基。 研究还表明，在培养的纹状体细胞中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能直接对抗百草枯产生的神经保护作用，抑制百草枯诱导的炎症信号传导（例如IL-8和中性粒细胞趋化活性），并保护DNA免受百草枯诱导的致突变作用——这为流行病学研究中“二甲基亚砜暴露与帕金森病风险呈负相关”这一发现提供了潜在的机制解释。 此外，没药醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 穿心莲内酯 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过Nrf2/HO-1通路）、VPA（一种组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂）、基质抑制剂、丙泊酚和白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 均能与DMSO协同作用，在多种组织模型中对抗百草枯诱导的毒性和氧化应激。

content.en: *Note: α-synuclein aggregation into toxic fibrils is a core driver of Parkinson’s neurodegeneration. [One study found](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6591385/) DMSO at 0.75-1.0%, especially when combined with ferric iron, promoted α-synuclein oligomer formation and cytotoxicity. However, [when oral DMSO was tested](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-022-07706-2) in living mice (both normal and transgenic mice overexpressing human α-synuclein), no increase in α-synuclein aggregation, no neuronal loss, and no Parkinson’s-like pathology was detected. Likewise, DMSO injected directly into the substantia nigra has not been found to cause dopaminergic neuron loss, ubiquitinated protein accumulation, or behavioral deficits <sup data-ref="244">244</sup>, <sup data-ref="245">245</sup> — suggesting that whatever pro-aggregant effect DMSO has on α-synuclein in isolated cell cultures (at much higher concentrations than it can reach clinically) does not translate to the living body.
content.cn: 注：α-突触核蛋白聚集形成有毒纤维是帕金森病神经退行性变的核心驱动因素。 一项研究发现，浓度为0.75%-1.0%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO），尤其是与三价铁结合时，会促进α-突触核蛋白寡聚体的形成并引发细胞毒性。然而，在活体小鼠（包括正常小鼠和过表达人类α-突触核蛋白的转基因小鼠）中进行口服DMSO实验时，未检测到α-突触核蛋白聚集增加、神经元丢失或帕金森病样病理变化。 同样，直接注射到黑质的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被证实不会导致多巴胺能神经元丢失、泛素化蛋白积累或行为缺陷 <sup data-ref="244">244</sup> <sup data-ref="245">245</sup> ——这表明，无论二甲基亚砜在分离细胞培养中（其浓度远高于临床可达浓度）对α-突触核蛋白具有何种促聚集效应，都不会在活体中产生相应影响。*

content.en: In addition to the experimental evidence, I have received a few reports from readers and physicians who had success with DMSO. As my experience is primarily with IV DMSO (which I believe offers the greatest benefit), I wanted to share this entire sample which includes non-IV approaches to illustrate the difference between them.
content.cn: 除了实验证据外，我还收到了一些来自读者和医生的报告，他们使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）取得了良好效果。由于我的经验主要集中在静脉注射二甲基亚砜（我认为这种方式效果最佳），因此我想分享这整份案例集——其中也包含非静脉注射的方法——以说明它们之间的区别。

content.en: [One wife described](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/200970754) what happened when her husband with Parkinson’s received an IV drip of mannitol and DMSO during stem cell therapy in Amsterdam: “He bounced down a flight of stairs without using the handrails, cut his own food for a week after, spoke clearly, opened cab doors.” They knew it wasn’t the stem cells, which would take months to show results.
content.cn: 一位妻子描述了她的丈夫在阿姆斯特丹接受干细胞治疗期间，通过静脉滴注甘露醇和二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后发生的情况：“他没有扶着扶手就一蹦一跳地跑下了一段楼梯，之后的一周里还能自己切食物，说话清晰，还能自己打开出租车车门。”他们知道这并不是干细胞起的作用，因为干细胞治疗通常需要数月才能见效。

content.en: [The most detailed](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/72436114) report came from a research scientist diagnosed with PD in 2018, who had already controlled his non-motor symptoms with sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> (an Nrf2 activator) but still had the full range of motor symptoms. After systematically testing oral DMSO over several months, he found that at an optimal dose, bradykinesia was eliminated, pain and dystonia reduced by 80%, stiffness reduced by 50%, and energy levels were markedly higher. He observed that DMSO addressed motor symptoms where sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> had not, suggesting DMSO was reaching the brain in ways sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> could not — consistent with DMSO’s known ability to cross the blood-brain barrier. Notably, doses above his threshold reliably worsened tremor, stiffness, and sleep, but these effects fully reversed within two days of stopping.
content.cn: 最详细的报告来自一位于2018年被诊断出患有帕金森病的科研人员，他虽然已通过硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> （一种Nrf2激活剂）控制了非运动症状，但仍存在全套运动症状。 经过数月对口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的系统性测试，他发现，在最佳剂量下，运动迟缓症状完全消失，疼痛和肌张力障碍减轻了80%，僵硬感减轻了50%，且精力水平显著提高。 他观察到，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）改善了硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 未能改善的运动症状，这表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 无法企及的方式到达了大脑——这与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已知的穿透血脑屏障的能力相一致。值得注意的是，超过其阈值的剂量会可靠地加剧震颤、僵硬和睡眠问题，但这些影响在停药后两天内完全逆转。

content.en: [A third reported](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/146718940) that topical and oral DMSO initially helped her husband with Parkinson’s walk short distances, but the effect did not persist.
content.cn: 还有一位受访者表示，外用和口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）起初确实帮助她患有帕金森病的丈夫走了一小段路，但这种效果并未持续。

content.en: [Another reported](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/258055495) a dramatic improvement in a myriad of severe Parkinson’s symptoms when her husband DMSO was given intravenously in conjunction with stem cells.
content.cn: 还有一位患者报告称，当她的丈夫接受二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与干细胞联合静脉注射治疗后，多种严重的帕金森病症状出现了显著改善。

content.en: Additionally, I have also received a few reports of oral DMSO helping readers with Parkinson’s, but as they were in passing (verbally) I can’t offer any specifics on them.
content.cn: 此外，我还收到过几则关于口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对帕金森病患者有帮助的报告，但由于这些信息只是顺带提到的（口头传达），因此我无法提供任何具体细节。

content.en: Given all of this (and our own experiences with Parkinson’s), I believe DMSO has great potential for Parkinson’s disease — oral administration is likely to benefit patients, IV significantly more so — and that the best results will ultimately come from combining DMSO with a complementary neurotrophic agent. Currently, I have identified one very promising candidate for this purpose (along with a few other possibilities), but as the combination studies above demonstrate, there are likely many more waiting to be discovered.
content.cn: 鉴于以上种种（以及我们自身在帕金森病方面的经验），我认为二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在治疗帕金森病方面具有巨大潜力——口服给药可能对患者有益，而静脉注射的效果则更为显著——而且，最终最佳疗效将来自将DMSO与一种互补的神经营养剂联合使用。 目前，我已为此目的确定了一个非常有前景的候选药物（此外还有其他几种可能性），但正如上述联合研究表明的那样，可能还有许多其他候选药物有待发现。

content.en: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
content.cn: 肌萎缩性侧索硬化症（ALS）

content.en: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is a progressive neurodegenerative disease in which the motor neurons that control voluntary movement gradually die, leading to increasing muscle weakness, paralysis, and typically death within 2–5 years of diagnosis. No cure exists, and the few FDA-approved drugs provide only modest survival benefits. However, [as Todd’s story](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GB83pMRJLro) shows (particularly [since he was willing to prove DMSO worked](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FM7au2vNAnI) by repeatedly discontinuing it and then documenting the rapid worsening of symptoms that started), there is hope for ALS. In turn, there is also some research to corroborate it:
content.cn: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，其特征是控制随意运动的运动神经元逐渐死亡，导致肌肉无力日益加重、瘫痪，患者通常在确诊后2至5年内死亡。 目前尚无根治方法，而少数几款经美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的药物也仅能带来有限的生存获益。然而，正如托德的故事所示（尤其是他为了证明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有效，曾多次停用该药物，并记录了随后症状迅速恶化的过程），肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的治疗仍存希望。此外，也有一些研究结果佐证了这一点：

content.en: •In ALS model mice, long-term oral administration of 5% DMSO significantly increased mean survival time, reduced neurological scores, and improved motor performance (with the improvements being primarily functional rather than histological).<sup data-ref="246">246</sup>, <sup data-ref="247">247</sup>
content.cn: •在ALS模型小鼠中，长期口服5%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著延长了平均生存时间，降低了神经功能评分，并改善了运动功能（这些改善主要体现在功能层面，而非组织学层面）。 <sup data-ref="246">246</sup> <sup data-ref="247">247</sup>

content.en: • [Low concentrations of DMSO](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2019&filename=1019058003.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=bEdfYYEI-U_v-1_3aaaloMG7JnKqzAXr7Hg8TyFggbCGXsSl9C3WzdDl7rbL6cEe) were found to stabilize SOD1 protein conformation (SOD1 misfolding is a central cause of ALS). Additionally, 5-fluorouridine and epigallocatechin gallate <sup>⬖</sup> (which is often combined with DMSO) also stabilized SOD1.
content.cn: • 研究发现，低浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能稳定SOD1蛋白的构象（SOD1蛋白错误折叠是肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的主要病因）。此外，5-氟尿苷和表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯 <sup>⬖</sup> （常与DMSO联合使用）也能稳定SOD1。

content.en: •A variety of agents in combination with DMSO have also shown therapeutic benefit in ALS mice. [Chronic intraperitoneal resveratrol](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0006899312015041) <sup>⬖</sup> delayed disease onset, extended survival, and preserved nearly twice as many motor neurons. [A GSK-3β inhibitor](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0022510X12002663) delayed disease onset and death, and partially preserved lumbar motor neurons. [ASK1 inhibitors](https://doi.org/10.1093/hmg/ddv467) protected against motor neuron death and reduced glial activation. [Rapamycin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD2012&filename=1012417450.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=ifGag9ndpE3CZThKNQF18XYlD04zGpGcbmBKcdewoq34BW-4tWyfCCnaqTqJaINl) improved the neuroprotective mitochondrial fission/fusion balance. [Lycopene](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015325891.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=hQKLGQ0eAXyrqLN6Qz7tTlghq_AsoZjYdqn0sgP7K0eCyXHuZDMtORaAYWpuSROG) <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently reduced oxidative stress and reduced motor neuron apoptosis. Notably, [carboxyamidotriazole](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD2011&filename=1011164120.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Gxstwsa08l1TCPf6SIakwLIMwQwI-amWfIhjq9_gIvDn_pHg9kvnV96iOOh5x9fU) potently inhibited inflammatory cytokines in vitro but did not significantly improve onset or survival compared to the DMSO vehicle control in vivo—potentially suggesting DMSO itself was already providing a comparable benefit.
content.cn: •多种药物与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用，在ALS小鼠模型中也显示出治疗效果。长期腹腔注射白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 可延缓疾病发作、延长生存期，并使运动神经元存活数量增加近一倍。GSK-3β抑制剂可延缓疾病发作和死亡，并部分保护了腰部运动神经元。ASK1抑制剂可防止运动神经元死亡，并减少胶质细胞活化。 雷帕霉素改善了具有神经保护作用的线粒体分裂/融合平衡。番茄红素 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量依赖性方式减轻了氧化应激，并减少了运动神经元的凋亡。值得注意的是，羧酰胺三唑在体外对炎症细胞因子具有强效抑制作用，但在体内与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶剂对照组相比，并未显著改善发病时间或生存期——这可能表明DMSO本身已提供了相当的益处。

content.en: *Note: DMSO has also been combined with riluzole (one of the only ALS drugs) to treat a variety of other neurological conditions including neuropathic pain,<sup data-ref="248">248</sup>, <sup data-ref="249">249</sup> light-induced retinal degeneration,<sup data-ref="250">250</sup>, <sup data-ref="251">251</sup> [hearing loss](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22015942/) (where DMSO alone also was found to protect hearing and preserved cochlear neurons), and [status epilepticus](https://repositorio.usp.br/item/002267852) —all of which data shows DMSO treats. Additionally, [DMSO has been used](https://bio-protocol.org/pdf/Bio-protocol3353.pdf) as a solvent to screen large numbers of compounds for use in ALS.
content.cn: 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还曾与利鲁唑（为数不多的ALS药物之一）联合使用，用于治疗多种其他神经系统疾病，包括神经病理性疼痛、 <sup data-ref="250">250</sup> <sup data-ref="251">251</sup> 光诱导性视网膜变性、 <sup data-ref="250">250</sup> <sup data-ref="251">251</sup> 听力损失（研究发现仅使用DMSO也能保护听力并维持耳蜗神经元的功能），以及癫痫持续状态——所有相关数据均表明DMSO对这些病症具有治疗作用。此外，DMSO还被用作溶剂，用于筛选大量可用于治疗ALS的化合物。*

content.en: In addition to Todd’s remarkable response to topical and particularly IV DMSO, a few other reports suggest DMSO can benefit ALS and related conditions. [One book recounts](https://www.amazon.com/Persecuted-Drug-Story-DMSO/dp/0441151019) Stanley Jacob treating an ALS patient with DMSO, producing “instant, overnight and slightly delayed wonders of therapy” (after which their doctor forbade further treatment).
content.cn: 除了托德对局部用药（尤其是静脉注射二甲基亚砜）所作出的显著反应外，还有几份其他报告表明二甲基亚砜可能对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）及相关疾病有益。有一本书记载了斯坦利·雅各布用二甲基亚砜治疗一名ALS患者的情况，取得了“立竿见影、一夜之间见效以及稍有延迟的治疗奇效”（此后，该患者的医生禁止了进一步的治疗）。

content.en: *Note: I suspect this case may have been what first inspired a mentor to try IV DMSO for ALS.
content.cn: 注：我怀疑正是这个病例，最初启发了一位导师尝试使用静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）。*

content.en: [Another reader reported](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/74157942) that a colleague gave DMSO to her father with ALS and “was surprised at visible improvement in his condition.” Finally, [a reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/166148751) with cramping fasciculation syndrome (a condition that presents like early ALS but does not progress to it) described being driven to the point of planning suicide by the combination of chronic pain and severe sleep deprivation before discovering that oral DMSO dramatically improved the effectiveness of his other medications, allowing him to sleep through the night, largely eliminating his cramping and nerve pain, and giving him back the ability to hold down a job and watch his children grow up.
content.cn: 另一位读者报告说，一位同事给患有肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的父亲服用了二甲基亚砜（DMSO），并“惊讶地发现他的病情有了明显好转”。 最后，一位患有痉挛性肌束震颤综合征（一种表现类似早期肌萎缩侧索硬化症但不会发展为该病的疾病）的读者描述道，慢性疼痛和严重睡眠剥夺的双重折磨曾将他逼至计划自杀的边缘，直到他发现口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能显著提高其他药物的疗效，使他能够一觉睡到天亮，基本消除了痉挛和神经痛，并让他重新获得了工作能力，得以见证孩子们的成长。

content.en: *Note: our (limited) experience has been that IV DMSO halts the progression of ALS rather than reverses it. However, the stories I’ve received suggest some individuals have a considerably more dramatic response — whether due to inherent responsiveness or higher IV doses.
