One of my major unresolved questions is whether the post-COVID vaccine “atypical” ALS cases respond differently to DMSO than the pre-vaccine ALS we had previously encountered (which is where all of our experience comes from).
content.cn: 注：根据我们（有限）的经验，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）只能阻止肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的进展，而无法逆转病情。不过，我收到的案例显示，部分患者的反应要显著更为明显——这可能是由于个体固有的反应性，也可能是因为静脉注射剂量较高所致。 我目前尚未解决的一个主要疑问是：新冠疫苗接种后出现的“非典型”ALS病例，其对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的反应是否与我们此前遇到的疫苗接种前ALS病例（即我们所有经验的来源）不同。*

content.en: Huntington’s Disease
content.cn: 亨廷顿病

content.en: Huntington’s disease is a fatal genetic disorder characterized by progressive loss of motor control, cognitive decline, and psychiatric disturbances. It belongs to a family of nine neurodegenerative disorders (polyglutamine diseases) caused by misfolded proteins with abnormally long glutamine repeats, and [a review of chemical chaperones for these conditions](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17511600/) found that DMSO showed similar or superior suppression of polyglutamine-mediated toxicity compared to the other chemical chaperones tested (glycerol, TMAO). Likewise, [in cell models of Machado-Joseph disease](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12127147/) (another member of this family), DMSO stabilized mutant ataxin-3 protein folding, reducing aggregation, cytotoxicity, and cell death.
content.cn: 亨廷顿病是一种致命的遗传性疾病，其特征为运动控制能力的进行性丧失、认知功能衰退以及精神障碍。 该病属于一组由含有异常长谷氨酰胺重复序列的错误折叠蛋白所引起的九种神经退行性疾病（多谷氨酰胺病）之一；一项针对这些疾病的化学伴侣的综述发现，与其他经测试的化学伴侣（甘油、TMAO）相比，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对多谷氨酰胺介导的毒性具有相似或更强的抑制作用。 同样，在马查多-约瑟夫病（该家族的另一种疾病）的细胞模型中，二甲基亚砜稳定了突变型 ataxin-3 蛋白的折叠，从而减少了聚集、细胞毒性和细胞死亡。

content.en: [In the only study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0925443900000478) which directly tested DMSO against Huntington’s disease, DMSO (~1-4%) partially prevented cell death, increased cell viability, decreased aggregated huntingtin protein, and increased its soluble (non-toxic) form.
content.cn: 在一项唯一直接测试二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对亨廷顿病疗效的研究中，DMSO（约1%～4%）部分阻止了细胞死亡，提高了细胞存活率，减少了亨廷顿蛋白的聚集，并增加了其可溶性（无毒）形式。

content.en: A variety of agents in combination with DMSO have also shown therapeutic benefit in Huntington’s models. In rats, [inosine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35472453/) <sup>⬖</sup> protected against Huntington’s-like symptoms by improving motor function, activating the neurotrophic BDNF/TrkB/ERK/CREB pathway, increasing striatal BDNF, and reducing oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, and striatal neuronal damage. [FKBP5 inhibition](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34024231/) reduced mutant huntingtin levels and increased autophagic clearance in both human Huntington’s stem cells and mouse models. [In C. elegans Huntington’s models](https://opendata.uni-halle.de/bitstream/1981185920/103152/1/Dissertation_MLU_2022_SaierChristina.pdf), olive leaf extract <sup>⬖</sup> strongly protected neurons from polyglutamine-induced degeneration (up to 4-fold more intact neurons) and improved mechanosensory response, while 3-hydroxytyrosol <sup>⬖</sup> and tyrosol <sup>⬖</sup> reduced polyglutamine plaque number, protected neurons, and improved mechanosensory response. [Hyptis](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2352340920314785) species extracts <sup>⬖</sup> also significantly improved locomotion and increased oxidative stress resistance in polyglutamine models.
content.cn: 多种与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物在亨廷顿病模型中也显示出治疗效益。在大鼠实验中，肌苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过改善运动功能、激活神经营养因子BDNF/TrkB/ERK/CREB信号通路、增加纹状体中BDNF的水平，以及减轻氧化应激、神经炎症和纹状体神经元损伤，从而对亨廷顿病样症状起到了保护作用。 在人类亨廷顿病干细胞和小鼠模型中，FKBP5抑制均可降低突变亨廷顿蛋白水平并增强自噬清除作用。 在秀丽隐杆线虫亨廷顿病模型中，橄榄叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著保护神经元免受多谷氨酰胺诱导的退化（完整神经元数量最多增加4倍），并改善了机械感觉反应；而3-羟基酪醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 和酪醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 则减少了多谷氨酰胺斑块的数量，保护了神经元，并改善了机械感觉反应。 Hyptis属植物提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 在多谷氨酰胺模型中也显著改善了运动能力，并增强了对氧化应激的抵抗力。

content.en: *Note: [DMSO has also been used to screen](https://www.nature.com/articles/nchembio852) a large number of potential therapeutics for Huntington’s disease and [to investigate its underlying pathogenic mechanisms](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=17313553).
content.cn: 注：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还被用于筛选大量亨廷顿病潜在治疗药物，并用于研究其潜在的致病机制。*

content.en: Alzheimer’s Disease
content.cn: 阿尔茨海默病

content.en: Alzheimer’s disease (AD), the most common form of dementia, is characterized by the extracellular accumulation of amyloid-β (Aβ) plaques (particularly in the hippocampus and cortex) and intracellular neurofibrillary tangles from hyperphosphorylated tau protein. It is thought to result from the damage those proteins are known to cause to brain tissue and as such virtually all research into the disease has revolved around removing amyloid.
content.cn: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是最常见的痴呆症类型，其特征是细胞外积聚了β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）斑块（尤其在海马体和皮层中），以及由过度磷酸化tau蛋白形成的细胞内神经原纤维缠结。人们认为，该病是由于这些蛋白质对脑组织造成的已知损伤所致，因此几乎所有关于该疾病的研究都围绕清除β-淀粉样蛋白展开。

content.en: *Note: a strong case can be made amyloid proteins initially protect brain cells from stressors (e.g. toxins), supported by the fact all the amyloid eliminating drugs have failed (and often have significant side effects due to them priming the immune system to attack amyloid and hence create inflammation in the brain), along with the fact natural therapies which directly target the factors injuring brain tissue are currently the only treatment for Alzheimer’s with supportive data (discussed further [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/reversing-alzheimers-the-forgotten)).
content.cn: 注：有充分理由认为，淀粉样蛋白最初能保护脑细胞免受应激因子（如毒素）的侵害。这一观点得到了以下事实的支持：所有消除淀粉样蛋白的药物均已失败（且往往会因刺激免疫系统攻击淀粉样蛋白而在脑内引发炎症，从而产生显著的副作用）；此外，目前唯一有支持性数据佐证的阿尔茨海默病治疗方法，是直接针对损伤脑组织因素的自然疗法 （相关内容将在本文中进一步探讨）。*

content.en: DMSO has unique utility in the disease as DMSO:
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在该疾病的治疗中具有独特的用途，具体表现为：

content.en: •Stabilizes proteins and eliminates misfolded amyloid aggregates (allowing it to remove dangerous amyloid accumulations in a non-injurious way). For example, [a computer modeling study](https://oiccpress.com/ijnd/article/view/4258) indicated DMSO inhibits Aβ aggregation by modulating the stability of the Lys28-Ala42 salt bridge, while [molecular dynamics simulations](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41560134/) showed DMSO promoted α-helical structure and stabilized Aβ42 (preventing the β-sheet formation that drives toxic aggregation).
content.cn: •稳定蛋白质并消除错误折叠的淀粉样蛋白聚集体（从而能够以无损伤的方式清除危险的淀粉样蛋白沉积）。 例如，一项计算机建模研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过调节Lys28-Ala42盐桥的稳定性来抑制Aβ的聚集；而分子动力学模拟则显示，DMSO能促进α-螺旋结构的形成并稳定Aβ42（从而阻止驱动毒性聚集的β-折叠结构的形成）。

content.en: •Is an acetylcholine esterase inhibitor,<sup data-ref="252">252</sup>, <sup data-ref="253">253</sup> (the same therapeutic strategy used by the FDA-approved Alzheimer’s drugs donepezil and galantamine).
content.cn: •是一种乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂， <sup data-ref="252">252</sup> <sup data-ref="253">253</sup> （与美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的阿尔茨海默病药物多奈哌齐和加兰他敏采用的治疗策略相同）。

content.en: • [Has been shown](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00306008) to increase the activity of lysosomal alkaline phosphatase (ALP) by 20%, which likely enhances the clearance of the toxic protein aggregates that contribute to neurodegeneration.
content.cn: • 研究表明，它能将溶酶体碱性磷酸酶（ALP）的活性提高20%，这可能有助于清除导致神经退行性变的有毒蛋白质聚集物。

content.en: *Note: a nasal insulin DMSO spray developed for treating AD was found in rats to deliver insulin throughout the brain within an hour with no signs of toxicity.<sup data-ref="254">254</sup>, <sup data-ref="255">255</sup>, <sup data-ref="256">256</sup>
content.cn: 注：研究发现，一种为治疗阿尔茨海默病（AD）而研发的鼻用胰岛素二甲基亚砜（DMSO）喷雾剂，在大鼠体内能在一小时内将胰岛素输送至整个大脑，且未出现任何毒性迹象。 <sup data-ref="254">254</sup> <sup data-ref="255">255</sup> <sup data-ref="256">256</sup>*

content.en: Additionally, DMSO’s foundational properties (e.g., improving circulation, reducing inflammation and reawakening dormant “shocked” cells) directly counteract the pathological processes that create AD. For example, DMSO has been shown to inhibit activation of NLRP3 inflammasomes and caspase-1, which mediate the chronic neuroinflammation that accelerates AD progression.<sup data-ref="257">257</sup>, <sup data-ref="258">258</sup>, <sup data-ref="259">259</sup>
content.cn: 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的基本特性（例如改善血液循环、减轻炎症以及唤醒休眠的“受损”细胞）能直接对抗导致阿尔茨海默病（AD）的病理过程。例如，研究表明，DMSO可抑制NLRP3炎性小体和半胱天冬酶-1的活化，而这两者正是介导慢性神经炎症的关键因子，这种炎症会加速AD的进展。 <sup data-ref="257">257</sup> <sup data-ref="258">258</sup> <sup data-ref="259">259</sup>

content.en: *Note: DMSO is routinely used in laboratory settings to solubilize and dissolve amyloid peptides for experimental use,<sup data-ref="260">260</sup>, <sup data-ref="261">261</sup>, <sup data-ref="262">262</sup>, <sup data-ref="263">263</sup> and initial solubilization conditions (including DMSO exposure) s [ignificantly impact the reproducibility of Aβ aggregation kinetics](https://alz-journals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/alz.089897). Studies characterizing the toxicity of different Aβ species (oligomers, protofibrils, fibrils) and molecular weight fractions have relied on DMSO for peptide preparation.<sup data-ref="264">264</sup>, <sup data-ref="265">265</sup> DMSO [has also been used](https://d1wqtxts1xzle7.cloudfront.net/104248885/729-libre.pdf?1689310895=&response-content-disposition=inline%3B+filename%3DIn_vitro_geroscience_Screening_anti_agin.pdf&Expires=1773211004&Signature=QCCCNlfhHj2TlZjKq81KTY9ilNcGPYaxmVgxPzkaIO6s5nJOmsXNyhhPoTiaInN9uC4aWIM95yYtm65MNOfWKgH7pzRjlhddqNxWe2suLKo21uPyXYt5VxqldEuppTyCsITTVWFmMLFXo49IrNBdaCRAwQxBjs5wc2p88uSzo34SVYINwvr3XIlboSnR3ja5G~vOYv~nNPX4Nm5PFoiBE3PmS2CW1oKeWT~lZmlmQbxahxT8zUC5--PHEREjNUTC8yi3JEzd74HH6lXifu90HWUlJ0WwSfNg5hcXO43Z1q0qSOSo2huEZE33MvrDgHb8wcJLqLtt3n6mLXAKQxmuPg__&Key-Pair-Id=APKAJLOHF5GGSLRBV4ZA) as a solvent platform for screening anti-aging drug cocktails against Aβ and tau neurotoxicity in neuronal cell lines.
content.cn: 注：在实验室环境中，通常使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）将淀粉样肽溶解并溶解以供实验使用， <sup data-ref="264">264</sup> <sup data-ref="265">265</sup> <sup data-ref="262">262</sup> <sup data-ref="263">263</sup> 而初始溶解条件（包括DMSO接触）会显著影响Aβ聚集动力学的可重复性。 针对不同Aβ物种（寡聚体、原纤维、纤维）及分子量分馏物的毒性表征研究，均依赖于DMSO进行肽制备。 <sup data-ref="264">264</sup> <sup data-ref="265">265</sup> DMSO还被用作溶剂平台，用于在神经元细胞系中筛选针对Aβ和tau神经毒性的抗衰老药物组合。*

content.en: In animal studies, DMSO has repeatedly demonstrated direct cognitive benefits in AD models:
content.cn: 在动物研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在阿尔茨海默病（AD）模型中一再显示出对认知功能的直接益处：

content.en: [In rats](https://applications.emro.who.int/imemrf/Res_Mol_Med/Res_Mol_Med_2013_1_1_21_28.pdf) where intracerebroventricular streptozotocin (STZ) infusions were used to model sporadic AD, daily IV DMSO for 2 weeks counteracted memory impairment, improving performance in behavioral and memory tests. This was corroborated by a study where chronic intracerebroventricular DMSO at 10% (but not 2.5% or 5%) significantly attenuated STZ-induced spatial memory deficits in the Morris water maze, with the authors attributing the benefit to DMSO’s antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cerebral perfusion-enhancing properties.<sup data-ref="266">266</sup>, <sup data-ref="267">267</sup> In [another STZ study](https://www.lareferencia.info/vufind/Record/BR_ff74512816eeb0dc1374d633c0ae2d90), a separate group found similar trends toward decreased neuroinflammation (IL-1β, TNFα), behavioral improvements and elevated BDNF with DMSO treatment.
content.cn: 在通过脑室注射链脲佐菌素（STZ）建立散发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）模型的大鼠中，连续2周每日静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可逆转记忆障碍，并改善行为和记忆测试的表现。 一项研究证实了这一结果：在莫里斯水迷宫实验中，慢性脑室注射10%的二甲基亚砜（而非2.5%或5%）显著减轻了STZ诱导的空间记忆缺陷，作者将这一益处归因于二甲基亚砜的抗氧化、抗炎和增强脑灌注的特性。 <sup data-ref="266">266</sup> <sup data-ref="267">267</sup> 在另一项STZ研究中，另一组研究人员发现，经DMSO治疗后，神经炎症（IL-1β、TNFα）减轻、行为改善以及BDNF水平升高，呈现出类似的趋势。

content.en: [In AD model rats](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2002&filename=ZYYB200206000&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=_l4-MF5_-yxJJLi27j1Z7fEVvBMSFrv0oYD9TQWjm-_TT5HfwalRH66rTg9KQZ_b) with Aβ25-35 injected into the hippocampus, DMSO improved learning and memory, reducing escape latency and search distance in the Morris water maze. Notably, no significant synergistic effect was seen when DMSO was combined with Ginkgo biloba extract,<sup>⬖</sup> suggesting DMSO alone was already exerting a substantial effect. [In a similar study](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=53736297), DMSO and Ginkgo biloba extract <sup>⬖</sup> each improved learning and memory in Aβ25-35 AD model rats, with effects associated with modulation of hippocampal APP expression.
content.cn: 在海马体中注射了Aβ25-35的AD模型大鼠中，DMSO改善了学习和记忆能力，缩短了莫里斯水迷宫实验中的逃逸潜伏期并缩短了搜索距离。值得注意的是，当DMSO与银杏叶提取物联合使用时，未观察到显著的协同效应， <sup>⬖</sup> 这表明DMSO单独使用时就已经产生了显著效果。 在一项类似的研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和银杏叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 均改善了Aβ25-35阿尔茨海默病模型大鼠的学习和记忆能力，其作用与海马区APP表达的调节有关。

content.en: Furthermore, [in mice genetically engineered to have AD](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0028390816304749), DMSO increased spine density in a region-specific manner in the hippocampus, enhanced spatial memory accuracy, modulated olfactory habituation, and displayed an anti-anxiety effect. Despite these improvements occurring in animals with elevated Aβ levels, **DMSO did not reduce oligomeric Aβ species**, and instead appeared to act through modulation of NMDA receptor signaling (as the NMDA antagonist MK-801 recapitulated DMSO’s effect on spine density) leading the authors to conclude: “ *DMSO should be considered as a true bioactive compound, which has the potential to be a beneficial adjuvant to counteract Aβ-mediated synaptotoxicity and behavioral impairment.*”
content.cn: 此外，在经基因工程改造而患有阿尔茨海默病（AD）的小鼠中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以区域特异性方式增加了海马区的棘突密度，提高了空间记忆准确性，调节了嗅觉习惯化，并表现出抗焦虑作用。 尽管这些改善发生在Aβ水平升高的动物身上，但二甲基亚砜并未减少寡聚体Aβ，而是似乎通过调节NMDA受体信号传导发挥作用（因为NMDA拮抗剂MK-801重现了二甲基亚砜对树突棘密度的影响），这促使作者得出结论： “应将二甲基亚砜视为一种真正的生物活性化合物，它有望成为对抗Aβ介导的突触毒性和行为障碍的有效辅助药物。”

content.en: [In a separate](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxnbOFrEsLV_vABYL8MVAWNhmwEmbO0RCoxlKHz4DfbycrEFBkcdZKdSRhA1HOfLBHuCtlJDKNJItiEhdXkoryvBmM8uRdC4mn9h938cOao7x9hg2aUZ_OpldyUGKBfngIMoDchKMXlv2x98yAQwCXgDX40-A6ffTAELUzReGbMGdXFtM5clG7E80T3PHJadAYw=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) mouse AD study, DMSO independently crossed the blood-brain barrier, improved cognition, and reduced neuroinflammation — effects observed even though the study was designed to test serpina3n, not DMSO itself.
content.cn: 在另一项针对小鼠阿尔茨海默病的研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够独立穿过血脑屏障，改善认知功能并减轻神经炎症——尽管该研究的设计初衷是测试serpina3n，而非DMSO本身，但仍观察到了这些效果。

content.en: [In young mice](https://iovs.arvojournals.org/article.aspx?articleid=2796823) (3–4 months) genetically engineered to have early-onset AD, 0.01% DMSO mixed with drinking water mitigated the visual declines and retinal thickening seen in the prodromal phase of AD (with benefits comparable to R-carvedilol), indicating DMSO enhanced the energy-dependent transport of water out of the eyes.
content.cn: 在经基因工程改造而患有早发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）的幼鼠（3–4个月大）中，将0.01%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）混入饮用水中，可缓解AD前驱期出现的视力下降和视网膜增厚现象（其疗效与R-卡维地洛相当），这表明DMSO增强了眼部水分的能量依赖性外排。

content.en: In C. elegans, DMSO greatly delayed (by 48–98%) the paralysis caused by Aβ42 and extended lifespan by 23.0–24.4%.<sup data-ref="268">268</sup>, <sup data-ref="269">269</sup> The researchers attributed the delay in paralysis [to DMSO modulating neurotransmission](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8558977/), noting DMSO reduced paralysis from acetylcholine-related agents by ~70% and that the protection was dependent on the daf-16/FOXO longevity pathway.
content.cn: 在秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著延缓了（延缓幅度达48%–98%）Aβ42引起的麻痹，并将寿命延长了23.0%–24.4%。 <sup data-ref="268">268</sup> <sup data-ref="269">269</sup> 研究人员将瘫痪延迟归因于DMSO对神经递质传递的调节作用，并指出DMSO可将乙酰胆碱相关物质引起的瘫痪程度降低约70%，且这种保护作用依赖于daf-16/FOXO长寿通路。

content.en: In cell culture, low concentrations of DMSO ([0.015625–0.0625](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/10915818251338235) %) increased the viability of brain cells and masked Aβ toxicity (concentrations readily achievable in brain tissue from taking DMSO at home or DMSO’s routine use in cellular experiments).
content.cn: 在细胞培养中，低浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）（0.015625%–0.0625%）可提高脑细胞的存活率，并掩盖Aβ的毒性（这些浓度在脑组织中很容易达到，无论是通过在家使用DMSO，还是在细胞实验中常规使用DMSO）。

content.en: *Note: since DMSO is used so frequently in Alzheimer’s research, it has been repeatedly proposed this protective effect likely has contributed to overestimating the efficacy of therapies used with it and underestimating the neurotoxicity of amyloid particles.<sup data-ref="270">270</sup>, <sup data-ref="271">271</sup>
content.cn: 注：由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在阿尔茨海默病研究中被广泛使用，因此有研究多次指出，这种保护作用很可能导致人们高估了与其联合使用的疗法的疗效，同时低估了淀粉样蛋白颗粒的神经毒性。 <sup data-ref="270">270</sup> <sup data-ref="271">271</sup>*

content.en: Additionally, [DMSO shifted amyloid precursor protein](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0169328X9390198X) (APP) splicing in the adult rat hippocampus to favor the neurotrophic isoform APP-695 (increasing its proportion from 89% to 94%) while reciprocally reducing the pathologic KPI-containing isoforms (APP-751/770) that are typically elevated in AD (again underscoring its utility in the disease). [In a controlled cortical impact model](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40510018/) of TBI in mice, DMSO (used as the vehicle for glibenclamide) demonstrated unexpected independent beneficial effects in female mice, significantly downregulating pathological TAU and TDP43 proteins across multiple brain regions and helping restore cerebral blood flow (effects the study authors highlighted as novel).
content.cn: 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）改变了成年大鼠海马中淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）的剪接模式，促使具有神经营养作用的APP-695异构体占主导（其比例从89%升至94%），同时相应地降低了在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中通常水平升高的、含有病理性KPI的异构体（APP-751/770）的水平（这再次凸显了其在该疾病治疗中的应用价值）。 在小鼠创伤性脑损伤（TBI）的受控皮质撞击模型中，二甲基亚砜（作为格列本脲的溶剂）在雌性小鼠身上表现出出乎意料的独立有益作用，显著下调了多个脑区中病理性的TAU和TDP43蛋白水平，并有助于恢复脑血流量（研究作者强调这些效果具有新颖性）。

content.en: [A 1980s Japanese review](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/geriatrics1964/25/4/25_4_375/_pdf/-char/ja) noted DMSO had been explored for dissolving amyloid deposits in Alzheimer’s, with one report documenting partial improvement in motor function.
content.cn: 一篇20世纪80年代的日本综述指出，曾有研究探索过二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在溶解阿尔茨海默病中淀粉样蛋白沉积方面的作用，其中一份报告记录了运动功能的部分改善。

content.en: Human Studies
content.cn: 人类学

content.en: [18 patients with probable Alzheimer’s](https://dmso.org/articles/alzheimers/Alzheimers.htm) were treated in Moldova with DMSO and tested regularly for nine months, with great improvements being noted after only three months of treatment, and becoming especially noticeable after six months. Areas of improvement included memory, concentration, and communication alongside a significant decrease of disorientation in time and space.
content.cn: 摩尔多瓦有18名疑似阿尔茨海默病患者接受了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗，并在九个月内定期接受检测。治疗仅三个月后便观察到显著改善，六个月后改善效果尤为明显。改善的方面包括记忆力、注意力及沟通能力，同时患者在时间和空间上的定向障碍也有显著减轻。

content.en: Likewise according [to Jack De La Torre](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1997.tb48462.x), the leading researcher on DMSO’s neurological applications: “Dimethyl sulfoxide, a powerful free radical scavenger that is known to increase cerebral blood flow clinically and experimentally during various pathological states involving brain, has been shown to improve cognitive function while stabilizing protein enzymes in Alzheimer’s patients treated with this drug for 6 months.”
content.cn: 同样，据二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在神经学领域应用方面的顶尖研究者杰克·德·拉·托雷（Jack De La Torre）指出：“二甲基亚砜是一种强效的自由基清除剂，临床和实验研究均表明，在涉及大脑的各种病理状态下，它能增加脑血流量；研究还表明，对于接受该药物治疗6个月的阿尔茨海默病患者，该药物不仅能改善认知功能，还能稳定蛋白质酶。”

content.en: *Note: I could not tell if De La Torre was referring to the Moldovan study or something else.
content.cn: 注：我无法确定德·拉·托雷指的是摩尔多瓦的研究，还是其他内容。*

content.en: Combination Studies in AD Models
content.cn: 阿尔茨海默病模型中的联合研究

content.en: A large body of research has evaluated therapeutic agents dissolved in DMSO across various AD models.
content.cn: 大量研究对溶解在二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的治疗药物在各种阿尔茨海默病（AD）模型中的效果进行了评估。

content.en: **APP Processing and Secretase Modulation
content.cn: APP的加工与分泌酶的调节**

content.en: A variety of agents dissolved in DMSO have demonstrated the ability to shift APP processing away from toxic Aβ production. [Cinnamon bark extract](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27865616/) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced Aβ40 production by 50–60% through its active compounds medioresinol and cryptamygin A, which decreased β-secretase levels. [Levistolide A](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201502&filename=1015363893.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=6_ENmAMPbKtqMqMaEI5FbvZzBSyYGEGBJ8eXsOiMy4aHFXLGvhvLbpldsW7B7EdI) <sup>⬖</sup> (from Danggui-Shaoyao-San) reduced extracellular Aβ1-42 in AD cells and was shown to cross the blood-brain barrier, reaching peak brain concentrations within 30 minutes. [Apicidin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016782739.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=5aGKRTOVPtszWiyFxr4iob7yA1RpyZ35Zx0vJMwSho_G2Qmjhz30BNX0VmLLtorq) (an HDAC inhibitor) increased ADAM10 (α-secretase) expression through USF1 and ERK signaling, shifting APP cleavage away from the amyloidogenic pathway. [Retinoic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23530929/) inhibited γ-secretase activity through ERK activation, [while sulfonamide-based γ-secretase modulators](http://tanpaku.org/pdf/0901symposium/poster/MPA4.pdf) shifted Aβ40/42 ratios without the Notch-related side effects of complete γ-secretase inhibition. Additionally, [multiple BACE1 inhibitors dissolved in DMSO](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3273469/) reduced Aβ1-40 and Aβ1-42 production in neuronal cells (but like other amyloid drugs, failed in subsequent human trials). [DMSO has also been used to dissolve ursolic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21835916/),<sup>⬖</sup> which was identified through high-content screening as a potent inhibitor of Aβ binding to the CD36 receptor, blocking microglial reactive oxygen species production.
content.cn: 多种溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的活性物质已被证实能够将APP的加工过程从产生有毒的Aβ转向其他方向。肉桂皮提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过其活性成分梅迪奥雷西诺尔和隐阿米吉因A降低了β-分泌酶的水平，从而使Aβ40的生成量减少了50%–60%。 Levistolide A <sup>⬖</sup> （源自当归芍药散）可降低AD细胞中的细胞外Aβ1-42水平，且已被证实能穿过血脑屏障，并在30分钟内达到脑内峰值浓度。 阿皮西丁（一种组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂）通过USF1和ERK信号通路上调ADAM10（α-分泌酶）的表达，从而将APP的裂解从淀粉样蛋白生成途径中转移出来。维甲酸通过激活ERK抑制γ-分泌酶的活性，而基于磺胺类化合物的γ-分泌酶调节剂则改变了Aβ40/42的比例，且不会产生完全抑制γ-分泌酶所导致的Notch相关副作用。 此外，多种溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的BACE1抑制剂可降低神经元细胞中Aβ1-40和Aβ1-42的生成（但与其他淀粉样蛋白药物一样，在后续的人体试验中均未获成功）。二甲基亚砜还被用于溶解熊果酸， <sup>⬖</sup> 该物质通过高通量筛选被鉴定为Aβ与CD36受体结合的强效抑制剂，可阻断小胶质细胞活性氧的产生。
**Transgenic AD Mice 转基因阿尔茨海默病小鼠**

content.en: DMSO combinations have been extensively studied in transgenic AD mice. [Dihydromyricetin](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20219835763) <sup>⬖</sup> improved Morris water maze performance, decreased Aβ accumulation and senile plaques, and restored autophagic flux by increasing Beclin1, the LC3-II/LC3-I ratio, and reducing P62. Numerous HDAC6 inhibitors alleviated cognitive decline, reduced Aβ levels and plaque deposition, decreased hyperphosphorylated tau, upregulated autophagy proteins, and protected cortical neurons from oxidative damage.<sup data-ref="272">272</sup>, <sup data-ref="273">273</sup> A [p38 MAPK inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=SWCX201710008&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=AI_8FqkTm3jdpa4dKkHzAobu9EWsHuXbUcr6FrLbffrOY2cDsNPYt9hmK9GyJPYI) improved cognition by reducing Aβ, tau phosphorylation, BACE1, and presenilin while increasing synaptic and amyloid-degrading proteins. [Astragalin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUpq9Wj4hp98A7jWJXhOENNomBWPNdHyEWNPbNyTrhPWFW_Hh_127pbfJaw_Lo5trNG5Ej2w2n66GmIOG7dYw4firDlj1ZQrVaQ0ZW11zmTn7uQ1CZsIMImk-_NCkwjiS33Kuf9xcWz8Fsmnpz0beyvUto5HZ01QXbmuZ22sqkRbqlYVxnlYa3w6LzSwngQ660M=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) improved spatial learning and memory in mice by reducing Aβ plaque deposition and enhancing autophagic flux via the PI3K/Akt-mTOR pathway. [Ligustilide](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2019&filename=1018272734.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Td0A6oeC5_PcrfyTqh_0Y5KituszTtwBtyG7HPSXuP9ODSqePRGE0bsVyL02jwLr) <sup>⬖</sup> improved learning and memory, promoted Aβ transport and clearance, and reduced neuroinflammation. [Chronic blockade of the TRPA1](https://theses.hal.science/tel-03130106/) channel normalized astrocytic activity, prevented neuronal dysfunction, preserved synaptic integrity, and prevented spatial working memory decline. [Kenpaullone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40566818/) improved cognitive performance and reduced Aβ plaques, neurodegeneration, and proinflammatory cytokines, while [erlotinib](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39434878/) improved short-term spatial memory, increased dendritic spine formation, and reduced tau phosphorylation and aggregation.
content.cn: 在转基因阿尔茨海默病（AD）小鼠模型中，对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的联合用药方案进行了广泛研究。二氢山楂素 <sup>⬖</sup> 改善了莫里斯水迷宫测试的表现，减少了β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）的积累和老年斑的形成，并通过增加Beclin1表达、提高LC3-II/LC3-I比值以及降低P62水平，恢复了自噬通量。 多种HDAC6抑制剂可缓解认知衰退，降低Aβ水平和斑块沉积，减少过度磷酸化tau蛋白，上调自噬相关蛋白，并保护皮层神经元免受氧化损伤。 <sup data-ref="272">272</sup> <sup data-ref="273">273</sup> 一种p38 MAPK抑制剂通过降低Aβ、tau磷酸化、BACE1和早老素水平，同时增加突触蛋白和淀粉样蛋白降解蛋白的表达，从而改善了认知功能。 阿斯塔加林通过PI3K/Akt-mTOR通路减少Aβ斑块沉积并增强自噬通量，从而改善小鼠的空间学习和记忆能力。利古斯蒂利德 <sup>⬖</sup> 改善了学习和记忆能力，促进了Aβ的转运和清除，并减轻了神经炎症。 长期阻断TRPA1通道可使星形胶质细胞活动恢复正常，预防神经元功能障碍，维持突触完整性，并防止空间工作记忆衰退。肯帕隆可改善认知表现，减少Aβ斑块、神经退行性变和促炎细胞因子；而厄洛替尼则可改善短期空间记忆，增加树突棘的形成，并减少tau蛋白的磷酸化和聚集。

content.en: Among agents targeting Aβ clearance or reduction, [novel c-KIT inhibitors](https://alz-journals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/alz.068944) enhanced autophagic clearance of Aβ and tau, [eriodictyol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahJZrm2ud-sCTjN9qc6dbR0tLSI226igQhVVAp1ORhnHTG4Czv4EAkR9BWto1LI4fs8s_P4RuzqN7DcoJELw8pTZzLIAgrHc5YKhUH6SWT_uhpjTcF1MAUdw64m57jP0ExW79Y3dSPdWQMnWnyf7ozcHNav8gXqO2QPXm5fgclQYalCKm74J-TfknFU1jCTepOA=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) promoted microglial Aβ clearance,<sup>⬖</sup> [menthol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2019&filename=ZGYG201802018&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=q6C6cAJqvvnZbdRTm3o4R3XY7ubgZv6cPnjVzOcpP5qNYqIwNQ6rPVqRBucHXqAt) <sup>⬖</sup> inhibited Aβ polymerization and reduced senile plaques, and [picropodophyllin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32719587/) reduced Aβ and hippocampal microgliosis, while [ellagic acid](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahJFrRtnDpGwo014cdbz4IADa7ljV7TEBApvjIl9RuzswGSLmbilUSNQCbzX-7pblxsxv1ProCJKoBogwgVV-vol_0lKyM8bFl8wUVowPvwzS4jIrsSw-ZZFhW6TpSIcSZsWBtPq5TKT5D__mSjOHLf7Z7eVc8CS8uNE5uT5id41EKsa7eMfQeoz&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced both Aβ and caspase-3. [GTM-1, rapamycin, and carbamazepine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28193995/) each improved spatial memory and reduced Aβ42 (with GTM-1 activating autophagy via mTOR).
content.cn: 在针对Aβ清除或减少的药物中，新型c-KIT抑制剂增强了Aβ和tau的自噬清除，埃里奥迪蒂醇促进了小胶质细胞对Aβ的清除， <sup>⬖</sup> 薄荷醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 抑制了Aβ聚合并减少了老年斑，皮克罗波多菲林降低了Aβ水平并减轻了海马区小胶质细胞增生，而鞣花酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 则同时降低了Aβ和caspase-3的水平。 GTM-1、雷帕霉素和卡马西平均改善了空间记忆并降低了Aβ42水平（其中GTM-1通过mTOR激活自噬）。

content.en: Among agents improving synaptic function and cognition, [a JNK inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015961173.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=hoHENUkjMz9W--blL6w-Kbfwt_HQyua9EMCpjouf6HUE842r0ow_jFfohfK0J96p) reduced inflammation, rescued synaptic proteins, and improved cognition; [a PDE4 inhibitor](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24067928/) improved memory, synaptic plasticity, and hippocampal signaling; [CA140](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39129007/) rescued memory and synaptic function via dopamine D1 signaling; [puerarin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3bOaBRsqxn6ZAu-J20DmZEnV5hVvXi9_5gK4AyqRWz-B_6RgcF2FMX-DAZAV4Y5G6PhW3Cm-yhwauAYoekNeB5QbfalQui14oY7DJyghpgCB0kblHR415-mCIE2k4Yt_pQLEAkF1TylVwtgmjhdI5lFA0-qLZWZUcoH2pWZtmvHSwSaWNXDdDtCREZAUQoWm6I=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> restored NMDA receptor activity; and [isoliquiritigenin](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202101&filename=1021511966.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=4sow4d_ox2q-U_EPGJIxZFQt5wIw-A-1cn3MKw9NcY-uxeGBoT49vRqr7zGAH4Gl) <sup>⬖</sup> restored excitatory/inhibitory synaptic balance. [A SERCA activator](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0960894X18302452) improved memory and motor coordination, while [clenbuterol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2016&filename=SJJP201603015&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=cG6vw5I2hz3rSLgaRkd2Pn97pCQ3UzQBLiCq0EFUEwz85kH_yia4sqIXkJQ7Vg7u) increased PSA-NCAM and improved cognition.
content.cn: 在改善突触功能和认知能力的药物中，一种JNK抑制剂可减轻炎症、恢复突触蛋白功能并改善认知能力；一种PDE4抑制剂可改善记忆、突触可塑性和海马体信号传导； CA140通过多巴胺D1信号通路恢复了记忆和突触功能；葛根素 <sup>⬖</sup> 恢复了NMDA受体活性；而异甘草素 <sup>⬖</sup> 恢复了兴奋性与抑制性突触的平衡。一种SERCA激活剂改善了记忆和运动协调能力，而克伦特罗则增加了PSA-NCAM的表达并改善了认知功能。

content.en: Additional agents working through neuroprotection, neurogenesis, or immune modulation include [a LXR agonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201301&filename=1012457080.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=tIwZiTtaO8soFy9wvCh46sekiRJJpCVDqVOha5I9a_YxRU3wD5OBH7wq8MeQ4h1U) (which promoted neurogenesis and upregulated apoE), [a CB2R agonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201402&filename=1014240978.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=LcXhmz-gMYQRhc5GUyBdB9J8sB7HFdZ4vuxATxZK4fKd8CePVdACy8Fwkm0m2nov) (which shifted microglia from M1 to anti-inflammatory M2), [idebenone](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVBDbaVvHrvtDmImuvG92gY9vWAoc5o2rcWXEK9DNT_I0cmsdIQrsO_u6gwooqENb8LY7basihYgdK1-KviF6JZebWSdA56XR-gMcbBSIhVPPyqwA4_OJgZlEgCcYop0ncIDwcFF3QYY_rgWjmFZ05huBVUO3wy6PchRRzndpL16sxy2x2A-659sfNtKzUCSgMI=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which improved spatial memory and mitochondrial function), an [estrogen receptor beta agonist](https://alz-journals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/alz.065607), and [berberine](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=SDYY201836014&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=1_XEXgEE95TxjqfT7LVtcqnd4kzKSYBRRxMn2dDbwrd2KmLa7geuRdMU0TIBE3mc) <sup>⬖</sup> (which dose-dependently reduced apoptosis and increased Bcl-2 expression in hippocampal neurons).
content.cn: 其他通过神经保护、神经发生或免疫调节发挥作用的药物包括：一种LXR激动剂（可促进神经发生并上调apoE表达）、一种CB2R激动剂（可将小胶质细胞从M1型转化为抗炎性M2型）、依达拉奉（可改善空间记忆和线粒体功能）、一种雌激素受体β激动剂，以及小檗碱 <sup>⬖</sup> （其能以剂量依赖性方式减少海马神经元的凋亡并增加Bcl-2的表达）。
**Sporadic AD Models 散发性阿尔茨海默病模型**

content.en: Sporadic AD models (using intracerebroventricular STZ) also responded to combination therapies. [A triazine derivative](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25597599/) improved spatial learning and increased hippocampal pyramidal layer thickness, [canagliflozin](https://www.ibroneuroreports.org/article/S2667-2421\(23\)00711-X/fulltext) improved dendritic morphology, the [Croton hirtus extract](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcs96GcT9K3USfqrJNwzf9O07_gGeqMBifLTaP9-9H5-iIcQnraPLa5LEOV25iN_uC_tVH3u6sNwWzBauGGhAOjrmzQL2BdRZDhExCEk4pbbckgUN24BGUN5lAkP7ee1TjAYH8s1h8BPmJRlYZoXWrs8JzTYIRlUegT6gNlXqIR4ZrxRn453KHGG&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> MECH reversed learning and memory impairments while reducing Aβ and AChE, and [rapamycin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201401&filename=1014149719.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=ImqLiEggHIRuHqKwPNQrgr6nvQab0KVdbibDGPOvAb_h17udE9U3D5h0W3C2ei1M) reduced hyperphosphorylated tau and mTOR signaling. The [MIF inhibitor ISO-1](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32303185/) improved hippocampal-dependent contextual memory and reduced cytokine production, with MIF levels found elevated in early-stage AD patients’ cerebrospinal fluid. The [GSK-3β inhibitor SB216763](https://alz-journals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/alz.041764) attenuated tunicamycin-induced UPR, synaptic impairments, and memory deficits.
content.cn: 散发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）模型（采用脑室注射STZ）也对联合治疗产生了反应。一种三嗪衍生物改善了空间学习能力并增加了海马锥体细胞层的厚度；卡那格列净改善了树突形态；克罗顿·希尔图斯（Croton hirtus）提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> MECH 逆转了学习和记忆障碍，同时降低了Aβ和乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）水平；雷帕霉素则减少了过度磷酸化tau蛋白和mTOR信号传导。 MIF抑制剂ISO-1改善了海马依赖性情境记忆并降低了细胞因子产生；研究发现，早期阿尔茨海默病患者的脑脊液中MIF水平升高。GSK-3β抑制剂SB216763减轻了筒菌素诱导的未折叠蛋白反应（UPR）、突触功能障碍和记忆缺陷。

content.en: **Acute Aβ Injection Models
content.cn: 急性Aβ注射模型**

content.en: Acute Aβ injection models have been used to test a wide range of agents. Piper kadsura ohwi extract <sup>⬖</sup> significantly ameliorated ethological deficits from both Aβ oligomers and fibrillar Aβ while reducing neuroinflammation via TLR4/NF-κB/TNF-α.<sup data-ref="274">274</sup>, <sup data-ref="275">275</sup> [Rapamycin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32375443/) improved cognitive function, reduced hippocampal Aβ deposition, and increased Homer3 expression. [Testosterone](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFD1214&filename=1013287426.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Pyx4DXx-Yc9Iyx8u9PE0B4BeaL-qrhw_fUYtUilNMMjer3XhWDHRwgDC_Gj9rPi9) reversed spatial learning deficits and neuronal loss via BDNF/CaMKII/CREB signaling (an effect completely blocked by the androgen receptor antagonist flutamide). Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO partially improved spatial learning in AD model rats and also reversed Aβ-induced damage to neural stem cells, improving viability and differentiation markers (Nestin, Tuj-1, GFAP).<sup data-ref="276">276</sup>, <sup data-ref="277">277</sup>, <sup data-ref="278">278</sup> [Pioglitazone](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2010&filename=YLBS201003002&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=UpiDOHjF5NFtbNHz5FvVfQYR6Wzef79hYRz4nUnHhU1r9ZHbx69Kxgpc4ZSPB_kb) dose-dependently reversed Aβ1-42-induced activation of MKK4, JNK1, and c-Jun in rat hippocampus, with most p-JNK immunoreactivity co-localizing with microglia.
content.cn: 急性Aβ注射模型已被用于测试多种药物。 Piper kadsura ohwi 提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著改善了由 Aβ 寡聚体和纤维状 Aβ 引起的行为缺陷，同时通过 TLR4/NF-κB/TNF-α 途径减轻了神经炎症。 <sup data-ref="276">276</sup> <sup data-ref="277">277</sup> 雷帕霉素改善了认知功能，减少了海马区的 Aβ 沉积，并增加了 Homer3 的表达。 睾酮通过BDNF/CaMKII/CREB信号通路逆转了空间学习缺陷和神经元丢失（该效应被雄激素受体拮抗剂氟他胺完全阻断）。溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 部分改善了AD模型大鼠的空间学习能力，并逆转了Aβ对神经干细胞的损伤，提高了细胞存活率及分化标志物（Nestin、Tuj-1、GFAP）的表达水平。 <sup data-ref="276">276</sup> <sup data-ref="277">277</sup> <sup data-ref="278">278</sup> 吡格列酮以剂量依赖性方式逆转了Aβ1-42在大鼠海马中诱导的MKK4、JNK1和c-Jun的活化，其中大部分p-JNK免疫反应性与小胶质细胞共定位。

content.en: Additional agents that improved cognition or reduced AD pathology in Aβ-injected models include [Angelica keiskei extract](https://koreascience.kr/article/JAKO201916936726187.page) <sup>⬖</sup> (which dose-dependently improved memory), low-dose [genistein](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2014&filename=HZZZ201429031&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=FUvHDbWLPb0HizdKmmYl5Ea62FsC8gdInM412rk6-aXJRVBPHFN42EwbzFIMGYLx) <sup>⬖</sup> (which upregulated STAT3 and suppressed caspase-3), [betulinic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28986104/) <sup>⬖</sup> (which improved memory, anxiety, and LTP), [DL0410](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27498773/) (a dual AChE/BChE inhibitor that improved learning via CREB/BDNF), [B. pendula leaf extract](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38136229/) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced oxidative stress and NF-κB signaling), [Huanglian Jiedu Decoction](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUq6CdH7EgdwUtW8UDCyY7cHGHaJmuyk1OnH5v82f3R7NK4UyloQ_Xj5IUYm6ZXpBT0prffwMkXnmeT2pVjCiVQr_NjNFlZLlj9UmzQNpU2LasUGPUIczj7QPTTOw7DqkntWNlTbvd2gbwGywaMiB-L5BLv82eMtUffnqXPIoP_o8bBSeA_VkuXyXiN4ZNxH_Z0=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced microglial activation), [a DAPK1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2018&filename=1017166882.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Axu9649xM7rYSIOchny41Zpd5XJHpm623J-y1Tpm3bh0BHxwNLm5wL3f4fF_VvAJ) (which reduced NLRP3 inflammasome activation and ameliorated memory deficits), and [atorvastatin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201501&filename=1014429714.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=he3bEJWWigq97a3_V1sz1lZzcDXY1-omfQmnD7jRaacAKRdrHkQGzIJ_TmQgpm_P) (which prevented synaptotoxicity and neuroinflammation via p38 MAPK inhibition). [Biochanin A](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016139821.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=6lefSk-Qeez3QQjKEOlUajKh5eGGTt3SI2SbYKuhQxZY6h8CCqUA4PYqnw26Plwg) <sup>⬖</sup> attenuated Aβ-induced neuronal death and improved spatial learning via estrogen receptor-dependent p38 MAPK inhibition, while [Perilla frutescens](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20183031555) <sup>⬖</sup> [hexane fraction](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20183031555) inhibited Aβ aggregation and protected cells from Aβ toxicity [as did a purpose-designed beta-sheet breaker peptide](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19238376/).
content.cn: 在Aβ注射模型中，其他可改善认知功能或减轻AD病理的药物还包括：Keiskei当归提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （以剂量依赖性方式改善记忆）、低剂量染料木黄酮 <sup>⬖</sup> （上调STAT3并抑制caspase-3）、白桦酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （改善记忆、焦虑及LTP）， DL0410（一种通过CREB/BDNF途径改善学习能力的双重乙酰胆碱酯酶/β-胆碱酯酶抑制剂）、B. pendula叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （可减轻氧化应激并抑制NF-κB信号传导）、 黄连解毒汤 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低小胶质细胞活化）、一种DAPK1抑制剂（可降低NLRP3炎性小体活化并改善记忆缺陷），以及阿托伐他汀（通过抑制p38 MAPK预防突触毒性和神经炎症）。 Biochanin A <sup>⬖</sup> 通过雌激素受体依赖性的 p38 MAPK 抑制作用，减轻了 Aβ 诱导的神经元死亡并改善了空间学习能力；而紫苏 <sup>⬖</sup> 己烷分馏物与一种专门设计的 β-折叠片破坏肽一样，均能抑制 Aβ 聚集并保护细胞免受 Aβ 毒性损害。

content.en: Additional agents showing neuroprotective effects in Aβ cell models include [Dendrobium nobile alkaloids](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=ZYYB201504006&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=jQLDxqNRPoTzyg15pca8kNonfCf_bNZh5ykEbYmA3B3HE6QXk3thQh0nMr8CgkqZ) <sup>⬖</sup> (which increased cell survival), [neuroprotectin D1](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016782609.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=ioampCE2bhLd478TJImHzsGamybTJQVR7S9k9G9dOk0qToBqCqc2bXpAqzX1Rmzl) (which reduced Aβ42, tau phosphorylation, and apoptosis while enhancing autophagy), curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced mitochondrial ROS, enhanced autophagy via Rab proteins, and increased axonal transport),<sup data-ref="279">279</sup>, <sup data-ref="280">280</sup>, <sup data-ref="281">281</sup> [icariin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDPfG78B2AgKLbK5eW0WWiuRT0zZXLriOqgWIy3k9yqxQJNZEG7s3fquejavfsLEDfXTpTvkZTM-Wodkj5Dd5nAPlx2T_bKwLA_AJfP-IulJo3LWlCLcBQMB4Pc7S_Od41EbwQG_DUtVHmIvWDu5Fhh9pUVPFOwI0uy4kKGZPEHsvVXqixG6Phf&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which inhibited autophagy and reduced Aβ production via p70 S6K), [a DPP-4 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=TJYZ201704002&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=KJSHLRW3mLmS08z2l00F0ZiV2kyJvclmgYXDQpzwfqmEcUaqCuimFt7JrrCwbwhC) (which activated PI3K/Akt/GSK-3β and reduced tau phosphorylation), [sodium ferulate](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUquvyNPmcWuJ4b8wc6ptGMogK3K9Qa_4rrfiEysXm2aC169B5wo7MdgeZhRUO9C5pQAo_Ajd__cQmEBxKyAtuhtHk5Z-rWwSIDVaILclY9AXtBn6V5gV8_gseCq148VNdyTNziHXGac7o07BbrAC3y0Mo0sn_Rkq_vRSFeFUQdoV_70RpuFHU2b&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which protected hippocampal neurons via Notch pathway modulation), butylphthalide (which protected endothelial cells from Aβ-induced apoptosis via TLR4/COX-2),<sup data-ref="282">282</sup>, <sup data-ref="283">283</sup> [ZL006](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32594052/) (which activated Akt/Nrf2/HO-1), [MS-275 and JQ1](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34915044/) (which improved memory via CREB and reduced TNF-α), [pioglitazone](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUoTq9ojP78ht9lSjfEB6wGU9zk-8uhoh9Im3Auu_-WKG7aPL1XCHXPus6ihW2rhqIOno3ymGUSLSgEZPHZBseIy0Yfwg9W_ijmRRcDkthu5k1OB2loJf20y3E7DcVU72qKB3U4kIufs-T6buQEfWRVcpwulSPzV_BPv3XmKDHRJcTxVP5aI9j5pHuxVpNsrf1o=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which reduced Aβ and tau via PPARγ activation), [tetrahydroxystilbene](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3teL9xvYmhyqeAetxKkTu0eBPxczZe9litrF0AyfK2FgeBQzKlhW6MilnBuvWgPOOL-16Tc9REkDe0i-uoEmdJ2LxCDVOtRGqcKw4pFaCeumQzil9qt0VJ6K8Q0ucuPe6cimnr00mZmDPgWCNPUVo6sgiJcscw0qs3sJzSsWyTNDUJdpUE8cGYFW&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) glucoside <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced microglial inflammation and APOE/TREM2 expression), [berberine](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11995938/) <sup>⬖</sup> (which promoted microglial M2 polarization via PI3K-AKT signaling, protecting neurons from Aβ-mediated injury), and [5-HT1B receptor inhibition](https://journals.physiology.org/doi/abs/10.1152/physiol.2025.40.S1.0693) (which restored Aβ1-42-disrupted eNOS and Akt phosphorylation in human endothelial cells, suggesting this receptor mediates Aβ-induced vascular dysfunction relevant to AD).
content.cn: 在Aβ细胞模型中表现出神经保护作用的其他物质包括：石斛碱 <sup>⬖</sup> （可提高细胞存活率）、神经保护素D1（可降低Aβ42水平、减少tau蛋白磷酸化及细胞凋亡，同时增强自噬）、姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> （可减少线粒体活性氧，通过Rab蛋白增强自噬，并促进轴突运输）， <sup data-ref="282">282</sup> <sup data-ref="283">283</sup> <sup data-ref="281">281</sup> 淫羊藿素 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过p70 S6K抑制自噬并减少Aβ生成）、一种DPP-4抑制剂（激活PI3K/Akt/GSK-3β通路并降低tau蛋白磷酸化）、 阿魏酸钠 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过调节Notch通路保护海马神经元）、邻苯二甲酰丁酯（通过TLR4/COX-2通路保护内皮细胞免受Aβ诱导的凋亡）、 <sup data-ref="282">282</sup> <sup data-ref="283">283</sup> ZL006（激活Akt/Nrf2/HO-1通路）、 MS-275和JQ1（通过CREB改善记忆并降低TNF-α），吡格列酮（通过激活PPARγ降低Aβ和tau水平），四羟基苯乙烯苷 <sup>⬖</sup> （减轻小胶质细胞炎症并降低APOE/TREM2表达）， 小檗碱 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过PI3K-AKT信号通路促进小胶质细胞向M2型极化，从而保护神经元免受Aβ介导的损伤），以及5-HT1B受体抑制（恢复了Aβ1-42破坏的人内皮细胞中eNOS和Akt的磷酸化，表明该受体介导了与AD相关的Aβ诱导的血管功能障碍）。

content.en: **Okadaic Acid (OA) Models 冈田酸（OA）模型**

Okadaic acid models (which induce tau hyperphosphorylation by inhibiting protein phosphatase 2A) also responded to DMSO-delivered therapies. [Trillium tschonoskii](https://pesquisa.bvsalud.org/portal/resource/pt/wpr-705188) <sup>⬖</sup> decoction improved spatial learning, increased PP2A activity, and reduced tau phosphorylation while preserving hippocampal neurons. [Banqiao Codonopsis pilosula decoction](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201902&filename=1019137901.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=ozVqnX2RwPksLBgptpoLYZQ8dDJEugGzdH7H-3-U0PFugXJCMV8xxOWCua0bT7Gy) <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently improved cognition, reduced tau hyperphosphorylation, and increased synaptic proteins and dendritic spine numbers.<sup data-ref="284">284</sup>, <sup data-ref="285">285</sup> In zebrafish, [Mansonone G](https://sciforum.net/paper/view/25754) <sup>⬖</sup> reversed OA-induced cognitive impairments, improving spatial and recognition memory and restoring cholinergic function. Additional agents include [ginsenoside Rb1](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15830099/) <sup>⬖</sup> (which attenuated tau hyperphosphorylation), [ginkgolide](https://manu41.magtech.com.cn/Jweb_clyl/CN/Y2006/V11/I11/1234) <sup>⬖</sup> [combined with insulin](https://manu41.magtech.com.cn/Jweb_clyl/CN/Y2006/V11/I11/1234) (which synergistically improved learning and reduced neurofibrillary tangles), [pilose antler polypeptide](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3td0bC2W5_LLhIz0x9cNPwau70-IAOhXFXKnB44srj1gknfjTS5blOO96N4-OgGN-h5At8D8dJU1bM5aaqFhaHPAW-G1OhK4WctHHNBXejUzKcyWeT1RqTXgxRCsp9zIi-zi2TE1sajuzyX6zDXizF_h0FpByDu34M74bSlLmyxPB0pGt7vSc6XD&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which activated PI3K/AKT and reduced apoptosis), and [sarsasapogenin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahIvymEMY9HYJ4KA9mN-gjTcCM0_EzmPi3EHbnZ91Lfwk2OMHVHzYNmr0HBycwogek3nM-gnUpJRloTIATLwnshiPDI4iiPMbjUsew98E5rLE6i-wsSzD4LrBkhxkrVyWPnMl_S5Vi60hga-ELcg7xFE_XHubv2ci7pVBL4N66sDcIgIC8BkN3VHbc2hBR2NFgs=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which attenuated tau hyperphosphorylation via Akt/GSK-3β).
content.cn: 冈田酸模型（通过抑制蛋白磷酸酶2A诱导tau蛋白过度磷酸化）也对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）递送的治疗方法产生了反应。 三叶草（Trillium tschonoskii） <sup>⬖</sup> 煎剂改善了空间学习能力，提高了PP2A活性，并减少了tau蛋白的磷酸化，同时保护了海马神经元。板桥党参（Codonopsis pilosula）煎剂 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量依赖性方式改善了认知功能，减少了tau蛋白的过度磷酸化，并增加了突触蛋白和树突棘的数量。 <sup data-ref="284">284</sup> <sup data-ref="285">285</sup> 在斑马鱼模型中，曼森酮G <sup>⬖</sup> 逆转了骨关节炎（OA）诱导的认知障碍，改善了空间记忆和识别记忆，并恢复了胆碱能功能。其他有效成分包括人参皂苷Rb1 <sup>⬖</sup> （可减轻tau蛋白过度磷酸化）、 银杏内酯 <sup>⬖</sup> 与胰岛素联合使用（协同改善学习能力并减少神经原纤维缠结）、毛鹿茸多肽 <sup>⬖</sup> （激活PI3K/AKT通路并减少细胞凋亡），以及沙萨皂苷元 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过Akt/GSK-3β通路减轻tau蛋白过度磷酸化）。

content.en: Tau Pathology Tau
content.cn: 病理学

content.en: Several findings directly address tau, a key driver of neurodegeneration in AD:
content.cn: 有几项研究结果直接涉及tau蛋白——这是阿尔茨海默病（AD）中神经退行性变的关键驱动因素：

content.en: In female mice following traumatic brain injury, [DMSO independently reduced pathological TAU and TDP43 proteins](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40510018/) across multiple brain regions, an effect comparable to glibenclamide. [EGTA](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3ZHcGCTisrRMG-cgOeb1mXDEsOeuZGF88jUAZcoSNHmBYyhtE8kaSCOFKNlCCex8IZrP_4NCQ-ru0dYLGyg5cqV7pdrt7HAP5i19cAAkQfIaNO-5fgu42kNcfGAr-MaAdH6OJ5G_1-QL_AZnnRgehAa14Au-sGC8ebNyNa_zy6BGFKc_cA-zxnV&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (a calcium chelator) decreased tau phosphorylation at Ser396 in AD mice by reducing calpain 2 and CDK5 expression. [Resveratrol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30478674/) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced cadmium-induced tau hyperphosphorylation via AMPK/PI3K/Akt activation, while resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> also reduced tau acetylation and phosphorylation in aged rats with postoperative cognitive dysfunction by activating SIRT1 and shifting microglia from M1 to M2a phenotype.<sup data-ref="286">286</sup>, <sup data-ref="287">287</sup> [Docosahexaenoic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24599472/) <sup>⬖</sup> administered after TBI reduced phosphorylated tau and APP accumulation. [UCH-L1 inhibition](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016267546.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=bMN0FVkG0nRBkvy-UvHptY03FsCOdAoZPz8Ty05Ye1rHrGmnllWoATrQkKj6jAxA) blocked tau aggresome formation by reducing K63-linked ubiquitin chains and impairing HDAC6-tau binding.
content.cn: 在遭受创伤性脑损伤的雌性小鼠中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）独立地降低了多个脑区中病理性的TAU和TDP43蛋白水平，其效果与格列本脲相当。EGTA（一种钙螯合剂）通过降低钙蛋白酶2和CDK5的表达，降低了阿尔茨海默病小鼠中Tau蛋白在Ser396位的磷酸化水平。 白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活 AMPK/PI3K/Akt 通路，减轻了镉诱导的 tau 蛋白过度磷酸化；同时，白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 还通过激活 SIRT1 并促使小胶质细胞从 M1 表型向 M2a 表型转化，降低了术后认知功能障碍的老年大鼠体内 tau 蛋白的乙酰化和磷酸化水平。 <sup data-ref="286">286</sup> <sup data-ref="287">287</sup> 创伤性脑损伤（TBI）后给予二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）可减少磷酸化tau蛋白和APP的积累。UCH-L1抑制通过减少K63连接的泛素链并破坏HDAC6与tau蛋白的结合，阻断了tau蛋白聚集体（aggresome）的形成。

content.en: [In C. elegans](https://morethesis.unimore.it/theses/available/etd-09192023-141749/) (AD strains) hemp extract <sup>⬖</sup> (containing both cannabinoids and terpenes, dispersed in DMSO) significantly increased lifespan in tau-model nematodes, with CBD <sup>⬖</sup> directly hindering protein aggregate formation.
content.cn: 在秀丽隐杆线虫（AD品系）中，大麻提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （同时含有大麻素和萜烯，分散于二甲基亚砜中）显著延长了tau突变模型线虫的寿命，其中CBD <sup>⬖</sup> 直接抑制了蛋白质聚集的形成。

content.en: Oxidative Stress
content.cn: 氧化应激

content.en: [Ferulic acid ethyl ester](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/jnr.20879),<sup>⬖</sup> administered intraperitoneally in DMSO, protected gerbil brain synaptosomes from Aβ-induced oxidative damage, reducing reactive oxygen species, protein oxidation, and lipid peroxidation while boosting antioxidant defenses (HO-1, HSP72) and reducing iNOS. [Astaxanthin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33575874/) <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently improved cognitive performance, reduced Aβ42 and malondialdehyde accumulation, inhibited AChE and MAO activities, and increased Nrf2 and miR-124 expression. [In mice](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0736574810000651), DMSO reduced cerebral ROS by 9.8–79% (greatest effect in young mice) and irreversible oxidative protein damage by 30.7–69% (greatest effect in aged mice); these benefits were further enhanced by curcumin.<sup>⬖</sup> In rats, [SIRT2 inhibition](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37519449/) reduced oxidative stress, increased anti-apoptotic bcl-2, and elevated autophagy regulator beclin-1 in cortex and hippocampus, while [melatonin <sup>⬖</sup> and curcumin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36705304/) <sup>⬖</sup> each reduced lipid peroxidation and SIRT2 expression and increased Nrf2 and antioxidant defenses in the cerebral cortex (though without synergistic effect when combined).
content.cn: 阿魏酸乙酯， <sup>⬖</sup> 以二甲基亚砜（DMSO）为溶剂经腹腔给药，可保护沙鼠脑突触体免受Aβ诱导的氧化损伤，在降低活性氧、蛋白质氧化和脂质过氧化的同时，增强抗氧化防御机制（HO-1、HSP72）并降低iNOS水平。 虾青素 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量依赖性方式改善了认知表现，减少了Aβ42和丙二醛的积累，抑制了乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）和单胺氧化酶（MAO）的活性，并增加了Nrf2和miR-124的表达。 在小鼠实验中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使脑内活性氧（ROS）水平降低了9.8%–79%（对年轻小鼠效果最显著），并将不可逆的氧化性蛋白质损伤降低了30.7%–69%（对老年小鼠效果最显著）；这些益处在姜黄素的作用下进一步增强。 <sup>⬖</sup> 在大鼠实验中， SIRT2抑制可减轻氧化应激，增加抗凋亡蛋白bcl-2的表达，并提高皮质和海马区自噬调节因子beclin-1的水平；而褪黑素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 则分别降低了皮质中的脂质过氧化水平和SIRT2表达，并提高了Nrf2及抗氧化防御能力（尽管两者联合使用时未产生协同效应）。

content.en: [MSM](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32926927/) <sup>⬖</sup> (DMSO’s oxidized metabolite) ameliorated BPA and radiation co-exposure-induced neurodegeneration, reducing AD markers (Aβ42 by 71.6%, AChE by ~50%, tau phosphorylation by 57%), boosting BDNF (132–160%), suppressing the TREM-2/DAP12 pathway, and reducing Aβ plaques by ~75%.
content.cn: MSM <sup>⬖</sup> （DMSO的氧化代谢物）缓解了双酚A（BPA）与辐射联合暴露引起的神经退行性变，降低了阿尔茨海默病（AD）标志物水平（Aβ42降低71.6%， AChE约50%、tau磷酸化57%），促进BDNF（132–160%），抑制TREM-2/DAP12通路，并使Aβ斑块减少约75%。

content.en: *Note: MSM* <sup>⬖</sup> *crosses the blood-brain barrier rapidly (detectable within ~10 minutes of oral intake), reaching brain concentrations of ~2.36 mM after oral supplementation with a half-life of approximately 7.5 days.<sup data-ref="288">288</sup>, <sup data-ref="289">289</sup>*
content.cn: 注：MSM <sup>⬖</sup> 可迅速穿过血脑屏障（口服后约10分钟内即可检测到），口服补充后脑内浓度可达约2.36 mM，半衰期约为7.5天。 <sup data-ref="288">288</sup> <sup data-ref="289">289</sup>

content.en: AChE Inhibition and Drug Screening
content.cn: 乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制与药物筛选

content.en: In addition to DMSO itself being an AChE inhibitor, a variety of AChE inhibitors have been tested in DMSO for AD relevance. [Novel tacrine-hydroxamic acid derivatives](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahJgtlh6a5gPRO63XJ-o1_QyL8mIJlXVcnyhLIqk9UFw86lzc3fD7akCnfxYdASbz_E0gDNmg3z0DOixb2A7t2uj5DRDy5tVbckrTvw9_99I0Zwr3gazEw6C1VEdPJiZxSTTxI122XPe4E1NFSrRO8Qb6c2XRG2RQ2sBotYyBzGkoYr7x2naWsJRwX_S2Sks9jw=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) showed potent dual AChE/HDAC inhibition with Aβ inhibition, while [thiazole-based inhibitors](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahKiq8PNQpcV6YAnXcQ7BbTnr5MxT6sIOE6liOppysRmuuecGMOOVNJy8kkDW-IKvR21_W5bfAMUIXCnUw0SWMZLXYSLvc6CZtGVo-knX8IuQmMKotTimDfX4449ukY_4HI15KqZpN99ZeGnu1JJVMYNiLV2X_wCbAs8fxGHR7ONKgKzs-3fUI91g8jJU8LUopk=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) outperformed rivastigmine and huperzine-A. Among 21 flavonoids screened, [galangin](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0009279710003170) showed the strongest brain AChE inhibition (IC50 ~120 μM). [Another screening](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39818048/) identified a multifunctional probe that (with DMSO) bound Aβ aggregates, inhibited cholinesterase, and improved cognitive and spatial memory.
content.cn: 除了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）本身就是一种乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）抑制剂外，还曾以DMSO为溶剂对多种AChE抑制剂进行了与阿尔茨海默病（AD）相关性的测试。新型塔克林-羟胺酸衍生物表现出强效的AChE/组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）双重抑制作用，并具有抑制Aβ的作用；而噻唑类抑制剂的性能则优于利伐斯汀明和石杉碱甲。 在筛选的21种黄酮类化合物中，高良姜素对脑内乙酰胆碱酯酶的抑制作用最强（IC50 约120 μM）。另一项筛选发现了一种多功能探针，该探针（与DMSO结合后）能结合Aβ聚集体、抑制胆碱酯酶，并改善认知能力和空间记忆。

content.en: Natural Compounds and Model Organisms
content.cn: 天然化合物与模式生物

content.en: A wide range of natural compounds dissolved in DMSO have shown neuroprotective effects in AD models. In C. elegans, [olive leaf extract](https://opendata.uni-halle.de/bitstream/1981185920/103152/1/Dissertation_MLU_2022_SaierChristina.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> strongly protected neurons from Aβ-induced degeneration, while 3-hydroxytyrosol,<sup>⬖</sup> tyrosol,<sup>⬖</sup> saffron,<sup>⬖</sup> Polygonum multiflorum,<sup>⬖</sup> and Ziziphus jujuba <sup>⬖</sup> each also provided significant protection.<sup data-ref="290">290</sup> [Cannabidiol](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11357-022-00559-7) <sup>⬖</sup> extended lifespan and slowed age-related neuronal deterioration in C. elegans and enhanced neurite outgrowth and dendritic spine density in mammalian neurons through the same SIRT1 pathway. [Quercetin <sup>⬖</sup> and rifampicin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38287930/) individually reduced Aβ plaques, with the combination producing the greatest clearance. [Quercetin <sup>⬖</sup> and kaempferol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CPFD&dbname=CPFD9908&filename=ZGYS200200002058&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=jo4jr0zDHjhvyrQUtzXYGMk7ULXkrLIbqhPKPpjF3LKKyg_bAWn8oECHUlQ7VAjomwFN3R09XeY%3d) <sup>⬖</sup> (polyphenols isolated from Ginkgo biloba cell cultures) dose-dependently reduced protein carbonylation in C. elegans, a key marker of aging-related protein damage linked to neurodegenerative diseases. [Oxoisoaporphine-lipoic acid hybrids](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201501&filename=1014393144.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=troGhTDQwMk1-ugdfY3GLTfJGArfP-1bFKxbeoY5GvKJD9QSJx9EdOeHwARrxm16) improved learning, memory, lifespan, and AChE inhibition in Aβ42 transgenic Drosophila. In zebrafish, [purinergic receptor antagonists](https://repositorio.pucrs.br/dspace/bitstream/10923/22580/2/Avaliao_do_potencial_neuroprotetor_de_agonistas_e_antagonistas_do_sistema_purinrgico_em_modelos_de_dficit_cognitivo.pdf) (caffeine, ZM241385, DPCPX) prevented scopolamine-induced memory impairment.
content.cn: 多种溶解于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的天然化合物在阿尔茨海默病（AD）模型中均表现出神经保护作用。在秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）中，橄榄叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 能有效保护神经元免受Aβ诱导的退化，而3-羟基酪醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 酪醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 藏红花、 <sup>⬖</sup> 何首乌、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及枣 <sup>⬖</sup> 也都分别提供了显著的保护作用。 <sup data-ref="290">290</sup> 大麻二酚 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过相同的 SIRT1 通路，延长了秀丽隐杆线虫的寿命，减缓了其与年龄相关的神经元退化，并增强了哺乳动物神经元的神经突生长和树突棘密度。槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和利福平单独使用时均可减少 Aβ 斑块，而两者联合使用时清除效果最佳。 槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和山奈酚 <sup>⬖</sup> （从银杏叶细胞培养物中分离出的多酚）以剂量依赖性方式降低了秀丽隐杆线虫体内的蛋白质碳酰化水平，这是与神经退行性疾病相关的、衰老相关蛋白质损伤的关键标志物。 氧异阿普芬-硫辛酸杂合物改善了Aβ42转基因果蝇的学习能力、记忆力、寿命以及乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）的抑制作用。在斑马鱼中，嘌呤能受体拮抗剂（咖啡因、ZM241385、DPCPX）可预防东莨菪碱诱导的记忆障碍。

content.en: In cell and animal models, carvacrol <sup>⬖</sup> protected neurons from Aβ-induced neurotoxicity and improved memory in AD rats,<sup data-ref="291">291</sup>, <sup data-ref="292">292</sup> while [Ashwagandha-derived withanolides](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/yakushi/128/8/128_8_1159/_pdf/-char/ja) <sup>⬖</sup> restored axon/dendrite lengths and synaptic markers in Aβ-injured neurons and reversed memory deficits when given orally. [Cynarae folium extracts](https://openurl.ebsco.com/EPDB%3Agcd%3A8%3A35676568/detailv2?sid=ebsco%3Aplink%3Ascholar&id=ebsco%3Agcd%3A190739001&crl=c&link_origin=scholar.google.com) <sup>⬖</sup> exhibited neuroprotective effects against Aβ in both cells and rats, while in drug-resistant Aβ flies, [anle138b](https://pub.dzne.de/record/144866) significantly prolonged survival. [Ptychopetalum olacoides extract](https://lume.ufrgs.br/bitstream/handle/10183/53613/000628104.pdf?sequence=1) reversed MK-801-induced amnesia, suggesting involvement of the glutamatergic system in its cognitive-enhancing properties.
content.cn: 在细胞和动物模型中，香芹酚 <sup>⬖</sup> 能保护神经元免受 Aβ 诱导的神经毒性损害，并改善阿尔茨海默病大鼠的记忆力， <sup data-ref="291">291</sup> <sup data-ref="292">292</sup> 而源自阿什瓦甘达的维塔诺甾醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 经口给药后，不仅能恢复 Aβ 损伤神经元中轴突/树突的长度及突触标志物，还能逆转记忆缺陷。 洋蓟叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 在细胞和大鼠模型中均表现出对抗Aβ的神经保护作用；而在耐药性Aβ果蝇中，anle138b显著延长了存活时间。Ptychopetalum olacoides提取物逆转了MK-801诱导的健忘症，这表明谷氨酸能系统与其认知增强特性有关。

content.en: Additional natural compounds showing anti-Aβ effects include curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="293">293</sup>, <sup data-ref="294">294</sup> (which suppressed microglial HMGB1/RAGE/NF-κB signaling), [bisdemethoxycurcumin](https://journal.china-pharmacy.com/zh/article/doi/10.6039/j.issn.1001-0408.2024.05.12/),<sup>⬖</sup> [Ginkgo biloba polyphenols](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=ZGYA201707005&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=26F6mZdYzEBeH3pY2_RuOwlt7vyeM2cx1x1aKVh56H_nG6JFMkepl5UkVtSsWUl5) <sup>⬖</sup> (which protected dPC12 cells from Aβ damage), [Perilla frutescens](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20183031555) <sup>⬖</sup> (which disaggregated preformed Aβ aggregates), [icariin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=BATE201702001&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=t4E1t_FTcCec00SCXYkvLSZSZD_kWLd3JyxRUGVfwZVpiCxBsrUPsQE326-q1PEQ) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced iNOS and TNF-α and improved cognition in LPS-induced AD mice), various edible sprout extracts <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="295">295</sup>, <sup data-ref="296">296</sup>, <sup data-ref="297">297</sup> (with buckwheat sprouts <sup>⬖</sup> showing the strongest ROS suppression and Aβ reduction), [curcumin](https://d1wqtxts1xzle7.cloudfront.net/39476164/Alzheimers_disease_diagnosis_and_monito20151027-15757-19lq6n7-libre.pdf?1445994740=&response-content-disposition=inline%3B+filename%3DAlzheimers_disease_diagnosis_and_monitor.pdf&Expires=1772619901&Signature=NF7ktUkJM4wKVxN0SJ4jdGPlqqrkfbD2FhscdB3EB0CY7h8SjLvGrx4bAcjDexP3HbR-eQZbysxJItrMNvVubBq1xfMdXDj2s7UJ0vXC~wShfha2eudC3CQVplmVZ2ppVXPNl2joJAlawFOK571o-Xbz83B3CcRt-mT4~6BwZrK-weCECFBosMXlaTSBxFfS7QpDD-huI6S9uFJDDsx2G1T0jIsWgT27wWCua-3jlL1QFicczFwyrUab637MEYqdBLnJVBIqJUwo2J8K~YK2QcAnlMQCuai34hrBg7CZPCosgyzCq205zonchtqcbEUYyLzFUhLmGGnlL42o6c8ijg__&Key-Pair-Id=APKAJLOHF5GGSLRBV4ZA) <sup>⬖</sup> (which, through binding amyloid, enabled in vivo detection of retinal amyloid in live transgenic AD mice via confocal ophthalmoscopy, demonstrating the potential for non-invasive AD diagnosis), and the [polyphenols nordihydroguaiaretic acid,](https://www.um.edu.mt/library/oar/handle/123456789/34379)<sup>⬖</sup> [baicalein,](https://www.um.edu.mt/library/oar/handle/123456789/34379)<sup>⬖</sup> [and Padina extract](https://www.um.edu.mt/library/oar/handle/123456789/34379) <sup>⬖</sup> (which protected cells from Aβ42-induced damage). [Curcumin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18990234/) <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO also achieved high serum solubility (at least 3 mM), effectively inhibiting Aβ plaque formation.
content.cn: 其他具有抗Aβ作用的天然化合物包括姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="295">295</sup> <sup data-ref="296">296</sup> （其可抑制小胶质细胞的HMGB1/RAGE/NF-κB信号传导）、双去甲氧基姜黄素、 <sup>⬖</sup> 银杏多酚 <sup>⬖</sup> （可保护dPC12细胞免受Aβ损伤）， 紫苏 <sup>⬖</sup> （可解聚预形成的Aβ聚集物）、淫羊藿素 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低iNOS和TNF-α水平，并改善LPS诱导的AD小鼠的认知功能）、各种可食用芽苗提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="295">295</sup> <sup data-ref="296">296</sup> <sup data-ref="297">297</sup> （其中荞麦芽 <sup>⬖</sup> 表现出最强的活性氧（ROS）抑制和Aβ降低作用）、姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> （其通过与淀粉样蛋白结合，使研究人员能够利用共聚焦眼底镜在活体转基因AD小鼠中检测视网膜淀粉样蛋白，从而证明了其用于非侵入性AD诊断的潜力），以及多酚类化合物北二氢桂皮酸、 <sup>⬖</sup> 黄芩素、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及海茸提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （可保护细胞免受Aβ42诱导的损伤）。溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 也具有较高的血清溶解度（至少3 mM），能有效抑制Aβ斑块的形成。

content.en: Aging-Related AD Models
content.cn: 与衰老相关的阿尔茨海默病模型

content.en: D-galactose injection creates accelerated aging in rodents that models age-related cognitive decline. [Guilingji](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUoFk9kG2yWtEE1npomub64yMuJHguzzXTlOFeO97zsg-nNele_3ZwDxHd2155W4DF-xxnzWFum_IkNxT5H9dXN88J6A4hDRCeVmFVoQ_7bJhhQHFWtBju8xLqSIgnBrSULOsbHGF-s-jtBSmJ5IXY5OerYMNgjRoVYZ2ZEzj5REDnFmlKxyLyKNiwCXiAEuYlQ=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (a traditional formula) significantly improved Morris water maze performance in D-galactose-aged rats, restoring antioxidant activity and normalizing neurotransmitters. [Ganoderma](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35390035/) tsugae extract <sup>⬖</sup> improved locomotion, learning, and memory by increasing brain antioxidant enzymes and BDNF while reducing inflammasome activation. [Kurarinone](https://search.ebscohost.com/login.aspx?direct=true&profile=ehost&scope=site&authtype=crawler&jrnl=1672416X&AN=189169986&h=wmPLXCPv8wf3ZE5NLYBMziVbr6Wsmh2QMDCkpzft6TUtUnW%2FfpY3BUt8ri1auTnh4sXYeUBdI1NMcw9Mka4Hqg%3D%3D&crl=c) <sup>⬖</sup> combined with rehabilitation exercise synergistically improved spatial learning and memory, upregulated synaptic plasticity markers (PSD-95, synaptophysin), and reduced Aβ1-42 deposition via the BACE1/Aβ pathway. [Resveratrol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2012&filename=YAOL201201032&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=nD7mGT_MDqDIjoWd6FqCy6xX_bNd-FfkH1M3hC4__F6KHiahjI0sX9drMeWkn9-H) <sup>⬖</sup> [significantly increased](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2012&filename=YAOL201201032&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=nD7mGT_MDqDIjoWd6FqCy6xX_bNd-FfkH1M3hC4__F6KHiahjI0sX9drMeWkn9-H) SOD and decreased oxidative damage in hippocampal neurons of mice with D-galactose-induced aging. [Curcumin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016232380.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=JOz285zGDSDX73cHvfyMODUfnTGlgDBD9QEoGhthcJUhcSIoe7nzb0ZjeUp1k6hp) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced APP and tau expression and suppressed HAT activity in AD rats. [Artemisinin](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-42782-4_22) <sup>⬖</sup> also demonstrated neuroprotective effects in an animal model of AD prevention.
content.cn: D-半乳糖注射可在啮齿类动物体内诱导加速衰老，从而模拟与年龄相关的认知功能下降。 桂灵剂 <sup>⬖</sup> （一种传统方剂）显著改善了D-半乳糖诱导衰老大鼠在莫里斯水迷宫中的表现，恢复了抗氧化活性并使神经递质水平恢复正常。桧木灵芝提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过增加脑内抗氧化酶和脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）的水平，同时抑制炎性小体的激活，从而改善了运动能力、学习和记忆能力。 库拉林酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 与康复训练相结合，协同改善了空间学习和记忆能力，上调了突触可塑性标志物（PSD-95、突触素），并通过 BACE1/Aβ 通路减少了 Aβ1-42 的沉积。白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著增加了 D-半乳糖诱导衰老小鼠海马神经元中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）水平，并减轻了氧化损伤。 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 可降低阿尔茨海默病大鼠体内的APP和tau蛋白表达，并抑制HAT活性。青蒿素 <sup>⬖</sup> 在阿尔茨海默病预防的动物模型中也表现出神经保护作用。

content.en: Aluminum chloride, which induces Aβ plaque accumulation and tau phosphorylation, was counteracted by a bithiophene derivative that restored antioxidant defenses, prevented neuronal and synaptic loss, and mitigated AD-related pathology.<sup data-ref="298">298</sup>, <sup data-ref="299">299</sup>
content.cn: 氯化铝会诱导Aβ斑块的积累和tau蛋白的磷酸化，而一种二噻吩衍生物则能抵消其作用，该衍生物不仅恢复了抗氧化防御机制，还防止了神经元和突触的丧失，并缓解了与阿尔茨海默病相关的病理变化。 <sup data-ref="298">298</sup> <sup data-ref="299">299</sup>

content.en: Vascular Dementia
content.cn: 血管性痴呆

content.en: Vascular dementia (VaD) results from chronic cerebral hypoperfusion that causes progressive neuronal damage and cognitive decline, making DMSO well suited for the condition.
content.cn: 血管性痴呆（VaD）是由慢性脑灌注不足引起的，会导致神经元逐渐受损和认知功能下降，因此二甲基亚砜（DMSO）非常适合用于治疗该病症。

content.en: Two p38 MAPK inhibitors dissolved in DMSO repeatedly improved spatial learning and memory in rats with bilateral carotid artery occlusion-induced VaD, reducing hippocampal apoptosis, extending survival, and decreasing p38 MAPK phosphorylation.<sup data-ref="300">300</sup>, <sup data-ref="301">301</sup>, <sup data-ref="302">302</sup> Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO dose-dependently improved learning and memory in rats with bilateral carotid artery occlusion-induced VaD, reducing hippocampal pathology and promoting brain cholesterol efflux via the LXR/RXR-ABCA1-apoA1 pathway.<sup data-ref="303">303</sup>, <sup data-ref="304">304</sup>, <sup data-ref="305">305</sup> [Paeoniflorin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2018&filename=1018863540.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=IvJD_MIqo7COw1JaK8OJNk-wjfxE_IVyom6vQJc531NHBAQrImo1bOGydMm-8mzq) <sup>⬖</sup> improved learning and memory in VaD rats by reducing proinflammatory cytokines and inducing microglial polarization from M1 to M2 via cannabinoid receptor type 2. [Cathepsin B inhibition](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40447852/) reduced mitochondrial abnormalities, neuronal apoptosis, neuroinflammation, and cognitive dysfunction after transient middle cerebral artery occlusion.
content.cn: 两种溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的p38 MAPK抑制剂，能反复改善因双侧颈动脉闭塞诱导的血管性痴呆（VaD）大鼠的空间学习和记忆能力，减少海马区细胞凋亡，延长生存期，并降低p38 MAPK的磷酸化水平。 <sup data-ref="303">303</sup> <sup data-ref="304">304</sup> <sup data-ref="305">305</sup> 溶于DMSO的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量依赖性方式改善了双侧颈动脉闭塞诱导的血管性痴呆大鼠的学习和记忆能力，减轻了海马病理变化，并通过LXR/RXR-ABCA1-apoA1通路促进了脑内胆固醇的外排。 <sup data-ref="303">303</sup> <sup data-ref="304">304</sup> <sup data-ref="305">305</sup> 芍花苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过减少促炎细胞因子，并经由大麻素受体2型诱导小胶质细胞从M1型向M2型极化，从而改善了VaD大鼠的学习和记忆能力。 在短暂性大脑中动脉闭塞后，抑制猫hepsin B可减轻线粒体异常、神经元凋亡、神经炎症和认知功能障碍。

content.en: Additional agents improving cognition in VaD models include [andrographolide](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2014&filename=HBYK201402003&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=9naQxJBEeydg5ZbxXBXLuAWH3vqIjr6aTnZM9JyEZfvQNnFp61B7UHB-oHp4QoKR) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced hippocampal apoptosis and increased Bcl-2), [PGE1](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=QYWA201720021&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=U6LWmHgdGyDBhXJDQ6DAkjdEy8b6c73h1h3XDoqHYytIn8am7fMaO3_QyjJrDX8l) (which improved learning and memory via the BDNF/TrkB pathway), [esketamine](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxmg-d1BEHsGiAcxvccz_46Eu-sMM96V2PRBUAIsRoDBwnC3ZgVdk2xcSbQ0K0_LTEgPzavBzwb6BmZk5xgmVzzyos5-rx5HeNeTIGu_LMhfo--4N-7DZFNxZ3A48sXPNr7DG3_QyWDlAGgSaIow-sTCSZ9SvQxUNZbuxS2KI7o8pytPMJJvWl4NoXKRM5HZ-dw=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which upregulated BDNF, ERK, and Nrf2), [tripchlorolide](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=GLYZ201724008&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=PovXhSV-2SIUIOH53Gyb7ej7PRbrAGSIXK5iW0Fs3AgWy4nQkjoUXDaUw8jRNcrn) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced Aβ, NF-κB, and COX-2), [IGF-1](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201502&filename=1015317131.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=7GQIjAy_D80QDNmvuXF4NVe8-_uihbQdHmM7jgrgPtSdUo-WOGVj2MUiDJtvOCh7) (which improved cognition via Akt/mTOR), [intranasal recombinant erythropoietin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015984731.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=vmlpozQr7qYA2G2lKSIyUPQYjIp7VfjYsQFPeyIT9_t9ELIXtkuzUZEqTh6-CdXB) (which improved escape latency and preserved hippocampal neurons), the [Shenmayizhi formula](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVBJciOtQzxHec7Gm7Xhd0Qzn6VGa0m9XFMkv2Z49T4KSK8VQ3Ipa95wAzfDFye5TiFsV1s8mfFXbAYXh5f-tfelFRGuEbbzetUR0WXVha1j9i_FomOws9dGckXhy_zEBI_xAzoJ_Tkdr_4wz130kv3r2vntmwWqbLd2YrcA_vvbCL8n_8fLQVwRY0k0BRQXIrI=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which upregulated synaptic proteins and VEGF), [resveratrol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDOLMU38Kw_9XZlfplGovLV0K7Ocsa-5Gvi8a6VckofnRL3UCF2_ezdfGuTEt3oHvrfeHv08QKymthj6yGsfb_aVn6GN6A2nar3L_ZlENtq35LZ1-NNQS8We3OzG8AgfEEbJ02SxmRppLxk-9x4EQFS5SOJv8x7bxVwddvDAhU97WfXIkjbUMNW&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) with SIRT1 activation (which improved cognition and enhanced antioxidant capacity in chronic cerebral ischemia), [HDAC inhibitor compound 13](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34216182/) (which activated BDNF isoforms and modulated AMPA receptor signaling), [rapamycin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201401&filename=1014146111.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=1WUyBo-mVgb2GLUh0NrKOKMirq2u1Cq1pPhYlh2BEnhW7VDpm_4yTX_h-hFOwWBs) (which reversed mTOR-mediated autophagy suppression, reducing Aβ accumulation and tau hyperphosphorylation in diabetic rats after orthopedic surgery), and [emodin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=DSDX201701008&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=OABVxdVAh9b1ChnPfkSPBuYZapidoLeq5Si62UbZIkOWJYrFeVhZsQrAJ7csnoPs) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced ROS and inhibited neointimal proliferation in carotid artery stenosis). [Quercetin](https://assets-eu.researchsquare.com/files/rs-1030799/v1/6e71a480-d801-4cbb-b29b-9a4848f46bf6.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> also alleviated hippocampal demyelination in a bilateral carotid artery stenosis model.
content.cn: 在血管性痴呆（VaD）模型中，其他可改善认知功能的药物还包括穿心莲内酯 <sup>⬖</sup> （可减少海马区细胞凋亡并增加Bcl-2表达）、PGE1（通过BDNF/TrkB通路改善学习和记忆能力）、艾司克他明（可上调BDNF、ERK、 和Nrf2的表达）、三氯蒺藜苷 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低Aβ、NF-κB和COX-2水平）、 IGF-1（通过Akt/mTOR途径改善认知功能）、鼻内给药的重组促红细胞生成素（改善逃逸潜伏期并保护海马神经元）、神妙之方 <sup>⬖</sup> （上调突触蛋白和VEGF）、伴随SIRT1活化的白藜芦醇（在慢性脑缺血中改善认知功能并增强抗氧化能力）、 组史丁抑制剂化合物13（可激活BDNF同工型并调节AMPA受体信号传导）、雷帕霉素（可逆转mTOR介导的自噬抑制，从而在骨科手术后的糖尿病大鼠中减少Aβ积累和tau蛋白过度磷酸化），以及大黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> （可在颈动脉狭窄模型中降低活性氧并抑制内膜增生）。 槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 还缓解了双侧颈动脉狭窄模型中的海马脱髓鞘现象。

content.en: *Note: molar loss (tooth extraction) in VaD rats worsened cognitive impairment and increased hippocampal apoptosis and iNOS/p38 MAPK/NF-κB expression; [a p38 MAPK inhibitor in](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36408103/) DMSO reduced these effects, illustrating that dental health impacts cerebrovascular cognitive decline.
content.cn: 注：VaD大鼠的牙齿缺失（拔牙）加剧了认知功能障碍，并增加了海马区的细胞凋亡以及iNOS/p38 MAPK/NF-κB的表达；DMSO中的p38 MAPK抑制剂减轻了这些影响，这表明牙齿健康会影响脑血管性认知功能衰退。*

content.en: DMSO has also been used to differentiate bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) [into neuron-like cells](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2014&filename=GYYB201402003&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=B7LKKQvSYM9S4Hv5G1WgEN7bsz9i9O3APfQN2njBCtwZanbAdG7x6eMOKSgR6Y-I) expressing neuronal markers (using a 2% DMSO/BHA medium), which were then transplanted into VaD rat brains, and [BMSCs promoted recovery of an AD cell](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201901&filename=1018288493.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=NCmEArweqRmC_9AuBTILoskZ6JmBJxTQ8fv1vvHducR4x3y4LuqWFj3tmfVWVSvJ) model by upregulating PDGF-BB via the PI3K/AKT pathway.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还被用于将骨髓间充质干细胞（BMSCs）分化为表达神经元标志物的神经元样细胞（使用2% DMSO/BHA培养基），随后将这些细胞移植到VaD大鼠脑内；此外，BMSCs通过PI3K/AKT通路上调PDGF-BB，从而促进了阿尔茨海默病（AD）细胞模型的恢复。

content.en: Reader Reports
content.cn: 读者反馈

content.en: [My uncle’s wife](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/105218392) has dementia and has been unable to speak for over a year. My mom recently visited them and told them about DMSO. He began to give his wife DMSO orally. After two weeks she began to talk again.
content.cn: 我舅舅的妻子患有痴呆症，已经一年多无法说话了。我妈妈最近去探望他们时，向他们介绍了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）。他开始让妻子口服二甲基亚砜。两周后，她又开始说话了。

content.en: [I read the article](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/92330056) and began giving it to my 93 year old mother in her juice every morning the end of November. She has had some form of dementia for over 15 years. In the last year or so she would get sundowners really bad and could not follow instructions. Since taking the DMSO, she no longer suffers with sundowners. She is more “with it” and can communicate and laugh with us. Her personality is back. She is able to understand when I am asking her to use the bathroom. She is more cognitive and has started coloring in her coloring books again.
content.cn: 我读了这篇文章，从11月底开始，每天早上都在93岁的母亲的果汁里加入这种物质。她患有某种形式的痴呆症已有15年以上。 在过去一年左右的时间里，她曾出现非常严重的“日落综合征”，无法听从指示。自从服用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以来，她不再受“日落综合征”的困扰。她变得更加“神志清醒”，能够与我们交流并开怀大笑。她的个性又回来了。当我提醒她去洗手间时，她能够理解我的意思。她的认知能力有所提升，并开始重新在涂色书上涂色了。

content.en: [I deeply appreciate your posts on DMSO](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/107777444). You helped bring spontaneous interaction back into the life of my father with Alzheimer’s. As well as many other people I have educated about its uses. God bless you.
content.cn: 我非常感谢您关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的帖子。您帮助我患有阿尔茨海默病的父亲重新找回了自发的互动能力。此外，我还向许多其他人介绍了它的用途，他们也从中受益。愿上帝保佑您。

content.en: [We have a customer](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/243494255) who has shared his wife uses dmso and it has slowed down dementia for her compared to the same group of people the doctor was working with and comparing
content.cn: 有一位客户告诉我们，他的妻子在使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），与医生所负责的对照组相比，这种治疗延缓了她的痴呆症进展。

content.en: [Meanwhile, your DMSO information](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/166393498) seems to have been a game-changer for him \[a stroke patient\]. We are now about eight weeks into treatment and I have observed: voice is stronger, speech is markedly improved, appetite has increased, dysphagia has changed dramatically---he is now able to eat normal-sized meals. He now feeds himself almost exclusively, using his affected hand. His sense of taste has started to return.
content.cn: 与此同时，您提供的关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的信息似乎彻底改变了他的状况\[一位中风患者\]。目前治疗已进行约八周，我观察到：他的声音更洪亮了，语言能力显著改善，食欲增强，吞咽困难的情况发生了巨大变化——他现在能够进食正常分量的餐食。他现在几乎完全能用患侧手自己进食。他的味觉也开始恢复。

content.en: [We have been using several of the therapies](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/166831954) you have informed us of. I started putting 2/3 teaspoon DMSO with a teaspoon of galactose <sup>⬖</sup> in his coffee each morning. I started giving him 2 teaspoons after breakfast in juice and again 2 teaspoons in the afternoon, with good results. Is he cured? NO but he’s functioning a lot better.
content.cn: 我们一直在采用您向我们介绍的几种疗法。我开始每天早上在他的咖啡里加入2/3茶匙二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和一茶匙半乳糖 <sup>⬖</sup> 。早餐后，我开始让他喝两茶匙掺有二甲基亚砜的果汁，下午再喝两茶匙，效果不错。他痊愈了吗？没有，但他现在的身体状况好多了。

content.en: Lastly, [a reader shared](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/164701931) their partner (75) was diagnosed with an inoperable 8cm glioblastoma causing a slow brain bleed, losing the ability to speak, and right-side paralysis, with a prognosis of 3 weeks to live. After copious topical 99% DMSO, motor function began returning within 24 hours. By week 3, he was eating meals at the table. By week 4, he could walk with a walker. A new CT scan at day 55 showed no brain bleed and reduced tumor metrics.
content.cn: 最后，一位读者分享道，他的伴侣（75岁）被诊断出患有8厘米的不可手术切除胶质母细胞瘤，该肿瘤导致缓慢的脑出血、丧失语言能力以及右侧瘫痪，预后仅剩3周寿命。 在大量外用99%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，24小时内运动功能开始恢复。到第3周，他已能坐在餐桌前进食。到第4周，他可以借助助行器行走。第55天进行的新一次CT扫描显示，脑出血已消失，肿瘤指标也有所下降。

content.en: Multiple Sclerosis
content.cn: 多发性硬化症

content.en: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune disease in which the immune system attacks myelin, the insulating sheath around nerves in the brain and spinal cord. As demyelinated nerves progressively lose their ability to transmit signals, patients develop worsening neurological deficits including impaired mobility, vision loss, pain, and cognitive decline. Despite decades of research, existing therapies primarily suppress the immune attack but do not restore lost myelin, leaving patients with accumulating disability.
content.cn: 多发性硬化症（MS）是一种自身免疫性疾病，其特征是免疫系统会攻击包裹在大脑和脊髓神经周围的绝缘鞘——髓鞘。随着脱髓鞘神经逐渐丧失传导信号的能力，患者会出现日益严重的神经功能缺损，包括活动能力受限、视力丧失、疼痛和认知能力下降。尽管经过数十年的研究，现有的治疗方法主要仅能抑制免疫攻击，却无法恢复已丧失的髓鞘，导致患者的残疾状况不断加重。

content.en: DMSO has several properties that make it mechanistically well-suited for MS: it crosses the blood-brain barrier, reduces harmful immune activity, decreases inflammation, improves circulation (including to vulnerable white matter tracts), and as discussed in the protein folding section, acts as a chemical chaperone that stabilizes proteins. Additionally, DMSO [inhibited the blood clotting triggered by myelin debris in a dose-dependent manner](https://kazanmedjournal.ru/kazanmedj/article/view/88054) — significant because when myelin is broken apart by the immune system, exposed phospholipids activate clotting pathways that compromise the blood supply nerves depend on, providing a secondary mechanism for MS neurodegeneration that existing anticoagulants do not target. [DMSO also prevented bilirubin-induced toxicity](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25160671/) in myelinated axons, suggesting DMSO directly protects myelin from the blood breakdown products released during hemorrhage or inflammatory demyelination (likewise [a caspase-1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=DYJD201805011&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=0enhLsA2gKt6QaO2N5TRC8ZwKf7KhiGwLR1JNPJIS_Oht4Qq2ZR8P9qn6_cQ5DjJ) —in DMSO—reversed bilirubin’s NLRP3-mediated damage to hippocampal neurons).
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有多种特性，使其在机制上非常适合用于治疗多发性硬化症（MS）：它能穿过血脑屏障，抑制有害的免疫活性，减轻炎症，改善血液循环（包括对易受损的白质束的供血），并且如“蛋白质折叠”一节所述，它还能作为化学伴侣蛋白来稳定蛋白质。 此外，DMSO以剂量依赖性方式抑制了由髓鞘碎片引发的血液凝固——这一点意义重大，因为当髓鞘被免疫系统破坏时，暴露的磷脂会激活凝血通路，从而损害神经所依赖的血液供应，这为多发性硬化症的神经退行性变提供了一种现有抗凝剂无法针对的次要机制。 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还防止了胆红素对有髓轴突的毒性作用，这表明DMSO能直接保护髓鞘免受出血或炎症性脱髓鞘过程中释放的血液分解产物的影响（同样，一种溶酶体相关蛋白酶-1（caspase-1）抑制剂——在DMSO中——逆转了胆红素通过NLRP3介导对海马神经元的损伤）。

content.en: This circulatory perspective on MS also aligns with a broader theory that beyond insufficient blood flow to the brain, impaired venous and lymphatic drainage from the brain also contribute to neurodegeneration — both by retaining toxins and by disrupting the glymphatic system (the brain’s waste clearance pathway), leading to accumulation of pathological proteins like β-amyloid and α-synuclein. In 2009, [it was proposed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19060024/) that MS was linked to chronic cerebrospinal venous insufficiency (CCSVI) — poor drainage from the head through the jugular veins — and significant clinical improvements were reported after stenting the jugular veins open (a technique also used for other complex neurological conditions before being restricted due to [both pharmaceutical lobbying](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-can-a-ms-charity-teach-us-about) and [legitimate safety concerns](https://caringmedical.com/prolotherapy-news/chronic-cerebrospinal-venous-insufficiency/)). More recently, in China, lymphatic-venous anastomosis (LVA) — a microsurgery that creates direct connections between the neck’s deep cervical lymphatic vessels and adjacent veins to bypass obstructed drainage — has already produced dramatic short-term improvements for dementia patients and is now offered at over 30 surgical centers.<sup data-ref="306">306</sup>, <sup data-ref="307">307</sup>, <sup data-ref="308">308</sup>
content.cn: 这种从循环角度看待多发性硬化症（MS）的观点，也与一项更广泛的理论相吻合：除了脑部血流不足外，脑部静脉和淋巴引流受阻也会导致神经退行性变——这既是因为毒素滞留，也是因为干扰了“甘淋巴系统”（大脑的废物清除通路），从而导致β-淀粉样蛋白和α-突触核蛋白等病理性蛋白质的积累。 2009年，有研究提出多发性硬化症与慢性脑脊液静脉功能不全（CCSVI）有关——即通过颈内静脉从头部排出脑脊液的引流不畅——且有报告称，在通过支架扩张颈内静脉后，患者的临床症状显著改善（该技术此前也曾用于治疗其他复杂的神经系统疾病，但后来因制药行业的游说以及合理的安全顾虑而受到限制）。 更近期的研究显示，在中国，淋巴静脉吻合术（LVA）——一种通过在颈部深颈淋巴管与相邻静脉之间建立直接连接以绕过阻塞的引流通道的显微外科手术——已为痴呆症患者带来了显著的短期改善，目前已有超过30家外科中心提供该手术。 <sup data-ref="306">306</sup> <sup data-ref="307">307</sup> <sup data-ref="308">308</sup>

content.en: *Note: [this article](https://caringmedical.com/prolotherapy-news/chronic-cerebrospinal-venous-insufficiency/) provides an excellent synopsis of the evidence for CCSVI and the neurological conditions it causes (although our treatment approach differs from the authors).<sup data-ref="309">309</sup>, <sup data-ref="310">310</sup>
content.cn: 注：本文对CCSVI的相关证据及其引发的神经系统疾病进行了极佳的综述（尽管我们的治疗方法与作者有所不同）。 <sup data-ref="309">309</sup> <sup data-ref="310">310</sup>*

content.en: I am inclined to believe this theory is correct, as we saw many neuroimmune patients make dramatic recoveries from jugular stenting when it was still available. Likewise, pioneering clinicians [recently found](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-hidden-link-between-hypermobility-c69) that COVID vaccine injuries frequently resulted from sudden persistent compression of the iliac vein ([which they successfully treated with stenting](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-hidden-link-between-hypermobility-c69)). My own belief is that drainage obstructions [often result from poor zeta potential](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-hidden-link-between-hypermobility-c69) — which both drives fluid flow and creates the expansive force that keeps vessels open — or from inherently weak blood vessels that collapse easily. This explains [why hypermobile patients are typically far more sensitive to pharmaceutical injuries](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-hidden-link-between-hypermobility-c69) (particularly vaccines that impair zeta potential, or via the spike protein, directly weaken blood vessels), and why [MS has been found to be 10–11 times as common in hypermobile EDS patients](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18208891/).
content.cn: 我倾向于认为这一理论是正确的，因为在颈内静脉支架置入术仍可实施时，我们曾看到许多神经免疫疾病患者通过该疗法实现了显著好转。同样，一些开创性的临床医生最近发现，新冠疫苗引起的伤害往往源于髂静脉的突然且持续性压迫（他们通过支架置入术成功治疗了这一情况）。 我个人认为，引流阻塞通常源于ζ电位不足——ζ电位既驱动体液流动，又产生维持血管通畅的扩张力——或者源于血管本身脆弱，容易塌陷。 这解释了为什么关节过度活动症患者通常对药物损伤（特别是那些会损害ζ电位的疫苗，或通过刺突蛋白直接削弱血管的疫苗）更为敏感，以及为什么在关节过度活动型埃勒斯-丹洛斯综合征（EDS）患者中，多发性硬化症（MS）的发病率被发现高出10–11倍。

content.en: Due to the risks associated with stenting, I have pursued other approaches to address impaired drainage (with success).
