Since DMSO increases lymphatic circulation, improves venous drainage, and clears the pathological protein aggregates that accumulate when drainage fails (as detailed earlier in this article), it may address this underlying impairment through pharmacological rather than surgical means.
content.cn: 鉴于支架置入术存在相关风险，我尝试了其他方法来解决淋巴引流障碍问题（并取得了成功）。由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能促进淋巴循环、改善静脉引流，并清除因引流障碍而积聚的病理性蛋白质聚集体（如本文前文所述），因此它或许能通过药物治疗而非手术手段来解决这一潜在的引流障碍问题。

content.en: *Note: pioneering physician Dietrich Klinghardt extensively investigated CCSVI across neurological conditions and reported it present in 100% of tested MS, autism, Parkinson’s, ALS, and Lyme patients — with patients suffering from fibromyalgia and chronic fatigue also frequently presenting with it — and Lyme patients typically testing worse than MS patients (4 of 5 diagnostic parameters positive vs. 2 of 5 in MS).<sup data-ref="311">311</sup>, <sup data-ref="312">312</sup>, <sup data-ref="313">313</sup>, <sup data-ref="314">314</sup> He concluded CCSVI was driven by chronic endothelial infections (Borrelia, Rickettsia, Chlamydia pneumoniae, Babesia) that caused inflammation, scarring, and permanent vasoconstriction of the jugular veins <sup data-ref="313">313</sup>, <sup data-ref="314">314</sup>, <sup data-ref="313">313</sup> (and I would argue zeta potential impairment—as Knisely observed malaria \[which is similar to babesia\] ultimately killed by life-threatening blood sludging which began with small sludges forming along the vessels within which it hid from the immune system <sup data-ref="315">315</sup>, <sup data-ref="316">316</sup>, <sup data-ref="317">317</sup>). While balloon dilation produced roughly one-third significant improvement, one-third modest, and one-third no lasting benefit, Klinghardt preferred it over stenting because stents caused scarring and vein occlusion <sup data-ref="311">311</sup>, <sup data-ref="312">312</sup> and he found that results were inconsistent regardless of method if the underlying infections, existing tissue compressions and elevated inflammatory markers (TGF-β1, C4a, MMP-9) were not addressed first, as the veins would re-stenose.<sup data-ref="313">313</sup>, <sup data-ref="314">314</sup>, <sup data-ref="318">318</sup>, <sup data-ref="311">311</sup>, <sup data-ref="312">312</sup>, <sup data-ref="313">313</sup> Likewise, other clinicians at a CCSVI summit corroborated it contributed to neurodegeneration across multiple conditions <sup data-ref="319">319</sup>, <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> and a diagnostic protocol Klinghardt helped create used therapeutic ultrasound to mobilize compartmentalized pathogens from the venous endothelium (or possibly sludges lining the endothelium) into the urine where they could be identified by DNA testing (and often were).<sup data-ref="320">320</sup>
content.cn: 注：先驱医生迪特里希·克林哈特（Dietrich Klinghardt）对各类神经系统疾病中的CCSVI进行了广泛研究，并报告称在接受检测的多发性硬化症、自闭症、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症和莱姆病患者中，该病变的检出率均为100%——纤维肌痛和慢性疲劳综合征患者也常伴有该病变——且莱姆病患者的检测结果通常比多发性硬化症患者更严重（5项诊断指标中有4项呈阳性，而多发性硬化症患者为5项中有2项）。 <sup data-ref="320">320</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> <sup data-ref="311">311</sup> 他得出结论：CCSVI是由慢性内皮感染（伯氏疏螺旋体、立克次体、肺炎衣原体、巴贝西虫）引发的，这些感染导致颈静脉出现炎症、瘢痕形成及永久性血管收缩 <sup data-ref="320">320</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> （而我认为还包括ζ电位受损——正如克尼塞利（Knisely）所观察到的，疟疾\[与巴贝西虫病相似\]最终会导致危及生命的血液泥化，其起因是微小的泥化物沿着血管形成，而疟原虫正是藏身于这些血管中以躲避免疫系统的追捕 <sup data-ref="320">320</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> ）。 虽然球囊扩张术大约有三分之一能带来显著改善，三分之一效果温和，还有三分之一没有持久益处， 克林哈特（Klinghardt）仍更倾向于气囊扩张而非支架置入，因为支架会导致瘢痕形成和静脉闭塞 <sup data-ref="320">320</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> ；他发现，如果不同先处理潜在感染、现有组织压迫以及升高的炎症标志物（TGF-β1、C4a、MMP-9），无论采用何种方法，结果都难以一致，因为静脉会再次狭窄。 <sup data-ref="320">320</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> <sup data-ref="311">311</sup> <sup data-ref="312">312</sup> <sup data-ref="313">313</sup> 同样， 在一次CCSVI峰会上，其他临床医生也证实该病变会导致多种疾病的神经退行性病变 <sup data-ref="320">320</sup> <sup data-ref="318">318</sup> ，而克林哈特参与制定的诊断方案利用治疗性超声波，将困在静脉内皮（或可能附着于内皮表面的沉积物）中的病原体转移至尿液中，从而通过DNA检测进行鉴定（且往往能检测到）。 <sup data-ref="320">320</sup>*

content.en: DMSO in MS Patients
content.cn: 多发性硬化症患者中的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）

content.en: [In a famous case from the DMSO literature](https://www.amazon.com/Persecuted-Drug-Story-DMSO/dp/0441151019), Stanley Jacob decided to risk giving a 29-year-old woman paralyzed from MS who also had kidney failure oral DMSO. “Her improvement was dramatic — as dramatic as any benefit I have ever seen,” Jacob reported. Her kidney problems came under control, and after a few more weeks, she walked again. Six years later she still walked, drove her car, and cared for her family — though she was slowly declining (indicating DMSO was not enough to completely treat her condition).
content.cn: 在二甲基亚砜（DMSO）文献中的一则著名案例中，斯坦利·雅各布决定冒险给一名因多发性硬化症导致瘫痪、同时患有肾衰竭的29岁女性口服二甲基亚砜。“她的病情改善非常显著——其显著程度堪比我迄今所见过的任何疗效，”雅各布报告道。她的肾脏问题得到了控制，再过几周后，她又能走路了。 六年后，她仍然能够行走、开车并照顾家人——尽管她的病情正在缓慢恶化（这表明二甲基亚砜不足以彻底治愈她的病情）。

content.en: [Another more recent case](https://www.amazon.com/Dmso-Handbook-Doctors-Archie-Scott-ebook/dp/B0792T53NW/) involved a California woman confined to bed in the fetal position at a convalescent hospital, expected to die within months. After starting DMSO through multiple routes (injectable, oral, and topical), she began regaining sensation in her legs — initially experiencing pain, which was considered positive given her prior lack of feeling. Over the following year she regained leg movement and the ability to feed herself, with continued improvement until she was moved to another state where the treatment was unavailable.
content.cn: 另一例较新的病例涉及一名加利福尼亚州的女性，她当时在一家疗养院卧床不起，呈蜷缩姿势，预计数月内将离世。在通过多种途径（注射、口服和外用）开始使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗后，她的双腿逐渐恢复了知觉——起初感到疼痛，但鉴于她此前完全没有感觉，这一反应被视为积极迹象。 在随后的这一年里，她恢复了双腿的活动能力以及自主进食的能力，病情持续好转，直到她被转至另一个无法提供该治疗的州。

content.en: [The only formal study I know of](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6506978/) evaluated 34 MS patients in Russia in 1984. Overall, the investigators felt DMSO had a very positive result, with the best outcomes in patients with remitting MS, while results were more inconsistent in rapidly progressive MS. They attributed the benefits to DMSO causing remyelination, reducing edema, improving nerve cell communication, and having positive effects on immunity and tissue repair, with no side effects reported.
content.cn: 据我所知，唯一一项正式研究是1984年在俄罗斯对34名多发性硬化症患者进行的评估。总体而言，研究人员认为二甲基亚砜（DMSO）取得了非常积极的效果，其中复发缓解型多发性硬化症患者的疗效最佳，而在快速进展型多发性硬化症患者中，疗效则较为不一致。他们将这些益处归因于二甲基亚砜能促进髓鞘再生、减轻水肿、改善神经细胞间的通信，并对免疫功能和组织修复产生积极影响，且未报告任何副作用。

content.en: Additionally:此外：
• [A Russian case report](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9072902/) documented successful DMSO therapy in an MS patient with trophic lesions and a cystostoma.
content.cn: • 一份俄罗斯病例报告记载了一例伴有营养性病变和膀胱造瘘的MS患者，经二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗取得成功。

content.en: • [DMSO has also been used topicall](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/nevralgiya-troynichnogo-nerva-u-bolnyh-rasseyannym-sklerozom) y (mixed with anesthetics) on trigger zones to manage trigeminal neuralgia in MS patients, with outcomes including reduction of carbamazepine to minimum doses or complete discontinuation and achievement of full remission during exacerbations.
content.cn: • 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还曾与麻醉剂混合后外用涂抹于触发区，用于治疗多发性硬化症患者的三叉神经痛，治疗效果包括将卡马西平剂量减至最低或完全停药，并在病情发作期间实现完全缓解。

content.en: • [A study of 35 MS patients](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=20919935) (disease duration 2–18 years) recommended DMSO-containing topical gels mixed with nonsteroidal analgesics for chronic neuropathic pain, myofascial pain from spastic muscles, and pain along peripheral nerve trunks in bedridden patients.
content.cn: • 一项针对35名多发性硬化症患者（病程为2至18年）的研究建议，对于慢性神经病理性疼痛、痉挛性肌肉引起的肌筋膜疼痛以及卧床患者沿周围神经干的疼痛，可使用含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的外用凝胶，并混合非甾体类镇痛药。
**Reader Reports 读者反馈**

content.en: A few readers have also reported improvements in MS following DMSO use which corroborate the previous data.
content.cn: 还有几位读者报告称，在使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，多发性硬化症（MS）的症状有所改善，这与先前的数据相吻合。

content.en: [One reader’s wife](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/115567844) with MS-related trigeminal neuralgia that had been painful for over a year and a half tested 70% DMSO cream on a small spot on her face, and her pain dropped 90%. The next morning she applied it over the entire trigeminal area and the pain was 99.9% gone — even after three days without reapplication, the pain had not returned.
content.cn: 一位读者的妻子患有与多发性硬化症相关的三叉神经痛，这种疼痛已持续了一年半多。她在脸部的一小块区域试用了70%浓度的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）乳膏，疼痛减轻了90%。第二天早上，她将乳膏涂抹在整个三叉神经区域，疼痛消退了99.9%——即使在停用三天后，疼痛也没有复发。

content.en: [Another reader reported](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/135933408) that DMSO “brings my MS hugs to a standstill. Before my husband found this for me I just had to endure them or go to the hospital for morphine.”
content.cn: 另一位读者表示，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）“让我的多发性硬化症发作彻底停止了。在我丈夫为我找到这种药之前，我只能硬着头皮忍受发作，要么就去医院打吗啡。”

content.en: [A reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/146719618) with MS, fibromyalgia, liver fibrosis, CRPS, and lymphedema described oral and topical DMSO as “a godsend” after about a year of use.
content.cn: 一位患有多发性硬化症、纤维肌痛、肝纤维化、复杂性区域疼痛综合征和淋巴水肿的读者表示，在服用和外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）约一年后，将其称为“天赐之物”。

content.en: [An MS patient](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/166715952) taking oral DMSO four times daily reported it was “incredibly helpful for pain and energy.”
content.cn: 一名多发性硬化症患者每天口服四次二甲基亚砜，称这“对缓解疼痛和恢复精力极有帮助”。

content.en: [One reader reported](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/110973959) that MSM <sup>⬖</sup> (DMSO’s oxidized metabolite), along with other supplements, allowed them to stop all prescribed MS medications and their associated side-effect medications, stating they “feel younger and better than ever.”
content.cn: 一位读者报告称，MSM <sup>⬖</sup> （DMSO的氧化代谢物）与其他补充剂配合使用后，使他能够停用所有处方类多发性硬化症（MS）药物及其相关的副作用治疗药物，并表示自己“感觉比以往任何时候都更年轻、更健康”。

content.en: *Note: [a 1982 article](https://asma.kglmeridian.com/downloadpdf/view/journals/asem/54/12/article-p1137-s.pdf) stated that DMSO had been touted as a miracle drug for numerous conditions including multiple sclerosis—suggesting these readers’ experiences are not unique.
content.cn: 注：一篇1982年的文章指出，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）曾被吹捧为治疗包括多发性硬化症在内的多种疾病的“神奇药物”——这表明这些读者的经历并非个例。*

content.en: DMSO Myelin Interactions
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜与髓鞘的相互作用

content.en: •X-ray diffraction studies have revealed that DMSO directly interacts with myelin structure and at high concentrations DMSO produces a fully reversible transformation of nerve myelin into a new highly ordered structure (DMSO squeezes the water out between myelin wraps and selectively alters the outer membrane layer).<sup data-ref="321">321</sup>, <sup data-ref="322">322</sup>
content.cn: •X射线衍射研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会与髓鞘结构直接相互作用；在高浓度下，DMSO会使神经髓鞘发生完全可逆的转变，形成一种新的高度有序结构（DMSO将髓鞘层之间的水分挤出，并有选择性地改变外膜层）。 <sup data-ref="321">321</sup> <sup data-ref="322">322</sup>

content.en: • [Clemastine](https://digitalcommons.wayne.edu/som_srs/160/), an antihistamine being investigated as a remyelinating agent for hypomyelinating diseases, also showed preliminary effects on myelination processes in vitro.
content.cn: • 氯马斯汀是一种抗组胺药，目前正作为治疗脱髓鞘性疾病的髓鞘再生剂进行研究，该药物在体外实验中也显示出对髓鞘形成过程的初步效果。

content.en: •Oligodendrocytes are the cells that produce myelin in the central nervous system, and their regeneration is essential for remyelination. DMSO, in turn, has been shown to drastically increase the generation of oligodendrocyte precursor cells from human stem cells <sup data-ref="323">323</sup>, <sup data-ref="324">324</sup>, <sup data-ref="325">325</sup> (and for this effect to be further enhanced in combination with all-trans-retinoic acid).<sup data-ref="326">326</sup>, <sup data-ref="325">325</sup> Additionally, in neural stem cells, [γ-secretase inhibitors](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201901&filename=1018108433.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=DZ6BiWY7GSAnj1ZoB1_eAuUnUbg3qgs80TWhDe-4a6LzJi5x6W45g-bXCkCPo1GY) (in DMSO) modulated Notch1 signaling and increased oligodendrocyte marker expression and likewise, [clobetasol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31363370/) (in DMSO) promoted neural stem cell differentiation into both neurons and oligodendrocytes.
content.cn: •少突胶质细胞是中枢神经系统中产生髓鞘的细胞，其再生对髓鞘再生至关重要。研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能显著增加人类干细胞向少突胶质细胞前体细胞的分化 <sup data-ref="326">326</sup> <sup data-ref="325">325</sup> <sup data-ref="325">325</sup> （且该效应在与全反式视黄酸联合使用时会进一步增强）。 <sup data-ref="326">326</sup> <sup data-ref="325">325</sup> 此外，在神经干细胞中，γ-分泌酶抑制剂（溶于DMSO）可调节Notch1信号通路并提高少突胶质细胞标志物的表达；同样，氯倍他索（溶于DMSO）也能促进神经干细胞向神经元和少突胶质细胞的分化。

content.en: *Note: [one study found](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/neuroscience/articles/10.3389/fnins.2019.01242/full) DMSO shifted stem cells towards producing astrocytes, suggesting lower doses promote oligodendrocyte differentiation, while longer sustained ones promote astrocytes.
content.cn: 注：一项研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会促使干细胞向星形胶质细胞方向分化，这表明较低剂量可促进少突胶质细胞分化，而较长持续时间的给药则会促进星形胶质细胞分化。*

content.en: Other Demyelinating Diseases
content.cn: 其他脱髓鞘性疾病

content.en: Experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), the standard animal model for MS, immunizes animals against myelin proteins to trigger autoimmune demyelination, and hence provides poignant insights for treating MS. Notably, as I show [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-is-every-newborn-forced-to-get), the hepatitis B vaccine (which overlaps with myelin, creating autoimmunity to myelin) has been repeatedly linked to multiple sclerosis and also has caused autoimmune EAE.
content.cn: 实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）作为多发性硬化症（MS）的标准动物模型，通过使动物对髓鞘蛋白产生免疫反应来诱发自身免疫性脱髓鞘，从而为多发性硬化症的治疗提供了深刻的见解。值得注意的是，正如我在本文中所示，乙型肝炎疫苗（其抗原与髓鞘抗原存在重叠，从而引发针对髓鞘的自身免疫反应）已被多次证实与多发性硬化症有关，并且也曾导致自身免疫性EAE。

content.en: In [a 1969 study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/5367302/) DMSO was listed as a therapeutic option for EAE, and in EAE experiments, animals are frequently treated with a therapeutic agent dissolved in DMSO. Across these studies, a consistent pattern emerged: agents dissolved in DMSO improved EAE clinical scores, decreased inflammatory cell infiltration, and reduced demyelination — with individual agents distinguished by their specific mechanisms and additional effects.
content.cn: 在1969年的一项研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）被列为实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）的治疗选择之一；在EAE实验中，常将治疗药物溶解于DMSO中用于动物治疗。这些研究中呈现出一个一致的趋势：溶解于DMSO中的药物能改善EAE临床评分、减少炎性细胞浸润并减轻脱髓鞘程度——而不同药物则因其特有的作用机制和附加效应而有所区别。

content.en: Nordihydroguaiaretic acid,<sup>⬖</sup> tanshinone IIA,<sup>⬖</sup> and sulforaphane <sup>⬖</sup> increased protective antioxidant and anti-inflammatory signals while lowering inflammatory IL-17A in EAE immune cells.<sup>⬖</sup> Nordihydroguaiaretic acid <sup>⬖</sup> also restored the blood-brain barrier, and in a separate study, both nordihydroguaiaretic acid <sup>⬖</sup> and tanshinone IIA <sup>⬖</sup> promoted remyelination and recovered axon integrity.<sup data-ref="327">327</sup>, <sup data-ref="328">328</sup>, <sup data-ref="329">329</sup>, <sup data-ref="330">330</sup>, <sup data-ref="331">331</sup> Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> delayed disease onset and in addition to reducing inflammatory infiltration and myelin loss, normalized impaired autophagy and lowered inflammatory cytokines.<sup data-ref="332">332</sup>, <sup data-ref="333">333</sup> Mitochondrial division inhibitor 1 decreased oligodendrocyte and spinal cord apoptosis, protected axonal integrity, and promoted nerve growth factors.<sup data-ref="334">334</sup>, <sup data-ref="335">335</sup> Butylphthalide protected mitochondria, inhibited necroptosis, and lowered TNF-α and IL-1β, while ferrostatin-1 (a ferroptosis inhibitor) and matrine <sup>⬖</sup> each similarly reduced neurological severity.<sup data-ref="336">336</sup>, <sup data-ref="337">337</sup> An epoxide hydrolase inhibitor reduced disease severity in chronic EAE by suppressing multiple inflammatory pathways (TLR4/NF-κB signaling, inflammasomes, COX-2, and nitric oxide synthases) and in a separate study, promoted remyelination via enhanced myelin proteolipid protein expression.<sup data-ref="338">338</sup>, <sup data-ref="339">339</sup>
content.cn: 北羟基桂皮酸、 <sup>⬖</sup> 丹参酮IIA、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 在增强保护性抗氧化和抗炎信号的同时，降低了EAE免疫细胞中炎症因子IL-17A的水平。 <sup>⬖</sup> 北二氢桂皮酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 还修复了血脑屏障；在另一项研究中，北二氢桂皮酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 和丹参酮 IIA <sup>⬖</sup> 均促进了髓鞘再生并恢复了轴突的完整性。 <sup data-ref="338">338</sup> <sup data-ref="339">339</sup> <sup data-ref="329">329</sup> <sup data-ref="330">330</sup> <sup data-ref="331">331</sup> 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 延缓了疾病发作，除减少炎症浸润和髓鞘丢失外，还使受损的自噬功能恢复正常，并降低了炎症细胞因子的水平。 <sup data-ref="338">338</sup> <sup data-ref="339">339</sup> 线粒体分裂抑制剂1减少了少突胶质细胞和脊髓细胞的凋亡，保护了轴突的完整性，并促进了神经生长因子的分泌。 <sup data-ref="338">338</sup> <sup data-ref="339">339</sup> 丁基苯酞醚可保护线粒体、抑制坏死性凋亡，并降低TNF-α和IL-1β的水平；而铁蛋白抑制剂-1（一种铁死亡抑制剂）和马特林 <sup>⬖</sup> 也分别以类似的方式减轻了神经系统症状的严重程度。 <sup data-ref="338">338</sup> <sup data-ref="339">339</sup> 一种环氧化物水解酶抑制剂通过抑制多种炎症通路（TLR4/NF-κB信号通路、炎性小体、COX-2和一氧化氮合酶），减轻了慢性实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（EAE）的疾病严重程度；在另一项研究中，该抑制剂通过增强髓鞘蛋白脂蛋白的表达，促进了髓鞘再生。 <sup data-ref="338">338</sup> <sup data-ref="339">339</sup>

content.en: Additional agents demonstrating efficacy in EAE include [hydroxyfasudil](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2019&filename=1019611523.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=qWpXdiOftyZlSc7ZwmKJFXYGC6j13VLtRyzCfdtA6Qjy-qQRnkcIz1tSrt4anaQF) (which also prevented EAE onset and suppressed key pro-inflammatory cytokines), a p38 MAPK inhibitor <sup data-ref="340">340</sup>,<sup data-ref="341">341</sup> (which reduced IL-17 expression), [ginkgolide A](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3teD6e5P7ulaA9AFOpd7iwP606rCXeUn6MjWm6rfsSGBSMlCIRy4jiv3b8J0Kr3C6Up-OAGpibdQtHf_sHA59wnbbnBM8giLyIG5SvCdhoc_2KqRJJM8yTPwozrtMcjDpQRIyx5NfKNxGD4KuZ5GuUjkNBUO27lPbd-PEv3YuCg92SWUSam_hoDb5Q49I25esgA=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which delayed disease onset and shifted macrophages toward an anti-inflammatory state), [isoliquiritigenin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahK1ano_gnEsdo3Xp8EpgYrYMNaNikSz3e7_IATfF2IYHUIBXLI24HTMjnZ3FmEw8lAKMfAYRx9oWaRRHPhB95qSQW8EaO3zrshNnN7t1p9gj3SXo76VUX18TKetzPpmNXlFZ9U9NGVavQfgkHqCKljQ26DFI6GJYbjOfVGrni0NLgdAOz-fhiV4kiWXBg7nLC0=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which suppressed inflammatory Th1 cells and activated protective astrocytes), nitidine chloride <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="342">342</sup> (which increased anti-inflammatory IL-10 when given preventively), [a JAK2 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201302&filename=1013287237.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=a9IWNuZ_eNXt1aNvOtH7WugGPDof25TI9qDOeb2RFwUbi9RZfw8DL9YPHYO6AeE4) (which delayed onset and decreased Th17-driven inflammation), [a GSNOR inhibitor](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0306452224006079?ref=pdf_download&fr=RR-2&rr=9daff2ad4c73b49c) (reduced demyelination and inflammation) [arctigenin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2021&filename=1016704181.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=NdSaoPRHBhMYPPmICw44g0ZgIPY739xZdZPy3waM3_NVGK2tEwrnl3CXnNtOX3vG) <sup>⬖</sup> (which decreased Th1 and Th17 cells via AMPK/PPAR-γ activation and p38 inhibition), [a caspase-1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016212885.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=FePQHLMc6L8Hr4xtywrWBQacTs3XhpuoOjKk4Cx4GJqkez4zP8cdKRVoFnsDnLFT) (which delayed onset and lowered IL-1β and IL-18), [tacrolimus](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15248293/) (reduced demyelination and axonal loss by up to 95%) and [schisandrin B](https://www.mdpi.com/2504-3900/40/1/15),<sup>⬖</sup> [baicalin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17653455/),<sup>⬖</sup> [AG490](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015327345.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=AbPLCzQ-Hc8KY45urASrQ_TOnipyf2R3BmMlfh0MnUj2BS3n-4EpsPOLoXROrnoE), and NBP.<sup data-ref="343">343</sup>, <sup data-ref="344">344</sup>, <sup data-ref="345">345</sup>
content.cn: 其他在EAE中显示出疗效的药物包括羟基法苏地尔（该药还能预防EAE发作并抑制关键的促炎细胞因子）、一种p38 MAPK抑制剂 <sup data-ref="343">343</sup> 、 <sup data-ref="344">344</sup> （可降低IL-17的表达）、银杏内酯A <sup>⬖</sup> （可延缓疾病发作并将巨噬细胞诱导至抗炎状态）、异甘草素 <sup>⬖</sup> （可抑制炎性Th1细胞并激活具有保护作用的星形胶质细胞）、氯化尼替丁 <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="343">343</sup> （预防性给药时可增加抗炎性IL-10的水平）、一种JAK2抑制剂（可延缓发病并减轻Th17驱动的炎症）、一种GSNOR抑制剂（可减轻脱髓鞘和炎症）、阿克蒂根 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过激活AMPK/PPAR-γ和抑制p38来减少Th1和Th17细胞）、caspase-1抑制剂（可延缓发病并降低IL-1β和IL-18水平）、他克莫司（可将脱髓鞘和轴突丢失减少高达95%）以及五味子素B、 <sup>⬖</sup> 黄芩苷、 <sup>⬖</sup> AG490以及NBP。 <sup data-ref="343">343</sup> <sup data-ref="344">344</sup> <sup data-ref="345">345</sup>

content.en: In addition to EAE models, in cells from newly diagnosed and IFN-β-treated MS patients, [silymarin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30178232/) <sup>⬖</sup> suppressed Th1 cell proliferation and inhibited IFN-γ production in a dose- and time-dependent manner, suggesting it could complement existing MS therapies. [Chrysin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24412705/) <sup>⬖</sup> reduced disease severity and demyelination in experimental autoimmune neuritis (an animal model of Guillain-Barré syndrome).
content.cn: 除了EAE模型外，在新确诊和接受IFN-β治疗的多发性硬化症（MS）患者的细胞中，水飞蓟素 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量和时间依赖性方式抑制了Th1细胞的增殖并抑制了IFN-γ的产生，这表明它可能对现有的MS治疗起到辅助作用。 黄酮苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 减轻了实验性自身免疫性神经炎（吉兰-巴雷综合征的动物模型）的疾病严重程度并抑制了脱髓鞘。

content.en: Lastly, [one reader with Morvan’s syndrome](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/152884648), a rare and severe autoimmune channelopathy (that developed following viral encephalitis) reported that after two weeks of topical 70% DMSO cream, inflammation in his hands visibly decreased and pain was reduced by 75%. His case was particularly severe, having required multiple nerve decompression surgeries, four joint replacements, cervical fusion, and two nerve stimulator implants.
content.cn: 最后，一位患有莫尔万综合征（一种罕见且严重的自身免疫性离子通道病，由病毒性脑炎引发）的读者报告称，在连续两周外用70%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）乳膏后，其手部炎症明显减轻，疼痛减轻了75%。他的病情尤为严重，曾接受过多次神经减压手术、四次关节置换术、颈椎融合术以及两次神经刺激器植入手术。
**Cuprizone Models 铜唑酮模型**

content.en: Cuprizone is a copper chelator that, when fed to mice, causes toxic demyelination — providing a model to study remyelination independently of the autoimmune component. In cuprizone-demyelinated mice, the cannabinoid agonist WIN55212-2 (1 mg/kg in DMSO) significantly reduced weight loss, improved motor function, reduced corpus callosum demyelination, increased myelin basic protein expression, decreased astrocyte activation, and upregulated juxtanodin and Nkx2.2 (transcription factors involved in myelin repair).<sup data-ref="346">346</sup>, <sup data-ref="347">347</sup>, <sup data-ref="348">348</sup> [Hydroxyfasudil and fasudil](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=lLcTIqQqO-0YyhgzDDtux78pmzqTNWDuewChC1-vSNCae88drT2B4C1kYsRsY4wmfRdLCCHVaJEqN5NrRF9mVtjP3K5ewSDUI_2JeQWYCwY0lvzZig_IK8K_eIKp2mAaExoXSsejGt1AfpzJ3iVgTvDvmMdsg-yrJ_rb353m8AfVpa79PI7jBUt2cX2GoDZxKPzgUkmBjpo=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) also improved behavioral deficits, attenuated demyelination, and strongly inhibited microglia-driven neuroinflammation in the cuprizone EAE model. [Mitochondrial division inhibitor 1](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tclzC57XaQAjjntDHxjtTJE_zi5d0gmOfg2FdO-ZWPGAif7H-iEOc7hBNs5IhlWI4T97poiBOpChrZRM-1JOtv0rVodUEomR0EQPh-UzDPozgfaV2LVPxEjVQbJ44eQr06O-xJC5VlyCxjIsjjSYi2Y6c9JR0BdxJWriotDS3zOQ1q590xIurfw&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) protected oligodendrocytes and suppressed complement activation on oligodendrocytes in the corpus callosum. [Biochanin A](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35323389/) <sup>⬖</sup> improved grip strength, spatial and recognition memory, and mitigated hippocampal and prefrontal cortex neuronal damage.
content.cn: 库普里ゾン（Cuprizone）是一种铜螯合剂，当喂食小鼠时会引起毒性脱髓鞘——从而提供了一个独立于自身免疫成分之外的研究再髓鞘化的模型。 在铜吡唑酮诱导脱髓鞘的小鼠模型中，大麻素激动剂WIN55212-2（溶于二甲基亚砜，剂量为1 mg/kg）显著减轻了体重下降，改善了运动功能，减轻了胼胝体脱髓鞘程度，增加了髓鞘基本蛋白的表达，降低了星形胶质细胞的活化程度，并上调了juxtanodin和Nkx2.2（参与髓鞘修复的转录因子）的表达。 <sup data-ref="346">346</sup> <sup data-ref="347">347</sup> <sup data-ref="348">348</sup> 羟基法苏地尔和法苏地尔同样改善了行为缺陷，减轻了脱髓鞘程度，并在铜嗪诱导的EAE模型中强效抑制了小胶质细胞驱动的神经炎症。线粒体分裂抑制剂1保护了少突胶质细胞，并抑制了胼胝体中少突胶质细胞上的补体活化。 生物黄酮A <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了抓握力、空间记忆和识别记忆，并减轻了海马体和前额叶皮层的神经元损伤。
**Neuromyelitis Optica 视神经脊髓炎**

content.en: Neuromyelitis optica (NMO) is a related autoimmune demyelinating disease that preferentially attacks the optic nerves and spinal cord through antibodies targeting aquaporin-4 water channels. In an NMO mouse model, [tanshinone IIa](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017872672.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=ixQCUnlUyrYOguaceM3RJNztLeg5cvQTC_ibePzdKMTZ2Ch00-5Ib4Nx9U_UCISJ) <sup>⬖</sup> (in DMSO) significantly reduced loss of aquaporin-4, GFAP, and myelin basic protein, decreased neutrophil and microglial infiltration, and increased neutrophil apoptosis. [Arbidol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015327757.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=fcIFmQALL97icFjGqrzYnLGVGjl7oy0UrRgxs7L_2LIA5ZySChDumm6cz3JV89qP) (in DMSO) similarly increased cortical cell survival from 49% to 79% in vitro and reduced aquaporin-4/GFAP loss in vivo.
content.cn: 视神经脊髓炎（NMO）是一种相关的自身免疫性脱髓鞘疾病，其特征是针对水通道蛋白-4（AQP-4）的抗体优先攻击视神经和脊髓。 在NMO小鼠模型中，丹参酮IIa <sup>⬖</sup> （溶于DMSO）显著减少了水通道蛋白-4、GFAP和髓鞘基本蛋白的丢失，减少了中性粒细胞和小胶质细胞的浸润，并增加了中性粒细胞的凋亡。 阿比多尔（溶于二甲基亚砜）同样在体外将皮质细胞存活率从 49% 提高到 79%，并在体内减少了水通道蛋白-4/GFAP 的丢失。

content.en: **White Matter Injury and Neonatal Myelination
content.cn: 白质损伤与新生儿髓鞘化**

content.en: Several studies have demonstrated that agents combined with DMSO can protect or restore myelination in non-autoimmune white matter injury. The [hydrogen sulfide donor anethole trithione](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVBJEFzWSQtnl4ex2TTt8IkMgMHVYkP_1K1th6xyYfgGG2e1bf3puUCvGYMrN3wQPiwW7QiWLYaPlS7pbgQ95OaHJjv0yyBNa0eK2uS9y2xAf4B9-m2hHopvAVzvUpgW7TP8072inG15IsyKVTFyk-JzDbNRwZdo5Tv1F82vu6pT7cznZuhKdt3OEWphszeHAns=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) promoted remyelination, oligodendrocyte precursor cell proliferation and differentiation, microglial myelin debris clearance, and long-term functional recovery after subcortical white matter stroke. [Siponimod](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUoAXSiPuCcMk6H5BZUQQEd0QyR07ilIc9WBaOo_JzlmoGzduCuzrCnriPKV4IhGDmFxI1g4DAntjapryctDUxWKuq3ZGBvHXmjoL4MR3U9tJzU7jy2yVag8E1HUdCHEYoyNgmklI4316-XWOlDBWWbMPqKZFgoigN8Rp5H2ZxdtzATCbd3NG-mOuSmMsUObUgU=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) reduced myelin loss and brain atrophy after intracerebral hemorrhage. [An α5 GABAA receptor inverse agonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2020&filename=1019891645.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=I4uUmEHx542HieaUgPhafj0LmVaVp1PAwkKsEnVR57ArDFWgKrUAqRXTDEG649BY) promoted oligodendrogenesis, myelination, and improved motor function in ischemic rats. In a neonatal white matter damage model, [miconazole](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=LCAK201706022&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=drlEZI0lpinOrW48KqGbVOlU3_th7ldTogyMxOzh16iSmRzdGZQP0KZNis3I5vKU) (in DMSO) significantly increased myelin basic protein expression and improved myelin ultrastructure. [MiR-219 agomir](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahIxRVCTDlDtHcw7u3fHMG6esQG-K2aH6kJOcmfm_AhrgAvN7NayUU5DTav8pcLOgmLa8yHBx9_lA_dy1D2Xpt70UdQeuJ6y287pA_TxGvZefZjUDcJlU84j982n4Wo2gF4b9rUeTmgcjztcekk-KMH5GAMslXVq6-U4fAnEt432kfEnS8M6SvFcUiB5Qfn53Ek=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) improved oligodendrocyte maturation in neonatal rats with LPS-induced neuroinflammation via the ERK1/2 pathway. In spinal cord injury, [an epidermal growth factor receptor inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFD0911&filename=2010184683.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=6heQBhGxWjvDEO9qRf07Sdg3QZsF5HvmimdIcQsZXHazZMtAKIVzAfdKOxeNbboc) reduced demyelination and myelin-associated inhibitory molecule expression.
content.cn: 多项研究表明，与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物可在非自身免疫性白质损伤中保护或恢复髓鞘化。硫化氢供体茴香脑三硫酮可促进皮质下白质卒中后的再髓鞘化、少突胶质细胞前体细胞的增殖与分化、小胶质细胞对髓鞘碎片的清除，以及长期功能恢复。西波尼莫德可减轻脑内出血后的髓鞘丢失和脑萎缩。 一种α5 GABAA受体反向激动剂在缺血性大鼠模型中促进了少突胶质细胞生成和髓鞘形成，并改善了运动功能。 在一项新生儿白质损伤模型中，咪康唑（溶于二甲基亚砜）显著增加了髓鞘基本蛋白的表达，并改善了髓鞘的超微结构。MiR-219 agomir通过ERK1/2通路，改善了LPS诱导神经炎症的新生大鼠少突胶质细胞的成熟。在脊髓损伤中，一种表皮生长因子受体抑制剂减少了脱髓鞘并降低了髓鞘相关抑制分子的表达。

content.en: DMSO and Protein Folding
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜与蛋白质折叠

content.en: [Chemical chaperones](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chemical_chaperone) are small molecules that help proteins be folded into their correct configuration, and hence can ensure protein stability or help the body eliminate misfolded protein. Since many challenging diseases (particularly genetic ones) are a result of misfolded or non-functional proteins, chemical chaperones offer a potentially invaluable therapeutic strategy.
content.cn: 化学伴侣是一类小分子，能够帮助蛋白质折叠成正确的构象，从而确保蛋白质的稳定性，或协助机体清除错误折叠的蛋白质。由于许多棘手的疾病（尤其是遗传性疾病）都是由蛋白质错误折叠或功能失常引起的，因此化学伴侣可能成为一种极具价值的治疗策略。

content.en: *Note: I believe the [physiologic zeta potential](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-makes-all-vaccines-so-dangerous) has an important role in ensuring the correct folding of proteins.
content.cn: 注：我认为生理性ζ电位在确保蛋白质正确折叠方面起着重要作用。*

content.en: [Some of the best-known chemical chaperones include](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16610368/) glycerol, deuterated water, **and DMSO (**which is thought to be in part due to it creating a tighter packing around proteins and stabilizing their conformation). DMSO, in turn, has shown promise in misfolding diseases such as nephrogenic diabetes insipidus,<sup data-ref="349">349</sup>, <sup data-ref="350">350</sup> [cystic fibrosis](https://journals.physiology.org/doi/full/10.1152/ajpcell.1998.275.2.C599) and [Machado-Joseph disease](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12127147/), and can increase the ability of impaired immune cells (due to defective HLA-DM) to present the antigens necessary to mount an immune response.<sup data-ref="351">351</sup>
content.cn: 一些最著名的化学伴侣包括甘油、氘代水和二甲基亚砜（DMSO）（据认为，这部分是因为它能在蛋白质周围形成更紧密的排列，从而稳定其构象）。 DMSO在治疗蛋白质错误折叠类疾病方面也显示出良好前景，例如肾源性尿崩症、 <sup data-ref="351">351</sup> <sup data-ref="350">350</sup> 囊性纤维化以及马查多-约瑟夫病；此外，它还能增强因HLA-DM缺陷而功能受损的免疫细胞呈现抗原的能力，从而引发免疫应答。 <sup data-ref="351">351</sup>

content.en: One protein-misfolding disease, amyloidosis, occurs when misfolded proteins enter the bloodstream, aggregate into amyloid fibrils, and deposit in tissues (which over time damages organs and can lead to organ failure). As options for this disease are limited, DMSO was attempted, and early positive responses led to it being repeatedly used in certain areas (e.g., in Japan), where it was found the best results were obtained when high concentrations could be applied directly to the affected area (e.g., bladder lining or skin), and that while not consistently effective, a large body of literature showed it repeatedly produced dramatic results for patients with otherwise fatal conditions, and appeared to do so by both dissolving amyloids and facilitating their urinary excretion (detailed [here](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/steroid-dangers-and-safe-autoimmune)).
content.cn: 一种蛋白质错误折叠疾病——淀粉样变性，是由于错误折叠的蛋白质进入血液，聚集成淀粉样纤维，并沉积在组织中而引起的（随着时间的推移，这会损害器官并可能导致器官衰竭）。 由于该病的治疗选择有限，人们尝试使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），早期取得的积极疗效促使该药物在某些地区（例如日本）被反复使用。研究发现，当高浓度的二甲基亚砜能直接作用于受累部位（例如膀胱内壁或皮肤）时，可获得最佳疗效， 虽然疗效并非始终稳定，但大量文献表明，对于其他治疗手段下本将危及生命的患者，该疗法屡屡产生显著疗效，其作用机制似乎既包括溶解淀粉样蛋白，也包括促进其经尿液排出（详见此处）。

content.en: *Note: since many cancer-causing proteins are misfolded proteins, [it is thought](https://dm5migu4zj3pb.cloudfront.net/manuscripts/119000/119302/JCI97119302.pdf) that this may partly explain DMSO’s anticancer properties.
content.cn: 注：由于许多致癌蛋白都是错误折叠的蛋白质，因此人们认为这或许可以部分解释二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的抗癌特性。*

content.en: In addition to diseases discussed previously, three neurological conditions characterized by defective proteins have shown promising responses to DMSO.
content.cn: 除了前文讨论的疾病外，还有三种以蛋白质缺陷为特征的神经系统疾病对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗反应颇为可观。

content.en: Niemann-Pick disease
content.cn: 尼曼-皮克病

content.en: Niemann-Pick disease is a rare genetic lysosomal storage disorder marked by intracellular accumulation of sphingomyelin, either due to a defect in sphingomyelinase, the enzyme which breaks it down (types A/B) or defective lysosomal cholesterol trafficking (type C). Each causes damage to the organs and neurodegeneration, with A \[NPA\] being the most severe (death is typical at 2-3 years), B \[NPB\] the least severe (minimal neurological involvement), and C \[NPC\] on average causing death around 13 years of age. As DMSO stabilizes proteins and improves cellular transport, it has been repeatedly explored for this condition (particularly type C).
content.cn: 尼曼-皮克病（Niemann-Pick disease）是一种罕见的遗传性溶酶体贮积病，其特征为细胞内鞘磷脂的积聚，这要么是由于分解鞘磷脂的酶——鞘磷脂酶（sphingomyelinase）存在缺陷（A型/B型），要么是由于溶酶体胆固醇转运缺陷（C型）。 每种亚型都会导致器官损伤和神经退行性变，其中A型\[NPA\]病情最为严重（通常在2-3岁时死亡），B型\[NPB\]病情最轻（神经系统受累极轻微），而C型\[NPC\]患者平均在13岁左右死亡。由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能稳定蛋白质并改善细胞转运，因此该物质已被多次用于该病（特别是C型）的治疗研究。

content.en: This disease is frequently studied in human fibroblasts with that defect. There DMSO has been shown to do the following:
content.cn: 这种疾病常以具有该缺陷的人类成纤维细胞为研究对象。研究表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有以下作用：

content.en: • [In normal fibroblasts](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0006291X85902499), 2% DMSO for 4 days increased sphingomyelinase activity to 230% of control levels in normal cells in a dose-dependent manner (with a much smaller increase in other lysosomal hydrolases). In fibroblasts from NPC patients, 2% DMSO raised sphingomyelinase activity by 480% (correcting the deficiency), along with a smaller (280% increase) seen in NPB fibroblasts.
content.cn: • 在正常成纤维细胞中，用2%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）处理4天后，鞘磷脂酶活性以剂量依赖性方式升至正常细胞对照水平的230%（而其他溶酶体水解酶的活性增幅则小得多）。 在NPC患者的成纤维细胞中，2%二甲基亚砜使鞘磷脂酶活性提高了480%（纠正了该酶的缺乏），而NPB患者的成纤维细胞中则观察到较小的升高（增加280%）。

content.en: *Note: in NPC, a decrease in sphingomyelinase activity results from the massive buildup of cholesterol in the cell (rather than genetic impairment of the enyzme).
content.cn: 注：在NPC中，鞘磷脂酶活性的降低是由于细胞内胆固醇的大量积聚所致（而非该酶的遗传缺陷）。*

content.en: • [In normal fibroblasts](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0005276088900951), 2% DMSO increased sphingomyelinaseactivity, primarily within the lysosomes, by 168-263% (depending on pH). In NPC fibroblasts (which retained 30% sphingomyelinaseactivity), DMSO caused a 2+ fold increase in activity that brought it close to normal levels, whereas in NPA and NPB fibroblasts no improvement was seen. Additionally, smaller increases in other lysosomal hydrolases were seen, indicating DMSO specifically targets sphingomyelinase.
content.cn: • 在正常成纤维细胞中，2% 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使鞘磷脂酶活性（主要存在于溶酶体内）提高了168%至263%（具体数值取决于pH值）。 在NPC成纤维细胞中（其鞘磷脂酶活性保留了30%），DMSO使鞘磷脂酶活性增加了2倍以上，使其接近正常水平；而在NPA和NPB成纤维细胞中则未见改善。此外，其他溶酶体水解酶的活性也出现了较小程度的增加，这表明DMSO特异性地作用于鞘磷脂酶。

content.en: • [When NPC fibroblasts were exposed](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/0005276089902002) to LDL, 2% DMSO had minimal effect in the first 12 hours but substantially reduced the excessive accumulation of unesterified cholesterol in lysosomes thereafter (particularly at 24–48 hours), bringing cholesterol levels close to those in normal cells (markedly diminished perinuclear/lysosomal cholesterol fluorescence), and restored the impaired cellular homeostatic responses to cholesterol.
content.cn: • 当NPC成纤维细胞暴露于LDL时，2%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在前12小时内几乎没有影响，但此后（特别是在24–48小时期间）显著减少了溶酶体中未酯化胆固醇的过度积累，使胆固醇水平接近正常细胞的水平（核周/溶酶体胆固醇荧光明显减弱），并恢复了受损的细胞对胆固醇的稳态反应。

content.en: • [In normal fibroblast](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0387760412801185) s, twelve specific drugs (e.g., older psychiatric ones) were found to markedly reduce cholesterol esterification (e.g., one caused a 93% reduction for at least 48 hours). DMSO (2%) partially counteracted this and restored 16-20% of the lost cholesterol processing capacity, suggesting potential use in NPC.
content.cn: • 在正常成纤维细胞中，发现有十二种特定药物（例如某些较老的精神科药物）能显著降低胆固醇酯化作用（例如，其中一种药物在至少48小时内使胆固醇酯化作用降低了93%）。二甲基亚砜（2%）部分抵消了这一效应，并恢复了16%至20%的胆固醇代谢能力，这表明该物质在NPC治疗中具有潜在应用价值。

content.en: • [2% DMSO](https://www.scielo.br/j/bjmbr/a/mcsPSNCm8mw9ydd6K3f6JBL/?format=html&lang=en) (but not 1% or 4%) significantly increased sphingomyelinase activity in both normal and NPC fibroblasts. However unlike the other studies, none of the concentrations reduced cytoplasmic cholesterol in NPC fibroblasts.
content.cn: • 2% DMSO（但不是 1% 或 4%）显著提高了正常成纤维细胞和 NPC 成纤维细胞中的鞘磷脂酶活性。然而，与其他研究不同的是，这些浓度均未降低 NPC 成纤维细胞中的胞浆胆固醇水平。

content.en: • [Lastly, in mice fibroblasts](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/expanim1985/5/0/5_0_86/_article/-char/ja/) (modeling NPA/B), 2% DMSO caused a 2-3 fold increase in sphingomyelinase activity.
content.cn: • 最后，在小鼠成纤维细胞（模拟NPA/B）中，2%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）导致鞘磷脂酶活性增加了2至3倍。

content.en: These results suggested DMSO could partially improve the disease, and they (especially the early ones) generated sufficient interest to explore using DMSO to treat it where the following was found:
content.cn: 这些结果表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可能对该疾病具有部分改善作用，其中（尤其是早期研究）引起了足够的关注，从而促使人们探索使用二甲基亚砜治疗该疾病，并发现了以下情况：

content.en: [In NPA/B mice](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/expanim1985/5/0/5_0_86/_article/-char/ja/), oral DMSO administration (0.25% in drinking water from 6 weeks of age) prolonged survival from ~12 weeks in untreated mice to an average of 15 weeks and 5 days (maximum 17 weeks and 5 days) and delayed the onset of neurological symptoms such as tremors. However, it failed to prevent symptom progression or improve manifestations once present and had minimal effect on cholesterol accumulation (liver slightly decreased, spleen and brain were unaffected).
content.cn: 在NPA/B小鼠中，口服二甲基亚砜（自6周龄起在饮水中添加0.25%）将未治疗小鼠的生存期从约12周延长至平均15周零5天（最长17周零5天），并延缓了震颤等神经系统症状的出现。 然而，该方法未能阻止症状的进展，也无法改善已出现的症状，且对胆固醇积聚的影响微乎其微（肝脏中的胆固醇略有减少，脾脏和脑部未受影响）。

content.en: • [In NPC mice](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2007&filename=GWKF200702006&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=gEpGGM2nh8BixtYsFxwc097JIQzmG95RhCBLPDeEL1QeyjXqkC5neRkIZcC70Vyu), flavopiridol (dissolved in DMSO) and infused directly into the brain dose dependently reduced hyperphosphorylation of cytoskeletal proteins and improved behavior.
content.cn: • 在NPC小鼠模型中，将黄嘧啶醇（溶于二甲基亚砜）直接输注至脑内，可呈剂量依赖性地减轻细胞骨架蛋白的过度磷酸化，并改善行为表现。

content.en: • [In human NPC patients](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8577061/), a Japanese paper reported oral administration of DMSO resulted in some clinical benefits, including decreased size of hepatosplenomegaly, lesser frequency of seizures, and improved EEG findings. However, the progressive clinical course of the disease was not changed, although it appeared to slow down.
content.cn: • 针对人类神经母细胞瘤（NPC）患者，一篇日本论文报道称，口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可带来一些临床益处，包括肝脾肿大程度减轻、癫痫发作频率降低以及脑电图（EEG）结果改善。然而，尽管疾病的进展似乎有所放缓，但其进行性病程并未改变。

content.en: The author of that paper also published:
content.cn: 该论文的作者还发表了以下文章：

content.en: • [A case report of an 8 year old girl](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1442-200X.1988.tb02544.x) with NPC who presented with severe psychomotor deterioration, marked cortical atrophy, frequent seizures, moderate ventricular dilatation and hepatosplenomegaly. Oral DMSO was shown to normalize her sphingomyelinase activity. After 2 years of oral DMSO, she had a slight improvement in response to her surroundings, her seizures decreased (allowing an anticonvulsant to be tapered), her EEGs showed marked improvement (theta waves and spindles normalized), there was no further progression of her cortical atrophy, and both the spleen and liver shrank to normal size.
content.cn: • 一例8岁NPC患儿病例报告，该患儿表现为严重的心理运动功能退化、显著的皮质萎缩、频繁癫痫发作、中度脑室扩大以及肝脾肿大。口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使她的鞘磷脂酶活性恢复正常。 经口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗2年后，她对周围环境的反应略有改善，癫痫发作次数减少（从而得以逐步减少抗癫痫药物的用量），脑电图显示显著改善（θ波和纺锤波恢复正常），皮质萎缩未进一步进展，脾脏和肝脏均缩小至正常大小。

content.en: • [Another report](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1442-200X.1988.tb02544.x) on siblings with NPC who clinically improved with DMSO.
content.cn: • 另一份关于患有鼻咽癌的兄弟姐妹在二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗下临床症状有所改善的报告。

content.en: •A study that again found [DMSO corrected sphingomyelinase deficiency](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C44&q=CORRECTION+OF+SPHINGOMYELINASE+DEFICIENCY+%28ACID+AND+NEUTRAL%29+IN+CULTURED+FIBROBLASTS+FROM+NIEMANN-PICK+PATIENTS+WITH+DIMETHYLSULFOXIDE+%28DMSO%29&btnG=) in cultured fibroblasts from NPC patients.
content.cn: •一项研究再次发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可纠正鼻咽癌（NPC）患者体外培养成纤维细胞中的鞘磷脂酶缺乏症。

content.en: • [A study showing](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1442-200X.1987.tb00341.x) other dipolar aprotic substances besides DMSO also selectively increased sphingomyelinase activity.
content.cn: • 一项研究表明，除二甲基亚砜（DMSO）之外，其他双极非极性物质也能选择性地提高鞘磷脂酶的活性。

content.en: *Note: lastly, a [final case report](https://europepmc.org/article/med/2400614) detailed unsuccessful treatment of NPC with oral DMSO.
content.cn: 注：最后，一份病例报告详细描述了口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗鼻咽癌未获成功的案例。*

content.en: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease and Prion Disorders
content.cn: 克雅氏病与朊病毒病

content.en: Prion diseases (such as CJD in humans and scrapie in animals) result from normal prion proteins misfolding into a pathogenic form (PrPSc) that aggregates into toxic fibrils and progressively destroys brain tissue. [These conditions are universally fatal and have no approved treatment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Creutzfeldt%E2%80%93Jakob_disease).
content.cn: 朊病毒病（如人类的克雅氏病和动物的羊瘙痒病）是由正常朊蛋白发生错误折叠，形成致病性朊蛋白（PrPSc），进而聚集形成有毒纤维，并逐渐破坏脑组织所引起的。这些疾病均会致命，且目前尚无获批的治疗方法。

content.en: DMSO has shown therapeutic potential through multiple mechanisms. As a chemical chaperone, [DMSO stabilized](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8978663/) the normal alpha-helical structure of newly synthesized prion protein in infected neuroblastoma cells, inhibiting its conversion to the pathogenic form. In cells carrying a familial CJD mutation, DMSO reversed the mutant phenotype by reducing lysosomal accumulation of misfolded prion protein and restoring its normal distribution to the cell surface.<sup data-ref="352">352</sup>, <sup data-ref="353">353</sup> In yeast prion models, [DMSO cured multiple prion variants](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32134970/) more efficiently than guanidine hydrochloride by enhancing chaperone activity (Hsp104) and converting aggregated protein back into soluble forms.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已通过多种机制展现出治疗潜力。作为一种化学伴侣蛋白，DMSO 能稳定受感染神经母细胞瘤细胞中新合成的朊蛋白的正常α-螺旋结构，从而抑制其向致病性形式的转化。在携带家族性克雅氏病（CJD）突变的细胞中，DMSO 通过减少错误折叠朊蛋白在溶酶体中的积累，并恢复其在细胞表面的正常分布，从而逆转了突变表型。 <sup data-ref="352">352</sup> <sup data-ref="353">353</sup> 在酵母朊蛋白模型中，DMSO 通过增强分子伴侣（Hsp104）的活性，并将聚集蛋白转化回可溶性形式，其治愈多种朊蛋白变体的效率高于盐酸胍。

content.en: DMSO also partially inhibited PrPSc aggregation, producing amorphous aggregates with less than 1% of the prion infectivity of untreated rod-like aggregates when inoculated into hamsters.<sup data-ref="354">354</sup>, <sup data-ref="355">355</sup>, <sup data-ref="356">356</sup> In prion-infected hamsters, DMSO prolonged incubation time, reduced the rate of PrPSc accumulation in the brain, and (like seen in amyloidosis) increased urinary clearance of protease-resistant prion protein — though it was not sufficient as a standalone cure.<sup data-ref="357">357</sup>, <sup data-ref="358">358</sup>
content.cn: DMSO 还部分抑制了 PrPSc 的聚集，产生的非晶态聚集体在接种到仓鼠体内时，其朊病毒传染性不到未经处理的棒状聚集体的 1%。 <sup data-ref="357">357</sup> <sup data-ref="358">358</sup> <sup data-ref="356">356</sup> 在感染朊病毒的仓鼠中，DMSO延长了潜伏期，降低了脑内PrPSc的积累速率，并（与淀粉样变性中的情况相似）增加了蛋白酶抗性朊蛋白的尿液清除率——尽管仅靠它还不足以作为独立疗法。 <sup data-ref="357">357</sup> <sup data-ref="358">358</sup>

content.en: Ruthenium-DMSO complexes (related to NAMI-A) showed even stronger effects, disaggregating prion peptide fibrils, reducing copper-mediated oxidative stress, and rescuing neuronal cell viability from 33% to 85%.<sup data-ref="359">359</sup>, <sup data-ref="360">360</sup>
content.cn: 钌-二甲基亚砜（DMSO）配合物（与NAMI-A相关）表现出更显著的效果，不仅能使朊蛋白肽纤维解聚，还能减轻铜介导的氧化应激，并将神经元细胞存活率从33%提升至85%。 <sup data-ref="359">359</sup> <sup data-ref="360">360</sup>

content.en: [One reader reported](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/77749908) that her cousin with CJD improved after approximately one month of IV DMSO infusions; we subsequently learned she operated an infusion center and had used high-dose vitamin and DMSO infusions to treat numerous severe conditions, with her cousin still alive several years later.
content.cn: 一位读者报告称，她患有克雅氏病（CJD）的表亲在接受约一个月二甲基亚砜（DMSO）静脉输注后病情有所好转；我们随后了解到，她经营着一家输液中心，曾使用高剂量维生素和二甲基亚砜输液治疗过多种严重疾病，而她的表亲在数年后仍然健在。

content.en: *Note: two prion studies found less favorable results,<sup data-ref="361">361</sup>, <sup data-ref="362">362</sup> indicating results may vary by species, strain, or protocol.
content.cn: 注：两项朊病毒研究得出了不太理想的结果， <sup data-ref="361">361</sup> <sup data-ref="362">362</sup> 这表明结果可能因物种、菌株或实验方案的不同而有所差异。*

content.en: Lastly, DMSO’s protein-stabilizing properties likely extend beyond misfolded proteins — it has been shown to act as a pharmacological chaperone that restores normal membrane receptor trafficking, and (in many studies) to stabilize brain microtubules during isolation by preventing tubulin depolymerization under stress.<sup data-ref="363">363</sup>, <sup data-ref="364">364</sup> Since microtubules are essential for neuronal function and are impaired in neurodegenerative diseases, this likely enhances DMSO’s neuroprotective effects in conditions like strokes or TBIs, where microtubule collapse from oxidative stress or ischemia worsens neuronal damage.
content.cn: 最后，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的蛋白质稳定特性可能不仅限于错误折叠的蛋白质——研究表明，它能作为一种药理学伴侣蛋白，恢复膜受体的正常转运；并且（在许多研究中）在脑组织分离过程中，通过防止应激条件下微管蛋白的解聚，从而稳定脑微管。 <sup data-ref="363">363</sup> <sup data-ref="364">364</sup> 由于微管对神经元功能至关重要，且在神经退行性疾病中功能受损，这很可能增强了DMSO在中风或创伤性脑损伤等病症中的神经保护作用——在这些病症中，由氧化应激或缺血导致的微管坍塌会加剧神经元损伤。

content.en: *Note: the benefits seen in the final disease, Down Syndrome, (discussed further below) may result from DMSO’s neuroprotective and antioxidant effects, combined with DMSO’s ability to act as a chemical chaperone (which could help cells manage proteostasis overload from excess proteins and support clearance of misfolded or damaged proteins), or DMSO improving transport of vital nutrients across compromised membranes.
content.cn: 注：在最后一种疾病——唐氏综合征（下文将进一步讨论）中观察到的益处，可能源于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的神经保护和抗氧化作用，结合其作为化学伴侣的能力（这可能有助于细胞应对过量蛋白质导致的蛋白质稳态失衡，并促进错误折叠或受损蛋白质的清除），或者源于DMSO改善了重要营养物质穿过受损细胞膜的转运。*

content.en: Cognitive Impairment and Dementia
content.cn: 认知障碍与痴呆

content.en: The same degenerative processes which cause dementia initially trigger cognitive impairment and as such, being able to head this off early, beyond greatly improving one’s current quality of life, also allows much worse situations to be avoided. As these neurodegenerative processes (e.g., poor blood flow and inflammation) also underlie many of the other neurological disorders DMSO treats, significant data has accumulated for either DMSO alone, or DMSO in combination with another therapy to reverse cognitive loss.
content.cn: 导致痴呆症的那些退行性病变最初会引发认知功能障碍；因此，若能及早加以遏制，不仅能极大改善患者当前的生活质量，还能避免病情恶化至更严重的境地。 由于这些神经退行性病变（例如血流不畅和炎症）也是二甲基亚砜（DMSO）所治疗的许多其他神经系统疾病的基础病因，因此已积累了大量数据，证明单独使用DMSO或将其与其他疗法联合使用，均可逆转认知功能衰退。

content.en: The animal research in this field is as follows:
content.cn: 该领域的动物研究如下：

content.en: [When rats had their carotid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15145763/) arteries surgically modified to significantly reduce the amount of blood going to their brain, after 3 months, it was found that DMSO prevented both the neuronal damage and the significant loss of spatial memory and learning that otherwise resulted from that chronic loss of cerebral blood flow.
content.cn: 当通过手术对大鼠的颈动脉进行改造，使其流向大脑的血量显著减少后，3个月后发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）既能防止神经元损伤，也能防止因这种慢性脑血流减少而导致的空间记忆和学习能力的显著丧失。

content.en: In a similar study, rats 14 weeks old were subjected to either permanent bilateral carotid artery occlusion or sham occlusion (mimicking the chronic vascular impairments many experience with increasing age) and then tested for visuospatial memory function. After 14 weeks, four rats who had shown persistent and severe memory impairment received DMSO and FDP for 7 days, which improved their memory by 54%, almost reaching the cognitive function of the controls. Unfortunately, this improvement was partially lost once DMSO-FDP were discontinued (as the blood supply was still occluded).<sup data-ref="365">365</sup>, <sup data-ref="366">366</sup>
content.cn: 在一项类似的研究中，将14周大的大鼠分别进行永久性双侧颈动脉闭塞或假闭塞（模拟许多人随着年龄增长而出现的慢性血管功能障碍），随后对其视觉空间记忆功能进行测试。14周后，4只表现出持续且严重记忆障碍的大鼠接受了为期7天的DMSO和FDP治疗，其记忆能力提高了54%，几乎达到了对照组的认知水平。 遗憾的是，一旦停止使用DMSO-FDP，这种改善便部分消失（因为血液供应仍然处于阻断状态）。 <sup data-ref="365">365</sup> <sup data-ref="366">366</sup>

content.en: Lurcher mice are used to study olivary and cerebellar disorders because their Purkinje cells can’t survive (e.g., by 30 days of age their walking is grossly abnormal). When these mice received DMSO, it prevented the age-related deterioration of certain cognitive functions (e.g., memory and spatial learning abilities).<sup data-ref="367">367</sup>, <sup data-ref="368">368</sup>
content.cn: 卢彻小鼠常被用于研究橄榄核和小脑疾病，因为其浦肯野细胞无法存活（例如，到30日龄时，它们的行走能力已出现严重异常）。当这些小鼠接受二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗后，某些认知功能（例如记忆力和空间学习能力）的年龄相关性衰退得以阻止。 <sup data-ref="367">367</sup> <sup data-ref="368">368</sup>

content.en: DMSO has also demonstrated direct cognitive effects in other contexts. [It reduced MK-801-induced neuronal necrosis](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17141325/) in the rat cingulate and retrosplenial cortex by 80–86%, even when administered up to 4 hours after dosing—a finding relevant to both anesthesia safety and neuroprotection. [In morphine-sensitized mice](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34466459/), DMSO independently enhanced spatial memory formation in the Morris water maze (with the effects further enhanced by curcumin <sup>⬖</sup>). [In a mouse model of thiamine <sup>⬖</sup> deficiency](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00210-021-02148-5) (relevant to Wernicke’s encephalopathy), DMSO partially improved behavioral deficits and reduced thalamic damage, and when combined with high-dose thiamine,<sup>⬖</sup> enhanced recovery beyond thiamine <sup>⬖</sup> alone. [DMSO alone also produced](https://digitalcommons.iwu.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1315&context=jwprc) no spatial learning deficits when injected into the hippocampus in an 8-arm radial maze task, confirming its safety as a vehicle in cognitive research.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在其他研究情境中也表现出直接的认知效应。它能将MK-801诱导的大鼠扣带回和脾后皮层神经元坏死程度降低80%–86%，即使在给药后长达4小时内给药也能产生这种效果——这一发现与麻醉安全性和神经保护均密切相关。 在吗啡致敏小鼠模型中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在莫里斯水迷宫实验中独立增强了空间记忆的形成（其效果在姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 的作用下进一步增强）。 在硫胺素 <sup>⬖</sup> 缺乏的小鼠模型（与韦尼克脑病相关）中，二甲基亚砜部分改善了行为缺陷并减轻了丘脑损伤；当与高剂量硫胺素联合使用时， <sup>⬖</sup> 其促进的恢复效果优于单独使用硫胺素 <sup>⬖</sup> 。 在8臂放射迷宫任务中，单独将二甲基亚砜注射入海马体后，未出现空间学习缺陷，这证实了其作为认知研究中溶剂的安全性。

content.en: Anesthesia-Induced Cognitive Impairment
content.cn: 麻醉引起的认知功能障碍

content.en: General anesthesia, particularly prolonged or repeated exposure, can cause lasting cognitive deficits and is recognized to significantly increase the risk for Alzheimer’s (making it a growing concern for both young children whose brains are still developing and the elderly). As we’ve seen numerous people tip over into dementia (as some of their neurons which are put to sleep during the surgery never seem to wake up afterwards), we hence try to minimize surgeries, have anesthesiologists use less toxic anesthetics (inhaled anesthetics cause the most issues), and use nutraceuticals to counteract that sedation.
content.cn: 全身麻醉，尤其是长期或反复使用，可能会导致持久的认知功能障碍，且已被证实会显著增加患阿尔茨海默病的风险（这使得它不仅对大脑仍在发育的幼儿，也对老年人而言，都成为一个日益严峻的问题）。 鉴于我们目睹了众多患者逐渐陷入痴呆状态（因为他们在手术期间被“麻醉”的部分神经元似乎在术后再也无法“苏醒”），因此我们努力尽量减少手术次数，要求麻醉师使用毒性较低的麻醉剂（吸入性麻醉剂引发的问题最多），并借助营养保健品来抵消麻醉带来的影响。

content.en: Fortunately, DMSO addresses both the recognized mechanisms of anesthesia toxicity (e.g., neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, or neuronal apoptosis) and what we believe the key issue is ([cells becoming stuck in a dormant phase](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-do-cells-turning-off-underlie)). Unfortunately, all existing research on this subject involved DMSO combined with another agent, so definitive proof DMSO alone antidotes anesthesia toxicity does not exist.
content.cn: 幸运的是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）既能针对已知的麻醉毒性机制（例如神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍或神经元凋亡），也能解决我们认为的关键问题（即细胞陷入休眠状态）。遗憾的是，目前所有关于该主题的研究均涉及将DMSO与另一种药物联合使用，因此尚无确凿证据表明DMSO单独使用即可解救麻醉毒性。

content.en: **Sevoflurane**, one of the most widely used inhalational anesthetics, has been the most extensively studied. Resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO repeatedly protected against sevoflurane-induced cognitive deficits in both aged and neonatal rats by activating the SIRT1 pathway, reducing neuroapoptosis, upregulating BDNF, and improving spatial memory.<sup data-ref="369">369</sup>, <sup data-ref="370">370</sup>, <sup data-ref="371">371</sup> Additional combinations protecting against sevoflurane-induced cognitive impairment include [arctigenin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3YWaq8k8_NOF4KKOlQki_WBZcdohjZ3Bk81SlHZLQZwVmb452t39SlXlEG4m6wHKvj01PoqPvje842T707jS8vNQbrxhlnMO4Eu90K-YOASKc2Ka7bt_uqIEPHZMJwajbijw1-2MI-yo4RML14u440BEmo1gszuTPTw3TyZx2ZOpaNutx3RgZr1&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which reduced inflammation via the Akt/NF-κB pathway and upregulated CTRP6), [honokiol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahK4WnfqmiQBi2W0MBPLjRHv6-fdN81l6Zf3IC28S9twGY6P0OCIztghBGn7FSbOgYjc2PiwPSk3z_TepkKXogW5VmiZgmRbYbkQLMxj0wJexJ4Wj4TO2DwTeGQaDvk875KSaiDdGBNE7ng878B0PvCkWOqYenIu4hFgp4IjfTy9l1UvE-rq_sDTN4cQqKW-OXM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which activated SIRT3, reducing neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial dysfunction), SAHA (which inhibited NLRP3 inflammasome activation and ameliorated cognitive impairment in aged mice),<sup data-ref="372">372</sup>, <sup data-ref="373">373</sup> curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="374">374</sup>, <sup data-ref="375">375</sup> (which improved memory retrieval dysfunction and reversed sevoflurane-induced Aβ increases and BACE-1 upregulation in aged rats), [a S1P agonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1015368055.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=n7Ias9GEl8OmZ90Lw3wsi9V0W16Q8TfDeEOOII8u9fUJImop4pAif7BRr0_9O01h) (which prevented hippocampal apoptosis in neonatal rats), [progesterone](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tedvRTzfgl10Q-8oafkcEH7utKA9CvhOHNgmmZZ1mS8DII5A8xUzX2cD_egjXIbSC20kxD42Gp3QymwVnKhXqDoa6hGVcyJsfUy5kFfzvidbWA5g9sL4qrJZynPJwpmfcK5iMwRxVTS-hFNHxRE7wT-p9lF3WZZPBiUUrrtOOb6elFuyS7VEy8d&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which attenuated sevoflurane-induced neuronal injury in primary hippocampal neurons via progesterone receptors and Akt signaling), and [inhibitors of the TLR4-p38MAPK-NF-κB pathway](https://pesquisa.bvsalud.org/portal/resource/pt/wpr-755604) (which attenuated cognitive decline).
content.cn: 七氟醚作为应用最广泛的吸入麻醉药之一，也是研究最为深入的。溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过激活SIRT1通路、减少神经细胞凋亡、上调脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）水平以及改善空间记忆，在老年大鼠和新生大鼠中均多次成功预防了七氟醚诱导的认知功能障碍。 <sup data-ref="374">374</sup> <sup data-ref="375">375</sup> <sup data-ref="371">371</sup> 其他可预防七氟醚诱导的认知功能障碍的组合包括：阿克蒂根宁（通过Akt/NF-κB通路减轻炎症并上调CTRP6）、霍诺基醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （激活SIRT3，减轻神经炎症、氧化应激和线粒体功能障碍）， SAHA（通过抑制NLRP3炎性小体的激活，改善了老年小鼠的认知功能障碍）， <sup data-ref="374">374</sup> <sup data-ref="375">375</sup> 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="374">374</sup> <sup data-ref="375">375</sup> （改善了记忆检索功能障碍，并逆转了七氟醚在老年大鼠中诱导的Aβ水平升高及BACE-1上调）， 一种S1P激动剂（可预防新生大鼠海马区细胞凋亡）、孕酮（可通过孕酮受体和Akt信号通路减轻七氟烷诱导的原代海马神经元损伤），以及TLR4-p38MAPK-NF-κB通路抑制剂（可减轻认知功能下降）。

content.en: *Note: [in one neonatal rat study](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=JFJY201807011&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=TJ6TbduPHh3wACt1Xob9MgA68z5lVGe6mNDRxpjjWjLmkc5WuwqOHmB77s8KYLFg), resveratrol* <sup>⬖</sup> *improved molecular markers (SIRT1, PGC-1α, FOXO3α, SOD) and reduced brain pathological damage after sevoflurane, but Morris water maze testing showed no significant behavioral improvement across groups.*
content.cn: 注：在一项针对新生大鼠的研究中，白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 改善了分子标志物（SIRT1、PGC-1α、FOXO3α、SOD）的水平，并减轻了七氟烷引起的大脑病理损伤，但在莫里斯水迷宫测试中，各组间未观察到显著的行为改善。

content.en: **Propofol**, another widely used anesthetic, causes dose-dependent neuronal apoptosis and lasting cognitive deficits with repeated neonatal exposure. Agents dissolved in DMSO that protected against propofol neurotoxicity include dexmedetomidine (which activated PI3K/Akt/GSK-3β in multiple studies),<sup data-ref="376">376</sup>, <sup data-ref="377">377</sup> [etanercept](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017202612.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=nJr0iCLbxNY7CVUnVJWOU277ZmMVLG2ZaZYfst4Kvqnnh08w3x-1mAzH_Pqn1pDj) (which blocked TNF-α-mediated damage), [SAHA](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017224592.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=4T9vuhUSEsi0kiKccHzMG36iRctSuE0xCQj-i_ij3YbSotoDt611IYgsP499g1CE) (which reversed learning and memory impairments by modulating histone acetylation, synaptic proteins, and CREB phosphorylation), [17β estradiol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017826415.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=7cuQNVF6EibJISrqzKUBdkXgHdr_nhVOkyHDxpxZjMJofQ5vdAhkvNsUUbIwBfER) (which reversed deficits through the ERK pathway), [hydroxylfasudil](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2015&filename=1015324395.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=KPFr6VjfBhkb2N5auSHwyxAgwK8zNgh4NzSXjL1WB0P-FUTUDP1PcBetrrQce4p7) (which reduced apoptosis via p38 MAPK inhibition and improved Morris water maze performance) and [coenzyme Q10](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahKA8SRvdegk8bHlIQkjo6S7Xe3AC65Sr0nHq2tMYX6KSCQ0K2LnkeVKOmbloWFOnio9jhtYUpyPygWRjzBSHwRJfOmvOvrj3S2FdPND8ApECjTbQtKQK3fMysYIVQtUsSXwVYci4b_NBpsJjZcuFvQxBoZXZZTHiVpMDnXRiaj3RGAR8kZWD02DQdHVtKwhidM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which partially reversed propofol-induced mitochondrial respiratory chain inhibition in primary hippocampal neurons).
content.cn: 丙泊酚是另一种广泛使用的麻醉药，新生儿反复接触该药物会引起剂量依赖性的神经元凋亡以及持久的认知缺陷。溶解于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中且能抵御丙泊酚神经毒性的药物包括右美托咪定（多项研究表明其可激活PI3K/Akt/GSK-3β通路）， <sup data-ref="376">376</sup> <sup data-ref="377">377</sup> 依那西普（可阻断TNF-α介导的损伤）、SAHA（通过调节组蛋白乙酰化、突触蛋白及CREB磷酸化来逆转学习和记忆障碍）、 17β-雌二醇（通过ERK通路逆转功能缺陷）、羟基法舒地尔（通过抑制p38 MAPK减少凋亡并改善莫里斯水迷宫表现）以及辅酶Q10 <sup>⬖</sup> （部分逆转了丙泊酚对原代海马神经元线粒体呼吸链的抑制作用）。

content.en: **Isoflurane** -induced cognitive impairment was counteracted by [dexmedetomidine](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDHIS2&filename=YAOL201312021&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=hEPFAGoO08ops-3vKDnqrW8P1lxJkyAUKWqFt8gP41VuuaAWW_h6wwth9_Qgj7jJ) dissolved in DMSO (which activated PI3K/Akt and reduced hippocampal apoptosis), intranasal [levosimendan](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Aslihan-Sengelen/publication/373236664_Demirgan_et_al_2021_Supp_data_Levosimendan_Protects_Newborn_Rat_Against_Isoflurane_Anesthesiapdf/data/64e1b11a177c590413098980/Demirgan-et-al-2021-Supp-data-Levosimendan-Protects-Newborn-Rat-Against-Isoflurane-Anesthesia.pdf) (which protected newborn rat brains), and [modafinil](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxkfQVVSavjC11-8etv27EPNGVzIwK0bRlJgu3fJIHxQ6fPxtqThxvT7yYyw3wouHrmsLnXoyRGXZapLdYhndyMQzny47TYnq1wkfCq2NLu3IviPzOxrJaelWN_UTTXhO9-RKgUc0OGtnynqKepB21XteTsYFRIsDg5-jI4KD6ysWQPBDdjnNzNk&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which improved novel object recognition and contextual fear memory during the awakening period). [Dexmedetomidine](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=hmNf6PfbaBtRWQVWY051PS2Zl8jHY1n-QunGGirvMERahISpwgdutwA3MMdCv5eN-SEntT06obd0-oGMDAuEPAW4JaMF0nPDz4sVJ_2jGpDHIQPZ1VvGNW_MtDsrEbfOloQaqZneGwt4gx3k7d6uH-0KevsR_5HTbstS--42bzjDGi8VxDTkJQ4rHqqO09ik&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) in DMSO also dose-dependently protected neonatal rat hippocampal neurons from etomidate-induced injury via the same PI3K/Akt pathway.
content.cn: 异氟醚诱导的认知功能障碍可通过以下方式得到缓解：溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的德美沙多明（其可激活PI3K/Akt通路并减少海马细胞凋亡）、鼻内给药的左西孟丹（其可保护新生大鼠大脑）以及莫达非尼（其可在苏醒期间改善新物体识别能力和情境恐惧记忆）。 溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的右美托咪定也通过相同的PI3K/Akt通路，以剂量依赖性方式保护新生大鼠海马神经元免受异丙米德诱导的损伤。

content.en: **Other anesthetics**: [Dexmedetomidine](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdrrpt0t8wwyg4CNhoOsaq8jT51sN0UXUhrY_PuWlhlhtOfQJ3jhR956kNZ2R2l7URb_7ATTY4Nf1LYLhIWgnsdr0Brg1d1Kt8mCF96FOMOh1zRgQpe9vABaL3QrbSVDGlKl2x449NewGfPwM5oMRESxjfx4Cx4ZPCTGlr5wtLPdx2H-N6qeLuC5xMCxl4miZc=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) attenuated ropivacaine-induced mitochondrial toxicity via p38 MAPK. Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO also protected developing rat brains against ketamine-induced neurotoxicity through the Nrf2-ARE antioxidant pathway, and also protected neonatal hippocampal neurons against the neurotoxicity of the anticonvulsants phenobarbital and valproic acid, significantly reducing neuronal loss.<sup data-ref="378">378</sup>, <sup data-ref="379">379</sup>
content.cn: 其他麻醉药：德美沙多米定通过p38 MAPK途径减轻了罗哌卡因诱导的线粒体毒性。 溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 也通过Nrf2-ARE抗氧化通路，保护发育中的大鼠大脑免受氯胺酮诱导的神经毒性，并保护新生儿海马神经元免受抗惊厥药苯巴比妥和丙戊酸的神经毒性，显著减少了神经元损失。 <sup data-ref="378">378</sup> <sup data-ref="379">379</sup>

content.en: **Postoperative cognitive dysfunction** (POCD), which affects a significant percentage of elderly surgical patients, similarly responded to DMSO-delivered agents. [Jasplakinolide](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVCGFqS4bci6HSG3PJTsMVycKkxb1S_amfcVOBIurq-mtdQ9idqnhhcZ0VKzB2XW6tPoROjJZ_pIX4DTAodkQEu3E1EpWzp10Of0DXpuUXGiGhoD9_Z79vNp4ug40uqDrydt5RpowoQ4wspwdWBHzYXBqKtV4rCZD-lp9Q7YdXraCcOtVFo_9ZrM&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (an F-actin stabilizer) reversed POCD deficits in aged mice by restoring dendritic spine numbers, glutamate receptor expression, and hippocampal neuronal activation. Other agents improving POCD include a [P300 inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdXggVwFFYlHZOUButBV8oxp5CNrDzy2sEbNfWrhETIUK8K2ocfCTwqseZsGztJeL_56ufl91DKmc_fa632yfZJCF5-V9HSsXV4l_KA93e6wdbsTU0lmNTjLFnQMfLXgljzEPzjHVlmQ3FOJrbYK6sB1No4jimWUMUrCfuuhLi0dbT3f8Q7JdQhu7mRiGdeY6k=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which improved water maze performance and reduced hippocampal apoptosis after cardiopulmonary bypass), [ononin](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/brb3.70952) (which reduced neuroinflammation and oxidative stress after nephrectomy in aged mice), and the Hippo/YAP pathway modulator [Iduna](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zctrkqIMPV-0KTG5-CfeWiPe8qn4ESWXef3wU0TbBOOhlapu0RvQNbSTw1Hl396kzgY1Z9ejRHNjQLBeWVLlumtHHusZ0y8HvbYmk-JpGewHyWO0wm1IFXne7F-Mm5ObeotNPXU9HFABrKJ9S9GRhV8ircQgTfAYlgEpekTgxG3KRSY4m1fapJNY&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN). In a series of experiments, [rapamycin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2015&filename=1014411104.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=n7vKRUIEDdg7EX_mvF3P0eIPo9VAEZvAGYFSNTW3VhA4l3QtOSN5_orWYSTf6Vd3) activated hippocampal autophagy to alleviate postoperative cognitive impairment in aged rats, exendin-4 protected cognition by stabilizing blood glucose, and propofol at therapeutic doses prevented excessive autophagy from electroconvulsive shock (each through complementary mechanisms).
content.cn: 术后认知功能障碍（POCD）影响了相当比例的老年手术患者，该病症对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）递送的药物同样有反应。贾斯普拉基诺萜（一种F-肌动蛋白稳定剂）通过恢复树突棘数量、谷氨酸受体表达以及海马神经元活化，逆转了老年小鼠的POCD缺陷。 其他可改善POCD的药物包括：一种P300抑制剂（该药物在体外循环后改善了水迷宫表现并减少了海马细胞凋亡）、奥诺宁（该药物在老年小鼠肾切除术后减轻了神经炎症和氧化应激），以及Hippo/YAP通路调节剂Iduna。 在一系列实验中，雷帕霉素通过激活海马自噬来缓解老年大鼠的术后认知障碍；艾塞那肽-4通过稳定血糖水平保护认知功能；而治疗剂量的丙泊酚则防止了电休克引发的过度自噬（每种药物均通过互补机制发挥作用）。

content.en: Other Causes of Cognitive Impairment
content.cn: 认知功能障碍的其他原因

content.en: A wide range of conditions impair cognition, and in many of these, therapeutic agents delivered in DMSO have demonstrated cognitive protection.
content.cn: 多种疾病都会损害认知功能，而在其中许多疾病中，以二甲基亚砜（DMSO）为载体给药的治疗药物已显示出对认知功能的保护作用。

content.en: **Sleep disorders** are a significant and underappreciated cause of cognitive decline. In sleep-deprived rats, [diallyl sulfide](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDV1fv_Mi2IcLZiHBffMCmnYa1NAD0GqbmHUhY2lthYM7g1rYzjoeSzTsJb8fnDYDXhn6HxvsGIFWRfERbJprEo-XGAk4E7HTucq-01lfeBj6DPilLSaiht6E7Yi5TBsq2CfswWO4Et6zkxv6-gJyoQmDf1CZ34iwpjYkP4Zn8e0yCR_ZV0B-C3&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO reversed cognitive impairment, reducing anxiety behaviors and hippocampal oxidative stress, while [resveratrol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38501767/) <sup>⬖</sup> prevented sleep deprivation-induced cognitive deficits by reducing neuroinflammation and enhancing synaptic plasticity proteins. In chronic intermittent hypoxia models (which simulate obstructive sleep apnea), agents improving cognition include [a TGF-β1 inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdrSYpGA9GpGpuMLa4bxGI0Z5g0h6nFCaFA4IuDL5VySigitgFcq6fbv2xnoITj1ARto5bLioPBRjPw1mdU3u4rGC3qBpzfEkBLD96Stt5WwnvvtcyAYaBKbh3VOVzbSUdapooUGZx3LnDH1OcbaDQNnbHG4dMuK3-2Qj9Kjbj4Xh_Y2031nTMY7nIxb-obFYQ=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which improved spatial memory by reducing hippocampal TGF-β1/Smad3 signaling), [capsaicin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tfMhQBm0WPygPv2LdS94tM57ccn4hCmgHpvdIQGbr2SRZoxzzAlvGRHKe-oWJSW9IuXqshm2MJoTz7zwF1IRirecT97rK3GM1pfVinjWIfh_KzxWhYEyCZvBpAyrR2SWhsCtTU1JqEovqWPQ1cmj2CMmChdxbw2UBPmYvweBfWLOKsyz8eldz9l2xqT1_X5nYU=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN),<sup>⬖</sup> [STAT3 pathway inhibitors](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35871214/), [an α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34007230/) (which upregulated BDNF and CREB), and adenosine A1 receptor antagonists.<sup data-ref="380">380</sup>, <sup data-ref="381">381</sup>
content.cn: 睡眠障碍是导致认知功能下降的一个重要且常被低估的原因。在睡眠剥夺的大鼠模型中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的二烯丙基硫醚 <sup>⬖</sup> 可逆转认知功能障碍，减轻焦虑行为并降低海马区的氧化应激；而白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 则通过减轻神经炎症和增强突触可塑性蛋白的表达，预防了睡眠剥夺引起的认知缺陷。 在慢性间歇性缺氧模型（该模型模拟阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停）中，可改善认知功能的药物包括TGF-β1抑制剂（通过降低海马区TGF-β1/Smad3信号传导来改善空间记忆）、辣椒素、 <sup>⬖</sup> STAT3通路抑制剂、一种α7烟碱性乙酰胆碱受体激动剂（通过上调BDNF和CREB发挥作用）以及腺苷A1受体拮抗剂。 <sup data-ref="380">380</sup> <sup data-ref="381">381</sup>

content.en: **Diabetic cognitive impairment** was improved by a variety of agents in combination with DMSO. Rapamycin improved cognition across multiple studies by reducing mTOR, hyperphosphorylated tau, and apoptosis,<sup data-ref="382">382</sup>, <sup data-ref="383">383</sup>, <sup data-ref="384">384</sup> while [captopril and losartan](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahLAtouaLy724h83iiRZfIyefA_XLF6a7Ux_66cUtmGZloEqjQFSq9jFkU9vgEpG-36XVhDicMOk7I4LlifZxXJ-TyYw_KZuvKbyeqgHoW-PnUbsK5etkivqB08nvzFXx7psP_GMPprIYbef9WibpRr8HmyA1A0MjfikdnxHx6kyB7pQTekck2YvM_84e4wRD_Q=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) improved cognitive function through a distinct mechanism — inhibiting the ACE-angiotensin II-AT1R axis in the hippocampus of diabetic mice. [A TRPV4 agonist](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tf6JFGes1lCIlkeRnZI5GhXzlBX0pk2WIpLWesHc8ZpcyRvw7vU0pp7E5QwOrx_y3DsHOu1JU5PIeIN5dKfX1BswO6nFHu4WVfkHC2Gjs6uMi8XIDslwrB_s_UiAJZGrc17cGKRUFEbvKPerznzPfRzEX0zExMxMn8EYQrpjanVyda7NMu3NyQKHL6TmA0zpXU=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) reversed cognitive deficits and enhanced hippocampal neurogenesis, and [CNTF](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=ZLXZ201508072&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=hdk8Gjl8utoFcgRqWtKK-1dUcINlQeg695yuFZmT1PDPYSxWcisDKGEhxKVm3aob) improved escape latency and increased hippocampal choline acetyltransferase expression via JAK2/STAT3. Additional agents improving diabetic cognitive impairment include [pentamethylquercetin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFD1214&filename=1013274324.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=-BRGuxQjT95nxWi63PtJVm5NzN0UNeI8_e2f0KgdFX6NeaM0WM7fzwlZ36zD8Bi2) <sup>⬖</sup> (Akt/CREB signaling and increased synaptic proteins), [sulforaphane](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2017&filename=1017826312.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=SUlsMHNkAjW5xkM0pGcKTH8YuXOP52t6LYdNbj5oTNiH0EJmFfKV51MGqDBOq1QY) <sup>⬖</sup> (PI3K/Akt/GSK-3β and inhibited mitochondrial apoptosis), [curcumin nicotinate](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1018057561.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Wt6kdfE3ZO6qOlMbqyGowLAdlhBYP_vG5iKQrPWhq4ShiTFyKT2gQkWE4Jsl3rIk) <sup>⬖</sup> (improved spatial learning by regulating autophagy), [krill oil/EPA](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=hmNf6PfbaBuzxpY6dzP_PTp1pz88s_rgN6rjAoTFm0LeJxASgZC8lovSF4R3ozy85K8VfWRvc7qYUzhiFIXgyzfQJKdWOvS3pNymIoRj310zMJ6G-NRpXQbXkqVhp6TJPG3AoUYn5C6pW_R5NQOFu85boBMzIO3b6AF3GLICquC_-wg0uyzO2883X_eNJaAnNy8_wdG0738=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (NRF2 antioxidant pathway), [Urtica dioica <sup>⬖</sup> and pioglitazone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29606029/) (oxidative stress markers and mitochondrial function), and [PSD-95/nNOS inhibitors](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxkOTusOp1EZMd_XCxLTRt9ZXC5Sj5MMh__AL6z3lHv7lmnlfSuMaDEmHVdeJ3qcMY-AyJIT_tlfa_cj5n6lkvVzRhOS9GGu9jHK_liUi5WuL_qxya-08uQGLpdqLbTXRA9tgS6ABrfPKC3cJSDnZW4d7H0atVhXTGe9uAhH1rTl8-rlhkyWccud&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (reduced neuronal injury via Sirt3).
content.cn: 多种药物与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用，可改善糖尿病性认知障碍。 雷帕霉素通过降低mTOR活性、超磷酸化tau蛋白水平及细胞凋亡，在多项研究中均改善了认知功能， <sup data-ref="382">382</sup> <sup data-ref="383">383</sup> <sup data-ref="384">384</sup> 而卡托普利和洛沙坦则通过一种不同的机制——抑制糖尿病小鼠海马区中的ACE-血管紧张素II-AT1R轴——来改善认知功能。 一种TRPV4激动剂逆转了认知缺陷并增强了海马神经发生，而CNTF通过JAK2/STAT3通路缩短了逃逸潜伏期并提高了海马胆碱乙酰转移酶的表达。其他可改善糖尿病认知障碍的药物还包括五甲基槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过Akt/CREB信号通路及增加突触蛋白）、硫代葡萄糖苷 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过PI3K/Akt/GSK-3β信号通路并抑制线粒体凋亡）、烟酸盐姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过调节自噬改善空间学习能力）、磷虾油/EPA <sup>⬖</sup> （NRF2抗氧化通路）、双性荨麻 <sup>⬖</sup> 和吡格列酮（氧化应激标志物和线粒体功能），以及PSD-95/nNOS抑制剂（通过Sirt3减轻神经元损伤）。

content.en: **Sepsis-associated encephalopathy** responded to [a HIF-1α inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxmzZdGEbK6DbW7jBVRllbrw9dInTs1OS6MFkJ2oS0mgbHvH86RDaSUi7gbceura-XsONV6Y8GkN9LkE79XmDsw9sWFNURKphx1XMYcEdmHzsNz38JMs4sCA8TczLTu_438cBRFuS4BaipJvukEi0VOHUnWFJcH3IzW0gfiyNJnntV2Dw2VhB1UG&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which improved cognitive function and reduced autophagy), [resveratrol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015331428.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=5LYUlhrLZiZaVk0kzbfo3NN-JjA4DuEmmkCeL7mVHkD8bNJz1U5EqrsHD348Dnq0) <sup>⬖</sup> (which activated SIRT1, reduced hippocampal apoptosis and microglial activation), [ROCK inhibitors](https://doi.org/10.1111/fcp.12645) (which reduced cerebral injury, inflammation, and improved spatial memory), [and molecular hydrogen](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32447221/) (which improved survival and cognition via Nrf2-dependent signaling). Additional agents improving cognition in other disease states include [Babao Dan](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33383371/) <sup>⬖</sup> for minimal hepatic encephalopathy, [hesperidin <sup>⬖</sup>](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27677544/) for hyperhomocysteinemia and [curcumin](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1567576921000588) <sup>⬖</sup> for cerebral hypoperfusion combined with diabetes.
content.cn: 脓毒症相关脑病对以下药物有反应：HIF-1α抑制剂（可改善认知功能并减少自噬）、白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可激活SIRT1，减少海马区细胞凋亡和小胶质细胞活化）、ROCK抑制剂（可减轻脑损伤和炎症，并改善空间记忆），以及分子氢（可通过Nrf2依赖性信号通路提高生存率和改善认知功能）。 在其他疾病状态下可改善认知功能的其他药物还包括：用于轻度肝性脑病的八宝丹 <sup>⬖</sup> 、用于高同型半胱氨酸血症的橙皮苷 <sup>⬖</sup> ，以及用于合并糖尿病的脑灌注不足的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 。

content.en: **Epilepsy-related cognitive impairment** was improved by rolipram (a PDE4 inhibitor that rescued spatial learning, hippocampal long-term potentiation, and phosphorylated CREB after status epilepticus),<sup data-ref="385">385</sup>, <sup data-ref="386">386</sup>, <sup data-ref="387">387</sup> [an eEF2K inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxm46-xEZ77Abx9YmBdVN7ep3S2jOGYbRGzvSKo19P7jPLYiMjMpTLptCDPpxsYjJXxKN7-AiUOGx37QRoTddupD1BpoZ9tU6X8ADq222tGO8O98OvNjo9rkH8olLSG7XqFqjS_WpLfxGFtooqIXSEJItVs7Qkxzr6eJRoM4sehcM2ljxMLxzqr3JREEzT1iJa8=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which restored AMPKα1 expression and improved cognition and social behavior in chronic epileptic mice), [semaglutide](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUq89ps5qxiMmMaIXHAngOoOhmf0S9LMavhQj6AOJlHs7sisyp_t41CiGVa8MCjfOOnbnLK4Fm_k1hYAEiixc3MBldu-0LARp1ylJ28jb4rz8YKoNNu3tcXi8ZtgxRQ-0Uhg5Cqd-APXYoTROoqohzGKYy3Kskz4D3UMYK7Qwpi5e09yP9tRcd88LblikP3y7Ig=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which improved cognitive function and protected hippocampal neurons via SIRT-1/NLRP3), and [perampanel](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bbrc.2021.12.038) (which improved spatial learning and reduced hippocampal damage in immature mice with temporal lobe epilepsy).
content.cn: 罗利普兰（一种PDE4抑制剂，可在癫痫持续状态后恢复空间学习能力、海马长时程增强以及磷酸化CREB）改善了癫痫相关的认知障碍， <sup data-ref="385">385</sup> <sup data-ref="386">386</sup> <sup data-ref="387">387</sup> eEF2K抑制剂（该药物恢复了慢性癫痫小鼠的AMPKα1表达，并改善了其认知和社交行为）、司美格鲁肽（该药物通过SIRT-1/NLRP3通路改善了认知功能并保护了海马神经元）以及佩兰帕奈 （可改善颞叶癫痫未成熟小鼠的空间学习能力并减轻海马损伤）。

content.en: **Neuropathic pain** frequently impairs cognition, and this was reversed by [an α5-GABAAR inverse agonist](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=edlgIlFUcgtmDyHfSnywMNH-QpidZsRb5xu8SpYj8qWhtdArZJu-onAQesuATcdRj3Q0Hr9D4tQ1MedVdhNLKwMAem-YboK7Bwjq9hRrHsC8zmpcTGEOMnHKNGXZ4H1DT3B9QIbHARcsvPyJwW4C8KVxi2N8N0JSWHIZs50cHIsgPToPusaTVw==&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which restored GABAergic signaling and improved recognition and spatial memory in sciatic nerve injury rats), [SAHA](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2017&filename=1017014887.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=724LOx4pNZxZieq7PEbOSUe7HGsjRa14YTIxR2ScQJo51EQPIaLJKnr6iQmOGkWZ) (which improved spatial learning in bone cancer pain rats), and [curcumin](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.2147/JPR.S299604) <sup>⬖</sup> (which enhanced hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity). [Rutin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30972687/) <sup>⬖</sup> also protected against cadmium-induced cognitive impairment by restoring antioxidant balance.
content.cn: 神经病理性疼痛常会损害认知功能，而α5-GABAAR反向激动剂（该药物可恢复GABA能信号传导，并改善坐骨神经损伤大鼠的识别能力和空间记忆）、SAHA（该药物可改善骨癌疼痛大鼠的空间学习能力）以及姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> （该物质可增强海马区神经发生和突触可塑性）均能逆转这一影响。 芦丁 <sup>⬖</sup> 也能通过恢复抗氧化平衡，预防镉诱导的认知功能障碍。

content.en: **Neonatal brain injury** from hypoxia-ischemia was treated with [coumestrol](https://lume.ufrgs.br/bitstream/handle/10183/210155/001094548.pdf?sequence=1) <sup>⬖</sup> (which partially reversed cognitive deficits, tissue loss, and reactive astrogliosis), [C2-ceramide](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/11149666/) (which reduced neonatal hypoxic-ischemic brain damage by 45–65%) and recombinant human [chemerin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2019&filename=1018863685.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=h_P4WWClu3sJonGMRzdyBAMtqxoWmTZndwz8KGH5eZlyzAaOXh9qlhsyoB2dxyPk) (which improved both short-term neurological function and long-term cognitive outcomes via the ChemR23/CAMKK2/AMPK/Nrf2 pathway). [Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1018807376.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=dtkTSVxcwcjbjI_LqV77XbrnFkAqAU3_iMXGiPHEXwXdoaUI2a87xCnjGsBspgc0) combined with BDNF/TrkB signaling similarly improved spatial learning in rats with prenatal stress-induced cognitive deficits.
content.cn: 针对缺氧-缺血引起的新生儿脑损伤，采用库美斯特罗 <sup>⬖</sup> （该药物部分逆转了认知缺陷、组织缺损和反应性星形胶质细胞增生）进行治疗， C2-神经酰胺（可将新生儿缺氧-缺血性脑损伤减少45%–65%）以及重组人切梅林（通过ChemR23/CAMKK2/AMPK/Nrf2通路同时改善了短期神经功能和长期认知预后）。 重复经颅磁刺激结合 BDNF/TrkB 信号传导，同样改善了因产前应激导致认知缺陷的大鼠的空间学习能力。

content.en: **Oxidative stress and neuroprotection** were addressed by [ferrostatin-1 and a caspase inhibitor](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36493877/) (which improved cognitive function and preserved synaptic proteins in iron-overloaded rats), and by [glutamate receptor antagonists](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Mario-Valentino/publication/372316068_Targeting_Ionotropic_Glutamate_Receptors_in_Models_of_Focal_Cerebral_Ischemia/links/64afb1f995bbbe0c6e2f9454/Targeting-Ionotropic-Glutamate-Receptors-in-Models-of-Focal-Cerebral-Ischemia.pdf) (which protected white matter and myelin ultrastructure in a focal ischemia model relevant to vascular cognitive decline).
content.cn: 铁氟素-1和一种半胱天冬酶抑制剂（可改善铁过载大鼠的认知功能并保护其突触蛋白）以及谷氨酸受体拮抗剂（在与血管性认知衰退相关的局灶性缺血模型中，可保护白质和髓鞘的超微结构）均对氧化应激和神经保护起到了作用。

content.en: Agents addressing **psychiatric-related cognitive impairment** include [a CB1R antagonist](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVCHB6uXUyfIVnrhdzrrAZFND9EXHGSQ8FF9PMoLKNeQ3T_wb_s1yrrAOhZHR7bbLuoOtNDy9OOGvUY9XVeXjQi_I9fO62uoNxw7RbP5CBy3f_A4RoI1o_rDg_OIxdMkK1kPv9tQzcRli1i8yMI8iE5l24Pa1LQmI72LRqK3JtvoO5bLhrMLxnjn4vnnt625Hq8=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which rescued electroconvulsive shock-induced memory deficits without affecting antidepressant efficacy), [fisetin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3teq8U6X9iMqPhj3cprQEnmn7zYhUcH35vKY5-0J5klX-mYyn1ZP1LHCZl2ONJ9dZBzCz7BPk-bTtJ9Fb2eo97zwi5keat_QX01WvWghwvvBSMnxieLqsnOptrjYjrg8nMSwcdZE41GVmngKeRa2_i1komT5ER8HeUc-Y7sNOYW5_8kDzZdDzkXJYT-vE9fqlgc=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reversed MK-801-induced cognitive impairment in a schizophrenia model by restoring ERK/CREB/CaMKII), and [7,8-dihydroxyflavone](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=YYDB201710017&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=joW03jagp2a3kXWpSPBxNSwqJ7DNFQh7c7UyvUg_oGRTec5KS5MN7cidVHwoTgcM) <sup>⬖</sup> (which improved spatial cognition and restored hippocampal dendritic spines in a schizophrenia model).
content.cn: 用于治疗精神病相关认知障碍的药物包括一种CB1R拮抗剂（该药物在不影响抗抑郁疗效的情况下，逆转了电休克引起的记忆缺陷）、槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过恢复ERK/CREB/CaMKII通路，逆转了精神分裂症模型中MK-801诱导的认知功能障碍），以及7,8-二羟基黄酮 <sup>⬖</sup> （在精神分裂症模型中改善了空间认知能力并恢复了海马区树突棘）。

content.en: Additional agents improving cognition across various models include [a complement C3a receptor antagonist](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdWo4VPqSdYKVAv_L4OMhDhlVTrUelmz0Uk5a3I86AR0KmYHPUBbiCHe3UoHiBCMgu_rojgoDVrhEhTwA1_Y0_a6JNVSjj7hmBgF743CaHyLnOsAImatV_Y4aiIaxZR-b7Jhe82sEl7eBmhecPQpVMSYNuRugLImQ5-2Me1FopgFj4Zty3AM1TYFo2lctfoWm0=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (LPS-induced cognitive dysfunction), [a GPER agonist](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0006291X16320125) (traumatic brain injury), [novel PDE4 inhibitors roflupram and chlorbipram](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201401&filename=1014100773.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=vy8y4dYXTlYZEXuUE-2edV1Fbli5o0V6UNnWdfirCx-09xIA0hxEvmJIgXyxeFOt) (which reversed scopolamine-induced cognitive deficits without the emetic side effects of existing PDE4 inhibitors), and [pregnenolone](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=SJJP201502019&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=M7zr0imrQo-Je8Lc74lL5pHe3wbuXh4qaqK0Q5CVClimREH-u4OEObAo3dZBwzXp) <sup>⬖</sup> (which improved spatial learning and upregulated choline acetyltransferase in aged rats). [Sonchus asper](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3527136/pdf/1744-9081-8-21.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> and [Launaea](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23151029/) <sup>⬖</sup> [procumbens](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23151029/) extracts each improved cognition and brain antioxidant status (with Sonchus asper <sup>⬖</sup> also inhibiting acetylcholinesterase), while [7,8-dihydroxyflavone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40935120/) <sup>⬖</sup> enhanced response learning via TrkB receptor phosphorylation and [epigallocatechin gallate](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38097001/) <sup>⬖</sup> reversed high-fat diet and rapamycin-induced cognitive impairment while improving serotonin and acetylcholinesterase activity.
