content.cn: 在各种模型中改善认知功能的其他药物还包括：补体C3a受体拮抗剂（LPS诱导的认知功能障碍）、GPER激动剂（创伤性脑损伤）、新型PDE4抑制剂罗氟普兰和氯比普兰（它们能够逆转东莨菪碱诱导的认知缺陷，且不具有现有PDE4抑制剂的催吐副作用），以及孕烯醇酮 <sup>⬖</sup> （可改善老年大鼠的空间学习能力并上调胆碱乙酰转移酶水平）。刺蓟（Sonchus asper） <sup>⬖</sup> 和匍匐劳纳草（Launaea procumbens） <sup>⬖</sup> 提取物均能改善认知功能和脑部抗氧化状态（其中刺蓟 <sup>⬖</sup> 还可抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶）， 而7,8-二羟基黄酮 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过TrkB受体磷酸化增强了反应性学习，表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯 <sup>⬖</sup> 则在改善5-羟色胺和乙酰胆碱酯酶活性的同时，逆转了高脂饮食和雷帕霉素诱导的认知障碍。

content.en: Human Studies
content.cn: 人类学

content.en: These findings have been replicated in humans. A study evaluated 104 elderly adults with organic brain disease due to cerebrovascular diseases (e.g., a previous stroke, cerebral embolism, or hardening of the arteries of the brain), a previous head injury, senility, or degenerative disease (e.g., Parkinson’s, hyperthyroidism, or epilepsy). They received two DMSO mixes, Merinex (DMSO with amino acids <sup>⬖</sup>) and Ipran (DMSO with vasoactive substances), typically alternating between the two, and for the majority of the time as an injection, and a minority of the time orally (with the fastest results occurring if both routes were used simultaneously), all of which resulted in remarkable improvements.<sup data-ref="388">388</sup>, <sup data-ref="389">389</sup> To quote the author:
content.cn: 这些研究结果已在人类身上得到验证。一项研究评估了104名患有器质性脑病的老年患者，其病因包括脑血管疾病（例如既往中风、脑栓塞或脑动脉硬化）、既往头部外伤、老年痴呆或退行性疾病（例如帕金森病、甲状腺功能亢进或癫痫）。 受试者接受了两种二甲基亚砜（DMSO）混合制剂——Merinex（含氨基酸的DMSO <sup>⬖</sup> ）和Ipran（含血管活性物质的DMSO）——通常交替使用这两种制剂，大部分时间采用注射给药，少数情况下口服（若同时采用两种给药途径，效果最为显著），所有治疗均取得了显著改善。 <sup data-ref="388">388</sup> <sup data-ref="389">389</sup> 引用作者的话：

content.en: The DMSO aminoacid therapy is undoubtedly valuable in the treatment of numerous organic cerebral diseases. At the same time, thanks to the improved cerebral blood irrigation achieved by DMSO used in combination with vasoactive substances, a highly favorable effect on the psychic and somatic functions of senile patients was achieved.
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）氨基酸疗法在治疗多种器质性脑部疾病方面无疑具有重要价值。与此同时，由于二甲基亚砜与血管活性物质联合使用能改善脑部血液灌注，因此对老年患者的心理和躯体功能产生了非常积极的影响。

content.en: *Note: another study found Merinex also treated patients with mood and anxiety disorders.<sup data-ref="390">390</sup>, <sup data-ref="389">389</sup>
content.cn: 注：另一项研究发现，Merinex 还用于治疗患有情绪障碍和焦虑障碍的患者。 <sup data-ref="390">390</sup> <sup data-ref="389">389</sup>*

content.en: A Chilean study evaluated 100 patients with cerebrovascular diseases (e.g., a previous stroke, cerebral embolism, or hardening of the arteries of the brain), many of whom were senile, who received DMSO orally and through intramuscular injections over the course of 50 days. It was noted that their coronary heart disease and high blood pressure had a good improvement in 74.35% of DMSO recipients, a fair response in 21.77%, and no response for 3.88%.<sup data-ref="391">391</sup>,*<sup data-ref="389">389</sup>* The neurologists overseeing these patients remarked that:
content.cn: 一项智利研究对100名脑血管疾病患者（例如既往中风、脑栓塞或脑动脉硬化）进行了评估，其中许多患者为老年患者，他们在50天内通过口服和肌肉注射的方式接受了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗。 研究发现，在接受二甲基亚砜治疗的患者中，74.35%的冠心病和高血压症状明显改善，21.77%的患者症状有所缓解，3.88%的患者未见改善。 <sup data-ref="391">391</sup>, <sup data-ref="389">389</sup> 负责监护这些患者的神经科医生指出：

content.en: “Recovery from the general symptoms was positive; there were favorable changes which were reflected in a feeling of well being, the recovery of agility, changes of mood from depressed to gay \[cheerful\], improvement of sleeping, and clearer speech. As regards the ‘focal’ results, accelerated recovery from hemiplegia and hemiparesia was registered. A speedier recovery of speech in cases of defined or indicated aphasia took place.”
content.cn: “一般症状的恢复情况良好；出现了积极的变化，具体表现为身体状况良好、活动能力恢复、情绪从抑郁转为开朗\[愉快\]、睡眠质量改善以及言语更加清晰。就‘局灶性’疗效而言，观察到偏瘫和偏瘫后遗症的恢复速度加快。在确诊或疑似失语症的病例中，言语功能恢复得更快。”

content.en: Additionally, [in 127 elderly patients](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/effektivnost-elektroforeza-s-neyromidinom-v-lechenii-bolnyh-s-tserebrovaskulyarnymi-narusheniyami-v-pozhilom-vozraste) (aged 75–85) with cerebrovascular disorders, bitemporal ionophoresis with Neuromidin in a DMSO solution resulted in clinical improvement by the 5th procedure in 86%, including normalized sleep, reduced dizziness, improved memory and hearing, and decreased cognitive disorders (versus delayed improvement in controls receiving standard therapy alone). In another study of 250 patients with cerebral vascular pathology, DMSO plus vinpocetine via cervical-collar zone ionophoresis stabilized brain blood flow parameters and improved blood supply to the large cerebral arteries.<sup data-ref="392">392</sup>, <sup data-ref="393">393</sup> Likewise, a [Russian geriatrics physiotherapy monograph](https://fiziosfera.ru/userfiles/modules/FilesInProduct/files/%D0%9A%D0%BB%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B8%D1%87%D0%B5%D1%81%D0%BA%D0%B0%D1%8F%20%D1%84%D0%B8%D0%B7%D0%B8%D0%BE%D1%82%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%BF%D0%B8%D1%8F%20%D0%B2%20%D0%B3%D0%B5%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B0%D1%82%D1%80%D0%B8%D0%B8_3949.pdf) recommended DMSO in transcranial ionophoresis protocols for discirculatory encephalopathy (chronic cerebral ischemia), including 50% DMSO solutions with aspirin. [In a clinical study](http://www.irbis-nbuv.gov.ua/cgi-bin/irbis_nbuv/cgiirbis_64.exe?I21DBN=LINK&P21DBN=UJRN&Z21ID=&S21REF=10&S21CNR=20&S21STN=1&S21FMT=ASP_meta&C21COM=S&2_S21P03=FILA=&2_S21STR=bumv_2019_23_1_5) of 154 patients undergoing open revascularization for acute lower limb ischemia, intravenous DMSO (10 mg/kg) administered before reperfusion as part of a comprehensive prevention protocol resulted in reduced reperfusion injury markers, fewer renal dysfunction cases, less cardiopulmonary worsening, and milder cognitive issues compared to standard care.
content.cn: 此外，在一项针对127名患有脑血管疾病的老年患者（年龄75–85岁）的研究中，采用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶液中的神经米丁（Neuromidin）进行双侧颞部离子导入治疗后，86%的患者在第5次治疗时即出现临床改善，表现为睡眠恢复正常、眩晕减轻、记忆力和听力改善以及认知障碍减轻（相比之下，仅接受标准治疗的对照组改善较迟）。 在另一项针对250名脑血管病理患者的研究中，通过颈部-领区离子导入法将二甲基亚砜与文波西汀联合使用，稳定了脑血流参数，并改善了大脑主要动脉的血液供应。 <sup data-ref="392">392</sup> <sup data-ref="393">393</sup> 同样，俄罗斯老年物理治疗专著建议在经颅离子导入疗法方案中使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗循环性脑病（慢性脑缺血），包括与阿司匹林联合使用的50%二甲基亚砜溶液。 在一项针对154例因急性下肢缺血接受开放性再血管化手术的患者的临床研究中，作为综合预防方案的一部分，在再灌注前静脉注射二甲基亚砜（10 mg/kg），与标准治疗相比，该方案显著降低了再灌注损伤标志物水平，减少了肾功能障碍病例，减轻了心肺功能恶化程度，并使认知问题表现得更为轻微。

content.en: *Note: [at a Russian military sanatorium](https://innoscience.ru/2307-9266/article/view/111337) treating victims of terrorist attacks and other emergencies, 25% DMSO was among the most frequently used agents for neurological injuries (primarily spinal pain and cerebrovascular disease), most commonly as part of a 21-day ionophoresis rehabilitation course (that was noted to effectively resolve pain).
content.cn: 注：在一家专门收治恐怖袭击及其他突发事件受害者的俄罗斯军事疗养院中，25%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是治疗神经系统损伤（主要是脊柱疼痛和脑血管疾病）最常用的药物之一，通常作为为期21天的离子导入疗法康复疗程的一部分（据观察，该疗法能有效缓解疼痛）。*

content.en: DMSO alone is generally thought to have a minimal impact here (e.g., one paper stated “ *[In all experiments, dimethyl sulfoxide](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S016643280700486X) (DMSO) was used as vehicle, since it has no significant effect on passive avoidance learning and memory* ”) so a variety of studies exist where DMSO facilitated another agent improving memory.
content.cn: 一般认为，仅使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在此方面的影响微乎其微（例如，有篇论文指出：“在所有实验中，均使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）作为溶剂，因为它对被动回避学习与记忆没有显著影响”），因此存在大量研究表明，DMSO能促进其他药物改善记忆。

content.en: Studies which have combined a therapeutic agent with DMSO to enhance learning and memory are as follows:
content.cn: 以下是将治疗药物与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用以增强学习和记忆能力的研究：

content.en: In three different rat studies, pemoline (Pm) or magnesium pemoline (MgPm) was dissolved in DMSO to influence memory and learning. In one, where rats were evaluated on how many trials it took them to learn a complex maze, compared to a saline baseline, the following reductions were observed: **DMSO alone** (11.1%), Pm (25.3%), low dose MgPm (32.5%), high dose MgPm (44.6%)—whereas amphetamine worsened learning by 14.5%.<sup data-ref="409">409</sup>, <sup data-ref="410">410</sup> In [a second study](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00404222), MgPm (both low and high dose) dissolved in DMSO completely prevented retrograde amnesia induced by electroconvulsive shock (ECS). Lastly, [a third study](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.2466/pr0.1971.28.1.71) found these agents did not improve reversal learning (the ability to cognitively update an ingrained habit when the reward rule changes).
content.cn: 在三项针对大鼠的不同研究中，将培莫林（Pm）或镁培莫林（MgPm）溶解于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中，以影响大鼠的记忆和学习能力。其中一项研究评估了大鼠掌握复杂迷宫所需试验次数，并与生理盐水基线组相比，观察到以下改善：仅用DMSO组（11.1%）、 Pm（25.3%）、低剂量MgPm（32.5%）、高剂量MgPm（44.6%）——而安非他明则使学习能力下降了14.5%。 <sup data-ref="409">409</sup> <sup data-ref="410">410</sup> 在第二项研究中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的MgPm（无论低剂量还是高剂量）完全预防了电休克（ECS）诱发的逆行性遗忘。最后，第三项研究发现，这些药物并未改善逆转学习（即当奖励规则发生变化时，认知上更新固有习惯的能力）。

content.en: *Note: [DMSO was also shown](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6058689/) to increase transport of pemoline into the brain.
content.cn: 注：研究还表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也能促进培莫林向大脑的转运。*

content.en: Additional agents enhancing learning or memory in otherwise healthy or aged animals include [pregnenolone](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=SJJP201502019&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=M7zr0imrQo-Je8Lc74lL5pHe3wbuXh4qaqK0Q5CVClimREH-u4OEObAo3dZBwzXp) <sup>⬖</sup> (which improved spatial learning and upregulated choline acetyltransferase in aged rats), [capsaicin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28112976/) <sup>⬖</sup> (which improved acquisition and retention and mitigated a CB1/CB2 agonist's negative effects on learning), [rapamycin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3teMOsqq3G67VquBOYCGK_WVqiO28_BQKK6YaFOIMzq_SP4hUQ3erN8mxxTgLuByrhtGckbtVIiNDKFUfdtXqQH8NEvFRmdEuCe4WSLZGucL9P1F0duruMJ_sfWblyxsB-Tu1lst-y73oh-O1xoChNHkS-uTXAfri_biQp_AUbiNA-kE9ESHTgmGaC6cRo90uUM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which improved novel object recognition and spatial working memory in middle-aged mice while protecting hippocampal neurons), testosterone (which nearly doubled hippocampal dendritic spine density via ERK/MAPK signaling and restored spatial memory in gonadectomized rats),<sup data-ref="411">411</sup>, <sup data-ref="412">412</sup> [nandrolone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31499080/) (which improved spatial learning and long-term potentiation in adolescent rats), and intracerebroventricular [DHEA](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2968827/) <sup>⬖</sup> (which enhanced memory retention and prevented amnesia). [Datumetine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37346877/) modulated hippocampal and prefrontal NMDA receptor signaling, upregulating CREB phosphorylation and BDNF expression, while [sumac extract](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20183390978) <sup>⬖</sup> enhanced passive avoidance learning and memory retention. [In C. elegans](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36422268/), a mitochondrial uncoupler preserved mechanosensory neurons, short-term memory, and extended lifespan. [Aniracetam and 1-BCP](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00213-007-1013-7) reversed pyrilamine-induced working memory deficits and restored hippocampal theta power.
content.cn: 其他可增强健康或老年动物学习或记忆能力的药物包括孕烯醇酮 <sup>⬖</sup> （该物质可改善老年大鼠的空间学习能力并上调胆碱乙酰转移酶的表达）、辣椒素 <sup>⬖</sup> （可改善学习内容的习得与保持，并减轻CB1/CB2激动剂对学习的负面影响）、雷帕霉素（可在保护海马神经元的同时，改善中老年小鼠的新物体重认能力和空间工作记忆）、睾酮（通过ERK/MAPK信号通路将海马树突棘密度提高近一倍，并恢复了去性腺大鼠的空间记忆）， <sup data-ref="411">411</sup> <sup data-ref="412">412</sup> 诺龙（可改善青春期大鼠的空间学习和长时程增强），以及脑室注射DHEA <sup>⬖</sup> （可增强记忆保持并预防健忘）。 达图美汀调节了海马体和前额叶的NMDA受体信号传导，上调了CREB磷酸化和BDNF表达，而漆树提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 则增强了被动回避学习和记忆保留能力。在秀丽隐杆线虫中，一种线粒体解偶联剂保护了机械感觉神经元，维持了短期记忆，并延长了寿命。阿尼拉西坦和1-BCP逆转了吡啶胺诱导的工作记忆缺陷，并恢复了海马体的θ波功率。

content.en: These therapeutic agents (in DMSO) showed strong protective effects against memory impairment across a variety of injury models. Following strokes, [4-methylumbelliferone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41355840/) reduced infarct volume and improved learning and memory by downregulating HAS1/HAS2, modulating inflammatory cytokines, and reducing oxidative stress. In aged rats, [pioglitazone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36541251/) improved learning and memory by reducing oxidative stress and increasing antioxidant enzymes in the hippocampus and cortex. In Alzheimer’s disease model rats, oral [quercetin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017110557.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=0XQWBU4WM8vBFCCEiCFzskDskYSGaR1tCT38J0iiU0P-bst4P024FQC3AUzWiElI) <sup>⬖</sup> significantly improved spatial learning and memory while lessening hippocampal oxidative stress and neuronal damage. [5-HT2A receptor agonists](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.06.25.661375v3.full.pdf) protected long-term memories from being disrupted by new memories formed shortly afterward. In ovariectomized rats modeling hormonal loss, [an ERβ agonist](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201801&filename=1017235782.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=2YVOlLnArHRlqwMsVTKhiIU7pr98MHcOhXDJVDDEyhTPfX6SE5ani7GpKtRrwfT0) reversed spatial learning and reference memory deficits along with impairments in dendritic spine density and synaptic structural integrity, while [estrogen supplementation](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201901&filename=1018858816.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=WVutL5SWkVIRXr3OES8R-oMfzXJbxwf6SiENeSTfbAKy7LPYnfpB565-Xq1HF_Do) partially restored spatial learning and significantly increased CD147 expression (a neuroprotective protein involved in synaptic function and amyloid-β clearance). Additional agents protecting against memory impairment include [Artemisia absinthium](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36698740/) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reversed scopolamine-induced deficits and counteracted oxidative stress), [a cannabinoid agonist](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0014299925003668) (which prevented scopolamine-induced spatial memory impairment), [a selective CB1 antagonist](https://lume.ufrgs.br/bitstream/handle/10183/52617/000532187.pdf?sequence=1) (which improved consolidation of aversive associative memory), and [7,8-dihydroxyflavone](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=XYXB201704034&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=tnap2APFUloeG1N95OmxsLZU4mU8YyHGEoVN9LoGYuplREadP3q7WSpdR1L8h5L4) <sup>⬖</sup> (which restored spatial learning in rats subjected to maternal separation stress).
content.cn: 这些治疗药物（溶于二甲基亚砜）在多种损伤模型中均表现出对记忆障碍的强效保护作用。中风后，4-甲基伞形花内酯通过下调HAS1/HAS2、调节炎性细胞因子以及减轻氧化应激，从而减少了梗死体积并改善了学习和记忆能力。 在老年大鼠中，吡格列酮通过降低氧化应激并增加海马体和皮层中的抗氧化酶活性，从而改善了学习和记忆能力。在阿尔茨海默病模型大鼠中，口服槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著改善了空间学习和记忆能力，同时减轻了海马体的氧化应激和神经元损伤。5-HT2A受体激动剂可保护长期记忆免受随后形成的新记忆的干扰。 在模拟激素缺失的卵巢切除大鼠中，ERβ激动剂逆转了空间学习和参照记忆缺陷，以及树突棘密度和突触结构完整性的损伤；而雌激素补充则部分恢复了空间学习能力，并显著增加了CD147的表达（一种参与突触功能和β-淀粉样蛋白清除的神经保护蛋白）。其他可预防记忆障碍的药物包括苦艾 <sup>⬖</sup> （可逆转东莨菪碱诱导的缺陷并对抗氧化应激）、一种大麻素激动剂（可预防东莨菪碱诱导的空间记忆障碍）、一种选择性CB1拮抗剂（可改善厌恶性联想记忆的巩固）以及7,8-二羟基黄酮 <sup>⬖</sup> （可恢复经历母体分离应激的大鼠的空间学习能力）。

content.en: *Note: in studies detailed in other parts of this article, memory and learning improvements were also demonstrated by agents combined with DMSO across a wide range of injury models — including chronic cerebral hypoperfusion ([fructose 1,6-diphosphate](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9473696/)* <sup>⬖</sup>*), chronic restraint and psychological stress ([necrostatin-1](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=JPXZ201805013&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Uq1DzUe4MQrkxpTD8p7TVfWOthYNKr-djFlYkp_9_XZFkfKxUPUr5MC0bFH-PrGr), [flupirtine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25869780/), and [retigabine](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1015593294.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=6VoQVXa0Z0UrHcH-s8JLeVARhylwDb6mZoM2EXXC5t211O6o-WcwpWTSiElPB0Xk)), sleep deprivation ([quercetin](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0006291X22013444)* <sup>⬖</sup> *and [almorexant](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDYS_stL9FUnEDTZSEyvOtQy3Vb9H9oCQerxl0ktH_CHSIeAwV1Ewm6LGxxfJVJ5Dq-la1bzpu4Z9ZgYDeB5HGbias9SuwmLYvRer_-7dcnuogUD-SZiZYHMqPffSIrvKWwjeGZ0gLFgSAl6Fyq8-h3CO29sE9DRqqqT7CG4AY4T7pRUtHw_MnmBEPorFTznO4=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN)), sepsis-associated encephalopathy ([an LRRK2 inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=iB5Z0i9DW_zYt_WU1cRRrea8RjQ_dV1S987Oxz6CRi5dCpEtRCCG8GDub8q6jeO4lMWrVQvh0inMadU3Nnz_WT_YKiV_OL0gwj-hE8_ApMt12xAoE5rcm7sR9DUbc9RTJeb5r_Em4qxyPVQpjq0CaTuFIT3cvgk3zv3KwbUeA8zI6Sy9wnTPM1RaQLuHmXM8&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN)), manganese neurotoxicity ([sodium para-aminosalicylate](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2020&filename=1020068752.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=rqNEvredLBN5z77PbZ95exp4nEcnVseE8ZTzzxf6EpG5oaL9ak2sxWGQeHH7EUMc)), anesthesia exposure during pregnancy ([suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=JLYB201708004&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=TIlpYNrbKHnIxlAWvr6SwpdwoZ4uR9hSsbQlBi5ANmpV-vbE3_RKy4y6oQeQs-qM)), hyperthyroidism ([AMPA and NMDA receptor agonists](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUoZLQjtbvVkMbBR6lB3oUjL4BBaK3IlYiBsIJY34WnpljpvFXiHMNy0DnBESoIlOA--74iiePZJ1m0QPSb51vY6vuSAm5KyjgRmf7HSHQydTX2uySflahTV4JC23btoxJlhKydsGimIj6K0G30w2Gd9aFiwO4H-iKE45cWnncnRj9xI4e-WSZyRzYYzUdNCCXM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN)), and NMDA-receptor blockade modeling glutamatergic dysfunction ([Ptychopetalum olacoides](https://lume.ufrgs.br/bitstream/handle/10183/53613/000628104.pdf?sequence=1)* <sup>⬖</sup>*) — collectively reinforcing that the cognitive benefits of DMSO-delivered therapies extend across virtually every category of neurological insult that impairs memory.*
content.cn: 注：在本文章其他部分详细介绍的研究中，与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物在多种损伤模型中也显示出对记忆和学习的改善作用——包括慢性脑灌注不足（果糖-1,6-二磷酸 <sup>⬖</sup> ）、 慢性束缚和心理应激（necrostatin-1、氟吡汀和雷替加滨）、睡眠剥夺（槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和阿莫雷桑）、脓毒症相关脑病（一种LRRK2抑制剂）、锰神经毒性（对氨基水杨酸钠）、妊娠期麻醉暴露（苏贝罗酰胺羟胺酸）、 甲状腺功能亢进（AMPA和NMDA受体激动剂），以及模拟谷氨酸能功能障碍的NMDA受体阻断（Ptychopetalum olacoides <sup>⬖</sup> ）——这些研究共同证实，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）递送疗法的认知益处几乎涵盖了所有导致记忆障碍的神经系统损伤类别。

content.en: Lastly, [in a study](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/stresskagakukenkyu/35/0/35_35.72/_pdf/-char/ja) showing that **impairing dural (meningeal) lymphatic drainage disrupts spatial working memory** and interhemispheric coherence, six weeks of daily DMSO injections had no adverse effects on memory.
content.cn: 最后，在一项表明阻断硬脑膜（脑膜）淋巴引流会干扰空间工作记忆和半球间一致性的研究中，连续六周每天注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）并未对记忆产生不良影响。

content.en: Movement Disorders
content.cn: 运动障碍

content.en: Movement disorders encompass conditions characterized by abnormal voluntary or involuntary movements — including tremors, ataxia (loss of coordination), dystonia, and muscle spasticity. Many arise from dysfunction in the cerebellum, basal ganglia, or their neural connections, areas particularly sensitive to the circulatory and inflammatory disruptions DMSO addresses (e.g., consider the previously mentioned Lurcher mice study where DMSO counteracted cerebellar damage). For example:
content.cn: 运动障碍是一类以异常的随意或不随意运动为特征的疾病，包括震颤、共济失调（协调能力丧失）、肌张力障碍和肌肉痉挛。 其中许多疾病源于小脑、基底节或其神经连接的功能障碍，这些区域对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）所针对的循环和炎症紊乱尤为敏感（例如，可参考前文提到的Lurcher小鼠研究，该研究表明DMSO能抵消小脑损伤）。例如：

content.en: [In a copper-deficient sheep model](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/19751439002), a single subcutaneous injection of DMSO combined with copper sulfate during mid-pregnancy completely prevented enzootic ataxia (swayback) in lambs (0% incidence vs. 60% in untreated controls), performing comparably to multiple oral copper doses and suggesting DMSO enhanced systemic copper delivery sufficiently to protect fetal neurological development. In veterinary case reports, [IV DMSO contributed to the recovery of a mare](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16627114/) with ataxia and cranial nerve deficits from temporohyoid osteoarthropathy (near-normal neurological status by discharge on day 5), while [in a foal with cerebellar abiotrophy](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39961496/), DMSO as part of a multi-agent regimen produced temporary neurological improvement before the animal relapsed due to the progressive nature of the underlying genetic condition. [In another horse](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17444936/), DMSO was used to manage vestibular disease and blindness that developed following a jugular catheter complication during anesthesia recovery.
content.cn: 在一项铜缺乏绵羊模型研究中，妊娠中期单次皮下注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合硫酸铜，完全预防了羔羊的地方性共济失调（弓背症）（发病率为0%，而未经治疗的对照组为60%），其效果与多次口服铜剂相当，这表明DMSO足以增强全身性铜的输送，从而保护胎儿的神经系统发育。 在兽医病例报告中，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有助于一匹因颞舌骨骨关节病导致共济失调和颅神经功能缺损的母马恢复健康（第5天出院时神经系统状况接近正常）；而在一匹患有小脑变性症的驹身上，作为多药治疗方案组成部分的DMSO虽使神经系统状况暂时改善，但因潜在遗传性疾病的进行性特征，该动物随后仍出现复发。 在另一匹马的病例中，二甲基亚砜被用于治疗因麻醉恢复期间颈静脉导管并发症而引发的前庭疾病和失明。

content.en: In rats, [a neurotensin antagonist](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12770567/) (in DMSO) attenuated neuroleptic-induced vacuous chewing movements (a model of tardive dyskinesia), supporting a role for neurotensin in its pathogenesis, [while abscisic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35591769/) <sup>⬖</sup> (in DMSO) improved harmaline-induced tremor and motor performance. Separately, microinjection of [a synthetic cannabinoid](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVBcss_qqAFWFjnPVvr1oKOml2kY_7Ee1QIDw7UTS4ssRXYQjMJtvSN-z40MHeTXrQEtTgiJu0qpMVZgsZ0kuLsNgW4h2xRUlAQJFcKJrgxeKH8VnrfAPhoDBYZ4fQcRIAPikGekgfCe2i_Y4Wk2o_Qcqm84cVyT4KkPwc6esoKdIL-NA9zWJFWA&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) into the globus pallidus enhanced motor behavior in rats.
content.cn: 在大鼠实验中，一种神经张力素拮抗剂（溶于二甲基亚砜）减轻了抗精神病药物诱发的空嚼运动（迟发性运动障碍的模型），这支持了神经张力素在该病发病机制中的作用；而脱落酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （溶于二甲基亚砜）则改善了哈马林诱发的震颤并提升了运动表现。 此外，将一种合成大麻素微量注射入苍白球后，大鼠的运动行为得到改善。

content.en: Reader reports suggest DMSO can benefit several movement disorders. [One reader with vaccine-induced Stiff Person Syndrome](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/128107017) reported that topical 100% DMSO was the only treatment that relieved constant muscle spasms — spanning the back, calves, feet, and chest — over 22 months of uncontrolled pain, noting “I have it with me at all times.” [A 74-year-old reader with essential tremors](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/187504916), multiple spinal and thoracic fractures, and advanced tendonitis credited “DMSO, and DMSO alone” with keeping them out of a wheelchair. Other readers reported improvements in [essential tremors](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/187504916), [neuropathic tremors](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/272683859) (where [an 80 year old regained the ability to write in a month](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/272683859)), in [tremors from vaccine injury](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/113177064) and [a neck tremor](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/74101927) that responded to topical DMSO.
content.cn: 读者反馈表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对多种运动障碍症有疗效。一位因疫苗接种而患上僵人综合征的读者报告称，外用100%二甲基亚砜是唯一能缓解其持续性肌肉痉挛（涉及背部、小腿、脚部和胸部）的治疗方法——此前长达22个月的疼痛始终无法控制——并指出：“我随时随身携带它。” 一位74岁的读者患有原发性震颤、多处脊柱和胸椎骨折以及晚期肌腱炎，他将自己能够避免坐轮椅归功于“二甲基亚砜，而且仅靠二甲基亚砜”。 其他读者报告称，原发性震颤、神经病理性震颤（其中一位80岁患者在一个月内恢复了书写能力）、疫苗损伤引起的震颤以及颈部震颤均有所改善，且这些症状对局部外用DMSO均有反应。

content.en: Several readers also reported that topical DMSO dramatically improved restless leg syndrome, in some cases allowing them to discontinue long-term medications they had taken for decades.
content.cn: 还有几位读者反映，外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）显著改善了他们的不宁腿综合征，有些患者甚至因此得以停用服用了几十年的长期药物。

content.en: Additionally, multiple dog owners reported that topical DMSO applied to the temples or behind the ears rapidly resolved vestibular episodes — stroke-like events characterized by disorientation, wobbly legs, and vomiting — with one describing recovery within an hour and continued preventive use whenever symptoms reappear, while another credited DMSO (along with grounding) with giving their elderly dog an extra year and a half of life.<sup data-ref="413">413</sup>, <sup data-ref="414">414</sup>
content.cn: 此外，多位狗主人反映，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）外敷于太阳穴或耳后，能迅速缓解前庭发作——这是一种类似中风的症状，表现为定向障碍、步态不稳和呕吐——其中一位主人描述说，爱犬在一小时内便恢复了健康，且每当症状再次出现时，他都会继续使用该方法进行预防；另一位主人则认为，正是二甲基亚砜（配合接地疗法）让他的老年犬多活了一年半。 <sup data-ref="413">413</sup> <sup data-ref="414">414</sup>

content.en: Seizures and Epilepsy
content.cn: 癫痫发作与癫痫

content.en: [I’ve been using DMSO](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/258084523) for a year now and I’m not going every three days to emergency with seizures and all sorts of other conditions linked to the COVID vaccine booster.
content.cn: 我使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已经一年了，现在不再像以前那样每三天就因癫痫发作以及与新冠疫苗加强针相关的各种其他症状而跑急诊了。

content.en: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent seizures (sudden bursts of abnormal electrical activity in the brain that can cause involuntary movements), altered consciousness, and in severe cases, prolonged seizures that cause permanent brain damage or death. DMSO’s ability to cross the blood-brain barrier, counteract oxidative stress, modulate ion channels, and suppress excitotoxic glutamate signaling suggest it could help epilepsy — though as detailed below, its effects are notably dose-dependent.
content.cn: 癫痫是一种神经系统疾病，其特征为反复发作的癫痫发作（大脑中突然出现的异常电活动，可能导致不自主运动）、意识障碍，以及在严重情况下，持续时间较长的癫痫发作会导致永久性脑损伤或死亡。 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有穿过血脑屏障、对抗氧化应激、调节离子通道以及抑制兴奋性谷氨酸信号传导的能力，这表明它可能有助于治疗癫痫——尽管如下文所述，其效果明显与剂量相关。
**Anti-Seizure Properties 抗癫痫特性**

content.en: Several studies have directly examined DMSO’s effects on seizure activity, revealing a consistent biphasic pattern: therapeutic doses suppress seizures while high doses can provoke them. [In rats](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S016502701100080X) genetically prone to epilepsy, low-dose DMSO (1.65 mg/kg) significantly decreased the number and total duration of spike-wave discharges, while high doses (825–1651 mg/kg) significantly increased them — with all effects being fully reversible (supported by the fact [higher concentrations of DMSO begin blocking GABA-induced chloride currents](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/030439409290459K)). Likewise [when 50% DMSO was injected](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S266724212500034X) into the brain’s ventricles (diluting to approximately 6% in the CSF), no seizure activity was generated over the next hour, whereas 75% and 100% did create a significant spike in mice hippocampal evoked potentials.
content.cn: 多项研究直接考察了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对癫痫发作的影响，结果显示出一致的双相模式：治疗剂量可抑制癫痫发作，而高剂量则可能诱发癫痫发作。 在具有癫痫遗传易感性的大鼠中，低剂量二甲基亚砜（1.65 mg/kg）显著减少了尖波-波形放电的次数和总持续时间，而高剂量（825–1651 mg/kg）则显著增加了这些指标——所有这些效应均完全可逆（这一结论得到了以下事实的支持：较高浓度的二甲基亚砜会开始阻断GABA诱导的氯离子电流）。 同样，当将50%的DMSO注入脑室（在脑脊液中稀释至约6%）时，随后一小时内未产生任何癫痫发作活动；而75%和100%浓度的DMSO则在小鼠海马区诱发电位中引发了显著的峰值。

content.en: [In a different temporal lobe epilepsy model](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S030439401300390X), high-dose DMSO (1651 mg/kg) produced significant anticonvulsant effects — prolonging seizure onset latency by 32%, shortening seizure duration by 34%, and reducing afterdischarge duration by 45% — effects the authors attributed to suppression of glutamatergic NMDA/AMPA-mediated calcium influx. [In mice with chronic temporal lobe epilepsy](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37797423/), only 100% DMSO (1651 mg/kg) reduced seizure number and cumulative duration (by 19–41% depending on sex), while lower concentrations had no effect — and notably, DMSO did not alter acute seizure threshold in non-epileptic mice, suggesting its anticonvulsant action is specific to the chronically epileptic brain. [Another study confirmed this pattern](http://umj.umsu.ac.ir/browse.php?a_id=5083&sid=1&slc_lang=en), finding 10% DMSO significantly reduced PTZ-induced epileptiform activity while 100% DMSO increased it. [DMSO also raised seizure thresholds](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/1557297/pdf/bripharmchem00013-0203.pdf) by approximately 9% against two different seizure-inducing agents and [prolonged the latency to convulsions](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1608912/) from hyperbaric oxygen exposure (thereby reducing seizures).
content.cn: 在另一种颞叶癫痫模型中，高剂量二甲基亚砜（DMSO，1651 mg/kg）产生了显著的抗惊厥作用——将癫痫发作起始潜伏期延长了32%，将癫痫发作持续时间缩短了34%，并将后放电持续时间减少了45%——作者将这些作用归因于对谷氨酸能NMDA/AMPA介导的钙离子内流的抑制。 在患有慢性颞叶癫痫的小鼠中，仅100%二甲基亚砜（1651 mg/kg）能减少癫痫发作次数和累计持续时间（根据性别不同，减少幅度为19%–41%），而较低浓度则无效果——值得注意的是，二甲基亚砜并未改变非癫痫小鼠的急性癫痫阈值，这表明其抗惊厥作用特异性地作用于慢性癫痫大脑。 另一项研究证实了这一模式：10%的DMSO显著降低了PTZ诱导的癫痫样活动，而100%的DMSO则使其增加。此外，针对两种不同的致痫剂，DMSO还使癫痫阈值提高了约9%，并延长了高压氧暴露后出现抽搐的潜伏期（从而减少了癫痫发作）。

content.en: In specific contexts, DMSO has shown targeted protective effects: [it partially prevented convulsions](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1023/B:NERE.0000042204.33161.9d) induced by 5-aminolevulinic acid (reducing their number and duration), likely through hydroxyl radical scavenging, and [pretreatment with DMSO](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0024320500007062) has been shown to prevent iron-induced epileptiform discharges, suggesting a potential role in preventing post-traumatic epilepsy.
content.cn: 在特定情况下，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）表现出针对性的保护作用：它能部分预防5-氨基乙醛酸诱发的抽搐（减少抽搐次数和持续时间），这很可能是通过清除羟基自由基实现的；此外，研究表明，预先使用DMSO可预防铁诱导的癫痫样放电，这表明其在预防创伤后癫痫方面可能发挥作用。

content.en: *Note: the biphasic dose response is an important consideration when using DMSO either therapeutically or as a research vehicle in epilepsy studies. Several studies have specifically documented proconvulsant effects: [DMSO prolonged cortical epileptic afterdischarges](https://www.biomed.cas.cz/physiolres/pdf/2013/62_S109.pdf) in immature rats (most pronounced in the youngest animals), [lowered tonic seizure thresholds in a PTZ model](https://nyaspubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1749-6632.1967.tb34886.x), and in one study, [even 0.1% DMSO accelerated PTZ kindling](https://journals.lww.com/iphr/fulltext/2018/50020/potentiation_of_pentylenetetrazole_induced.5.aspx) and potentiated hippocampal neuronal damage. [These findings](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0165027024002000) underscore the importance of dose selection and appropriate vehicle controls in epilepsy research (e.g., one reader found DMSO—which greatly helped her dog—appeared to also increase seizures until she changed the timing of it <sup data-ref="415">415</sup>).
content.cn: 注：无论是在癫痫治疗中使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO），还是将其作为癫痫研究中的研究载体，其双相剂量反应都是一个重要考量因素。 多项研究已专门记录了其促癫痫发作作用：二甲基亚砜（DMSO）延长了未成熟大鼠的皮层癫痫后放电（在最年轻的动物中表现最为明显），降低了PTZ模型中的强直性癫痫阈值；在一项研究中，甚至0.1%的DMSO也加速了PTZ诱发的癫痫起火并加剧了海马神经元损伤。 这些发现突显了在癫痫研究中选择合适剂量及采用适当溶剂对照的重要性（例如，一位读者发现，DMSO——虽然对她的狗帮助很大——似乎也会增加癫痫发作，直到她调整了给药时间后才有所改善 <sup data-ref="415">415</sup> ）。*

content.en: Additionally, DMSO’s ability to open the blood-brain barrier creates a dual-edged property: when excitatory amino acids (L-aspartate or L-glutamate) were administered peripherally in DMSO, they induced seizures they would not otherwise cause — which while a safety consideration, has proven useful for studying NMDA receptor involvement in seizure circuits and for demonstrating that the kindled amygdala plays a critical role in generalized seizure expression.<sup data-ref="416">416</sup>, <sup data-ref="417">417</sup>, <sup data-ref="418">418</sup>, <sup data-ref="419">419</sup>
content.cn: 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够打开血脑屏障，这一特性具有双面性：当在DMSO中经外周途径给药兴奋性氨基酸（L-天冬氨酸或L-谷氨酸）时，这些物质会诱发在正常情况下不会发生的癫痫发作——虽然这需要考虑安全性问题，但已被证明对于研究NMDA受体在癫痫回路中的作用，以及证明“点燃”的杏仁核在全身性癫痫发作中的关键作用具有重要价值。 <sup data-ref="416">416</sup> <sup data-ref="417">417</sup> <sup data-ref="418">418</sup> <sup data-ref="419">419</sup>
**Seizure Reduction 减少癫痫发作**

content.en: The most direct clinical evidence for DMSO reducing seizures comes from patients with Niemann-Pick disease type C (detailed earlier). [In NPC patients](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8577061/), oral DMSO decreased seizure frequency and improved EEG findings. Most notably, [in an 8-year-old girl](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1442-200X.1988.tb02544.x) with frequent seizures and severe psychomotor deterioration, two years of oral DMSO decreased seizure frequency enough to allow tapering of an anticonvulsant, produced marked EEG improvement (with normalization of theta waves and spindle morphology), and halted the progression of cortical atrophy.
content.cn: 关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可减少癫痫发作的最直接临床证据来自尼曼-皮克病C型患者（前文已有详细说明）。 在NPC患者中，口服二甲基亚砜可降低癫痫发作频率并改善脑电图（EEG）表现。最值得注意的是，一名患有频繁癫痫发作和严重精神运动功能退化的8岁女童，在口服二甲基亚砜两年后，癫痫发作频率显著降低，以至于可以逐步减少抗癫痫药物的用量；其脑电图出现明显改善（θ波和纺锤波形态恢复正常），并阻止了皮质萎缩的进展。

content.en: In veterinary medicine, IV DMSO has been used as part of multimodal seizure management. [In a horse](https://bvajournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1136/vetreccr-2015-000222) that developed seizures following surgery, IV 10% DMSO (1 g/kg twice daily for four days) — administered for its free radical scavenging and thromboxane-inhibiting properties to maintain cerebral blood supply — contributed to seizure cessation by day 3 and a satisfactory long-term outcome. [In a 2-day-old foal](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16627116/) with perinatal asphyxia presenting with seizures, cerebral edema, and acute renal failure, IV DMSO contributed to marked resolution of cerebral edema and complete neurological recovery by day 12. [In a 3-day-old foal](https://repository.unilasallista.edu.co/server/api/core/bitstreams/d812cc0a-b063-4c13-8960-d2bd18d1d539/content) with convulsions and ataxia secondary to electrolyte derangements from bladder rupture, IV DMSO was included in supportive care that resolved the neurological signs within days.
content.cn: 在兽医学中，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已被用作多模式癫痫治疗方案的一部分。在一例术后出现癫痫发作的马匹中，静脉注射10%二甲基亚砜（1克/千克，每日两次，连续四天）——该药物因其清除自由基和抑制血栓素的特性而被用于维持脑部血液供应——有助于在第3天停止癫痫发作，并取得了令人满意的长期预后。 在一例患有围产期窒息、表现为癫痫发作、脑水肿和急性肾衰竭的出生2天大的驹中，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）促使脑水肿显著消退，并于第12天实现了完全的神经系统恢复。在一例因膀胱破裂导致电解质紊乱而出现抽搐和共济失调的出生3天大的驹中，将静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）纳入支持性治疗方案，神经系统症状在数日内得到缓解。

content.en: Lastly, [as mentioned above](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jvma1951/54/2/54_2_119/_pdf/-char/ja), a dog which had seizures develop from hydrocephalus had those seizures improve from IV DMSO.
content.cn: 最后，如上所述，一只因脑积水而出现癫痫发作的狗，其癫痫症状在静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后有所改善。

content.en: **Combination Studies 联合研究**
A large number of agents combined with DMSO have demonstrated anticonvulsant or neuroprotective effects in seizure models.
content.cn: 大量与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物在癫痫模型中均表现出抗惊厥或神经保护作用。

content.en: Among those directly reducing seizure severity, [glibenclamide](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2021&filename=1017235000.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=tmshwUG78_6CvNj4J2WdF5ADDySo_hPPBCWZXoL3oFH-iKWqmh4-81MSB_L35JSR) produced the greatest effects: following status epilepticus, it significantly reduced brain edema, blood-brain barrier damage, and neuronal loss while more than doubling 28-day survival (47.8% vs. 22.2%). Resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> prolonged seizure latency, shortened seizure duration, reduced the brain injury marker S100B in cerebrospinal fluid and serum, protected hippocampal CA1 and CA3 neurons, and improved spatial learning and memory in PTZ-kindled rats.<sup data-ref="420">420</sup>, <sup data-ref="421">421</sup> [Resveratrol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2005&filename=DEJD20050400Y&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=e71b6sR40nf5Cj8LIx4z2meYUJHaEJUdkRNTN3x2J2ktcU2UL1qsKdSNxuBAPcpY) <sup>⬖</sup> also protected against hyperbaric oxygen-induced convulsions. [Quercetin](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4211749/) <sup>⬖</sup> (10–20 mg/kg) significantly prolonged seizure onset, reduced severity, and shortened generalized seizure duration in PTZ-induced seizures, though higher doses (40 mg/kg) lost efficacy and in a picrotoxin model paradoxically shortened seizure onset. The DMSO combination of palmitoylethanolamide (PEA) with the neurosteroid ganaxolone markedly amplified seizure suppression and eliminated mortality, whereas PEA alone showed no efficacy in that model (though it did exhibit anticonvulsant activity in kindled amygdaloid seizures).<sup data-ref="422">422</sup>, <sup data-ref="423">423</sup> [Montelukast](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25684626/) synergistically enhanced phenobarbital’s anticonvulsant effect (when both were dissolved in DMSO), lowering the effective dose while reducing phenobarbital-induced sedation. [Ruxolitinib](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39643584/) shortened seizure duration, lowered seizure frequency over 4 weeks, and improved memory. [A p38MAPK inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201702&filename=1017816616.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=qIjiiVEbeIN9UxOF2nagKOihGuHp_-q5dz6asYzb6ACjm2Dv5ozi6c_FCLCubLt-) prolonged seizure latency by 45% and halved seizure frequency. A 5-HT6 receptor antagonist reduced spontaneous recurrent seizure frequency, increased protective potassium channel (KCNQ2/3) expression, and in combination with ERK1/2 or Fyn inhibitors reversed the aberrant mossy fiber sprouting that perpetuates chronic epilepsy.<sup data-ref="424">424</sup>, <sup data-ref="425">425</sup> [Triptolide](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40878478/) <sup>⬖</sup> inhibited epilepsy in mice by improving hippocampal GABAergic inhibition and reducing IL-1β levels.
content.cn: 在直接减轻癫痫发作严重程度的药物中，格列本脲的效果最为显著：在癫痫持续状态后，它显著减轻了脑水肿、血脑屏障损伤和神经元丢失，同时将28天生存率提高了一倍多（47.8% 对比 22.2%）。 白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 延长了癫痫发作潜伏期，缩短了发作持续时间，降低了脑脊液和血清中脑损伤标志物 S100B 的水平，保护了海马 CA1 和 CA3 神经元，并改善了 PTZ 诱发癫痫大鼠的空间学习和记忆能力。 <sup data-ref="424">424</sup> <sup data-ref="425">425</sup> 白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 还能预防高压氧诱发的惊厥。 槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> （10–20 mg/kg）在PTZ诱导的癫痫发作中显著延长了发作起始时间、降低了发作严重程度并缩短了全身性癫痫发作持续时间，但较高剂量（40 mg/kg）则失去疗效；而在皮克罗毒素模型中，槲皮素反而缩短了发作起始时间。 棕榈酰乙醇胺（PEA）与神经类固醇加纳索酮的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）复方制剂显著增强了抗惊厥作用并消除了死亡率，而单独使用PEA在该模型中则未显示出疗效（尽管它在诱发性杏仁核惊厥中确实表现出抗惊厥活性）。 <sup data-ref="424">424</sup> <sup data-ref="425">425</sup> 蒙特卢卡斯特（Montelukast）与苯巴比妥（当两者均溶于二甲基亚砜时）呈现协同增强作用，既降低了有效剂量，又减轻了苯巴比妥引起的镇静作用。鲁索利替尼（Ruxolitinib）缩短了癫痫发作持续时间，在4周内降低了癫痫发作频率，并改善了记忆力。 一种p38MAPK抑制剂将癫痫发作潜伏期延长了45%，并将癫痫发作频率减半。 一种5-HT6受体拮抗剂可降低自发复发性癫痫发作频率，增加保护性钾通道（KCNQ2/3）的表达，并与ERK1/2或Fyn抑制剂联合使用时，能逆转导致慢性癫痫持续存在的苔藓纤维异常分支现象。 <sup data-ref="424">424</sup> <sup data-ref="425">425</sup> 三萜醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过增强海马区GABA能抑制作用并降低IL-1β水平，抑制了小鼠的癫痫。

content.en: [Carvedilol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20571219/) suppressed spontaneous seizure activity in hippocampal slices from Alzheimer’s model mice — a finding with implications for the seizure susceptibility frequently seen in that disease.
content.cn: 卡维地洛抑制了阿尔茨海默病模型小鼠海马切片中的自发癫痫活动——这一发现对该疾病中常见的癫痫易感性具有重要意义。

content.en: [In a high-throughput screening](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxmY0rjATubQAnUngIPa23xAupizxjFH8jPTiOvWQPXtGkRH5mdmUN2-6IZn4DBJZ1LXchFAF65dJld2SwWwHjaI29-WTFUR00BfKBY8dQ3mJFCm-lMtvSxUjlNgJ0GJgWZ-plsoQaeIDozFqhwMSFbD1Naxk0GpwP3RcVGZLBbJGS2UdXoCgmrW&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) of 343 essential oils using a PTZ-induced zebrafish epilepsy model, 52 demonstrated antiepileptic activity, with 15 (including patchouli <sup>⬖</sup> and cinnamon oils <sup>⬖</sup>) showing potency far exceeding that of phenytoin. [Maslinic acid](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVAi0F7SIi8WBxqA19s9ZQnpFY3YmtM3IE8pF4aIs9NwDFZCzTjP68-jRklvMz04pprAgCSyjlY-Nge4gnij97IqKf4RFObunET3eGlR6iKVcLovku72QpOeNAIXsJjvB63jOBZLUJb5xQy8H73zlcRu5QMCDNBMLichZr9eDAGWMhxeH1_4FeN0dfVde-zB_0k=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN),<sup>⬖</sup> identified through computational gene expression profiling, showed significant antiepileptic activity in the same model and selectively inhibited voltage-gated sodium channel subtypes Nav1.2 and Nav1.7.
content.cn: 在一项利用PTZ诱导的斑马鱼癫痫模型对343种精油进行的高通量筛选中，有52种表现出抗癫痫活性，其中15种（包括广藿香油 <sup>⬖</sup> 和肉桂油 <sup>⬖</sup> ）的效力远超苯妥英钠。 通过计算基因表达谱分析鉴定出的马斯林酸 <sup>⬖</sup> ，在同一模型中表现出显著的抗癫痫活性，并能选择性地抑制电压门控钠通道亚型Nav1.2和Nav1.7。

content.en: Many agents combined with DMSO also protected against the neuronal damage that follows status epilepticus. Mitochondrial division inhibitor 1 (Mdivi-1) repeatedly reduced neuronal apoptosis and oxidative stress across multiple studies, in some cases also increasing seizure latency, decreasing seizure frequency, and improving post-seizure cognition.<sup data-ref="426">426</sup>, <sup data-ref="427">427</sup>, <sup data-ref="428">428</sup>, <sup data-ref="429">429</sup>, <sup data-ref="430">430</sup> Recombinant human erythropoietin protected hippocampal neurons via PI3K/Akt anti-apoptotic signaling across multiple seizure models.<sup data-ref="431">431</sup>, <sup data-ref="432">432</sup> Ganoderic acid <sup>⬖</sup> reduced hippocampal damage through multiple pathways (caspase-3 reduction, CaSR/JNK/P38 modulation, and improved dendritic spine density and spatial memory).<sup data-ref="433">433</sup>, <sup data-ref="434">434</sup>, <sup data-ref="435">435</sup> [Salidroside](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDkILi8wej_B_rVVNcfZUha8jW0rpvKWLT7k2hI8RRvdgae-Rz_WQmjzaRkPqIen3F8hUo3wYL3O1fqObFwbzkozn13zTIG0qqyBLGUQWhKzNKilOEt5G6qLYPn4H9PQG4rQdhifgNt4S4X08zZG1VNya6Cw6leKMoEKf5teFNG8PyCLJOZ1ufx&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> dose-dependently increased seizure latency, enhanced antioxidant defenses, and reduced endoplasmic reticulum stress-mediated apoptosis. Gastrodin <sup>⬖</sup> reduced seizure severity, protected hippocampal neurons, enhanced GABAA receptor expression, and regulated post-status epilepticus autophagy.<sup data-ref="436">436</sup>, <sup data-ref="437">437</sup> [Rolipram](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=ZQYK201504021&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=foPsE7JGnwVjR2hjfMS6b_orYoUfU195OZEsca5FEkk1BEhTeKteOhHSsBWPFlP0) rescued cognitive deficits, hippocampal long-term potentiation, and CREB phosphorylation in immature rats following status epilepticus. [Curcumin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=hmNf6PfbaBvfsQeUNORiuzTDMbk4eRbf22rQ2J-6iEiwGVt85IXjaDi0yLY_R3aBMQq1s-L1l74hzlLOCBA5A4Oaxjwh9gwghWzhU206xml0SqIR7rt6KRiBwLCetyuU3bUVdN3eonsRQ2XtUQxgyeFg0ZSP2l-y0lvY-dWnw4TgAUy-sIs4KEf6UIVtFV1h&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> decreased aberrant mossy fiber sprouting through miR-134/LIMK1 modulation. [ERK1/2 and p38 MAPK inhibitors](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2017&filename=LCSJ201702018&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=JiWtkkLUSw3mkwlNgX4rQS71KgBpjCd6s4tEzdoNYRTj6DcSTyQHUHdhbPbgtc3S) reduced inflammatory markers, chemokine expression, and microglial activation in the hippocampus of immature rats with kainic acid-induced epilepsy.
content.cn: 许多与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物也能预防癫痫持续状态引发的神经元损伤。在多项研究中，线粒体分裂抑制剂1（Mdivi-1）多次被证实能减少神经元凋亡和氧化应激，在某些情况下还能延长癫痫发作潜伏期、降低癫痫发作频率，并改善发作后的认知功能。 <sup data-ref="436">436</sup> <sup data-ref="437">437</sup> <sup data-ref="435">435</sup> <sup data-ref="429">429</sup> <sup data-ref="430">430</sup> 在多种癫痫模型中，重组人促红细胞生成素通过PI3K/Akt抗凋亡信号通路保护海马神经元。 <sup data-ref="436">436</sup> <sup data-ref="437">437</sup> 灵芝酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过多种途径（降低半胱天冬酶-3 活性、调节 CaSR/JNK/P38 信号通路，以及提高树突棘密度和空间记忆能力）减轻了海马损伤。 <sup data-ref="436">436</sup> <sup data-ref="437">437</sup> <sup data-ref="435">435</sup> 萨利德罗苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 以剂量依赖性方式延长了癫痫发作潜伏期，增强了抗氧化防御能力，并减少了内质网应激介导的凋亡。 Gastrodin <sup>⬖</sup> 减轻了癫痫发作的严重程度，保护了海马神经元，增强了GABAA受体的表达，并调节了癫痫持续状态后的自噬。 <sup data-ref="436">436</sup> <sup data-ref="437">437</sup> Rolipram 挽救了癫痫持续状态后未成熟大鼠的认知缺陷、海马长时程增强以及CREB磷酸化。 姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过调节 miR-134/LIMK1 通路，减少了苔藓纤维的异常分支。ERK1/2 和 p38 MAPK 抑制剂降低了海马中由海葵酸诱导癫痫的未成熟大鼠的炎症标志物、趋化因子表达以及小胶质细胞活化。

content.en: Additional agents showing neuroprotective effects in status epilepticus models include [glycyrrhizic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32800785/) <sup>⬖</sup> (enhanced mitochondrial autophagy and antioxidant defenses in juvenile epilepsy rats), [glycyrrhizin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36633134/) <sup>⬖</sup> (reduced HMGB1/p38MAPK in the hippocampus), an [Omi/HtrA2 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2016&filename=ZFSJ201511001&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=PqIUR9-QRqqd4I3CrTR4_ICuerIwROAxO_wrWPnWTe2ZrwpfRrOckAgwb5I9Cf-w) (ucf-101; increased anti-apoptotic XIAP and HAX-1), [levetiracetam](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcsRAp6EJxu5mIjhbbcKfthj_GN46AMiQR_lluaim_plQ6UxDKn2SsLxkoZFPDOrRI4PWs8mCu1HkIdLWome25B3iyUiWy-D9EOmIdQu1ckpE0vQ7OMxiw7iQKlBQy3mwUg7pejyfSq-Ezz5bFuT-iE8BzS8zYm9bkffb_C26w3MQJdP5dRp5BMK&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (dose-dependently reduced oxidative stress and caspase-3 in epileptic offspring mice), [a caspase-12 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFD2011&filename=WZYX201105013&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=he7o0vNES9Zro5w9GG3swzLMWMPVgOkVtZMXHlDNM6wK-g68OsT3f7DxSzXFabIU), [olomoucine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17925171/) (a CDK inhibitor that reduced neuroinflammation and apoptosis), [2-methoxyestradiol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016131617.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=fnTnOSzpTltWLZEC0RbUorutuk3mWTtM-BNDGWbHT4yL-5q6e_cMmrf2UN_AilLQ) (via HIF-1α suppression), [a CaMKII inhibitor](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31074121/), [honokiol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40693886/),<sup>⬖</sup> [a hydrogen sulfide donor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3te0QF9Q-DcESMWEWn24ctDWnfPQK5KfSffKp33fNPBT7Vkpo9zcZJQ8O7-knxAhnquvwh1WjOkIVF8bbuCPGyfvivJqDD-YcYBgUaVj93teLimotZPTVmEBRuhXon8u0LRpf2fQ4HGLQiEpEbvDUK2o76xFYPwbdm1YAIW2C1YES_J5YT_m4yUB&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (via PI3K/Akt), [an IRAK1/4 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201401&filename=1014110278.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=E7egGCxXcKxEOMVtA8MfCZqi_6ROFpTqKGH4rKBdKtmy1CdkvP71tH5LfVBNrtzq), [an exosome inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUqIjtbQOwfrrQzjZZja2Kfxqx111GLYQv_HZGnnZFds4owRe9QR-0JMFeMyvS8o9wysTAfOUygMlwAEGuXv0bzBCxz3Hvy_vskc4hS107Fs9LDjGxl57l_j6uq0VTFjNY8723cilXAquMbNlLtM6wXiHQVU8zUaK2uWaxcioPxdTo6y0dSv_MjNoGbpQHObnTM=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which prolonged seizure latency by reducing BBB permeability changes), [an eEF2K inhibitor](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Mz9udXFtQxm46-xEZ77Abx9YmBdVN7ep3S2jOGYbRGzvSKo19P7jPLYiMjMpTLptCDPpxsYjJXxKN7-AiUOGx37QRoTddupD1BpoZ9tU6X8ADq222tGO8O98OvNjo9rkH8olLSG7XqFqjS_WpLfxGFtooqIXSEJItVs7Qkxzr6eJRoM4sehcM2ljxMLxzqr3JREEzT1iJa8=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) that restored AMPKα1 expression and improved mitochondrial function, cognition, and social behavior in chronic epileptic mice, and [a PARP-1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFD1214&filename=1013220461.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=_pajivowAynZna0MrDAsnmthLjMWe0qcDoALv_F3-QFVxY-dFUAlRq7y_NNtOvt6) (DPQ) that reduced neuronal apoptosis and activated the PI3K/Akt-SIRT1 survival pathway.
content.cn: 在癫痫持续状态模型中表现出神经保护作用的其他药物还包括甘草酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （可增强幼年癫痫大鼠线粒体自噬和抗氧化防御能力）、甘草次酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低海马区HMGB1/p38MAPK水平）、一种Omi/HtrA2抑制剂（ucf-101； 增加抗凋亡蛋白XIAP和HAX-1的表达）、左乙拉西坦（以剂量依赖性方式降低癫痫后代小鼠的氧化应激和caspase-3水平）、一种caspase-12抑制剂、奥洛莫辛（一种可减轻神经炎症和凋亡的CDK抑制剂）、2-甲氧基雌二醇（通过抑制HIF-1α发挥作用）、一种CaMKII抑制剂、矶木醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 一种硫化氢供体（通过PI3K/Akt途径起作用）、一种IRAK1/4抑制剂、一种外泌体抑制剂（通过降低血脑屏障通透性变化来延长癫痫发作潜伏期）、 一种eEF2K抑制剂（可恢复AMPKα1表达，并改善慢性癫痫小鼠的线粒体功能、认知能力及社交行为），以及一种PARP-1抑制剂（DPQ）（可减少神经元凋亡并激活PI3K/Akt-SIRT1生存通路）。

content.en: Interestingly, [GPER-1](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tdII4nZj5BedX4PQYvxGPYkOymjcwOt0yYDTeS24DeIg8PUFAK63h5cn5XAoa2PY20N2UBzCIGG1CVjhlp8-bq9kQLiE96I1u2xziPYr8DlJ_HjozevoUHv00U3DZ82AoEauGMIWuBNgOjEABB4Kb9wXjH0bqtv5sz9p_P6sCgnz0nvZrOGxSU7M8KBaP9g-2c=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (the G protein-coupled estrogen receptor) activation with G1 improved spatial learning, memory, and reduced mossy fiber sprouting in chronically epileptic rats, yet [the same receptor’s activation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26721354/) with G-1 or estradiol increased acute seizure susceptibility and nitric oxide levels in cortex and hippocampus during PTZ kindling — suggesting estrogen-mediated effects on epilepsy differ between acute seizure generation and chronic post-epileptic recovery.
content.cn: 有趣的是，在慢性癫痫大鼠中，通过G1激活GPER-1（G蛋白偶联雌激素受体）可改善空间学习与记忆能力，并减少苔藓纤维的萌发；然而，在PTZ诱发癫痫期间，通过G-1或雌二醇激活同一受体，则会增加急性癫痫发作的易感性，并升高皮层和海马区的一氧化氮水平——这表明雌激素对癫痫的影响在急性癫痫发作诱发阶段与慢性癫痫后恢复阶段存在差异。

content.en: Natural compounds demonstrating anticonvulsant effects in zebrafish or rodent models include [vitexin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39392022/) <sup>⬖</sup> (comparable to diazepam), [sesamin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37605727/) <sup>⬖</sup> (via PI3K/Akt), [onopordia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33511058/) <sup>⬖</sup> (via the nitric oxide/nNOS pathway), [linalool <sup>⬖</sup> and trans-nerolidol](https://lume.ufrgs.br/bitstream/handle/10183/269277/Resumo_81249.pdf?sequence=1) <sup>⬖</sup> (with nerolidol <sup>⬖</sup> showing superior efficacy), [the combination](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40289034/) of ursolic acid <sup>⬖</sup> with caprylic acid,<sup>⬖</sup> [Lippia sidoides extract](https://www.mdpi.com/2223-7747/13/21/3034) <sup>⬖</sup> (comparable to diazepam), [olive pit polyphenols](https://europepmc.org/article/med/25208788) <sup>⬖</sup> (which protected against kainic acid-induced neurotoxicity), [a tryptamine derivative of securinine](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=16655353) <sup>⬖</sup> (with antioxidant, chelating, and anticonvulsant properties), [ε-viniferin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3bpf4DWlZxrV0eK4htsfuOcZUA_KDdE7pFfDf5zXjxXxjB5QyKEx74_QPvxfUUnKbNiGOXTqvkdQz5mr2A4vioxucq8uuoZxLqXco3BBMovc65JRP1g526txhQErO1cTPxoJ0RYpV5AVO8vNwEisrMsysBTSir0WNLXj3S8vjEavS8K4J7WDuVMerfQQfUE56E=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which inhibited NLRC4 inflammasome activation in astrocytes), [thymoquinone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27094523/),<sup>⬖</sup> and [progabide](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9728521/) (which specifically suppressed the tonic phase of seizures). [Lamotrigine combined with anakinra](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=48459542) partially normalized psychoneurological disturbances (anxiety, locomotor activity, social behavior) in chronically epileptic rats, suggesting their combination addresses both seizure control and behavioral comorbidities.
content.cn: 在斑马鱼或啮齿类动物模型中表现出抗惊厥作用的天然化合物包括：维特辛 <sup>⬖</sup> （与地西泮相当）、芝麻素 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过PI3K/Akt通路）、奥诺波迪亚 <sup>⬖</sup> （通过一氧化氮/nNOS通路）、 芳樟醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 和反式-香叶醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （其中香叶醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 显示出更优的疗效）、熊果酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 与辛酸的组合、 <sup>⬖</sup> 侧翅香草提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （与地西泮相当）、 橄榄籽多酚 <sup>⬖</sup> （可预防海因酸诱导的神经毒性）、色氨胺衍生物塞库里宁 <sup>⬖</sup> （具有抗氧化、螯合及抗惊厥特性）、ε-维尼菲林 <sup>⬖</sup> （可抑制星形胶质细胞中NLRC4炎性小体的激活）、百里酚、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及普加比德（可特异性抑制癫痫发作的持续期）。拉莫三嗪与阿那金拉联合使用，可部分纠正慢性癫痫大鼠的心理神经功能紊乱（焦虑、运动活动、社交行为），表明该联合用药既能控制癫痫发作，又能改善行为共病。

content.en: [Rapamycin combined with pitolisant](https://repo.odmu.edu.ua/xmlui/bitstream/handle/123456789/16670/Pervak.pdf) markedly improved anxiety (2.7-fold on maze testing) and depression (37.5% improvement in swim testing) in PTZ-kindled epileptic rats, highlighting that DMSO-delivered agents can address the psychiatric comorbidities that frequently accompany epilepsy.
content.cn: 雷帕霉素与匹托利桑联合使用，显著改善了PTZ诱发癫痫大鼠的焦虑症状（迷宫测试中改善2.7倍）和抑郁症状（游泳测试中改善37.5%），这表明通过二甲基亚砜（DMSO）递送的药物能够治疗常伴随癫痫出现的精神疾病共病。

content.en: [In stimulant toxicity models](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2217500/), MK-801 dissolved in DMSO abolished EEG afterdischarges and seizures induced by cocaine, amphetamine, and methamphetamine — though notably, eliminating seizures did not prevent death from methamphetamine or cocaine, demonstrating that seizure-independent toxicity pathways drive stimulant lethality.
content.cn: 在兴奋剂毒性模型中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的MK-801消除了可卡因、安非他命和甲基安非他命诱导的脑电图后放电和癫痫发作——但值得注意的是，消除癫痫发作并不能防止因甲基安非他命或可卡因而导致的死亡，这表明存在独立于癫痫发作的毒性途径驱动着兴奋剂的致死性。

content.en: *Note: [CBD](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304394014002031)* [<sup>⬖</sup>](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304394014002031) *[in DMSO](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0304394014002031) blocked voltage-gated sodium channels and demonstrated anticonvulsant effects in a PTZ model, whereas cannabigerol produced comparable sodium channel blockade but had no anticonvulsant effect — indicating that sodium channel inhibition alone does not confer seizure protection. [3-carene](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41165896/)* <sup>⬖</sup> *modulated resting-state brain activity but did not reduce epileptiform activity. [Retigabine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34133772/), despite being an established antiepileptic drug, paradoxically increased spike-and-wave discharge number and duration in aged WAG/Rij rats, revealing age-dependent pro-epileptic effects from neuronal potassium channel activation. [Two plant-derived extracts](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21669274/) (Searsia dentata* <sup>⬖</sup> *and Searsia pyroides* <sup>⬖</sup>*) inhibited NMDA receptor currents and reduced intracellular calcium influx, supporting their traditional use for epilepsy.*
content.cn: 注：DMSO中的CBD <sup>⬖</sup> 可阻断电压门控钠通道，并在PTZ模型中表现出抗惊厥作用；而大麻二酚则产生了类似程度的钠通道阻断作用，但未显示抗惊厥效果——这表明仅靠钠通道抑制并不能提供抗癫痫保护。3-蒎烯 <sup>⬖</sup> 可调节静息状态下的大脑活动，但未能减少癫痫样活动。 雷替加滨尽管是一种公认的抗癫痫药物，但在老年WAG/Rij大鼠中却悖论性地增加了尖波-波形放电的数量和持续时间，这揭示了由神经元钾离子通道激活引起的、与年龄相关的促癫痫效应。 两种植物提取物（Searsia dentata <sup>⬖</sup> 和 Searsia pyroides <sup>⬖</sup> ）抑制了 NMDA 受体电流并减少了细胞内钙离子内流，这印证了它们在癫痫治疗中的传统应用。

content.en: **DMSO and Antiepileptic Drug Interactions
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜与抗癫痫药物的相互作用**

content.en: Several findings are relevant to using DMSO alongside conventional antiepileptic drugs. [DMSO has been safely used](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2323033/) as a vehicle for diazepam in seizure treatment studies. The antiepileptic drugs [carbamazepine and lamotrigine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16821006/) dissolved in DMSO showed no concerning interactions on human reproductive tissue, suggesting compatibility during pregnancy. [A pharmacological study](http://www.ajprd.com/index.php/journal/article/view/944) demonstrated favorable molecular interactions between levetiracetam and DMSO-water mixtures, supporting DMSO’s potential utility in antiepileptic drug formulation. [Mood-stabilizing antiepileptics](https://hirosaki.repo.nii.ac.jp/records/3408) (zonisamide, carbamazepine, valproate) dissolved in DMSO enhanced monoamine and acetylcholine systems in the striatum and hippocampus at therapeutic doses while reducing them at supratherapeutic doses — a biphasic pattern that may partly explain both their therapeutic effects and certain side effects. [DMSO combined with ethosuximide](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C5&q=Changes+of+epinephrine+levels+in+mouse+brains+after+administered+ethosuximide+DMSO+and+ethosuximide+simultaneously+with+DMSO&btnG=) may synergistically increase brain epinephrine levels, as DMSO alone can stimulate the central nervous system and increase catecholamines, potentially augmenting the neurotransmitter changes the antiepileptic produces. [Menthol](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11273200/) <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO demonstrated dose-dependent anticonvulsant effects, with 400 mg/kg significantly reducing seizure activity below control levels — while simultaneously counteracting the proconvulsant influence of high-concentration DMSO, suggesting menthol <sup>⬖</sup> may be a useful adjuvant when DMSO is used as a seizure medication vehicle.
content.cn: 有几项研究结果与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与传统抗癫痫药物的联合使用相关。在癫痫治疗研究中，DMSO已被安全用作地西泮的载体。溶解于DMSO中的抗癫痫药物卡马西平和拉莫三嗪对人体生殖组织未显示出令人担忧的相互作用，这表明其在妊娠期间具有相容性。 一项药理学研究表明，左乙拉西坦与二甲基亚砜-水混合物之间存在良好的分子相互作用，这支持了二甲基亚砜在抗癫痫药物制剂中的潜在应用价值。 溶于DMSO的情绪稳定型抗癫痫药物（佐尼沙胺、卡马西平、丙戊酸）在治疗剂量下可增强纹状体和海马区的单胺和乙酰胆碱系统活性，而在超治疗剂量下则会降低其活性——这种双相模式可能部分解释了这些药物的治疗效果及其某些副作用。 二甲基亚砜与乙琥胺联用可能产生协同作用，提高脑内肾上腺素水平，因为二甲基亚砜单独使用即可刺激中枢神经系统并增加儿茶酚胺，从而可能增强该抗癫痫药物引起的神经递质变化。 溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的薄荷醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 表现出剂量依赖性的抗惊厥作用，400 mg/kg的剂量可将癫痫发作活动显著降低至低于对照组水平——同时还能抵消高浓度DMSO的促惊厥作用，这表明当DMSO用作抗癫痫药物载体时，薄荷醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 可能是一种有用的辅助剂。

content.en: *Note: multiple studies confirmed DMSO at vehicle concentrations had no independent effect on seizure parameters, supporting its safety as a solvent at appropriate doses.<sup data-ref="420">420</sup>, [<sup>2,</sup>](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0197018611002129)<sup data-ref="438">438</sup> [A study employing](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11064-010-0148-9) DMSO-based electron spin resonance spectroscopy demonstrated that seizures induce rapid accumulation of ascorbate (an antioxidant) in the hippocampus in parallel with seizure progression — likely as a response to excessive free radical production during excitotoxicity — providing mechanistic support for why antioxidants like DMSO can be neuroprotective in seizure contexts.
content.cn: 注：多项研究证实，溶剂浓度下的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对癫痫发作参数无独立影响，这证明其在适当剂量下作为溶剂是安全的。 <sup data-ref="420">420</sup> <sup>2,</sup> <sup data-ref="438">438</sup> 一项采用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）基电子自旋共振光谱法的研究表明，癫痫发作会导致海马体中抗坏血酸（一种抗氧化剂）的快速积累，且该积累过程与癫痫发作的进展同步——这很可能是对兴奋性毒性期间过量自由基产生的反应——从而从机制上解释了为何DMSO等抗氧化剂在癫痫发作背景下能发挥神经保护作用。*

content.en: Encephalitis
content.cn: 脑炎

content.en: [I contracted viral meningitis 10 years ago,](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/158964366) neither I nor my doctor knew how. I went to the ER and they sent me home with ‘there’s nothing we can do, sorry.’ I put DMSO on the base of my skull in the back of my neck and within 24 hours I was healed.
content.cn: 10年前，我患上了病毒性脑膜炎，当时无论是我还是我的医生，都不知道是怎么回事。我去急诊室就诊，他们却让我回家，说“我们无能为力，很抱歉”。我在后颈部的颅底涂抹了二甲基亚砜（DMSO），不到24小时就痊愈了。

content.en: In addition to mitigating experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis DMSO also mitigates brain inflammation triggered by a variety of infectious sources.
content.cn: 除了能缓解实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）还能缓解由多种感染源引发的大脑炎症。
**Viral Encephalitis 病毒性脑炎**

content.en: Intranasal DMSO mixed with nuclease mixture was used in human patients to treat meningitis and meningoencephalitis caused by acute viral respiratory infections.<sup data-ref="439">439</sup>, <sup data-ref="440">440</sup>
content.cn: 将与核酸酶混合物混合的鼻内用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）用于人类患者，以治疗由急性病毒性呼吸道感染引起的脑膜炎和脑膜脑炎。 <sup data-ref="439">439</sup> <sup data-ref="440">440</sup>

content.en: Multiple papers have noted that DMSO was used in horses to treat myeloencephalopathy from herpes, but no data was provided other than longer courses of DMSO being used in more severe outbreaks.<sup data-ref="441">441</sup>, <sup data-ref="442">442</sup> In the only [case report](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16627115/) I’ve found, 500 mg/kg of IV DMSO (given every 24 hours to a hospitalized horse) contributed to a stabilization of neurologic deficits, clinical improvement and then full recovery.
content.cn: 多篇论文指出，曾将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）用于治疗马匹的疱疹病毒性脑脊髓病，但除在病情较严重的爆发期间采用较长疗程的DMSO治疗外，未提供其他数据。 <sup data-ref="441">441</sup> <sup data-ref="442">442</sup> 在我查到的唯一一例病例报告中，以500 mg/kg剂量静脉注射二甲基亚砜（每24小时给药一次，对象为一匹住院马匹），有助于神经功能缺损的稳定、临床症状的改善，并最终实现完全康复。

content.en: Multiple papers have reported DMSO being used to treat suspected West Nile virus encephalomyelitis,<sup data-ref="443">443</sup>, <sup data-ref="444">444</sup> [one of which](https://web.archive.org/web/20210124165815/https:/cris.unibo.it/handle/11585/84934#.YA2nZuxenEl) reported mild to moderate cases recovered fully after an anti-inflammatory protocol that included DMSO.
content.cn: 多篇论文报道了使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗疑似西尼罗河病毒脑脊髓炎的情况， <sup data-ref="443">443</sup> <sup data-ref="444">444</sup> 其中一篇论文指出，轻度至中度患者在接受包含DMSO的抗炎治疗方案后完全康复。

content.en: [Intraperitoneal arctigenin](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20083131518) <sup>⬖</sup> (a plant lignan dissolved in DMSO), administered one day post intravenous infection, provided complete protection to mice from an otherwise fatal Japanese encephalitis virus infection (along with reducing brain inflammation, oxidative stress, cell death, and associated behavioral impairments).
content.cn: 在静脉感染后一天给予腹腔注射的阿克蒂根素 <sup>⬖</sup> （一种溶于二甲基亚砜的植物木脂素），可使小鼠完全免受原本致命的日本脑炎病毒感染（同时还能减轻脑部炎症、氧化应激、细胞死亡及相关行为障碍）。

content.en: [In mice](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3bcebYeTyuodG-Cof1H8PsivAbmfExP7EJGxf-wjo2KTVPpYrdX96XFhsivdo5R1fIdznEY64ERXPlmVs2Hloi2eV8oQCmVMk8uDF80iI34Jm7bXUGaY54AZUlKQOUBeZbrf7QuwkSxs4zqaBm-94Tm00nOi2DrVDSzQfP1j_KTFyX8fR-tWBB3qHQe_fa9JZA=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) with a 100% fatal encephalomyocarditis (EMCV) viral infection, intraperitoneal DMSO combined with a DHEA derivative reduced mortality to 72.73%, greatly reduced (otherwise severe) neurological symptoms, prevented inflammatory brain lesions, and decreased brain viral load. [In another study](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVAa76jwU-MR3tzOBraEIzVU3hcKgmICF7mxYU2IGPQGYlRnaP0sVxSg5JKfrTDQX0cWzN3LqVONuoxPju5V1lUjR6YKB7lcUTsYB7csAKLHLOOT9R7ZWUiPZFERPUsf911w2ch15O5QjqrkOmBP63rUOQlnsTHsSOV-NhpI3oNBdKShYsHovDXOS2-2X5mJ9tg=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) DMSO combined with a furin inhibitor or a different DHEA derivative showed strong antiviral activity against Zika and Japanese encephalitis virus in human and mosquito cells.
content.cn: 在感染致死率达100%的脑心肌炎（EMCV）病毒的小鼠模型中，腹腔注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合DHEA衍生物可将死亡率降至72.73%，显著减轻（原本严重的）神经系统症状，预防脑部炎症病变，并降低脑部病毒载量。 在另一项研究中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与富林酶抑制剂或另一种DHEA衍生物联合使用，在人类细胞和蚊子细胞中对寨卡病毒和日本脑炎病毒表现出强烈的抗病毒活性。

content.en: [A p38-MAPK inhibitor dissolved](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2017&filename=1017230410.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=q70nLcGAj1AddcpyyHhhDaZh4lir000_AfDi7xAxhWyqmfJ7Kn0D5Q2UmMgVpIyB) in DMSO improved survival rate, reduced paralysis scores, lowered viral load in skeletal muscle, and decreased inflammatory cytokines in suckling mice with enterovirus 71 infection.
content.cn: 一种溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的p38-MAPK抑制剂，可提高感染肠道病毒71型的哺乳期小鼠的存活率，降低其瘫痪评分，减少骨骼肌中的病毒载量，并降低其体内的炎性细胞因子水平。

content.en: [In dogs with neurological](https://www.scielo.br/j/pvb/a/BFVxnhBBLFBYhThkhfFQHnn/?lang=pt) canine distemper, DMSO alone or combined with ribavirin and prednisone helped maintain higher hemoglobin levels and reduced the severity of anemia compared to regimens without DMSO. [In another similar study](https://repositorio.unesp.br/entities/publication/0f9133f7-670e-478a-bb70-6ba8dba95b42), DMSO synergistically enhanced the treatment efficacy of ribavirin.
content.cn: 对于患有神经型犬瘟热的犬只，与未使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗方案相比，单独使用DMSO或将其与利巴韦林和泼尼松联用，有助于维持较高的血红蛋白水平，并减轻贫血的严重程度。在另一项类似的研究中，DMSO协同增强了利巴韦林的治疗效果。
**Parasitic Encephalitis 寄生虫性脑炎**

content.en: Equine protozoal myeloencephalitis (EPM) is a common and severe disease in horses that is difficult to treat because the medications for it have poor oral absorption. A 2009 study found that dissolving ponazuril in DMSO rather than water roughly tripled its bioavailability and enhanced its ability to reach the brain, potentially revolutionizing management of EPM.<sup data-ref="445">445</sup>, <sup data-ref="446">446</sup> [In another study,](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/pdf/10.5555/20093134406) DMSO was also found to greatly enhance the absorption of toltrazuril (resulting in oral toltrazuril having 56% of the bioavailability of IV toltrazuril). [In the only clinical case report](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/pdf/10.5555/20133224991) I could locate, severe EPM neurological dysfunction initially improved following DMSO+ponazuril and a few other therapies, but the elderly horse eventually succumbed to the illness. Lastly, [a 2014 veterinary paper](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/pdf/10.5555/20143185665) noted that IV DMSO and ponazuril was a viable EPM treatment.
content.cn: 马原虫性脑脊髓炎（EPM）是一种常见且严重的马匹疾病，由于相关药物的口服吸收率较低，因此难以治疗。2009年的一项研究发现，将波那祖里尔溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）而非水中，可使其生物利用度提高约三倍，并增强其进入大脑的能力，这可能彻底改变EPM的治疗方式。 <sup data-ref="445">445</sup> <sup data-ref="446">446</sup> 在另一项研究中，也发现二甲基亚砜能显著提高托特拉唑啉的吸收率（使口服托特拉唑啉的生物利用度达到静脉注射托特拉唑啉的56%）。 在我能找到的唯一一例临床病例报告中，一匹患有严重EPM神经功能障碍的老年马，在采用二甲基亚砜+波那祖瑞尔及其他几种疗法后，病情初期有所好转，但最终仍因病不治。最后，一篇2014年的兽医论文指出，静脉注射二甲基亚砜和波那祖瑞尔是治疗EPM的可行方案。

content.en: [Megazol formulated as a gel](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8673840/) in DMSO and combined with melarsoprol successfully cured experimental CNS-trypanosomiasis in mice.
content.cn: 以二甲基亚砜（DMSO）为溶剂配制的凝胶剂型Megazol与melarsoprol联合使用，成功治愈了小鼠实验性中枢神经系统锥虫病。

content.en: [Arctigenin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahLy8csJtDlW2Fmck_-_Hc8kt8f3QdA7vXjrEPdfehg6iCLHLIBr4Rg-j1Y8vb5ww6iVgjtg525wIQzXA6QogaDLBcYEBOyhTrTmAXOmjH4DMAsxEudci0X6hWHwPed5L93tPJXZVjOUYcnAydQIUTvd5_4j29kadMYA0SiYjfVf68ExOb22HsMfPufVNZlPCcA=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> [improved depression-like behaviors in](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahLy8csJtDlW2Fmck_-_Hc8kt8f3QdA7vXjrEPdfehg6iCLHLIBr4Rg-j1Y8vb5ww6iVgjtg525wIQzXA6QogaDLBcYEBOyhTrTmAXOmjH4DMAsxEudci0X6hWHwPed5L93tPJXZVjOUYcnAydQIUTvd5_4j29kadMYA0SiYjfVf68ExOb22HsMfPufVNZlPCcA=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) Toxoplasma gondii-infected mice, reduced neuroinflammation, and restored neurotransmitter balance by suppressing the TLR4/NF-κB pathway and IDO overexpression. Sertraline also inhibited Toxoplasma gondii brain proliferation, reduced neuroinflammation (TNF-α, TRAF2, NF-κB p65 nuclear translocation), and protected neurons in both in vitro and in vivo models of acute T. gondii infection.<sup data-ref="447">447</sup>, <sup data-ref="447">447</sup>
content.cn: 阿克蒂根宁 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过抑制 TLR4/NF-κB 信号通路和 IDO 的过表达，改善了感染弓形虫（Toxoplasma gondii）小鼠的抑郁样行为，减轻了神经炎症，并恢复了神经递质平衡。 舍曲林同样抑制了弓形虫在脑内的增殖，减轻了神经炎症（TNF-α、TRAF2、NF-κB p65核转位），并在急性弓形虫感染的体外和体内模型中保护了神经元。 <sup data-ref="447">447</sup> <sup data-ref="447">447</sup>

content.en: A rare complication for dogs from babesia infections is cerebellar ataxia, and [in one case](https://journals.co.za/doi/abs/10.10520/AJA00382809_1496) where this was accompanied by blindness and quadriparesis, a dose of IV DMSO and then other treatments preceded a rapid recovery.
content.cn: 犬巴贝西虫感染的一种罕见并发症是小脑共济失调；在一例同时伴有失明和四肢轻瘫的病例中，先静脉注射一剂二甲基亚砜（DMSO），随后进行其他治疗，患者很快便康复了。

content.en: [Two species of Acanthamoeba](https://www.mdpi.com/2076-0817/10/4/491) (which can cause eye infections, and occasionally encephalitis), were found to be roughly twice as sensitive (and in one case four times as senstive) to tea tree oil <sup>⬖</sup> when it was mixed in DMSO. [The growth of another amoeba](https://journals.uc.edu/index.php/Undergradshowcase/article/view/8052/6591) (used to model the deadly brain infecting N. fowleri) was inhibited by Torin-1 dissolved in DMSO.
content.cn: 研究发现，两种阿坎萨阿米巴（可引起眼部感染，偶尔还会引发脑炎）对茶树油 <sup>⬖</sup> 的敏感性约为其未混合时的两倍（其中一种甚至达到四倍），前提是茶树油需与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）混合使用。另一种阿米巴（用于模拟致命的脑部感染病原体福氏耐克里氏阿米巴）的生长则被溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的托林-1所抑制。

content.en: *Note: [a review paper](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Geraldo-Eleno-Alves/publication/268395682_Dimetilsulfoxido_DMSO/links/551d67700cf252bc3a87a882/Dimetilsulfoxido-DMSO.pdf) citing numerous 1990s veterinary textbooks stated that DMSO has been indicated in cases of viral and bacterial encephalitis, Herpes virus I, and myelitis due to protozoa \[parasites\].
content.cn: 注：一篇引用了大量20世纪90年代兽医学教科书的综述文章指出，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）已被用于治疗病毒性和细菌性脑炎、I型疱疹病毒感染以及由原生动物\[寄生虫\]引起的脊髓炎。*
**Bacterial Meningitis 细菌性脑膜炎

content.en: **One Russian paper reported that in human patients DMSO enhanced the effectiveness of meningitis treatment protocols.<sup data-ref="448">448</sup>, <sup data-ref="449">449</sup>
content.cn: 有篇俄罗斯论文报道称，在人类患者中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能提高脑膜炎治疗方案的疗效。 <sup data-ref="448">448</sup> <sup data-ref="449">449</sup>

content.en: [In a foal with suspected bacterial menin](https://repository.unilasallista.edu.co/server/api/core/bitstreams/6e5002e7-584a-4dd1-982f-05749d9ffc61/content) gitis, intravenous DMSO was included as part of intensive supportive therapy for its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, neuroprotective, and free radical-scavenging properties. The foal showed clinical improvement (recovery of suckling reflex and milk intake) by day 7–8, at which point DMSO was discontinued.
content.cn: 对于一例疑似细菌性脑膜炎的驹，鉴于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有抗炎、镇痛、神经保护及清除自由基等特性，将其纳入强化支持治疗方案中进行静脉注射。该驹在第7至8天时临床症状有所好转（吸吮反射恢复且开始摄入乳汁），随后即停用DMSO。**

content.en: Sepsis-Associated Encephalopathy
content.cn: 脓毒症相关脑病**

content.en: When infections reach the circulation, they can frequently set off sepsis, a life-threatening inflammatory cascade. As a toxin many bacteria carry (LPS) can trigger sepsis, this condition is often studied in animals by injecting LPS.
content.cn: 当感染扩散至血液循环系统时，往往会引发脓毒症——一种危及生命的炎症级联反应。由于许多细菌携带的毒素（LPS）可诱发脓毒症，因此研究人员通常通过向动物注射LPS来研究该病症。

content.en: As one of the organs harmed by sepsis is the brain (e.g., by far the most common form of encephalopathy in critically ill patients is sepsis encephalopathy) numerous studies have evaluated how agents protect the nervous system from sepsis, such as a sheep one where [intravenous DMSO significa](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Ali-Hajimohammadi/publication/260793632_Effect_of_Dimethyl_sulfoxide_on_clinical_signs_and_acute_phase_proteins_during_endotoxemia_induced_by_Escherichia_Coli_Serotype_O55B5_in_sheep/links/5e09c0f5a6fdcc2837487f7c/Effect-of-Dimethyl-sulfoxide-on-clinical-signs-and-acute-phase-proteins-during-endotoxemia-induced-by-Escherichia-Coli-Serotype-O55B5-in-sheep.pdf) ntly reduced clinical signs of sepsis and lowered acute phase protein levels (haptoglobin, serum amyloid A, ceruloplasmin, and fibrinogen).
content.cn: 由于脑部是受脓毒症损害的器官之一（例如，在危重患者中，脓毒症性脑病是迄今为止最常见的脑病类型），许多研究评估了各种药物如何保护神经系统免受脓毒症的损害，例如一项针对绵羊的研究表明，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可显著减轻脓毒症的临床症状，并降低急性期蛋白水平（血红蛋白结合蛋白、血清淀粉样蛋白A、 铜蓝蛋白和纤维蛋白原）的水平。

content.en: A variety of agents in combination with DMSO have also been shown to reduce LPS triggered brain injury:
content.cn: 研究还表明，多种药物与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用可减轻脂多糖（LPS）诱导的脑损伤：

content.en: • [Dexmedetomidine pretreatment](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tcbBXgXCx0H1fNtDUW5pwh1X35P9A5fw7OX1bZRaL2ccvGF1Jv6IMuFCUpIBmONrx5P-A8-yLcY7q7-J5NfVQZsgH_ZZE95x_8Kg2xjLshZ7xMpYBUMhBfqezPDh1N_2bbqsy8WM9Uvw30_5WHC-sZSn347pkuYA3kW4cXQPTiu-PX7iHokxwpX&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) in rats reduced systemic and brain inflammation in sepsis-related encephalopathy by lowering inflammatory cytokines and suppressing NF-κB signaling in the hippocampus.
content.cn: • 大鼠预先给予德美沙多明治疗，通过降低炎症细胞因子水平并抑制海马区NF-κB信号传导，减轻了脓毒症相关脑病的全身性和脑部炎症。

content.en: • [Ibrutinib reduced neuroinflammati](http://www.latamjpharm.org/resumenes/41/2/LAJOP_41_2_1_24.pdf) on and brain damage in mice by lowering pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β), increasing IL-10, and suppressing the inflammatory TLR4/AKT/PI3K/STAT3 pathway.

Several other compounds also demonstrated protective effects in LPS-stimulated glial and neuronal models:
