content.en: *Note: in emergency brain surgeries, removed skull bones are often frozen for later reinsertion. [In 39 such cases](https://europepmc.org/article/med/11993170), bones frozen with DMSO showed less absorption and better outcomes than those frozen without it.
content.cn: 注：在紧急脑部手术中，取出的颅骨通常会被冷冻，以便日后重新植入。在39例此类病例中，使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）冷冻的颅骨比未使用该物质冷冻的颅骨吸收更少，手术效果也更好。*

content.en: Encephalopathy
content.cn: 脑病

content.en: In addition to pathogens that directly cause inflammatory brain damage, a variety of other triggers can also induce encephalopathy. DMSO, alone or in combination with other agents, has shown potential benefit against many of these (e.g., [this Russian paper](https://elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=38115368) cites DMSO as a treatment method for encephalopathy).
content.cn: 除了直接导致脑部炎症性损伤的病原体外，还有多种其他诱因也可能引发脑病。二甲基亚砜（DMSO）无论是单独使用还是与其他药物联合使用，均显示出对其中许多诱因的潜在疗效（例如，这篇俄罗斯论文就将DMSO列为治疗脑病的方法之一）。

content.en: [Ebselen (dissolved in DMSO](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21699073/)) reduced symptoms of oxidative and nitrative stress in a rat model of hepatic encephalopathy induced by thioacetamide.
content.cn: 在硫代乙酰胺诱导的大鼠肝性脑病模型中，埃布塞伦（溶于二甲基亚砜）减轻了氧化应激和硝化应激的症状。

content.en: [In a 2015 review](https://linkinghub.elsevier.com/retrieve/pii/S0749072014000851), DMSO was proposed as a potential treatment for naturally occurring bovine polioencephalomalacia due to it being mechanistically plausible it could help the condition, certain veterinarians using it there with success, and a general lack of strong evidence existing for treatment options for the condition. This disease often results from a thiamine <sup>⬖</sup> deficiency, to varying degrees responds to a repeated IVs of high-dose thiamine,<sup>⬖</sup> and has symptomatic overlaps with Wernicke’s encephalopathy, a thiamine <sup>⬖</sup> deficiency seen in humans (particularly alcoholics), suggesting DMSO may have use in that condition. [Corroborating this](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00210-021-02148-5), in a 2021 mouse model of thiamine <sup>⬖</sup> deficiency, DMSO (intraperitoneal) alone partially improved behavioral deficits and reduced thalamic damage (a key region affected in Wernicke’s encephalopathy). When combined with high-dose thiamine,<sup>⬖</sup> DMSO further enhanced recovery of locomotor function, motor coordination, and thalamic cell viability **beyond thiamine** <sup>⬖</sup> **alone**, and helped minimize long-term neurological sequelae.
content.cn: 在2015年的一项综述中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）被提议作为治疗自然发生的牛脑软化症的潜在方法，理由是：从作用机制上讲，它可能有助于改善该病症；部分兽医在临床应用中取得了成功；且目前针对该病症的治疗方案普遍缺乏有力证据。 该疾病通常由硫胺素 <sup>⬖</sup> 缺乏引起，对高剂量硫胺素的反复静脉注射有不同程度的反应， <sup>⬖</sup> 且其症状与韦尼克脑病（一种见于人类——尤其是酗酒者——的硫胺素 <sup>⬖</sup> 缺乏症）存在重叠，这表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可能对该病症也有治疗作用。 佐证这一观点的是，在2021年一项硫胺素 <sup>⬖</sup> 缺乏的小鼠模型研究中，单独使用二甲基亚砜（腹腔注射）部分改善了行为缺陷，并减轻了丘脑损伤（这是韦尼克脑病受累的关键区域）。 当与高剂量硫胺素联合使用时， <sup>⬖</sup> 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在改善运动功能、运动协调性以及丘脑细胞存活率方面，效果进一步优于单独使用硫胺素 <sup>⬖</sup> ，并有助于最大限度地减少长期神经系统后遗症。*

content.en: Note: DMSO’s chemical interactions with thiamine

注：二甲基亚砜与硫胺素的化学相互作用* <sup>⬖</sup> *(e.g., to enhance thiamine* <sup>⬖</sup> *delivery) have also been repeatedly studied.<sup data-ref="454">454</sup>, <sup data-ref="455">455</sup>, <sup data-ref="456">456</sup>*
content.cn: <sup>⬖</sup> （例如，为了提高硫胺素 <sup>⬖</sup> 的输送效率）也已多次被研究。 <sup data-ref="454">454</sup> <sup data-ref="455">455</sup> <sup data-ref="456">456</sup>

content.en: [In a group of horses](https://europepmc.org/article/med/8313709) who developed leukoencephalomalacia from Fusarium moniliforme mycotoxins in their food, a DMSO combination therapy aimed at reducing cerebral edema halved their death rate (66% to 33%) and allowed the surviving horses to fully recover.
content.cn: 在一群因饲料中含有链孢菌属（Fusarium moniliforme）真菌毒素而患上脑白质软化症的马匹中，采用旨在减轻脑水肿的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合疗法，使死亡率减半（从66%降至33%），并使幸存的马匹完全康复。

content.en: Myasthenia Gravis
content.cn: 重症肌无力

content.en: In order for skeletal muscles to fire, they need to receive acetylcholine from the nerve that directs them. In myasthenia gravis (MG) the body forms antibodies to the muscle’s acetylcholine receptors (AChRs), and as they are destroyed, the muscles need more and more acetylcholine to be sent by the nerves to activate. In turn, MG is managed by various immune-suppressing medications, filtering the AChR antibodies out of the blood, and acetylcholine esterase inhibitors (which boost acetylcholine levels)—suggesting DMSO’s anti-inflammatory and AChR-augmenting properties (via [acetylcholine esterase inhibition](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for)) may benefit the disease.
content.cn: 骨骼肌要收缩，就需要从控制它们的神经中接收乙酰胆碱。在重症肌无力（MG）中，人体会产生针对肌肉乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）的抗体，随着这些受体被破坏，肌肉需要神经传递越来越多的乙酰胆碱才能被激活。 因此，重症肌无力通常通过多种免疫抑制药物、血液中AChR抗体的过滤，以及乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂（可提高乙酰胆碱水平）进行治疗——这表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的抗炎特性及其增强AChR功能的作用（通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶实现）可能对该疾病的治疗有益。

content.en: DMSO's potential for MG [was initially discovered](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7453805/) (accidentally) in 1980, when two researchers tested a variety of agents for their ability to reduce AChR antibodies, and realized that the DMSO being used as a vehicle for the various agents they were testing was independently reducing those antibodies. They then found giving rats daily intraperitoneal injections of 1 mL DMSO for two weeks resulted in a 52% decrease in AChR antibodies (but not total IgG levels) that persisted for an additional six weeks after treatment was terminated.<sup data-ref="457">457</sup>, <sup data-ref="458">458</sup>
content.cn: 二甲基亚砜（DMSO）在肌无力症（MG）治疗中的潜在作用最初于1980年（偶然）被发现。当时，两名研究人员在测试多种药物降低乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体水平的能力时，发现作为这些测试药物载体使用的二甲基亚砜，本身也在独立地降低这些抗体水平。 随后他们发现，对大鼠进行为期两周的每日1毫升二甲基亚砜腹腔注射，可使乙酰胆碱受体抗体水平降低52%（但总IgG水平未受影响），且该效果在停药后仍能持续六周。 <sup data-ref="457">457</sup> <sup data-ref="458">458</sup>

content.en: *Note: after this discovery, the researchers expressed their eagerness to test DMSO in humans with MG ([the New York Times even covered it](https://www.nytimes.com/1981/01/15/us/scientists-seek-to-test-controversial-solvent-on-disease-of-muscles.html)).
content.cn: 注：这一发现公布后，研究人员表示迫切希望对患有肌无力症（MG）的患者进行二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的人体试验（《纽约时报》甚至对此进行了报道）。*

content.en: [A follow-up rat study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/3876185/) then found DMSO suppressed anti-AChR antibody levels by an average of 53%–76%, with the effect being similar regardless of whether DMSO was given orally, rectally, or intraperitoneally. Additionally, DMSO treatment suppressed the anti-AChR antibody response to a weak primary antigenic stimulus. Interestingly, when given during strong primary or secondary immune responses, DMSO instead enhanced antibody production 1.7–2.8-fold — indicating bidirectional immune modulation depending on timing and stimulus strength (or DMSO’s ability to potentiate allergens).
content.cn: 随后的一项大鼠研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可将抗乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）抗体水平平均抑制53%–76%，且无论采用口服、直肠给药还是腹腔注射给药，其抑制效果均相似。 此外，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗还能抑制针对弱初级抗原刺激产生的抗AChR抗体反应。值得注意的是，当在强烈的初级或继发免疫应答期间给药时，DMSO反而会使抗体产生量增加1.7–2.8倍——这表明其免疫调节作用具有双向性，取决于给药时机和刺激强度（或DMSO增强过敏原活性的能力）。

content.en: These antibody findings were complemented by direct evidence that DMSO restores neuromuscular function. [In ex vivo](https://academic.oup.com/jpp/article-abstract/24/5/417/6200698?login=false) mouse nerve-muscle preparations where tubocurarine was used to mimic MG (reducing the strength of nerve-evoked muscle contractions), DMSO produced a rapid, dose-dependent, and sustained restoration of twitch force — with 0.1% restoring 20–30% of force and 0.75% achieving complete restoration that was sustained for over 150 minutes. Electrophysiology confirmed DMSO increased the amplitude of nerve signals at the muscle by ~25–30%, consistent with its acetylcholinesterase-inhibiting properties.
content.cn: 这些抗体研究结果得到了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可恢复神经肌肉功能的直接证据的印证。 在利用管状库拉林模拟肌无力（降低神经诱发的肌肉收缩强度）的小鼠体外神经-肌肉制备模型中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可快速、剂量依赖性且持续地恢复肌肉颤动力量——0.1%浓度可恢复20–30%的力量，0.75%浓度则可实现完全恢复，且该恢复状态可持续超过150分钟。 电生理学研究证实，二甲基亚砜使肌肉处的神经信号振幅增加了约25–30%，这与其乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制特性相一致。

content.en: Additional studies in frog and mammalian nerve-muscle preparations confirmed that DMSO at concentrations ≤1% enhanced neuromuscular transmission through acetylcholinesterase inhibition, while concentrations above 1% began to have depressant effects in mammals, and that THC (but not CBD) counteracted this restoration of neuromuscular function.<sup data-ref="459">459</sup>, <sup data-ref="460">460</sup>, <sup data-ref="461">461</sup>10419-7/abstract), <sup data-ref="462">462</sup> DMSO has also been shown to reverse neuromuscular blockade caused by organophosphates (which poison the same acetylcholinesterase system that is therapeutically targeted in MG).<sup data-ref="56">56</sup>, <sup data-ref="57">57</sup>, <sup data-ref="58">58</sup>, <sup data-ref="59">59</sup>, <sup data-ref="60">60</sup>, <sup data-ref="61">61</sup>针对青蛙和哺乳动物神经-肌肉制备物的进一步研究证实，浓度≤1%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可通过抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶来增强神经肌肉传导，而浓度超过1%时则开始对哺乳动物产生抑制作用；此外，四氢大麻酚（THC）（而非大麻二酚CBD）可抵消这种神经肌肉功能的恢复。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> 研究还表明，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能够逆转有机磷化合物引起的神经肌肉阻断（有机磷化合物会毒害乙酰胆碱酯酶系统，而该系统正是重症肌无力（MG）治疗的靶点）。 <sup>1</sup> <sup>2</sup> <sup>3</sup> <sup>4</sup> <sup>5</sup> <sup>6</sup> ,

*Note: [this research inspired a 1982 study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0090122982901647) to determine if DMSO suppressed thyroid autoantibodies (which were experimentally induced in rats). It did, and also was found to increase the ratio of IgM to IgG plaque forming cells (which suggested a true immunoregulatory effect). In turn, some patients report that DMSO benefits autoimmune thyroiditis.
content.cn: 注：这项研究启发了一项1982年的研究，旨在确定二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是否能抑制甲状腺自身抗体（这些抗体是在大鼠身上通过实验诱导产生的）。研究结果表明，DMSO确实具有这种作用，并且还发现它能提高IgM与IgG斑块形成细胞的比例（这表明其具有真正的免疫调节作用）。因此，一些患者反映，DMSO对自身免疫性甲状腺炎有疗效。*

content.en: A variety of agents combined with DMSO have also shown benefit in experimental autoimmune MG models — including [resveratrol](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201501&filename=1015505513.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=niESZZtdnfQJix7RCRNDPc3QeEtwOjsD-eZRBzqexhicS6EHxSxVQhYul41-1Ope) <sup>⬖</sup> (which reduced anti-AChR antibodies and protected AChR density at the neuromuscular junction), [total glucosides of peony](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202001&filename=1020017727.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=8aJLjug5upywrLTZWWsnQMmvgowRAmHDt12lV-uThFHN3I_aIjSGkrp2VdRewxqt) <sup>⬖</sup> and [artemisinin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2016&filename=ZSMB201603002&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=dGIB7C0IJdp7odWkekWnwlL1AWAN4cusL04_kaWWG_kAYrlzoU4oGsa_sSgkohU6) <sup>⬖</sup> (both reduced clinical scores and anti-AChR antibodies while modulating regulatory T cells), atorvastatin-derived exosomes,<sup data-ref="463">463</sup>, <sup data-ref="464">464</sup>, <sup data-ref="465">465</sup> and [a caspase-1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2016&filename=1016164619.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=Ck0Kp9pDqxAT0I4lkKUTYtzquBWdxWgX5MzWQMjwK0_KKC8uKKkSEUYiwsiNH8Ns) (which suppressed disease progression via IL-1β/IL-17 pathways).
content.cn: 多种与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用的药物在实验性自身免疫性肌无力（MG）模型中也显示出疗效——包括白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> （可降低抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体水平并保护神经肌肉接头处的乙酰胆碱受体密度）、芍药总苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 和青蒿素 <sup>⬖</sup> （二者均能降低临床评分和抗AChR抗体水平，同时调节调节性T细胞），阿托伐他汀衍生的外泌体， <sup data-ref="463">463</sup> <sup data-ref="464">464</sup> <sup data-ref="465">465</sup> 以及一种半胱天冬酶-1抑制剂（该抑制剂通过IL-1β/IL-17通路抑制疾病进展）。

content.en: Separately, sepsis-induced disruption of acetylcholine receptor clustering on muscle cells was reversed by GSK3β inhibition, restoring the receptor aggregation needed for normal neuromuscular transmission.<sup data-ref="466">466</sup>, <sup data-ref="467">467</sup> In a rat sepsis model, [rapamycin](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2020&filename=1019659142.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=TM9sdtB4S_XSHfmiq6wArNzH2nckBzLH1NCOXgx7NcR4lSH3GPD1mCDwS0UZTe4f) similarly improved nerve conduction velocity, muscle action potential amplitude, and survival by restoring acetylcholine receptor homeostasis.
content.cn: 此外，脓毒症导致的肌肉细胞上乙酰胆碱受体聚集紊乱，可通过抑制GSK3β得到逆转，从而恢复正常神经肌肉传导所需的受体聚集。 <sup data-ref="466">466</sup> <sup data-ref="467">467</sup> 在大鼠脓毒症模型中，雷帕霉素同样通过恢复乙酰胆碱受体的稳态，改善了神经传导速度、肌肉动作电位振幅以及存活率。

content.en: Sadly, [while physicians have highlighted DMSO’s potential for human patients](https://asma.kglmeridian.com/downloadpdf/view/journals/asem/53/1/article-p82.pdf), no human studies have ever been performed for DMSO with MG. However, [one reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/80694307) with generalized MG reported that after starting oral and topical DMSO in 2022, her muscle fatigue, cognitive function, and vision dramatically improved, and she has not had a myasthenic crisis since. She noted that higher doses at night would wake her after an hour feeling alert and functional — which she attributed to DMSO boosting her acetylcholine levels — and described the effect as “better than the pyridostigmine I used to take 6x/day.” Another reader with generalized MG alongside multiple other autoimmune conditions reported no myasthenic crises since starting DMSO in 2022, along with dramatically reduced muscle fatigue, greatly improved cognition and near-normal vision — after having been on 30 prescription medications, she is now nearly off all of them <sup data-ref="468">468</sup>, <sup data-ref="469">469</sup> while a third reported “such amazing results” including “my swallowing and speaking goes back to normal” and “right side facial grimace reducing.<sup data-ref="470">470</sup> Other readers with MG have also noticed positive effects from DMSO.<sup data-ref="471">471</sup>
content.cn: 遗憾的是，尽管医生们已强调了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对人类患者的潜在疗效，但迄今为止尚未针对肌无力症（MG）患者开展过任何涉及DMSO的人体研究。不过，一位患有全身性肌无力症的读者报告称，自2022年开始口服和外用DMSO后，她的肌肉疲劳、认知功能和视力均显著改善，且此后再未出现过肌无力危机。 她指出，晚上服用较高剂量后，一小时便会醒来，感觉神清气爽且行动自如——她将此归因于DMSO提高了她的乙酰胆碱水平——并形容这种效果“比我以前每天服用6次的吡啶斯汀还要好”。另一位患有全身性肌无力症并伴有多种其他自身免疫性疾病的读者报告称，自2022年开始使用DMSO以来，不仅再未出现肌无力危象，肌肉疲劳也大幅减轻， 认知能力显著改善，视力接近正常——此前她曾服用30种处方药，如今已几乎停用所有药物 <sup data-ref="471">471</sup> <sup data-ref="469">469</sup> ；还有一位读者报告了“如此惊人的效果”，包括“吞咽和说话恢复正常”以及“右侧面部扭曲有所减轻”。 <sup data-ref="471">471</sup> 其他患有肌无力症的读者也注意到二甲基亚砜带来的积极效果。 <sup data-ref="471">471</sup>

content.en: Hydrocephalus
content.cn: 脑积水

content.en: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is primarily produced and circulates within chambers in the brain called ventricles. When too much CSF is produced or its drainage or flow from the ventricles is obstructed (or absorption is impaired), the ventricles enlarge and exert pressure on surrounding brain tissue. This can lead to cognitive impairment (including dementia-like symptoms), impaired coordination or gait disturbance, and urinary incontinence. Since DMSO facilitates fluid circulation and drainage, it could potentially help hydrocephalus.
content.cn: 脑脊液（CSF）主要在脑内称为脑室的腔室内产生并循环。当脑脊液生成过多，或者其从脑室的引流或流动受阻（或吸收受损）时，脑室会扩大并压迫周围的脑组织。这可能导致认知功能障碍（包括类似痴呆的症状）、协调能力下降或步态异常，以及尿失禁。 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能促进体液循环和引流，因此可能对脑积水有帮助。

content.en: Unfortunately, research in this area is quite limited, with the primarily referenced studies being work from a team that found injuring the ventricles (by puncturing them and then injecting DMSO) caused hydrocephalus in a dose dependent manner, with 2% DMSO causing a small increase (8-16% developed it, on average increasing ventricle volume by 50%), and 10% or 100% causing it much more frequently. This led the authors to postulate the effect they observed could account for why hydrocephalus is occasionally seen from other therapies which inject high concentrations of DMSO into the cerebral circulation.<sup data-ref="472">472</sup>, <sup data-ref="473">473</sup>, <sup data-ref="474">474</sup>03326-7?uuid=uuid%3A68afe2e0-15f1-4ebf-a392-5e3de37e2db7)
content.cn: 遗憾的是，该领域的研究相当有限，主要引用的研究来自一个研究团队，该团队发现损伤脑室（通过穿刺脑室并注入二甲基亚砜）会以剂量依赖性方式引发脑积水：2%浓度的二甲基亚砜会导致脑积水发生率小幅上升（8%-16%的受试者出现脑积水，脑室体积平均增加50%）， 而10%或100%浓度的二甲基亚砜则导致该病症的发生频率显著更高。这促使作者推测，他们观察到的这种效应或许可以解释为何在其他将高浓度二甲基亚砜注入脑循环的治疗中，偶尔会出现脑积水。 <sup data-ref="472">472</sup> <sup data-ref="473">473</sup> <sup data-ref="474">474</sup>

content.en: As these concentrations are much higher than what can be reached with standard DMSO infusions (let alone any other route of administration) and interventricular injections of a variety of substances besides DMSO reliably cause hydrocephalus, it is unlikely these results are relevant to DMSO users, especially if high-dose IV DMSO infusions are avoided.
content.cn: 由于这些浓度远高于标准二甲基亚砜（DMSO）输注所能达到的水平（更不用说其他给药途径了），而且除二甲基亚砜（DMSO）外，将多种物质进行室间隙注射都会可靠地导致脑积水，因此这些结果不太可能与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使用者相关，尤其是如果避免高剂量静脉输注二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的话。

content.en: Outside of this study, two case reports suggested DMSO can benefit hydrocephalus:
content.cn: 除本研究外，另有两份病例报告表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对脑积水有治疗作用：

content.en: • [In a Shih Tzu dog](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jvma1951/54/2/54_2_119/_pdf/-char/ja) which had severe acute neurological symptoms (e.g., seizures and opisthotonus) due to non-communicating hydrocephalus, IV 10% DMSO (1g/kg over 50 minutes), greatly improved symptoms (e.g., seizures were largely suppressed and consciousness was restored), which the authors attributed to DMSO reducing intracranial pressure and protecting neurological tissue. Ultimately, the dog died after 50 days, but its prognosis greatly exceeded what had been expected.<sup data-ref="475">475</sup>, <sup data-ref="476">476</sup>
content.cn: • 一只因闭锁性脑积水而出现严重急性神经系统症状（如癫痫发作和角弓反张）的西施犬， 静脉注射10%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）（1克/千克，50分钟内完成）后，症状显著改善（例如，癫痫发作基本得到抑制，意识恢复），作者认为这是由于DMSO降低了颅内压并保护了神经组织。最终，该犬在50天后死亡，但其预后远超预期。 <sup data-ref="475">475</sup> <sup data-ref="476">476</sup>

content.en: • [A diffuse cerebral encephalopathy](https://avmajournals.avma.org/view/journals/javma/203/5/javma.1993.203.05.694.pdf) associated with hydrocephalus and cholesterinic \[cholesterol\] granulomas in a horse partially improved from a DMSO-containing regimen. [In a horse](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12859913/) with a large intracranial epidermoid cyst causing ataxia, head-pressing, and circling, IV DMSO with glucocorticoids and penicillin produced gradual clinical improvement (though the animal relapsed over six months due to the progressive nature of the lesion).
content.cn: • 一匹患有脑积水和胆固醇肉芽肿的马，其弥漫性脑病在采用含二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗方案后症状部分缓解。 一匹因颅内巨大表皮样囊肿导致共济失调、头部压地及绕圈行走的马，经静脉注射含二甲基亚砜（DMSO）、糖皮质激素和青霉素的方案后，临床症状逐渐改善（尽管由于病变的进行性特点，该马在六个月内出现了复发）。

content.en: While in contrast, [in a study](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201902&filename=1017268918.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=ViX7pIxz-9XvWzbyG2O47FBXd-LumK50DMg99cuYs3MbVxi-V3aV14TY-I2rcYWD) of experimentally induced hydrocephalus where DMSO was used to deliver an aquaporin 4 inhibitor (which worsened hydrocephalus) intraperitoneal DMSO (at an unspecified dose) did not provide a therapeutic benefit.
content.cn: 相比之下，在一项针对实验性脑积水的研究中，研究人员使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）递送水通道蛋白4抑制剂（该抑制剂会加剧脑积水），结果表明腹腔注射二甲基亚砜（剂量未明确）并未带来治疗益处。

content.en: Lastly, [one reader shared that](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/186582079) his brother had a progressive neurological disorder (syringomyelia, astrocytoma in the cervical spine causing paralysis, complications from its complex removal, and then hydrocephalus) which his (renowned) neurologists eventually said would be fatal in a few years (likely from encephalitis), so he sought out Stanley Jacob who agreed to treat him experimentally with DMSO. This proved to be a miracle for him and his spinal cord, with his neurologists saying “they’d never seen anyone in a similar situation stabilize and that was ‘making medical history.’” He lived 30 more joyful years, 20 of which he was Stanley Jacob’s patient, but unfortunately, IV DMSO gave him the greatest benefit and he was no longer able to obtain it once he stopped being Jacob’s patient.
content.cn: 最后，一位读者分享道，他的兄弟患有一种进行性神经系统疾病（脊髓空洞症、导致瘫痪的颈椎星形细胞瘤、复杂手术切除后的并发症，以及随后出现的水脑症），他的（著名）神经科医生最终表示，这种病将在几年内致命（很可能是由于脑炎），因此他找到了斯坦利·雅各布，后者同意用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对他进行实验性治疗。 这对患者及其脊髓而言堪称奇迹，他的神经科医生表示“从未见过类似情况的患者病情能稳定下来，这‘创造了医学史’”。他随后又度过了30个充满喜悦的年头，其中20年是作为斯坦利·雅各布的患者度过的。但遗憾的是，静脉注射二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对他效果最佳，而一旦不再是雅各布的患者，他就无法再获得这种治疗了。

content.en: *Note: [another reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/132292967), who had a 9-year-old daughter with cerebral palsy (and a shunt for hydrocephalus) shared that topical DMSO helped the cerebral palsy symptoms.
content.cn: 注：另一位读者表示，她9岁的女儿患有脑瘫（并因脑积水植入了分流管），使用外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后，脑瘫症状有所缓解。*

content.en: Psychiatric Conditions
content.cn: 精神疾病

content.en: Let’s now look at the rest of the data which has accumulated for using DMSO in psychiatry and note how often it mirrors the findings of the Russian researchers.
content.cn: 现在，让我们来看看精神病学领域中关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）应用的其余积累数据，并注意这些数据在多大程度上与俄罗斯研究人员的发现相吻合。

content.en: Human Studies
content.cn: 人类学

content.en: [The most detailed study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/5342267/) on DMSO’s use for psychiatric patients was conducted at a Peruvian psychiatric hospital, where 42 patients (25 schizophrenics, 4 manic depressive psychotics, 4 alcoholic psychotics, 4 compulsive-obsessive neurotics and 5 patients with severe anxiety) were taken off all their medications then given 2-5 intramuscular DMSO injections each day (with more given to the most psychotic patients) and compared to 16 controls receiving standard care.<sup data-ref="477">477</sup>, <sup data-ref="478">478</sup>
content.cn: 关于DMSO在精神病患者中应用的最详细研究是在一家秘鲁精神病院进行的，该研究中，42名患者 （包括25名精神分裂症患者、4名躁郁症伴精神病症状患者、4名酒精性精神病患者、4名强迫-焦虑型神经症患者以及5名重度焦虑症患者）被停用所有药物，随后每天接受2至5次二甲基亚砜（DMSO）肌肉注射（精神病症状最严重的患者剂量较高），并与接受标准治疗的16名对照组患者进行了对比。 <sup data-ref="477">477</sup> <sup data-ref="478">478</sup>

content.en: Of the schizophrenics, **all 14 of the acute cases** experienced a rapid and dramatic improvement (particularly in their agitation—especially for the catatonic-paranoid patients), with all being discharged within 45 days (three having a complete recovery 15 days after admission) and not having a recurrence. To quote one of them:
content.cn: 在精神分裂症患者中，全部14例急性病例均出现了迅速而显著的改善（尤其体现在躁动症状上——特别是对于木僵型-偏执型患者），所有患者均在45天内出院（其中3人在入院15天后完全康复），且未出现复发。引用其中一位患者的话：

content.en: “I have been out of my mind. I don’t know what happened to me. I wonder what my children are going to say.”
content.cn: “我简直疯了。我不知道自己怎么了。真不知道我的孩子们会怎么说。”

content.en: Of the 11 chronic schizophrenics, 4 periodically needed hospitalization and had a complete remission following DMSO (allowing them to be discharged much faster than normal), and in those who later relapsed, there was again a positive response to DMSO. The remaining 7 were more severe cases (e.g., they had been hospitalized for over 6 years and failed years of therapies) and experienced an improvement from DMSO, but it was not enough to leave the hospital.
content.cn: 在11名慢性精神分裂症患者中，有4人需要定期住院治疗，接受二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗后实现了完全缓解（使他们比正常情况更快出院）；而在那些后来复发的患者中，再次对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗产生了积极反应。 其余7例病情更为严重（例如，他们已住院超过6年，且经多年治疗未见成效），虽然二甲基亚砜（DMSO）使他们的病情有所好转，但改善程度尚不足以让他们出院。

content.en: *Note: results like this (I’ve seen similar ones with other therapies as well) lead me to believe that the existing understanding of schizophrenia is far from complete. To further support that contention, [this author](https://www.amazon.com/DMSO-Handbook-Doctors-Archie-Scott/dp/1475997922) also shared a case of a severely delusional paranoid schizophrenic responding to DMSO.
content.cn: 注：像这样的结果（我也曾在其他疗法中见过类似的情况）让我认为，目前对精神分裂症的认识还远未完善。为了进一步支持这一观点，本文作者还分享了一个案例：一名患有严重妄想型偏执型精神分裂症的患者对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）产生了良好反应。*

content.en: The 4 manic-depressive psychotics (who were in the manic phase, averaging 15 days of psychomotor agitation) rapidly calmed down and lost their mania after DMSO (with their recovery being much faster than what they’d previously experienced from conventional therapy).
content.cn: 这4名躁郁症精神病患者（当时正处于躁狂期，平均持续15天的精神运动性兴奋）在服用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）后迅速平静下来，躁狂症状也随之消失（其康复速度远快于此前接受常规治疗时的恢复速度）。

content.en: The 4 alcoholic psychotics (2 with hallucinations and 2 with delirium tremens) had previously been hospitalized for these issues. They rapidly responded to DMSO, with restlessness improving in the first few days while the hallucinations took longer.
content.cn: 这4名酒精性精神病患者（其中2名出现幻觉，2名出现震颤性谵妄）此前曾因这些问题住院治疗。他们对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗反应迅速，焦躁不安的症状在头几天就有所改善，而幻觉症状的缓解则耗时较长。

content.en: The remaining patients (obsessive-compulsive neurosis and severe anxiety) also had a good response to DMSO (e.g., they were calmer, ideas did not upset them as before, they were able to act in a more spontaneous way, and they were able to overcome their obsessive compulsions).
content.cn: 其余患者（强迫性神经症和严重焦虑症患者）对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也反应良好（例如，他们变得更加平静，不再像以前那样因某些想法而感到不安，能够更自然地行动，并且能够克服强迫行为）。

content.en: *Note: the authors of the 1967 paper [noted that DMSO](https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/annurev.pa.12.040172.002033) had antipsychotic and antianxiety properties and that its action differed from tranquilizers in that little sedation or central depression was produced. A later [1992 paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/030698779290117U?via%3Dihub) proposed that the antipsychotic effects observed in this trial resulted from DMSO suppressing excessive interleukin-2 (IL-2) production by T-lymphocytes, a mechanism also attributed to certain antipsychotics in the same model.
content.cn: 注：1967年论文的作者指出，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有抗精神病和抗焦虑特性，其作用机制与镇静剂不同，几乎不会引起镇静或中枢抑制。 1992年发表的一篇后续论文提出，该试验中观察到的抗精神病效应源于DMSO抑制了T淋巴细胞过量产生白细胞介素-2（IL-2），这一机制在同一模型中也被认为是某些抗精神病药物起效的原因。*

content.en: Sadly (like many things in medicine) these 1967 results elicited minimal interest and no attempts were made to replicate them (although a [1982 Russian review](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6123209/) noted DMSO could be used for psychiatric disorders and [a 2006 Russian literature review](https://www.babyblog.ru/user/svetilein/3165985) noted intramuscular injections of 50% DMSO had a sedating effect on psychotic patients).
content.cn: 遗憾的是（就像医学领域的许多事情一样），这些1967年的研究结果几乎未引起任何关注，也没有人尝试进行重复验证（尽管1982年的一篇俄罗斯综述指出二甲基亚砜可用于治疗精神疾病，而2006年的一篇俄罗斯文献综述也指出，50%二甲基亚砜的肌内注射对精神病患者具有镇静作用）。

content.en: To the best of my knowledge, only five other human psychiatric studies have been done with DMSO:
content.cn: 据我所知，此前仅进行过另外五项关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的人类精神病学研究：

content.en: • [In 17 patients](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/european-psychiatry/article/dimethylsulfoxid-application-for-overcoming-of-therapy-resistance-in-patients-with-lingering-depressions/E77A59DCF2B37482B28F9E0F3C9523AA) (ages 28-55 years) with chronic depression (for at least 5-20 years) that did not respond to antidepressant therapy whose most recent depressive episode lasted 8 months to 2 years, DMSO was able to treat their depression. Specifically, the existing basic antidepressant therapy (amitriptyline, pirasidol, anafranil), was combined with 1ml 50% oral DMSO and taken three times a day, resulting in 14 (82.3%) of the patients having a resolution of their depression which persisted for the 1-4 years of follow-up each patient received.
content.cn: • 在17名慢性抑郁症患者（年龄28-55岁）中，这些患者对抗抑郁药治疗无反应，病程持续至少5-20年，且最近一次抑郁发作持续了8个月至2年，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）成功治愈了他们的抑郁症。 具体而言，将现有的基础抗抑郁治疗（阿米替林、吡拉西多、阿纳弗兰）与1毫升50%浓度的口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用，每日三次，结果显示其中14名（82.3%）患者的抑郁症状得到缓解，且这种缓解状态在随后对每位患者进行的1至4年随访期间得以维持。

content.en: *Note: studies evaluating DMSO in combination with SSRI antidepressants are quite rare. [In one of the only ones I’ve found](https://academic.oup.com/chemse/article-abstract/38/3/211/320058), they jointly decreased rat appetite for sugar, while in the other ([a heart study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1880654625000800)) the detected effects occurred at much higher concentrations than the blood of an SSRI user will reach.
content.cn: 注：评估二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂（SSRI）类抗抑郁药联合使用的研究非常罕见。在我找到的为数不多的研究中，其中一项显示两者联合使用可降低大鼠对糖分的食欲；而在另一项（关于心脏的研究）中，所观察到的效应是在远高于SSRI使用者血液中浓度的情况下出现的。*

content.en: • [A study of 210 women w](https://medstominst.ru/data/vestnik/Vestnik_MSI_02_2019.pdf#page=27) ith exacerbated chronic generalized periodontitis found that 10% DMSO mixed with 0.2% oxymetacil and delivered via ultrasound effectively relieved their periodontitis and lowered their anxiety.
content.cn: • 一项针对210名患有急性发作性慢性泛发性牙周炎的女性患者的研究发现，将10%的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与0.2%的氧美西林混合，并通过超声波给药，能有效缓解其牙周炎症状并减轻其焦虑感。

content.en: •In two Chilean studies, a DMSO combination with amino acids <sup>⬖</sup> was used to treat depressive neuroses (e.g., mood and anxiety disorder) while in another, when used to treat cognitive impairment and dementia, those patients also experienced a significant improvement of their mood (going from depressed to happy).<sup data-ref="390">390</sup>, <sup data-ref="479">479</sup>
content.cn: •在两项智利研究中，研究人员采用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与氨基酸的组合 <sup>⬖</sup> 来治疗抑郁性神经症（例如情绪障碍和焦虑障碍）；而在另一项研究中，当该组合用于治疗认知功能障碍和痴呆症时，这些患者的情绪也出现了显著改善（从抑郁转为快乐）。 <sup data-ref="390">390</sup> <sup data-ref="479">479</sup>

content.en: • [In women with post partum depression](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tenbv5vAzOrnsxvzc2z6LAyyCx9-s16bPC4-M6sMZNozxO-RqxGC6gCNHF5BwYqWYbF2JI7RZhTkFfxEcDe5EuLrVe-zRw2UsIsFf3JuJU4GHNvr4O14q9HFdYgid9CKy7ksbKVqLcfJ0iVhpYKpCeRpHeHxyXw6Z1SpGK9EMHhWQdQhZUwkU2B&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (PPD), blood tests consistently showed significantly lower vitamin D, serotonin, and norepinephrine. When vitamin D <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO was given to cultured hippocampal neurons, beneficial increases were observed in both their proliferation and secretion of serotonin, and norepinephrine (likely via the PI3K/Akt pathway).
content.cn: • 在患有产后抑郁症（PPD）的女性中，血液检测结果一致显示其维生素D、5-羟色胺和去甲肾上腺素水平显著降低。当向体外培养的海马神经元添加溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的维生素D时，观察到这些神经元的增殖以及5-羟色胺和去甲肾上腺素的分泌均出现有益的增加（这很可能是通过PI3K/Akt通路实现的）。

content.en: *Note: [In lymphoblastoids from women with PPD](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37372414/), brexanolone (an approved PPD therapy) in DMSO modulated the expression of 98 genes potentially linked to PPD (which was believed to account for its rapid effect on PPD).
content.cn: 注：在患有产后抑郁症（PPD）的女性的淋巴母细胞样细胞中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的布雷克索隆（一种经批准用于治疗PPD的药物）调节了98个可能与PPD相关的基因的表达（这被认为是该药物对PPD产生快速疗效的原因）。*

content.en: However, a variety of animals ones have been and will be summarized (all of which, unless otherwise specified were conducted with rats or mice).
content.cn: 然而，已有的和今后将进行的涉及多种动物的研究均已汇总（除非另有说明，所有研究均以大鼠或小鼠为对象）。

content.en: PTSD
content.cn: 创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）

content.en: • [In one study](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUoYU-kY0Wq6ntUSksmPV0O1WYEJbFY1yD4AJ58W5uk_3kZS2Jx5OuFurGbDnJq4RhVahBEUz_-vDQ0MHqNkkKzmHtsLEeX6-cSkxXmhHpgvG8ET6PLpVpZldq5J5eWZVyTrfjhnugup7ApkZrBaTkklenZYmXr_30_o-oby1ZXLG41Iz5-NhuTJiHvsaf8b8Ao=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) designed to model PTSD (via traumatic stress in adolescence), the methyltransferase inhibitor Unc0642 (dissolved in DMSO) alleviated (otherwise permanent) anxiety, depression, social and cognitive dysfunction and normalized PTSD impaired brain development.
content.cn: • 在一项旨在模拟创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）（通过青少年期的创伤性应激）的研究中，甲基转移酶抑制剂Unc0642（溶于二甲基亚砜）缓解了（否则将持续存在的）焦虑、抑郁、社交和认知功能障碍，并使因PTSD受损的大脑发育恢复正常。

content.en: • [In a modified single prolonged stress](https://d1wqtxts1xzle7.cloudfront.net/52633514/1.550-559-libre.pdf?1492321927=&response-content-disposition=inline%3B+filename%3DDual_Effects_of_Exposure_Therapy_and_Can.pdf&Expires=1772715895&Signature=DG9RVy19p7aKDXNJmm4LP~61MZSGVeyiBxuugh~bpi11fE8xGARtAWFSHBLXqpOc1aHwn7hcSr-ECl78WY0gElLeuZfYBZDT64ZoqxgKkao4sGOXQQ4YLA-NOQIixTXpSgIlGpfGtnCwCAieaCAVTuquZ-ygwck8fsbPIMwvVY4sBpvdcBElgxaXvp2G24VEavxya84C5bzvxkGLd~LMgtOmIGeEiasHmsmPvGFu8qTWtxBAxniHUpq8AoP7CxJ6TQRIAP4rWLr0oVEo~fdf26XqzEAxCkYa9sPGA9c7MXjur0B1xvvNtdHBVI0aFqW4ScPvFGhvLOjuGi31UOfglA__&Key-Pair-Id=APKAJLOHF5GGSLRBV4ZA) (SPS) model of PTSD, a moderate dose of Cannabis sativa leaf extract <sup>⬖</sup> (dissolved in DMSO) significantly enhanced the efficacy of exposure therapy in extinguishing the conditioned fear memory. The benefit was CB1 receptor-dependent and persisted in a drug-free test 14 days later.
content.cn: • 在一种改良的创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）单一长期应激（SPS）模型中，中等剂量的大麻（Cannabis sativa）叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （溶于二甲基亚砜）显著增强了暴露疗法在消退条件性恐惧记忆方面的疗效。该疗效依赖于CB1受体，并在14天后的无药物测试中仍持续存在。

content.en: Stress
content.cn: 压力

content.en: In addition to the stress which causes PTSD, many rodent studies have modeled a variety of other stressful situations (which frequently cause anxiety or depression). These comprise the majority of DMSO psychiatric studies, and collectively, these results help support the theory of psychiatric illness proposed by the previously mentioned Russian Researchers.
content.cn: 除了导致创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）的应激因素外，许多以啮齿类动物为对象的研究还模拟了其他各种应激情境（这些情境通常会引发焦虑或抑郁）。这些研究构成了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）精神病学研究的主体，而这些研究结果综合起来，有助于支持前文提到的俄罗斯研究人员提出的精神疾病理论。

content.en: •In chronic “social defeat” stress induced by repeated exposure to an aggressive male which attacks another rodent into submission, [DMSO combined with Dihydromyricetin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=K6QWI_fIKJGG_Z_FL6IsXbMqhySKeJaiL0DEqeNxC7-_jX9dUBlMCIop6UTVZSpH1fLcEL5cGV8IREtFul1qtVFu8aqj5JdlMv9SnX0YW8yXiZdrBYtarrZKmk0ngYYP2FnLTEMdHT8x2AeTaPnxn4CrKDJHvsaRsXQaJZzHYEx0ykOQNMHwRGDvtVXS1seK&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> significantly improved learning and memory, decreased immobility time, and reduced anxiety. [In another study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39820117/), Epothilone D, dissolved in DMSO, prevented brain changes in the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus caused by this type of stress. [Naringenin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29906750/) <sup>⬖</sup> attenuated social defeat-induced neurobehavioral deficits, reduced oxidative stress (brain MDA), restored glutathione, and lowered TNF-α and IL-1β.
content.cn: •在由反复接触一只攻击另一只啮齿类动物直至其屈服的具有攻击性的雄性动物所诱发的慢性“社会挫败”应激中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与二氢山柰酚 <sup>⬖</sup> 联合使用显著改善了学习和记忆能力，缩短了不动时间，并减轻了焦虑。 在另一项研究中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的埃波替隆D（Epothilone D）预防了此类应激在前额叶皮层和海马体中引发的脑部病变。柚皮苷（Naringenin） <sup>⬖</sup> 减轻了社会挫败诱导的神经行为缺陷，降低了氧化应激（脑内丙二醛），恢复了谷胱甘肽水平，并降低了肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）的水平。

content.en: Numerous studies have shown promise for mitigating the effects of chronic emotional-painful stress (typically three weeks of EPS).
content.cn: 大量研究表明，在缓解慢性情绪性痛苦压力（通常为三周的EPS）的影响方面，这一方法前景可期。

content.en: •In one,<sup data-ref="480">480</sup>, <sup data-ref="481">481</sup> DMSO prior to the stress, increased superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity in brain homogenates and serum, in another, DMSO also increased SOD activity and decreased ceruloplasmin-transferrin activity <sup data-ref="482">482</sup> —suggesting DMSO’s ability to neutralize chronic stress relates to DMSO reducing oxidative stress.
content.cn: •在一项研究中， <sup data-ref="482">482</sup> <sup data-ref="481">481</sup> 应激前给予二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可提高脑组织匀浆和血清中超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的活性；在另一项研究中，DMSO同样提高了SOD活性，并降低了铜蓝蛋白-转铁蛋白的活性 <sup data-ref="482">482</sup> ——这表明DMSO中和慢性应激的能力与其减轻氧化应激的作用有关。

content.en: • [In another](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/BF00854664), DMSO prior to chronic EPS completely prevented the development of gastric ulcers, blocked the stress-induced behavioral changes in the open field test (excessive locomotion, rearing, and reduced center exploration indicative of anxiety), and normalized the cardiovascular and autonomic responses, including the hypertension and altered heart and respiration rates that occurred both during stress and during subsequent immobilization. Additionally, like the previous studies, it markedly increased SOD activity in the brain.<sup data-ref="483">483</sup>, <sup data-ref="481">481</sup>
content.cn: • 在另一项研究中，慢性EPS治疗前给予DMSO可完全预防胃溃疡的发生，阻断了开放场试验中应激诱导的行为变化（过度活动、后腿站立以及中心区域探索减少等焦虑表现），并使心血管和自主神经反应恢复正常，包括应激期间及随后固定期间出现的高血压以及心率和呼吸频率的改变。 此外，与先前研究一致，它显著提高了大脑中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性。 <sup data-ref="483">483</sup> <sup data-ref="481">481</sup>

content.en: *Note: since DMSO interfered with the formation of malonic dialdehyde (a marker of lipid peroxidation) the investigators were unable to also measure if it reduced its formation within the brain.
content.cn: 注：由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）会干扰琥珀醛（一种脂质过氧化标志物）的形成，因此研究人员无法同时测定它是否能减少大脑内该物质的生成。*

content.en: The controversial [forced swimming test](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Behavioural_despair_test) (FST) evaluates depression through the shift from active coping behaviors to passive immobility in mice facing an inescapable stressor. Either alone or in combination with the tail suspension test, studies found DMSO in combination with the following substances elicited anti-depressant activity: [flavonoi](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27191791/) [ds from Alpinia oxyphylla](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27191791/https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27191791/)*,*<sup>⬖</sup> [cinnamon extract](https://d1wqtxts1xzle7.cloudfront.net/79481177/article-1-2344-fa-libre.pdf?1643031987=&response-content-disposition=inline%3B+filename%3DEffect_of_hydroalcoholic_extract_of_cinn.pdf&Expires=1773094522&Signature=E2giR4uCAQYTq8Schsx~-e2rezInu1dNtdFkHDVbCKehVQZr2ZgnJj4mKsJVnf6vnS9vU~klL0sb4oXo2yigRMyFd1Uqj9GKPvsm1mbB-1-UIBWbvQwKx~5dCCB38rp1RWpw8qHwoLEg3lsORrb3oMKBx2bF5tw~1QcmQduOkvTtR7xMVGgQxmExtAmfXP6t50CWFwo8PzqO1qDY0d0MSgzGGPGSHx1bY3bPw83IbLfeMQX0gVacWj7yrrmwK8TWQ6S~xvVQtPdBpVQWtkGi2-REG1WhOATUqVqBlp5LxCySFWw0a4qmOm9R3kC8q29N3r4i5K9nzRSvA2M9eNDvzA__&Key-Pair-Id=APKAJLOHF5GGSLRBV4ZA),<sup>⬖</sup> [asiatic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26016167/) <sup>⬖</sup> (comparable to midazolam), [trans-resveratrol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24364217/),<sup>⬖</sup> chrysin <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="484">484</sup>, <sup data-ref="485">485</sup> (which was further enhanced by prozac and similar in efficacy to diazepam), [ethanolic extract of Ptychopetalum olacoides](https://lume.ufrgs.br/bitstream/handle/10183/52485/000529996.pdf?sequence=1),<sup>⬖</sup> [essential oil of Nepeta rtanjensis](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Jean-Claude-Chalchat/publication/7588112_Effect_of_Different_Locations_on_the_Chemical_Composition_of_Essential_Oils_of_Laurel_Laurus_nobilis_L_Leaves_Growing_Wild_in_Turkey/links/561501d008ae983c1b41c3bc/Effect-of-Different-Locations-on-the-Chemical-Composition-of-Essential-Oils-of-Laurel-Laurus-nobilis-L-Leaves-Growing-Wild-in-Turkey.pdf#page=232) <sup>⬖</sup> (a monoamine oxidase inhibitor), [Riparin III](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25846646/) <sup>⬖</sup> (from an Amazonian plant), [methanolic extracts of Cuminum nigrum (L) <sup>⬖</sup> and Centratherum anthelminticum](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30772794/) <sup>⬖</sup> *(*which also reduced anxiety*)*, [ganoderic acid A](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202102&filename=1017215846.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=nzN-RjBc-GoJWWHW0t4o00gwV8tz5pp-SbyfG4b27tnvhjG2minC5viE4gdkpnCW),<sup>⬖</sup> [methanolic extract of Withania qaraitica](https://d1wqtxts1xzle7.cloudfront.net/100334610/27661-libre.pdf?1679930256=&response-content-disposition=inline%3B+filename%3DAntidepressant_Like_Activity_of_Methanol.pdf&Expires=1772171800&Signature=QWjuawRMcvjgDuWMCHMngdMSU5UCLUzspR8dyRGmI30e8cXpyO5sGwV2jVt~PuVtxIA~sJzmhliseSSkEOlL7FOm1sVA7msqrp62EGVXRY8f9vZF11x6kGbkwJkMR5RUZs6YrghKl-9xBOfP3DgqnUj4GdGwM0wwhYiMw-rGKQfcjw9l5KQI4mBsq3yiARaCRsRnSeNKku1Mz6eNmkYYoVlqF~dKZAzlcYA~98U75Ym9sVMjxCpxkNJ4bXOkFHTmVFENOOZOaFX9xeY50GXWuiJ3zJo1ZlV~UToReU1wWC7vfsNYbEZ~pcn52Wl09ynk6Jn2mk~Y4x3q5UBEQlqgfg__&Key-Pair-Id=APKAJLOHF5GGSLRBV4ZA) <sup>⬖</sup> (similar in efficacy to citalopram or desipramine), [oridonin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUob6xEC22mBk4F5h5xW_EJBsAnTzx1Wtd2Hf_PNf8d6aQnF4tHhKdOdSM7bc5n0XRHVFGwWsvb8Lhjc1CdZhniDovhwfe-N6Fohv9EEh2hRP2dn8zQNdWDsAzgO2qzj-wD092CeLhdWwsnLXaivBp3DbvisiYGYmhwMboNsoQUYUn9PyD1An2oJbkEJ-mvV9Lo=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN),<sup>⬖</sup> [alarin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25476565/), [ODQ and 7-NI](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12191834/), [Prozac](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Hina-Zahid/publication/265212077_Antidepressant_activity_of_ethanolic_extract_of_Hibiscus_rosa_sinenesis_Linn/links/5a13c7c50f7e9b1e57309e18/Antidepressant-activity-of-ethanolic-extract-of-Hibiscus-rosa-sinenesis-Linn.pdf), and a [cannabinoid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17762511/) CB1 receptor agonist.
content.cn: 备受争议的强制游泳试验（FST）通过观察小鼠在面临无法逃避的应激源时，从主动应对行为向被动静止状态的转变，来评估抑郁症状。 无论是单独使用还是与尾悬试验结合使用，研究发现二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与以下物质联合使用可产生抗抑郁活性：来自尖叶山姜（Alpinia oxyphylla）的黄酮类化合物、 <sup>⬖</sup> 肉桂提取物、 <sup>⬖</sup> 亚洲酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （其效果与咪达唑仑相当）、反式白藜芦醇、 <sup>⬖</sup> 木犀草素 <sup>⬖</sup> <sup data-ref="484">484</sup> <sup data-ref="485">485</sup> （其抗抑郁作用可被百忧解进一步增强，且疗效与地西泮相当）、Ptychopetalum olacoides的乙醇提取物、 <sup>⬖</sup> 兰坦猫薄荷 <sup>⬖</sup> 的精油（一种单胺氧化酶抑制剂）、 瑞帕林III <sup>⬖</sup> （源自亚马逊地区的一种植物）、黑孜然（Cuminum nigrum (L)） <sup>⬖</sup> 和驱虫草（Centratherum anthelminticum） <sup>⬖</sup> 的甲醇提取物（后者亦可减轻焦虑）、灵芝酸A、 <sup>⬖</sup> 卡拉伊蒂卡阿什瓦甘达的甲醇提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （疗效与西酞普兰或去甲丙咪嗪相当）、奥利多宁、 <sup>⬖</sup> 阿拉林、ODQ 和 7-NI、百忧解，以及一种大麻素 CB1 受体激动剂。

content.en: Chronic restraint stress is a common rodent test for modeling human depression, anxiety. For CRS rats, in combination with DMSO:
content.cn: 慢性束缚应激是模拟人类抑郁症和焦虑症的一种常见啮齿类动物实验模型。对于CRS大鼠，结合DMSO：

content.en: • [A caspase-1 inhibitor](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CDFD&dbname=CDFDLAST2018&filename=1017139376.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=o6z4K2fCHoayfTa4Dllca_LUlS_Ux1Nx6DOrUg0zvDD0jHRYVkoWZ-4opB6dp81a) reduced the immobility, social avoidance and anhedonia which followed CRS and social defeat stress.
content.cn: • 一种半胱天冬酶-1抑制剂减轻了限制性饮食综合征（CRS）和社交挫败应激后出现的活动减少、社交回避和快感缺失。

content.en: •Xiao Yao San <sup>⬖</sup> and a c-Jun (JNK) inhibitor repeatedly improved anxiety-like behaviors. Additionally, the Chinese herbal formula reduced phosphorylated JNK, JNK, and P-c-Jun protein and mRNA expression in hippocampus comparably to the JNK inhibitor in CRS rats with liver depression and spleen deficiency syndrome.<sup data-ref="486">486</sup>, <sup data-ref="487">487</sup>
content.cn: •逍遥散 <sup>⬖</sup> 与 c-Jun（JNK）抑制剂均能反复改善焦虑样行为。此外，在患有肝郁脾虚综合征的 CRS 大鼠中，该中药方剂降低了海马区磷酸化 JNK、JNK 及 P-c-Jun 蛋白和 mRNA 的表达水平，其效果与 JNK 抑制剂相当。 <sup data-ref="486">486</sup> <sup data-ref="487">487</sup>

content.en: •Intraperitoneal [quercetin](https://assets-eu.researchsquare.com/files/rs-1030799/v1/6e71a480-d801-4cbb-b29b-9a4848f46bf6.pdf) <sup>⬖</sup> significantly mitigated anxiety- and depression-like behaviors in CRS rats who also had restricted cerebral blood flow (via bilateral carotid artery stenosis) along with alleviating hippocampal demyelination, restoring myelin sheath thickness, reducing brain inflammation (via reduced IL-1β/TNF-α, increased IL-10/IL-4, promoted microglial M2 polarization) and enhanced microglial phagocytosis (elimination) of harmful myelin fragments.
content.cn: •腹腔注射槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著缓解了同时存在脑血流受限（通过双侧颈动脉狭窄引起）的 CRS 大鼠的焦虑和抑郁样行为，同时减轻了海马区的脱髓鞘现象，恢复了髓鞘厚度，减轻了脑部炎症（通过降低 IL-1β/TNF-α 水平、提高 IL-10/IL-4 水平， 促进小胶质细胞M2极化），并增强了小胶质细胞对有害髓鞘碎片的吞噬（清除）作用。

content.en: • [A corticotropin-releasing hormone](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2015&filename=DSDX201522014&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=yD_WXuA1MmrOppRhao2Gu4xAlnNR7mCI_ZH3I8vp9KtJSl1A-G_7pVvjSIRTWrDb) type 1 receptor antagonist prevented stress-induced decreases in body weight, sucrose preference, and locomotion along with hypothalamus BDNF and GAP-43 upregulation (as unlike in the hippocampus, hypothalamic increases are maladaptive).
content.cn: • 一种促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素1型受体拮抗剂可防止应激导致的体重下降、蔗糖偏好降低及活动能力减弱，同时伴随下丘脑中脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）和GAP-43表达上调（与海马区不同，下丘脑中的这种上调属于不良适应性反应）。

content.en: • [Safranal](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28866053/) <sup>⬖</sup> protected against restraint stress-induced oxidative brain damage and alleviated stress-induced behavioral changes.
content.cn: • 萨弗纳尔 <sup>⬖</sup> 可预防束缚应激引起的大脑氧化损伤，并缓解应激引起的行为改变。

content.en: • [Saikosaponin A <sup>⬖</sup> and paeoniflorin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201701&filename=1016208693.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=q6xZRvj9z5Mx_s24e6iYsvLaWnwufbs-HYbncw77Vdlsm6sP3HcBcV4MSpIyW7Yh) <sup>⬖</sup> relieved corticosterone induced inhibition of autophagic flux in PC12 cells by reducing LC3II/I, P62, and mTOR expression, suggesting a role in chronic stress.
content.cn: •柴胡皂苷A <sup>⬖</sup> 和芍药苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过降低LC3II/I、P62和mTOR的表达，缓解了皮质酮诱导的PC12细胞自噬流抑制，这表明它们在慢性应激中发挥着作用。

content.en: Depression
content.cn: 抑郁症

content.en: The Chronic Unpredictable Mild Stress (CUS) test mirrors the development of depression in humans is one of the top tests for evaluating it in rodents. Natural compounds, targeted pathway inhibitors, and clinically used pharmaceutical drugs (administered in combination with DMSO) showed the following beneficial effects in CUS-exposed rats:
content.cn: 慢性不可预测轻度应激（CUS）试验模拟了人类抑郁症的发病过程，是评估啮齿类动物抑郁症的首要试验之一。天然化合物、靶向通路抑制剂以及临床用药（与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合给药）在暴露于CUS的大鼠身上表现出以下有益作用：

content.en: • [A ptychopetalum olacoides](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19682881/) <sup>⬖</sup> extract preventedanxiety and hyperglycemia.
content.cn: • 一种名为 Ptychopetalum olacoides <sup>⬖</sup> 的植物提取物可预防焦虑和高血糖。

content.en: • [Intraperitoneal curcumin](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201601&filename=1015370682.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=nqWi72axdvLag7LFqt8qs9EHzp8lgc4u-2YFM-koLDwIykbnL7O31NVsy49YYC6g) <sup>⬖</sup> ameliorated depressive-like behavior and upregulated (neurotrophic) BDNF, PSD-95, synaptophysin, p-Limk1, and p-cofilin expression in the prefrontal cortex. [In another study](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201402&filename=1014314527.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=auBYH85v_DlJsP2Z18Lx19wRdKvdOjonnLpsIL4RPqXeiw9kHINBssS59huWT8WL), it also reversed CUS behaviors and upregulated those three neurotrophic proteins in the lateral amygdala.
content.cn: • 腹腔注射姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 缓解了抑郁样行为，并上调了前额叶皮层中（神经营养因子）BDNF、PSD-95、突触素、p-Limk1 和 p-cofilin 的表达。在另一项研究中，它还逆转了慢性应激（CUS）诱导的行为，并上调了外侧杏仁核中这三种神经营养因子的表达。

content.en: • [Oridonin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUob6xEC22mBk4F5h5xW_EJBsAnTzx1Wtd2Hf_PNf8d6aQnF4tHhKdOdSM7bc5n0XRHVFGwWsvb8Lhjc1CdZhniDovhwfe-N6Fohv9EEh2hRP2dn8zQNdWDsAzgO2qzj-wD092CeLhdWwsnLXaivBp3DbvisiYGYmhwMboNsoQUYUn9PyD1An2oJbkEJ-mvV9Lo=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (from *Rabdosia rubescens*) reduced social anxiety and depression, improved sucrose preference, open field activity, and neuronal morphology and cell numbers in prefrontal cortex and hippocampus and suppressed the inflammatory p38 MAPK/NF-κB/NLRP3 pathway.
content.cn: • 奥里多宁 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自红拉布多西亚）可减轻社交焦虑和抑郁症状，改善蔗糖偏好性、开放场活动，并改善前额叶皮层和海马区的神经元形态及细胞数量，同时抑制炎症性 p38 MAPK/NF-κB/NLRP3 信号通路。

content.en: The JNK blocker SP600125 partially modulated the hyperactive HPA axis by significantly lowering pituitary ACTH levels and upregulating glucocorticoid receptor (GR) expression in the hippocampal CA3 region compared to the solvent control, reduced the stress-induced increase in caspase-12 (suppressing hippocampal neuronal apoptosis), reduced C-jun (a pathway often overactivated in chronic stress) and enhanced electroacupuncture’s reduction of depression.<sup data-ref="488">488</sup>, <sup data-ref="489">489</sup>, <sup data-ref="490">490</sup>, <sup data-ref="491">491</sup>
content.cn: 与溶剂对照组相比，JNK抑制剂SP600125通过显著降低垂体ACTH水平，并在海马CA3区上调糖皮质激素受体（GR）的表达，部分调节了过度活跃的下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺（HPA）轴；同时，该药物减轻了应激诱导的caspase-12水平升高 （从而抑制海马神经元凋亡），降低了C-jun（一种在慢性应激中常过度活化的通路）的水平，并增强了电针疗法对抑郁症的缓解效果。 <sup data-ref="488">488</sup> <sup data-ref="489">489</sup> <sup data-ref="490">490</sup> <sup data-ref="491">491</sup>

content.en: • [Necrostatin-1](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34867405/) (which blocks inflammatory cell death) also improved depressive-like behaviors.
content.cn: • Necrostatin-1（可阻断炎症性细胞凋亡）也改善了抑郁样行为。

content.en: • [Intracerebroventricular](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25476565/) a [larin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25476565/) reduced depression, decreased latency to feed, and restored p-ERK/ERK and p-AKT/AKT (neurotrophic/neuroplasticity) activity in prefrontal cortex.
content.cn: • 脑室内给药可减轻抑郁症状，缩短进食潜伏期，并恢复前额叶皮层中p-ERK/ERK和p-AKT/AKT（神经营养/神经可塑性）的活性。

content.en: • [Agomelatine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35914635/) reduced TRPV1-mediated calcium influx, oxidative stress, and apoptosis in hippocampal neurons of chronically stressed rats, improving depression-related behaviors.
content.cn: • 阿戈美拉汀可减轻慢性应激大鼠海马神经元中TRPV1介导的钙离子内流、氧化应激和细胞凋亡，从而改善与抑郁相关的行为。

content.en: • [Pioglitazone](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahIe9LhY7GtitAZoB7qSWIRjLlS52A_V-QJf4UO_iVscbPHKQ5uDmB72oiY4eojeoFXpNFIpGHWjoN14l8NsuO0TmMHA17ZKnWqu6zkebmA4_uYRKvadHuvw102S7wba_trCSC9k02FRuo-LtL0k8JTNrDR8AfwL6-N5CM2jnrE8xArhjzD7qxW9GN_cWTItPMw=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) improved depressive-like behaviors, suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokine increases (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6), reduced M1/M2 microglial ratio, decreased NF-κB expression, and ameliorated peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) expression loss in the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus
content.cn: • 吡格列酮改善了抑郁样行为，抑制了促炎细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6）的升高，降低了M1/M2小胶质细胞的比例，减少了NF-κB的表达，并改善了前额叶皮层和海马区过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARγ）表达的缺失

content.en: • [Quetiapine ameliorated](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD201501&filename=1014047424.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=l1VGxyl7oFjJnq1sqQpNK8YUdLQbaIXe4WMSov_YdJCMsbvfik2uT1nwbFxTRMs_) depressive-like behavior in chronic unpredictable stress rats, increased hippocampal BDNF and phospho-ERK1/2 expression, and promoted neurogenesis **(and was synergistically enhanced by combination with** transcranial magnetic stimulation).
content.cn: • 喹硫平缓解了慢性不可预测应激大鼠的抑郁样行为，增加了海马区脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）和磷酸化ERK1/2的表达，并促进了神经发生（且与经颅磁刺激联合使用时，其效果呈协同增强）。

content.en: *Note: [DMSO alone decreased](https://cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CJFD&dbname=CJFDLAST2018&filename=JZYB201802011&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=DZCY9AeZJcv9x_7t8OQRdepkMa9n7qLx3_W4oNHxyjZE1hni1WUVbX-w-m5MAvJY) elevated caspase-12 protein expression in hippocampus (which can cause neuronal death).
content.cn: 注：单独使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可降低海马体中升高的caspase-12蛋白表达（该蛋白可导致神经元死亡）。*

content.en: Separating infant rats from their mothers produces long-term depressive-like behaviors (e.g., anhedonia, HPA-axis dysregulation, and reduced hippocampal neurogenesis) that mirror those seen in human adults with depression and chronic stress. [In separated rats](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1600-079X.2004.00157.x), melatonin <sup>⬖</sup> dissolved in DMSO significantly increased BrdU-positive cells and lowered glucocorticoid receptor expression in the dentate gyrus, directly counteracting the depressive process.
content.cn: 将幼鼠与母鼠分离会引发长期的抑郁样行为（例如，快感缺失、下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴紊乱以及海马神经发生减少），这些表现与患有抑郁症和慢性应激的人类成年人所表现出的症状相似。 在被分离的大鼠中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的褪黑素显著增加了齿状回中BrdU阳性细胞的数量，并降低了糖皮质激素受体的表达，从而直接抵消了抑郁过程。

content.en: *Note: The term “depression” is used for both a psychiatric (psychological/mood) state and a CNS-induced reduction in activity and alertness (neurologic depression or depressed mentation). These are related as inflammatory or infectious diseases can affect the nervous system and cause it partially shut down, triggering symptoms that overlap with both — such as reduced alertness/mentation and mood changes (often called “sickness behavior”). In certain cases, [such as a foal with brain damage from losing blood supply during childbirth](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16627116/), DMSO’s therapeutic activity on the nervous system also addressed the neurologic depression (improved alertness and mentation). In others, DMSO has been observed to help resolve psychiatric depression that followed an illness, likely through anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective effects on shared nervous-system pathways.
content.cn: 注：术语“抑郁”既指精神科（心理/情绪）状态，也指中枢神经系统（CNS）引发的活动和警觉性降低（神经性抑郁或思维抑制）。这两者之间存在关联，因为炎症或感染性疾病可能会影响神经系统并导致其部分功能停滞，从而引发与两者均重叠的症状——例如警觉性/思维能力下降以及情绪变化（通常称为“疾病行为”）。 在某些情况下，例如因分娩时供血不足导致脑损伤的驹，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对神经系统的治疗作用也改善了神经性抑郁（提高了警觉性和思维能力）。在其他情况下，观察到二甲基亚砜有助于缓解疾病后出现的精神性抑郁，这很可能是通过其对共同神经系统通路的抗炎和神经保护作用实现的。*

content.en: Anxiety
content.cn: 焦虑

content.en: In zebrafish, the willingness of zebrafish to leave dark areas to enter light areas is used to assess anxiety, and in this model, [DMSO alone reduced anxiety](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20523756/) (as did DMSO [in combination with the chalcone C2OHPDA](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37845792/)).
content.cn: 在斑马鱼中，利用斑马鱼离开黑暗区域进入明亮区域的意愿来评估其焦虑程度；在此模型中，仅使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）即可减轻焦虑（与二甲基亚砜联合使用查尔酮C2OHPDA同样具有减轻焦虑的作用）。

content.en: In mice and rats, the way they navigate specific mazes (e.g., elevated plus-maze test) or cross fields are used to evaluate anxiety. In one study, DMSO alone (10%, 0.5 µL) microinjected into the DPAG (a midbrain structure) greatly reduced anxiety and increased exploratory behavior.<sup data-ref="492">492</sup>, <sup data-ref="493">493</sup> In combination with DMSO the following agents were found to reduce anxiety: [eucalyptol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31566547/) <sup>⬖</sup> (primary component of eucalyptus oil), [cinnamomum](https://d1wqtxts1xzle7.cloudfront.net/79481177/article-1-2344-fa-libre.pdf?1643031987=&response-content-disposition=inline%3B+filename%3DEffect_of_hydroalcoholic_extract_of_cinn.pdf&Expires=1773094522&Signature=E2giR4uCAQYTq8Schsx~-e2rezInu1dNtdFkHDVbCKehVQZr2ZgnJj4mKsJVnf6vnS9vU~klL0sb4oXo2yigRMyFd1Uqj9GKPvsm1mbB-1-UIBWbvQwKx~5dCCB38rp1RWpw8qHwoLEg3lsORrb3oMKBx2bF5tw~1QcmQduOkvTtR7xMVGgQxmExtAmfXP6t50CWFwo8PzqO1qDY0d0MSgzGGPGSHx1bY3bPw83IbLfeMQX0gVacWj7yrrmwK8TWQ6S~xvVQtPdBpVQWtkGi2-REG1WhOATUqVqBlp5LxCySFWw0a4qmOm9R3kC8q29N3r4i5K9nzRSvA2M9eNDvzA__&Key-Pair-Id=APKAJLOHF5GGSLRBV4ZA) <sup>⬖</sup> (a hydroalcoholic extract), [marjoram](https://www.sid.ir/paper/105405/fa) <sup>⬖</sup> (extracted with DMSO), [luteolin](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1186/s13041-019-0539-z) <sup>⬖</sup> (following acute experimental colitis), [asiatic acid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26016167/),<sup>⬖</sup> [Casearin X](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28077331/),<sup>⬖</sup> [valepotriates](https://brieflands.com/journals/jid/articles/155412),<sup>⬖</sup> [5-MeO-DMT](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0014488620300078?via%3Dihub), [CCK-8](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0306452214005338), [CCK₂ agonists](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0304394004000801), [cannabinoid and vanilloid](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28539997/) (TRPV1) agonists.
content.cn: 在小鼠和大鼠身上，通常通过观察它们在特定迷宫（例如高架十字迷宫测试）中的行进方式或穿越试验场的表现来评估其焦虑水平。在一项研究中，将DMSO（10%，0.5 µL）单独微量注射到DPAG（中脑结构）中，可显著减轻焦虑并增强探索行为。 <sup data-ref="492">492</sup> <sup data-ref="493">493</sup> 研究发现，以下物质与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用可减轻焦虑：桉油精 <sup>⬖</sup> （桉树油的主要成分）、 肉桂 <sup>⬖</sup> （水醇提取物）、马郁兰 <sup>⬖</sup> （用二甲基亚砜提取）、木犀草素 <sup>⬖</sup> （急性实验性结肠炎后）、亚洲酸、 <sup>⬖</sup> 凯萨林X、 <sup>⬖</sup> 瓦莱波特里酸盐、 <sup>⬖</sup> 5-MeO-DMT、CCK-8、CCK₂ 激动剂、大麻素及香草素（TRPV1）激动剂。

content.en: • [A mGluR2/3 agonist dissolved in DMSO](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4423526) reduced anxiety in chicks stressed by brief social separation.
content.cn: • 溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的一种mGluR2/3激动剂，可减轻因短暂社会隔离而受到应激的雏鸡的焦虑。

content.en: *Note: [withania somnifera leaf extract](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27023641/)* <sup>⬖</sup> *(in DMSO) protected against benzo\[a\]pyrene-induced neurotoxicity in zebrafish **by restoring normal anxiety**, improving brain antioxidant status, and reducing neuronal damage in the optic tectum.*
content.cn: 注：印度人参叶提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> （溶于二甲基亚砜）通过恢复正常焦虑水平、改善大脑抗氧化状态以及减轻视盖区的神经元损伤，从而保护斑马鱼免受苯并\[a\]芘诱导的神经毒性。

content.en: Biological Stressors
content.cn: 生物应激因子

content.en: In addition to putting animals into psychologically stressful situations, a variety of stressors that directly injure the body have also been observed to trigger anxiety and depression and to respond to therapeutic combinations containing DMSO.
content.cn: 除了将动物置于心理压力情境之外，研究还发现，各种会直接对身体造成伤害的应激源也会引发焦虑和抑郁，并且对含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的联合疗法产生反应。

content.en: [Two AMPA-type glutamate receptor potentiators](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25338127/) reduced pain hypersensitivity and depression-like behavior in rats with neuropathic and inflammatory pain.
content.cn: 两种AMPA型谷氨酸受体增强剂减轻了患有神经病理性疼痛和炎症性疼痛的大鼠的疼痛超敏反应和抑郁样行为。

content.en: [In neuropathic pain caused b](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tfT_-f1Nr-qIWyGSqWkQStiU6x2h9BUKmBvzHSbvXLIzr0fnO3c59SjL1W4SR9B7xrNM7HecAbxuMmDNoJihHE1lcmtQMYYNxEv-a_C8nymfLiqnaAIwswq5TwuHVKKD_Cz4IFtguFh0NImjoZPr-hcDAzF0O8JLdsg3Cjz19UWzXZdJapvgyR9LSV97ElyACs=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) y a spared nerve injury (SNI), a DNA methyltransferase inhibitor (in DMSO) significantly improved depressive symptoms and increased neurotrophic brain BDNF levels. In [another SNI study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0361923024002260), a chemogenetic DREADD inhibitor (in DMSO) alleviated both pain and depressive symptoms and [in a third](https://pesquisa.bvsalud.org/portal/resource/pt/wpr-745662), rapamycin alleviated anxiety. depression and pain from an L5 SNI.
content.cn: 在由“幸存神经损伤”（SNI）引起的神经病理性疼痛中，一种DNA甲基转移酶抑制剂（溶于二甲基亚砜）显著改善了抑郁症状，并提高了大脑中神经营养因子BDNF的水平。在另一项关于SNI的研究中，一种化学遗传学DREADD抑制剂（溶于二甲基亚砜）同时缓解了疼痛和抑郁症状；而在第三项研究中，雷帕霉素缓解了由L5 SNI引起的焦虑、抑郁和疼痛。

content.en: [In rats](https://repo.odmu.edu.ua/xmlui/bitstream/handle/123456789/16670/Pervak.pdf?sequence=1) with pentylenetetrazol triggered epilepsy (which consistently produces anxiety and depression), rapamycin and pitolisant (dissolved in DMSO) markedly improved anxiety (2.7 fold improvement on a maze test) and depression (37.5% improvement in swim test).
content.cn: 在由戊烯四唑诱发的癫痫大鼠模型中（该模型会持续引发焦虑和抑郁），雷帕霉素和匹托利桑（溶于二甲基亚砜）显著改善了焦虑症状（迷宫测试中改善幅度达2.7倍）和抑郁症状（游泳测试中改善幅度达37.5%）。

content.en: [In mice](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27517628/) with LPS induced depression induced, resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO reversed their depression along with reversing neural inflammation and triggering neurogenesis (particularly within the hippocampus).
content.cn: 在LPS诱导抑郁的小鼠模型中，DMSO中的白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 不仅逆转了抑郁症状，还消除了神经炎症并促进了神经发生（特别是在海马区）。

content.en: [In mice with toxoplasmosis](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=BoNITJRTahLy8csJtDlW2Fmck_-_Hc8kt8f3QdA7vXjrEPdfehg6iCLHLIBr4Rg-j1Y8vb5ww6iVgjtg525wIQzXA6QogaDLBcYEBOyhTrTmAXOmjH4DMAsxEudci0X6hWHwPed5L93tPJXZVjOUYcnAydQIUTvd5_4j29kadMYA0SiYjfVf68ExOb22HsMfPufVNZlPCcA=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) triggered depression, arctigenin <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO significantly reduced depressive behaviors and brain inflammation by inhibiting key pro-inflammatory pathways (TLR4/NF-κB and TNFR1/NF-κB).
content.cn: 在因弓形虫病引发抑郁的小鼠模型中，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶液中的阿克蒂根素 <sup>⬖</sup> 通过抑制关键的促炎通路（TLR4/NF-κB 和 TNFR1/NF-κB），显著减轻了抑郁行为和脑部炎症。

content.en: [In ovariectomized](https://oversea.cnki.net/KCMS/detail/detail.aspx?dbcode=CMFD&dbname=CMFD202001&filename=1020713993.nh&uniplatform=OVERSEA&v=kAxl-64ER_ZMd-uFmwSpH08m5LKIUJhKeoN0TwAm1x-7UtXgbgg_L0arrkdc8Zxr) (OVX) mice modeling menopause, resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO significantly reduced ovariectomy (ovary removal) induced anxiety and depression and neural inflammation (particularly within the hippocampus).
content.cn: 在模拟绝经的卵巢切除（OVX）小鼠模型中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著减轻了卵巢切除（摘除卵巢）引起的焦虑、抑郁和神经炎症（尤其是海马区）。

content.en: [In mice](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=hmNf6PfbaBubPxIQp1HLrxs7MD5zZElVevtJ29WtUiXkXeNcPCxSFkilEBDY1kCLdZbqw5t2VVAdREddA7qrdGCLbCNxF6avHHf3faQ1PEAMP6Ji3ZRBDzIfyNTTYs10E2x7scLVetox_Ss781iGu1_1InS2hcrWtYTf7JR7clsEb4WnNhcVzvfelE3BD1Zn&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) with anxiety induced by high-fat diet, Japanese ginseng <sup>⬖</sup> in DMSO significantly reduced anxiety-like behaviors, increased brain BDNF and synaptophysin levels, and reversed the brain’s FGF21 resistance (a key driver of the anxiety).
content.cn: 在因高脂饮食诱发焦虑的小鼠模型中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的日本人参 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著减轻了焦虑样行为，提高了大脑中脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）和突触素的水平，并逆转了大脑对成纤维细胞生长因子21（FGF21）的抵抗性（这是引发焦虑的关键因素）。

content.en: [In mice, Naringenin](http://protecting%20amygdala%20neurons/) <sup>⬖</sup> improved hypoxia-triggered depression and anxiety, along with reducing brain oxidative stress and inflammation, increasing BDNF expression, and protecting amygdala neurons.
content.cn: 在小鼠实验中，柚皮苷 <sup>⬖</sup> 不仅改善了缺氧引发的抑郁和焦虑，还减轻了大脑的氧化应激和炎症，提高了脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）的表达，并保护了杏仁核神经元。

content.en: In mice exposed to X-rays after consuming saccharin (as this conditions them to avoid the sweetener), topical DMSO prior to the X-ray largely prevented this condition aversion (there was an 8% rather than 66% drop in saccharin consumption). A later study had similar results, suggesting DMSO counteracts the stress that would otherwise create the aversion.<sup data-ref="494">494</sup>, <sup data-ref="495">495</sup>
content.cn: 在摄入甜味素后接受X射线照射的小鼠中（因为这种处理会使它们对甜味素产生厌恶反应），若在X射线照射前局部涂抹二甲基亚砜（DMSO），则能很大程度上防止这种厌恶反应的发生（甜味素摄入量仅下降了8%，而非66%）。后续研究得出了类似的结果，这表明DMSO能够抵消原本会导致厌恶反应的应激效应。 <sup data-ref="494">494</sup> <sup data-ref="495">495</sup>

content.en: *Note: lastly some of the DMSO combinations described in the previous sections were used to treat conditions directly triggered by a pharmaceutical (e.g., [depression from corticosterone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25846646/) or [anxiety from salicylates](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0014488620300078?via%3Dihub)).
content.cn: 注：最后，前几节中描述的某些二甲基亚砜（DMSO）组合被用于治疗由药物直接引发的病症（例如，由皮质酮引起的抑郁症或由水杨酸盐引起的焦虑症）。*

content.en: Psychosis
content.cn: 精神病

content.en: • [DMSO was proposed to exert antipsychotic](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1361959/) effects by modulating chronic macrophage activation and downstream cytokine dysregulation, particularly interleukin-2 signaling, thereby reducing schizophrenia symptoms across disease phases through immune regulation.
content.cn: • 有研究提出，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通过调节慢性巨噬细胞活化及其下游细胞因子失调（尤其是白细胞介素-2信号传导），从而发挥抗精神病作用，进而通过免疫调节在精神分裂症的各个病程阶段减轻症状。

content.en: •MK-801, a drug with the same mechanism as psychosis-inducing phencyclidine (PCP) and ketamine, is used to induce schizophrenia in rodents. A study found that [atypical antipsychotics](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16123741/) and the Src kinase inhibitor PP1, dissolved in DMSO, significantly attenuated MK-801-induced cortical (brain) injury in rats, with the protective potency of the antipsychotics correlating with their clinical effectiveness in treating psychosis.
content.cn: •MK-801是一种与诱发精神病的苯环利定（PCP）和氯胺酮作用机制相同的药物，用于在啮齿类动物中诱发精神分裂症。 一项研究发现，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）中的非典型抗精神病药物和Src激酶抑制剂PP1，能显著减轻MK-801在大鼠中诱发的皮质（大脑）损伤，且抗精神病药物的保护效力与其在治疗精神病方面的临床疗效呈正相关。

content.en: • [In a MK-801 rat study](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDsrQh_1xCdo9bej83hjZ4GZYId0yDVVI4dmETFHZd8lzcFIP5miiilVrbt-ihd5jASRegRzsfODvObvcy2jYSV3Mc0ovH4KOqzXm6KB_8kf7mnBDUWMugzOcbA7gQDiUkPmwqqog_9AsUclpz8ji9iMFx41CjN5G3U5XIn1vXsn0ox-JxFDJjy&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), three different drugs that activated the α7nAChR receptor (when combined with DMSO), significantly improved schizophrenic behaviors by increasing following behavior and total interaction time, decreasing avoidance behavior time along with creating therapeutic changes within the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus (increased α7 nAChR protein expression, increased cAMP levels, decreased PDE4A and PDE4D protein expression).
content.cn: • 在一项针对MK-801大鼠的研究中，三种能够激活α7nAChR受体（与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用时）的药物，通过增加追随行为和总互动时间、减少回避行为时间，显著改善了精神分裂症样行为，并在前额叶皮层和海马体中引发了治疗性变化（α7nAChR蛋白表达增加、cAMP水平升高、PDE4A和PDE4D蛋白表达降低）。

content.en: • [Diosmin <sup>⬖</sup> attenuated hyperactivity](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36652038/), behavioral deficits, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation in a mouse model of LPS plus ketamine-induced schizophrenia-like symptoms.
content.cn: •在LPS联合氯胺酮诱导的类精神分裂症症状小鼠模型中，迪奥斯明 <sup>⬖</sup> 减轻了多动、行为缺陷、氧化应激和神经炎症。

content.en: • [In another MK-801 schizophrenia study](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=hmNf6PfbaBvOzLVeM86csXrm9D6aRlSUwX5Yx5tePIrIXMTTdb0_xl1RAjUGF2bE1WR6_CB5JVKITlUvT9rw6AnhXrJt4rtdt1pBVdeyJ-UsLiHR8-c7oMYDnYBAncM3nuEWPNlI4rlgzqvGRMII1cOEtNlt0OfHO9hBePHnqktZ3344sOgN-HsNivM4DGF2&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), the flavanoid Fisetin <sup>⬖</sup> (given intraperitoneally in DMSO) significantly decreased rat escape latency, increased space exploration time and platform crossings and (beneficially) phosphorylated CaMKII, ERK1/2, and CREB.
content.cn: • 在另一项关于MK-801治疗精神分裂症的研究中，黄酮类化合物槲皮素 <sup>⬖</sup> （以二甲基亚砜为溶剂腹腔注射）显著缩短了大鼠的逃逸潜伏期，增加了空间探索时间和平台穿越次数，并（有益地）促进了CaMKII、ERK1/2和CREB的磷酸化。

content.en: In addition to these combinations treating schizophrenia, [tinospora cordifolia](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22247829/) <sup>⬖</sup> (an Ayurvedic herb) dissolved in DMSO demonstrated antipsychotic activaty in mice given (psychosis-inducing) amphetamines (along with [curcumin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33819551/) <sup>⬖</sup> [in DMSO](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33819551/) counteracting methamphetamine-induced neurotoxicity and spatial memory impairment in rats).
content.cn: 除了这些用于治疗精神分裂症的复方制剂外，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的心叶藤（tinospora cordifolia <sup>⬖</sup> ，一种阿育吠陀草药）在给予（诱发精神病）安非他明的小鼠身上表现出抗精神病活性（此外，溶于二甲基亚砜的姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 可抵消甲基苯丙胺在大鼠体内引起的神经毒性和空间记忆障碍）。

content.en: *Note: [a study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21820819/) (which found female rats were more prone to developing methamphetamine addictions than male rats) found modafinil dissolved in DMSO, attenuated METH-seeking behavior in both sexes. [Another study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12423779/pdf/25789430-2025-micropub.biology.001720.pdf) found parthenolide (dissolved in 1% DMSO) partially blocked cocaine’s actions in the brain (but it is unlikely this could translate to a cocaine addiction therapy).
content.cn: 注：一项研究（该研究发现雌性大鼠比雄性大鼠更容易对甲基苯丙胺产生依赖）发现，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的莫达非尼可减轻两性大鼠对甲基苯丙胺的寻求行为。另一项研究发现，帕尔特诺利德（溶于1%的二甲基亚砜）可部分阻断可卡因在大脑中的作用（但这不太可能应用于可卡因成瘾的治疗）。*

content.en: Sedation and relaxation are sometimes reported from DMSO use (e.g., [sedation has been repeatedly observed](https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/annurev.pa.12.040172.002033) in humans and animals at higher doses, [intraperitoneal DMSO was observed](https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/annurev.pa.12.040172.002033) to cause a decrease in spontaneous motor activity and [in one large trial](https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/annurev.pa.12.040172.002033), 3% of DMSO users reported increased tiredness). This is likely due to DMSO increasing parasympathetic tone ([due to it inhibiting acetylcholinesterase](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-is-a-miraculous-therapy-for)), and may partially account for DMSO’s psychiatric properties as excessive sympathetic activity plays a key role in anxiety, mania and psychosis.
content.cn: 有报告称使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）有时会引起镇静和放松（例如，在较高剂量下，人类和动物中均多次观察到镇静现象；腹腔注射二甲基亚砜被发现会导致自发运动活动减少；在一项大型试验中，3%的二甲基亚砜使用者报告称疲劳感加重）。 这很可能是由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）增加了副交感神经张力（因其抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶），并且可能部分解释了DMSO的心理作用，因为过度的交感神经活动在焦虑、躁狂和精神病中起着关键作用。*

content.en: Note: I find a significant portion of psychiatric issues result from excessive sympathetic activity or deficient parasympathetic tone (e.g., the “buzz” that state creates frequently creates anxiety), and likewise many (myself included) believe a significant number of health issues result from vagal (parasympathetic) dysfunction. Given that DMSO can both directly increase parasympathetic function and also heal or restore the function of nerves (along with potentially relaxing tight muscles compressing them), it is possible some of DMSO’s benefits in psychiatric conditions arise from its effect on vagal function.
content.cn: 注：我发现相当一部分精神问题源于交感神经活动过度或副交感神经张力不足（例如，这种状态产生的“兴奋感”往往会引发焦虑），同样，许多人（包括我自己在内）认为，相当多的健康问题源于迷走神经（副交感神经）功能障碍。 鉴于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）既能直接增强副交感神经功能，又能修复或恢复神经功能（同时可能放松压迫神经的紧绷肌肉），因此DMSO在精神疾病治疗中的一些益处，很可能源于其对迷走神经功能的影响。*

content.en: Finally, like many other therapeutic agents, DMSO has also been combined with antipsychotics. For example, [with intraperitoneal haloperidol](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/2170802/), it facilitated haloperidol-induced 1.8-fold increases in striatal preproenkephalin mRNA and 1.6-fold increases in total endogenous opioid peptides (with no effect in other brain regions), increasing antipsychotic efficacy, and potentially reducing pain or antipsychotic extrapyramidal side effects.
content.cn: 最后，与许多其他治疗药物一样，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被用于与抗精神病药物联合使用。 例如，与腹腔注射氟哌啶醇联合使用时，它促进了氟哌啶醇诱导的纹状体前前脑啡肽mRNA水平增加1.8倍，以及内源性阿片肽总量增加1.6倍（对其他脑区无影响），从而提高了抗精神病药的疗效，并可能减轻疼痛或抗精神病药引起的锥体外系副作用。

content.en: *Note: a variety of antipsychotics have used DMSO as a vehicle (e.g., [this study](https://d1wqtxts1xzle7.cloudfront.net/99748696/j.euroneuro.2018.11.59620230312-1-1bp3wri-libre.pdf?1678633504=&response-content-disposition=inline%3B+filename%3DObjective_equilibriometric_quantificatio.pdf&Expires=1773174747&Signature=PQbO8NR4HEhGO~346DyBm7jaiAo~07JyQSqPjbOLho9GYn-7YH8~4bb9rDf3pp3q0dp94Nj7kOJEDnRzgweuAPPJZsZaLs8Rc92AKKO8V3rMFLdhS9haCrHNiFfSxMACbhF-GRWBYvCo9SLVxak0~cyplXl3hrkM6kvWQT1p8gEhLUKU28dZeRcTK0Mk0R6aCYsr7lPuPosVnGG91czVMHJy-k-3G7ALYn6144afGpUCikkUNh26O9~3GzHztCgpPI8a3CAJpqsyudaIiluKch7GFWWhgfsROZbMRCH-g85Gi0KJV66gVPKAfCuey0IeAl0dEB5hGn15tfSUQOTErQ__&Key-Pair-Id=APKAJLOHF5GGSLRBV4ZA) did so with intraperitoneal olanzapine, amisulpride, quetiapine and aripiprazole, while [this one did](https://kanazawa-u.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/17751/files/AN00044397-102-035.pdf) so with haloperidol, clozapine, RMI-81582 and risperidone).
content.cn: 注：多种抗精神病药物曾将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）用作给药载体（例如，本研究将奥氮平、阿米舒必利、奎硫平和阿立哌唑通过腹腔注射时采用了这种方法，而另一项研究则将氟哌啶醇、氯氮平、RMI-81582和利培酮通过腹腔注射时采用了这种方法）。*

content.en: Sleep
content.cn: 睡眠

content.en: Sleep is one of the most important, yet least appreciated facets of our existence, as sleep healing the body and integrating our minds is an immensely complex process that can easily be derailed (e.g., poor sleep causes neurodegeneration, and neurodegeneration worsens sleep). Sadly, rather than support it, our medical system defaults to treating insomnia with sedatives (e.g., sleeping pills) which “put you to sleep” but also sedate the restorative process of sleep—which is tragic, as restoring healthy sleep is frequently one of the top three things which needs to be done to heal chronic illnesses.
content.cn: 睡眠是我们生命中最重要的方面之一，却往往最不被重视，因为睡眠在修复身体和整合思维方面的作用是一个极其复杂的过程，很容易受到干扰（例如，睡眠质量差会导致神经退行性病变，而神经退行性病变又会进一步恶化睡眠质量）。 遗憾的是，我们的医疗体系非但没有支持这一过程，反而默认使用镇静剂（如安眠药）来治疗失眠。这些药物虽然能“让你入睡”，却同时也抑制了睡眠的恢复过程——这实在令人痛心，因为恢复健康的睡眠往往是治愈慢性疾病所需采取的三大措施之一。

content.en: Since DMSO heals the nervous system and restores impaired fluid circulation (which I believe is what ultimately underlies many cases of insomnia), I hence was hopeful DMSO could be a remarkable sleep aid to facilitate restorative sleep.
content.cn: 由于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能修复神经系统并恢复受阻的体液循环（我认为这正是许多失眠病例的根本原因），因此我曾寄希望于DMSO能成为一种卓越的助眠剂，帮助人们获得恢复性的睡眠。

content.en: Yet, in the 6,000 reports I’ve received from readers, I have only received a few reports indicating that happened.<sup data-ref="496">496</sup>, <sup data-ref="497">497</sup>, <sup data-ref="498">498</sup>, <sup data-ref="499">499</sup>, <sup data-ref="500">500</sup>, <sup data-ref="501">501</sup>, <sup data-ref="502">502</sup>, <sup data-ref="503">503</sup>, <sup data-ref="504">504</sup>, <sup data-ref="505">505</sup>, <sup data-ref="506">506</sup>
content.cn: 然而，在我收到的6,000份读者报告中，只有少数几份报告提到发生了这种情况。 <sup data-ref="496">496</sup> <sup data-ref="497">497</sup> <sup data-ref="498">498</sup> <sup data-ref="499">499</sup> <sup data-ref="500">500</sup> <sup data-ref="501">501</sup> <sup data-ref="502">502</sup> <sup data-ref="503">503</sup> <sup data-ref="504">504</sup> <sup data-ref="505">505</sup> <sup data-ref="506">506</sup>

content.en: [The thing](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/166793921) I have noticed most recently is a reduction of fatigue. I used to indulge in a daily nap, then go to bed and sleep another 8-9 hours at night. Now, if I try to nap I just can’t be bothered. I sleep my normal sleep at night and awaken refreshed.
content.cn: 最近我最明显的感觉是疲劳感减轻了。以前我每天都要睡个午觉，晚上上床后还要再睡8到9个小时。现在，就算想午睡，我也提不起劲来。晚上照常睡觉，醒来时神清气爽。

content.en: *Note: [another reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/77998422) had an almost identical experience, while [another reported DMSO](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/125020383) addressed the excessive sleep they had long required following a stroke.

content.en: [I take a couple of mls before bed](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/105250566) helps dramatically improve my sleep.
content.cn: 我睡前服用几毫升，这能显著改善我的睡眠质量。

content.en: [I feel amazing](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/170495216). My sleep is generally remarkable.
content.cn: 我感觉棒极了。我的睡眠质量通常都很棒。

content.en: [I love the really deep sleep it gives me](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/105254987). Feeling very tired after months of long intense work, I took a small dose one morning just because. An hour later I had no choice but to sleep. Woke up hours later totally refreshed. Amazing stuff.
content.cn: 我特别喜欢它能让我睡得特别香。经过数月高强度的工作后，我感到非常疲惫，某天早上就这么随手吃了一小剂量。一小时后，我不得不睡着了。几个小时后醒来时，感觉神清气爽。真是太神奇了。

content.en: [I have started using it instead of Hydroxyzine](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/80695669), which I use at times. No side effects!
content.cn: 我已经开始用它代替我偶尔服用的羟嗪了。没有任何副作用！

content.en: *Note: a few readers have also reported an energizing effect from DMSO causing them to wake up after much shorter periods and feeling refreshed (which may be positive or negative).
content.cn: 注：也有少数读者反映，DMSO具有提神效果，使他们在更短的时间后便醒来，并感到神清气爽（这可能有好有坏）。*

content.en: However, in the reports I’ve received, two consistent patterns have jumped out.
content.cn: 然而，在我收到的报告中，有两个明显的共同特征格外引人注目。

content.en: **First**, while DMSO did not inherently function as a “sleeping pill” a large number of people reported that DMSO cured an ailment which was causing insomnia, and I have received dozens of reports from individuals stating DMSO allowing them to sleep profoundly improved their life (including cases where they had previously been suicidal). This, in turn, highlights the flaws of the symptom-based approach to medicine we practice, as many cases of insomnia which have clearly identifiable causes (that are never addressed) are instead simply “treated” with sleeping pills.
content.cn: 首先，尽管二甲基亚砜（DMSO）本身并不具有“安眠药”的作用，但仍有大量人报告称，DMSO治愈了导致他们失眠的某种疾病；而且我收到了数十份个人报告，称DMSO帮助他们入睡，从而极大地改善了他们的生活（其中包括此前曾有自杀倾向的案例）。 这反过来凸显了我们当前所奉行的、以症状为导向的医疗方式的缺陷——许多成因明确（却从未得到解决）的失眠病例，反而仅仅被用安眠药“治疗”了。

content.en: Two factors can potentially explain this. First, by DMSO healing the nervous system and restoring circulation, this likely aids the neurological apparatus which facilitates dreaming. Second, two compounds are commonly used to facilitate lucid dreaming, 5HTP (as the above reader used) and galantamine (one of the few drugs I’ve ever used, primarily because of its phenomenal effects with lucid dreaming— **provided you do not use an excessive dose**). Galantamine is an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor, and since DMSO is also widely recognized to do so, this likely accounts for it increasing the vividness of dreams. However, the effects I’ve noticed from the two are very different (to the point it would not have occurred to me a similar mechanism was involved), so if this theory is valid, my best guess is DMSO should be viewed as a much weaker acetylcholinesterase inhibitor which only affects the dreams of a subset of the population.
content.cn: 有两个因素可能解释了这一点。首先，DMSO 通过修复神经系统并恢复血液循环，这很可能有助于神经系统的运作，从而促进做梦。其次，有两种化合物常被用于促进清醒梦，即 5-HTP（如上述读者所用）和加兰他敏（这是我曾使用过的为数不多的药物之一，主要是因为它对清醒梦有惊人的效果——前提是不要过量服用）。 加兰他敏是一种乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂，而二甲基亚砜（DMSO）也被广泛认为具有同样的作用，这很可能就是它能增强梦境生动性的原因。 然而，我观察到这两者的效果截然不同（甚至让我从未想到它们涉及相似的作用机制），因此如果这一理论成立，我最合理的推测是：DMSO应被视为一种效力较弱的乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制剂，仅对部分人群的梦境产生影响。
