content.en: Sleep Research
content.cn: 睡眠研究

content.en: The limited literature on DMSO and sleep shows the following:
content.cn: 关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与睡眠的文献虽不多，但显示了以下内容：

content.en: **1.** DMSO alone generally has a minimal impact on the sleep cycle. For example, [a 2005 rat study](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0378427405000810) found 5% and 10% DMSO administered intraperitoneally had no effects on sleep architecture, but 15% and 20% shifted deep sleep to light sleep. This indicates the doses individuals take are unlikely to affect sleep unless they are in the sensitive minority. Likewise, [in a study where intraperitoneal](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17588683/) corticotropin releasing factor was found to make rats REM sleep become Non-rem sleep, DMSO alone (at an unspecified dose) was found to have no effect on sleep architecture.
content.cn: 1\. 单独使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）通常对睡眠周期影响甚微。例如，一项2005年的大鼠研究发现，腹腔注射5%和10%浓度的DMSO对睡眠结构没有影响，但15%和20%浓度的DMSO会将深度睡眠转变为浅度睡眠。这表明，除非属于对DMSO敏感的少数人群，否则个人摄入的剂量不太可能影响睡眠。 同样，在一项研究中，虽然发现腹腔注射促肾上腺皮质激素释放因子会使大鼠的快速眼动睡眠（REM）转变为非快速眼动睡眠（NREM），但单独使用二甲基亚砜（剂量未明确）被发现对睡眠结构没有影响。

content.en: *Note: [one literature review](https://www.babyblog.ru/user/svetilein/3165985) cited a Russian report that one side effect of DMSO is sleep disturbance, but I have not seen this mentioned anywhere else.
content.cn: 注：有一篇文献综述引用了一份俄罗斯报告，称二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的副作用之一是睡眠障碍，但我尚未在其他任何地方看到相关提及。*

content.en: **2.** A few references corroborate that DMSO’s healing qualities improve sleep by healing something else causing insomnia:
content.cn: 2\. 一些文献证实，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的治疗功效通过治愈导致失眠的其他病因，从而改善睡眠：

content.en: • [In a study of 35 men with](https://web.archive.org/web/20250502052147/http:/www.irbis-nbuv.gov.ua/cgi-bin/irbis_nbuv/cgiirbis_64.exe?C21COM=2&I21DBN=UJRN&P21DBN=UJRN&IMAGE_FILE_DOWNLOAD=1&Image_file_name=PDF/Savm_2011_18_50.pdf) exacerbated knee osteoarthritis (and upper gastrointestinal bleeding), in addition to topical 50% DMSO (with hydrocortisone, lidocaine and potassium iodide) reducing their knee pain, it also improved their sleep (and ability to work). Specifically, on a -3 (worst) to 3 (best), scale, their baseline sleep score (0.4 ± 0.2) improved to 1.1 ± 0.4 with the DMSO combination, and to 2.8 ± 0.5 when the combination was used with physical therapy.
content.cn: • 在一项针对35名患有加重型膝关节骨关节炎（并伴有上消化道出血）的男性患者的研究中，外用50%二甲基亚砜（含氢化可的松、利多卡因和碘化钾）不仅减轻了他们的膝关节疼痛，还改善了他们的睡眠质量（及工作能力）。 具体而言，在-3（最差）至3（最佳）的评分量表上，受试者的基线睡眠评分（0.4 ± 0.2）在使用二甲基亚砜复方制剂后改善至1.1 ± 0.4，而当该复方制剂与物理治疗联合使用时，评分进一步改善至2.8 ± 0.5。

content.en: • [In 40 patients (on average 53.](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=36909201)7 years old) with cervical osteochondrosis complicated by shoulder myofascial pain syndrome, topical DMSO (in combination with other analgesics) and physiotherapy and acupuncture fully resolved the pain for 34 (85%), partially improved it for 6 (15%) and in all patients, there was a significant improvement in sleep.
content.cn: • 在40例合并肩部肌筋膜疼痛综合征的颈椎骨关节病患者（平均年龄53.7岁）中，局部应用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）（联合其他镇痛药）配合物理治疗和针灸，使34例（85%）患者的疼痛完全缓解，6例（15%）患者的疼痛部分缓解，且所有患者的睡眠质量均显著改善。

content.en: • [In a clinical guide](https://repository.tma.uz/jspui/bitstream/1/3865/1/%D0%9A%D0%B0%D1%84%D1%82%20%D0%B2%D0%B0%20%D0%B1%D0%B0%D1%80%D0%BC%D0%BE%D0%BA%20%D1%85%D0%B8%D1%80%D1%83%D1%80%D0%B3%D0%B8%D0%BA%20%D0%B8%D0%BD%D1%84%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%86%D0%B8%D1%8F%D1%81%D0%B8.pdf) from Uzbekistan on surgical infections of the hand and fingers, DMSO was recommended as a conservative treatment (in combination with novocaine and an antibiotic) and for abscess in the fingertip pad to prevent them from becoming painful enough to cause “sleepless nights” and require surgery. In [a Ukranian dental manual](https://ijmr.com.ua/web/uploads/pdf/International%20Journal%20of%20Medicine%20and%20Medical%20Research_2021_Vol.7_No.2,%202021_116823-58-65.pdf), DMSO was recommended for healing (and preventing infections) of dry sockets, as it resolved the conditions and improved numerous associated things including disrupted sleep.
content.cn: • 在乌兹别克斯坦关于手部和手指手术感染的一份临床指南中，建议将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）作为保守治疗手段（与诺卡因和抗生素联合使用），并用于治疗指尖肉垫脓肿，以防止其疼痛加剧到“彻夜难眠”的程度，从而避免手术。 在乌克兰的一本牙科手册中，二甲基亚砜被推荐用于干槽症的愈合（及预防感染），因为它能缓解症状并改善包括睡眠障碍在内的多种相关问题。

content.en: • [In a study of patients with localize](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=37473932) d scleroderma, daily topical DMSO (and a few other therapies) significantly improved skin lesions, prevented relapse and improved emotional health, appetite and sleep.
content.cn: • 在一项针对局限性硬皮病患者的研究中，每日外用二甲基亚砜（以及其他几种疗法）显著改善了皮肤病变，预防了复发，并改善了患者的情绪健康、食欲和睡眠质量。

content.en: **3:** Most of the existing research on DMSO for sleep involved it being a delivery vehicle that was combined with another sleep-promoting agent either to facilitate its action or make it more potent. These broke into four categories, two of which supported the observations in reader reports.
content.cn: 3：现有关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）对睡眠影响的研究大多将其作为载体，与另一种促眠剂结合使用，以促进后者的作用或增强其效力。这些研究可分为四类，其中两类的研究结果与读者报告中的观察结果相吻合。

content.en: **Potentiation of sleeping medications:
content.cn: 安眠药的药效增强作用：**

content.en: • [Prior administration of DMSO](https://europepmc.org/article/med/7121125) increased the sleeping time created by pentobarbitone sodium by 78%. Conversely, another study found [hexobarbital sleeping times](https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/annurev.pa.12.040172.002033) were not altered when 2.5 g/kg of 25% DMSO were given subcutaneously to mice beforehand.
content.cn: • 预先给予二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可使戊巴比妥钠诱导的睡眠时间增加78%。相反，另一项研究发现，若事先向小鼠皮下注射2.5 g/kg的25%二甲基亚砜溶液，则六巴比妥诱导的睡眠时间并无变化。

content.en: • [A DMSO dissolved fracti](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/14786419.2011.613388) on of a Coriandrum sativum extract <sup>⬖</sup> accelerated and prolonged pentobarbital induced sleep more than any other agent tested (including diazepam).
content.cn: • 芫荽（Coriandrum sativum）提取物中经二甲基亚砜（DMSO）溶解的分馏物 <sup>⬖</sup> 所诱导的戊巴比妥睡眠，其起效速度和持续时间均优于所测试的任何其他药物（包括地西泮）。

content.en: •A Marjoram DMSO extract <sup>⬖</sup> and separately a Nardostachys jatamansi rhizome extract <sup>⬖</sup> significantly increased ketamine-induced sleep duration.<sup data-ref="613">613</sup>, <sup data-ref="614">614</sup>
content.cn: •马郁兰的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及单独使用的纳多斯塔奇斯·贾塔曼西（Nardostachys jatamansi）根茎提取物 <sup>⬖</sup> 均显著延长了氯胺酮诱导的睡眠持续时间。 <sup data-ref="613">613</sup> <sup data-ref="614">614</sup>

content.en: **Modulation of circadian sleeping times (with potential utility for jet lag):
content.cn: 昼夜节律睡眠时间的调节（可能对缓解时差反应有帮助）：**

content.en: • [Melatonin](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10219488/),<sup>⬖</sup> which accelerated re-entrainment of the mouse’s circadian rhythm after a 6-hour phase shift and also made mice more susceptible to light-induced circadian shifts.<sup data-ref="615">615</sup>, <sup data-ref="616">616</sup> In two other studies, Triazolam (a sleeping pill dissolved in DMSO) shifted and lengthened hamsters’ circadian rhythm, whereas DMSO alone only created a small non-significant shift.<sup data-ref="617">617</sup>, <sup data-ref="618">618</sup> Finally, [DMSO’s metabolite, MSM](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40938468/) <sup>⬖</sup> (in DMSO) mitigated neurobehavioral impairment, oxidative stress, and disruptions in clock gene expression in mice exposure to alcohol combined with circadian rhythm disruption.*Note: we suspect DMSO has a significant synergy with photobiomodulation, but still do not have enough data to claim anything definitive.*
content.cn: • 褪黑素， <sup>⬖</sup> 它不仅能加速小鼠在经历6小时相位偏移后昼夜节律的重新同步，还使小鼠更容易受到光诱导的昼夜节律变化影响。 <sup data-ref="617">617</sup> <sup data-ref="618">618</sup> 在另外两项研究中，三唑仑（溶于二甲基亚砜的安眠药）使仓鼠的昼夜节律发生偏移并延长，而单独使用二甲基亚砜仅造成微小且无统计学意义的偏移。 <sup data-ref="617">617</sup> <sup data-ref="618">618</sup> 最后，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的代谢物 MSM <sup>⬖</sup> （溶于 DMSO 中）减轻了小鼠在酒精暴露与昼夜节律紊乱并存情况下出现的神经行为障碍、氧化应激以及生物钟基因表达紊乱。 注：我们推测二甲基亚砜与光生物调节存在显著的协同作用，但目前尚无足够数据得出明确结论。
**Improving sleep apnea:改善睡眠呼吸暂停：**

content.en: [Intraperitoneal treatment with](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29780237/) a Chinese herbal composition of Gastrodia elata <sup>⬖</sup> and Cinnamomum cassia <sup>⬖</sup> (dissolved in DMSO) reduced snoring pressure and frequency in aged rats and increased activity of phrenic, recurrent laryngeal, and hypoglossal nerves, while prolonging inspiratory, expiratory, and pre-inspiratory times, suggesting modulation of upper airway neural activity.
content.cn: 采用由天麻 <sup>⬖</sup> 和肉桂 <sup>⬖</sup> 组成的中药复方进行腹腔给药 （溶于二甲基亚砜）可降低老年大鼠的打鼾压力和频率，并增强膈神经、喉返神经和舌下神经的活动，同时延长吸气、呼气和吸气前期时间，这表明该制剂可调节上呼吸道的神经活动。

content.en: In mice with obstructive sleep apnea, dronabinol, a vagal cannabinoid agonist, significantly reduced sleep apnea episodes when combined with 100% DMSO but not when combined with 25% DMSO (while at both concentrations, REM sleep was suppressed).<sup data-ref="619">619</sup>, <sup data-ref="620">620</sup> Separately, [Anandamide](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/14746372/) (an endogenous cannabinoid) increased sleep and adenosine levels in the basal forebrain.
content.cn: 在患有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的小鼠中，迷走神经大麻素激动剂德罗纳比诺尔与100%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用时，显著减少了睡眠呼吸暂停发作次数，但与25%二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用时则未见此效果（不过在两种浓度下，快速眼动睡眠均受到抑制）。 <sup data-ref="619">619</sup> <sup data-ref="620">620</sup> 此外，阿南达胺（一种内源性大麻素）增加了基底前脑中的睡眠时间和腺苷水平。

content.en: [In an intermittent hypoxia model](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1875213625001378) of sleep apnea with rats that had heart attacks, Paxil prevented intermittent hypoxia from causing systemic insulin resistance or further damage to the injured heart (e.g., fibrosis and apoptosis was reduced).
content.cn: 在一项针对曾发生过心肌梗死的大鼠所建立的睡眠呼吸暂停间歇性缺氧模型中，帕罗西汀阻止了间歇性缺氧引发全身性胰岛素抵抗，并防止了受损心脏受到进一步损害（例如，减轻了纤维化和细胞凋亡）。

content.en: **Counteracting adverse effects of chronic sleep deprivation
content.cn: 缓解慢性睡眠不足的不良影响**

content.en: In mice models, a variety of substances in combination with DMSO have been found to counteract the adverse effects of chronic sleep deprivation. [Kaempferitrin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zctBhHlGddedtH-uKuA9Z4xPgXw87lL2SeV5GTIKxuCynMLMCT6lW1GicPmgJr9sGrZVOyvt3hCRiPTYCnf5FsLi79Px7RgB6ZJw7jT7M0EM6ntfMyUyIBNeQeMVpu_JgHzgEGPML8wXc_XMYoB7VK7dgxHClbVLwt03oIN4iSVFZfQA4LLI9Yhu&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (from monkfruit) increased antioxidant capacity, reduced oxidative stress, and reduced obesity. [Astragalin](https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/full/10.5555/20230304315) <sup>⬖</sup> significantly ameliorated liver oxidative stress. [Siraitia grosvenorii flavonoids <sup>⬖</sup> and melatonin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcuz0y9xW0qqsYd6lQ1Wt1hLnfXY1Fd3wl1I-OVqtK2SJ3C0tLRzYHQGrhBLhkhEWSwZrRDcOjnAo2Pa76RwmpVb73UbVpu7PBwTw17YP0JYHIB7ccv8wJrhF1Vp_xawdI60obPX6jYKZoq6gxF-0JQ2cyUERqm51m_LkDb96jCWn4VV8JQRBCFS&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> increased antioxidant capacity and reduced oxidative stress and inflammation. [Almorexant](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDYS_stL9FUnEDTZSEyvOtQy3Vb9H9oCQerxl0ktH_CHSIeAwV1Ewm6LGxxfJVJ5Dq-la1bzpu4Z9ZgYDeB5HGbias9SuwmLYvRer_-7dcnuogUD-SZiZYHMqPffSIrvKWwjeGZ0gLFgSAl6Fyq8-h3CO29sE9DRqqqT7CG4AY4T7pRUtHw_MnmBEPorFTznO4=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) improved spatial learning and memory and reduced (neuroinflammatory) astrogliosis. [A macrophage migration inhibitory](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcuNuZi4qpZo36r8Mm54i8TSf8U5v8p3dNlza9EL01j9kfhJdSosylcZmgnU41ppNwuXnTEpZPbt8Xg3zJNxU1pOhCpfoEdKmJ-CHPuA_fqbdEFIgl1J9ldBCYL7eGvDiwAW9vTTL4AVz10ZB3Gx12vkB48-11d02Vh-toAGQN9UbvtvcnQO6Fx6vkxFO7KtQug=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) factor inhibitor improved spatial learning and memory, and partially protected the hippocampal neurons.
content.cn: 在小鼠模型中，研究发现多种物质与二甲基亚砜（DMSO）联合使用可抵消慢性睡眠剥夺的不良影响。金丝桃素 <sup>⬖</sup> （源自罗汉果）提高了抗氧化能力，减轻了氧化应激，并缓解了肥胖。 阿斯塔加林 <sup>⬖</sup> 显著缓解了肝脏的氧化应激。罗汉果黄酮类化合物 <sup>⬖</sup> 和褪黑素 <sup>⬖</sup> 提高了抗氧化能力，并减轻了氧化应激和炎症。阿莫雷克桑改善了空间学习和记忆能力，并减轻了（神经炎症性）星形胶质细胞增生。一种巨噬细胞迁移抑制因子抑制剂改善了空间学习和记忆能力，并部分保护了海马神经元。

content.en: [Modafinil](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8958632/) (a stimulant used to increase wakefulness in individuals with chronic sleep deprivation) significantly decreased total sleep time and increased sleep latency in English bulldogs with sleep-disordered breathing, effectively alleviating hypersomnolence (tiredness).
content.cn: 莫达非尼（一种用于提高慢性睡眠剥夺患者清醒程度的兴奋剂）显著缩短了患有睡眠呼吸障碍的英国斗牛犬的总睡眠时间，并延长了入睡潜伏期，从而有效缓解了嗜睡（疲劳）症状。

content.en: [In rats, Paxil dissolved](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0168010224001196) in DMSO (for an osmotic minipump) significantly prolonged REM sleep episode duration and reduced the number of REM sleep episodes across multiple 6-h periods (which constitutes a positive shift in chronic sleep deprivation).
content.cn: 在大鼠实验中，溶解于二甲基亚砜（用于渗透微泵）的帕罗西汀显著延长了快速眼动睡眠时段的持续时间，并减少了多个6小时时段内的快速眼动睡眠次数（这在慢性睡眠剥夺状态下构成了一种积极变化）。

content.en: Down Syndrome and Developmental Disabilities
content.cn: 唐氏综合征与发育障碍

content.en: When I initially reviewed the DMSO literature, the thing I had the most difficulty believing was reports it significantly improved Down Syndrome, as like most doctors, I assumed this was a genetic condition absolutely nothing could be done for. However, after seeing the benefits being reported in numerous clinical studies and [the official Congressional transcripts](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/api/v1/file/79ee5132-06fb-4f64-b44e-a50dee889b47.pdf), I realized my assumption may have been wrong and decided to risk my credibility by publishing that data.
content.cn: 最初查阅关于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的文献时，我最难以置信的是那些称其能显著改善唐氏综合征的报告，因为和大多数医生一样，我原本认为这是一种遗传性疾病，根本无计可施。然而，在看到众多临床研究中报告的疗效以及国会官方会议记录后，我意识到自己的假设可能有误，于是决定冒着损害自身信誉的风险，将这些数据公之于众。

content.en: Shortly after, I received these testimonials from the parents of a two-year-old girl with Down Syndrome. [Her father](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/72415471) wrote first:
content.cn: 不久之后，我收到了一个患有唐氏综合征的两岁女孩父母发来的这些感言。先是她的父亲写道：

content.en: *We’ve been giving DMSO to our young daughter who has Down Syndrome along with extra vitamins \[e.g. amino acids* <sup>⬖</sup>*\] based on the treatment protocol from some studies. Almost immediately we noticed she was sleeping better through the night, she’s become more verbal—she suddenly seems like she wants to say words more intentionally now—and her appetite has improved substantially. She just seems more active, and that’s really awesome!*
content.cn: 根据一些研究的治疗方案，我们一直给患有唐氏综合征的小女儿服用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）以及额外的维生素\[例如氨基酸 <sup>⬖</sup> \]。几乎立刻，我们就发现她夜里睡得更香了，说话也更多了——她现在似乎突然更主动地想要说出单词了——而且她的食欲也大大改善了。她看起来就是更活泼了，这真的太棒了！

content.en: [Her mother](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/74198425) then followed up:
content.cn: 随后，她的母亲接着说道：

content.en: *Even in the time since my husband made that comment, we have seen changes in our little girl. The biggest one is that she is now CRAWLING—she had seemed for the longest time like she wasn’t even interested, but now she’s doing it (she started on her 2nd birthday, in fact!). Her coordination and motor skills are steadily improving, and she is super close to sitting up on her own, something I was getting really worried about. It’s almost like she’s not even the same kid she was two weeks ago. DMSO has been a game-changer for us. I am so excited to keep learning and seeing what’s possible!
content.cn: 就从我丈夫说那句话以来，我们已经看到了小女儿身上的变化。最大的变化是她现在会爬了——很长一段时间里，她似乎对此完全不感兴趣，但现在她真的会爬了（事实上，她是在两岁生日那天开始爬的！）。她的协调能力和运动技能正在稳步提高，而且她已经非常接近能够自己坐起来了，这正是我之前非常担心的。 她简直就像两周前那个孩子完全不同了。DMSO对我们来说堪称改变游戏规则的存在。我非常期待继续学习，看看未来还有什么可能！*

content.en: These parents’ experience echoes what was presented at [a 1980 Congressional hearing](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/api/v1/file/79ee5132-06fb-4f64-b44e-a50dee889b47.pdf) convened to (unsuccessfully) pressure the FDA to end its embargo on DMSO, where testimony was given of a child with Down Syndrome having a similarly miraculous response—but over a much longer timeframe.
content.cn: 这些家长的经历与1980年一次国会听证会上呈现的情况相呼应。该听证会旨在（但未成功）向美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）施压，要求其解除对二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的禁令。在听证会上，有证词提到一名唐氏综合征患儿也出现了类似的奇迹般疗效——但疗效显现的时间跨度要长得多。

content.en: There, Melody Clark was discussed, who at 11 months was started on DMSO by Dr. Jacob. At that time, her legs were “just like a rag doll’s,” she couldn’t roll from her back onto her stomach, and her eyes couldn’t focus. Her initial evaluation at six months had predicted she would never progress mentally beyond age six.
content.cn: 文中提到了梅洛迪·克拉克，她11个月大时由雅各布医生开始使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗。当时，她的双腿“就像布娃娃的一样”，无法从仰卧翻身到俯卧，眼睛也无法聚焦。她在6个月大时接受的初步评估曾预测，她的智力发展将永远停留在6岁水平。

content.en: After seven years on DMSO, Melody had progressed from what one physician described as “practically a vegetable state of existence” to being only mildly developmentally delayed—something her teachers had never seen in another child with Down Syndrome. Specifically, she functioned at a second-grade level (excelling in math, reading phonetically, spelling, and habitually using complete sentences), could jump rope, do somersaults, and play on a trampoline, and was quite popular with her classmates—having transformed from a child who played alone and stood near the teacher watching others into one who initiated group activities and took turns with peers. Her teacher wrote to Congress that in view of Melody’s achievements, she “would like to see DMSO given a fair testing and evaluation in helping the handicapped.”
content.cn: 在服用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）七年后，梅洛迪的状况已从一位医生所描述的“几乎处于植物人状态”改善为仅有轻微的发展迟缓——这是她的老师们在其他唐氏综合征患儿身上从未见过的。 具体来说，她的能力水平相当于小学二年级（在数学、音素拼读、拼写方面表现优异，且习惯使用完整句式），能够跳绳、翻跟头和在蹦床上玩耍，并且在同学中颇受欢迎——她已从一个独自玩耍、站在老师身边观看他人活动的孩子，蜕变为一个主动发起集体活动并与同伴轮流玩耍的孩子。 她的老师致信国会称，鉴于梅洛迪取得的成就，她“希望DMSO能在帮助残障人士方面获得公平的测试和评估”。

content.en: Her dentist additionally testified that her palate, jaw, and tongue had moved significantly toward normalcy—something he had never seen in this patient population. Melody’s extremely high palate at birth was now within normal range.
content.cn: 她的牙医还作证称，她的腭部、下颌和舌头已显著趋于正常——这是他在这一类患者中从未见过的。梅洛迪出生时极高的腭部，如今已处于正常范围内。

content.en: Two other similar cases have also been reported:
content.cn: 此外，还有两起类似的案例被报道：

content.en: • [At 10 months of age](https://www.amazon.com/Dmso-Natures-Healer/dp/B00EX5R4KW), Bronwyn Nash (who had Down Syndrome) was frail and unable to gain weight, so her mother started her on DMSO. She began gaining weight and developed an increased awareness of the people and objects around her and then started reaching out to touch things. At 18 months, she was able to stand up, and then became able to get into her mother’s cupboards, started to feed herself, and held her water glass well. At the time a health journalist visited her at 28 months of age, she was an alert, cheerful little girl much enjoyed and well loved by her family and improving steadily.
content.cn: • 10个月大时，布朗温·纳什（患有唐氏综合征）身体虚弱且无法增重，因此她的母亲开始让她服用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）。此后，她的体重开始增加，对周围的人和物也变得更加敏感，并开始伸手去触摸东西。 18个月大时，她已经能够站立，随后还能打开母亲的橱柜，开始自己进食，并能稳稳地端住水杯。当一位健康记者在她28个月大时去探访她时，她已成为一个机灵、开朗的小女孩，深受家人喜爱，状况也在稳步好转。

content.en: • [At 14](https://www.amazon.com/DMSO-Handbook-Doctors-Archie-Scott/dp/1475997922), Billy King could walk and feed himself but had the mental capacity of a ten month old. He then began drinking milk with DMSO each morning, and two years later, had the mental capacity of a seven year old and began losing the characteristic Down Syndrome appearance.
content.cn: • 14岁的比利·金虽然能够行走并自己进食，但智力水平仅相当于10个月大的婴儿。此后，他开始每天早晨饮用掺有二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的牛奶，两年后，他的智力水平已达到7岁儿童的水平，且唐氏综合征的典型外貌特征也开始逐渐消失。
Before treatment, 1 year into treatment and 2 years into treatment. 治疗前、治疗1年后及治疗2年后。

content.en: He continued to improve and was eventually able to hold a job in a Portland bookstore.
content.cn: 他的状况持续好转，最终在波特兰的一家书店里找到了一份工作。

content.en: *Note: [another account](https://www.amazon.com/Dmso-Natures-Healer/dp/B00EX5R4KW) of Billy King’s story has a differing chronology (e.g., he started DMSO at 8 not 14, and also took the amino acid* <sup>⬖</sup> *formula).*
content.cn: 注：关于比利·金故事的另一种说法，其时间线有所不同（例如，他是在8岁而非14岁时开始服用二甲基亚砜的，并且还服用了氨基酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 配方）。

content.en: Research in turn exists to support these unbelievable anecdotes.
content.cn: 而相关研究的存在，正是为了佐证这些难以置信的轶事。

content.en: • [In Oregon](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1055559/), 67 moderately or severely mentally disabled children (aged 4-17) with Down Syndrome were randomized to receive a high or low DMSO dose and then were compared to 23 similar children whose parents did not want them to receive an experimental drug.<sup data-ref="621">621</sup>, <sup data-ref="622">622</sup> No side effects occurred and a dose dependent improvement was observed:
content.cn: • 在俄勒冈州，67名患有唐氏综合征且存在中度或重度智力障碍的儿童（4至17岁）被随机分为两组，分别接受高剂量或低剂量的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗，随后将其与23名情况类似但父母不愿让孩子接受实验性药物治疗的儿童进行了对比。 <sup data-ref="621">621</sup> <sup data-ref="622">622</sup> 未出现任何副作用，且观察到剂量依赖性的改善：

content.en: [In Chile](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/124151/), 55 children with severe mental disability caused by Down syndrome (the oldest being 14) were given DMSO and amino acids <sup>⬖</sup> by intramuscular injection or served as controls. The vials for injection consisted of DMSO along with gamma aminobutyric acid (GABA <sup>⬖</sup>), gamma amino beta hydroxybutyric acid (GABOB <sup>⬖</sup>), and acetyl glutamine <sup>⬖</sup> (with lower doses given to those under 3 1⁄2 years of age). The children’s development was then evaluated with [Gese\[l scores](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gesell_Developmental_Schedules) and a massive improvement was seen in the DMSO group:
content.cn: 在智利，55名因唐氏综合征导致严重智力障碍的儿童（年龄最大的14岁）通过肌肉注射的方式接受了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和氨基酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 的治疗，其余儿童则作为对照组。 注射用安瓿中含有二甲基亚砜（DMSO），以及γ-氨基丁酸（GABA <sup>⬖</sup> ）、γ-氨基-β-羟基丁酸（GABOB <sup>⬖</sup> ）和乙酰谷氨酰胺 <sup>⬖</sup> （3岁半以下的儿童剂量较低）。 随后，通过Gese\[l评分对儿童的发展状况进行了评估，结果显示DMSO组出现了显著改善：

content.en: *Note: this study (and the additional improvements that occurred) can be viewed [here](https://dmso.org/articles/mentalretardation/downsyn1.htm) and [here](https://dmso.org/articles/mentalretardation/downsyn2.htm).
content.cn: 注：本研究（以及随后进行的进一步改进）可在此处和此处查阅。*

content.en: [In Argentina](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1093464/), 13 mentally disabled children (5 severe cases, **4** moderate cases, and **4** mild ones), who did **not** have Down Syndrome, received a DMSO amino acid <sup>⬖</sup> mixture (known as Merinex) three times a week by injection for 180 days (with periodic 15 day periods where the amino acids without DMSO were administered orally)
content.cn: 在阿根廷，13名非唐氏综合征的智力障碍儿童（其中5例为重度，4例为中度，4例为轻度）接受了为期180天的治疗，每周三次通过注射方式给予二甲基亚砜（DMSO）氨基酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 混合物（俗称Merinex）；期间每隔15天会进行一次口服不含二甲基亚砜的氨基酸治疗。

content.en: *Note: [other authors](https://www.amazon.com/DMSO-Handbook-New-Paradigm-Healthcare/dp/3981525558) have reported young patients (and older ones) with learning difficulties, low intelligence, ADHD, anxiety disorders, epilepsy, nervousness, dyscalculia, dyslexia, exhaustion, and concentration problems all benefit from this protocol. Additionally, some have argued adding galactose* <sup>⬖</sup> *to it enhances its efficacy.*
content.cn: 注：其他作者曾报告称，患有学习困难、智力低下、注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）、焦虑障碍、癫痫、神经紧张、计算障碍、阅读障碍、疲劳及注意力不集中等问题的年轻患者（以及年龄较大的患者）均从该治疗方案中获益。此外，还有人认为在方案中添加半乳糖 <sup>⬖</sup> 可增强其疗效。

content.en: [In a 1969 study](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C5&q=Experiencia+cl%C3%ADnica+con+Merinex+en+ni%C3%B1os+con+d%C3%A9ficit+mental+y+difficultades+de+aprendizaje+b%C3%A1sico&btnG=), 44 severely developmentally delayed children received the DMSO amino acid <sup>⬖</sup> mix, with many experiencing a heightened capacity for learning in a relatively short time and over 70% having favorable responses such as “increase of the IQ, an evident and accelerated progress in basic achievements, an overall improvement of intellectual capacity, evident progress in reading, writing, and mathematics, better coordination of movements and improved manual skill, and a decrease of behavioral problems,” along with gaining better psychomotor control, no longer having anger for no reason, a general reduction of irritability, and a lessening of disobedience.
content.cn: 在一项1969年的研究中，44名严重发育迟缓的儿童服用了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）氨基酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 混合物，其中许多人在相对较短的时间内学习能力显著提高，超过70%的儿童出现了积极反应，例如“智商提高、 基础学业成绩的显著且快速进步、智力水平的全面提升、阅读、写作和数学能力的明显进步、动作协调性的增强和动手能力的提高，以及行为问题的减少”，此外还表现为心理运动控制能力的提升、不再无故发怒、整体易怒性降低，以及不服从行为的减少。

content.en: [Another 1969 study](https://obtienearchivo.bcn.cl/obtieneimagen?id=documentos/10221.1/55494/1/203298.pdf) gave the DMSO amino acid <sup>⬖</sup> mixture for six months to 30 learning disabled children with language disorders (who did not have an accompanying neurological illness) and compared them to 20 controls, and observed it resulted in:
content.cn: 另一项1969年的研究让30名患有语言障碍的学习障碍儿童（未伴有神经系统疾病）连续六个月服用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与氨基酸的 <sup>⬖</sup> 混合物，并将他们与20名对照组儿童进行比较，结果观察到：

content.en: •Disappearance of mental lethargy.
content.cn: •精神倦怠感消失。

content.en: •Evidence of sensorial reactions.
content.cn: •感觉反应的证据。

content.en: •Disappearance of automatic movements.
content.cn: •自动机芯的消失。

content.en: •Disappearance of inertia, passivity, and negativity.
content.cn: •惰性、被动性和消极心态的消失。

content.en: •Growing interest and initiative in tasks and activities.
content.cn: •对各项任务和活动表现出日益浓厚的兴趣和主动性。

content.en: •Improvement of the physiognomic expression and of the spoken language.
content.cn: •改善面部表情和口语表达。

content.en: •Lucid activity, group contact, and disappearance of unprovoked aggressiveness.
content.cn: •意识清醒、能与他人互动，且无故攻击性行为消失。

content.en: •Losing shyness and developing self-esteem.
content.cn: •克服羞怯，建立自尊。

content.en: •Successful training to carry out chores, to do shopping, to eat, and to dress without help, etc.
content.cn: •成功接受了相关培训，能够不依赖他人独立完成家务、购物、进食和穿衣等活动。

content.en: •Learning to read and to write and to do homework.
content.cn: •学习阅读、写作和完成作业。

content.en: [A 1976 Chile study](https://www.scielo.cl/pdf/rcp/v47n4/art05.pdf) gave DMSO and amino acids <sup>⬖</sup> (GABA,<sup>⬖</sup> GABOB,<sup>⬖</sup> L-acetylglutamine,<sup>⬖</sup> and arginine <sup>⬖</sup>) to 15 children (under 3.5 years old) with Down Syndrome and compared them to 13 untreated controls. After 12 months of intensive treatment, per the Gesell Developmental Quotient, motor area average rose from 56 to 72, adaptive from 50 to 66, language from 52 to 58, and social from 40 to 64 (with many individuals improving >10 points, especially in motor, adaptive, and social domains), while controls remained largely unchanged. Physical improvements included reduced macroglossia, better facial expressiveness, increased muscle tone/coordination, and postural changes in treated children. During the subsequent 6-month maintenance phase (to 18 months total), treated children’s gains were largely maintained or slightly increased (e.g., motor to 74, adaptive to 69, social to 67), with no significant regression and only minor isolated losses (e.g., in language for a few), whereas controls showed no progress or slight declines. The authors noted no significant adverse effects and concluded that early intervention appeared beneficial for neuronal stimulation and development.<sup data-ref="623">623</sup>, <sup data-ref="624">624</sup>, <sup data-ref="625">625</sup>
content.cn: 1976年智利的一项研究向15名儿童（3.5岁以下）给予了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和氨基酸 <sup>⬖</sup> （GABA、 <sup>⬖</sup> GABOB、 <sup>⬖</sup> L-乙酰谷氨酰胺、 <sup>⬖</sup> 以及精氨酸 <sup>⬖</sup> ），并将他们与13名未接受治疗的对照组儿童进行了比较。 经过12个月的强化治疗，根据盖塞尔发育商（Gesell Developmental Quotient）的评估，受试儿童的运动领域平均分从56升至72，适应性领域从50升至66，语言领域从52升至58，社交领域从40升至64（其中许多儿童的得分提升超过10分，尤其在运动、适应性和社交领域），而对照组儿童的得分则基本保持不变。 接受治疗的儿童在身体方面也出现了改善，包括巨舌症减轻、面部表情更丰富、肌肉张力/协调性增强以及姿势发生变化。 在随后的6个月维持阶段（总计18个月），接受治疗的儿童的进步基本得以维持或略有增加（例如，运动能力升至74，适应能力升至69，社交能力升至67），未出现显著倒退，仅有零星的轻微退步（例如，少数儿童在语言能力方面），而对照组则未见进步或出现轻微下降。 作者指出未发现显著不良反应，并得出结论：早期干预似乎有助于神经元的刺激与发育。 <sup data-ref="623">623</sup> <sup data-ref="624">624</sup> <sup data-ref="625">625</sup>

content.en: [One author](https://www.amazon.com/Dmso-Natures-Healer/dp/B00EX5R4KW) reported on an Argentinian study (I could not find) conducted by [this physician](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=DECORIAT+LF&cauthor_id=14065419), where 18 children with Down syndrome received DMSO and amino acids <sup>⬖</sup> and were compared to 91 controls, and to quote the author this resulted in:
content.cn: 一位作者报道了一项由这位医生进行的阿根廷研究（我未能找到该研究），该研究中，18名唐氏综合征患儿接受了二甲基亚砜（DMSO）和氨基酸的治疗 <sup>⬖</sup> ，并与91名对照组儿童进行了比较；据该作者所述，结果如下：

content.en: a tendency towards accelerated maturity in the children treated, with marked progress in language integration; this could be established in statistically significant degrees in the children treated
content.cn: 接受治疗的儿童表现出成熟进程加快的趋势，语言整合方面取得了显著进步；这一现象在接受治疗的儿童中具有统计学意义。

content.en: Additionally:此外：

• [This study](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C33&q=Experiencia+clinica+con+Merinex+en+nifios+con+dtficit+mental+y+difficultades+de+aprendizaje+blsico&btnG=), and [this study](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=Merinex+en+ni%C3%B1os+con+d%C3%A9ficit+mental+y+difficultades+de+aprendizaje+b%C3%A1sico&hl=en&as_sdt=0%2C33&as_ylo=1969&as_yhi=1969), also found the DMSO amino acid <sup>⬖</sup> mixture benefited developmentally disabled children.
content.cn: • 这项研究和另一项研究也发现，DMSO与氨基酸的 <sup>⬖</sup> 混合物对发育障碍儿童有益。

content.en: •A [1982 Spanish literature review](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6222437/) highlighted DMSO as a treatment for Down Syndrome.
content.cn: •1982年的一篇西班牙文献综述指出，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可作为唐氏综合征的治疗方法。

content.en: • [A 2009 Russian diabetes book promoted regu](https://www.test-poloska.ru/images/books/full/fabules.pdf) larly applying a topical mixture of DMSO, hydrogen peroxide, and copper sulfate for diabetes and tissue regeneration, which cited a case of a pregnant woman whose fetus was diagnosed with Down Syndrome who did that protocol and then had a normal child.
content.cn: • 2009年出版的一本俄罗斯糖尿病书籍推荐定期外用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）、过氧化氢和硫酸铜的混合物来治疗糖尿病并促进组织再生，书中引用了一例孕妇的案例：该孕妇的胎儿被诊断为唐氏综合征，但在采用该疗法后，最终生下了一名健康的婴儿。

content.en: • [1980](https://www.thieme-connect.com/products/ejournals/pdf/10.1055/s-0028-1089914.pdf) and [1982](https://asma.kglmeridian.com/downloadpdf/view/journals/asem/54/12/article-p1137-s.pdf) articles by skeptical physicians acknowledged DMSO was being explored as a treatment for Down Syndrome.
content.cn: • 1980年和1982年，一些持怀疑态度的医生在文章中承认，当时正在探索将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）作为唐氏综合征的治疗方法。

content.en: *Note: in addition to Down Syndrome, [the German DMSO community has had significant success](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-mixtures-transform-natural-medicine) using DMSO and amino acids* <sup>⬖</sup> *for learning disabilities, developmental delays, mood and anxiety disorders, and neurodegenerative diseases—of which minor or severe learning disabilities are the most common application.*
content.cn: 注：除了唐氏综合征外，德国的二甲基亚砜（DMSO）研究社群在运用二甲基亚砜和氨基酸 <sup>⬖</sup> 治疗学习障碍、发育迟缓、情绪和焦虑障碍以及神经退行性疾病方面也取得了显著成效——其中，轻度或重度学习障碍是最常见的应用领域。

content.en: Autism
content.cn: 自闭症

content.en: One of the most frequent questions I receive is if DMSO can be used to treat autism (as many factors mechanistically argue for it), but unfortunately, other than a few vague parent reports I’ve come across suggesting it worked (I could not corroborate), I do not have any direct parental data to assess this question.
content.cn: 我最常收到的问题之一是，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能否用于治疗自闭症（因为从机制上讲，许多因素都支持这一观点），但遗憾的是，除了我偶然看到的一些家长报告含糊地表示它有效（但我无法证实）之外，我并没有任何来自家长的直接数据来评估这个问题。

content.en: However, a variety of studies on mice (modified to model autism) have found DMSO in combination with another therapeutic helped their autism-like behaviors. Specifically, with DMSO:
content.cn: 然而，多项针对小鼠（经基因改造以模拟自闭症）的研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与另一种治疗药物联合使用，有助于改善其自闭症样行为。具体而言，使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）时：

content.en: Epothilone D (a microtubule-stabilizing agent) improved autism-like repetitive behaviors across multiple studies <sup data-ref="626">626</sup>, <sup data-ref="627">627</sup>, <sup data-ref="628">628</sup>, <sup data-ref="627">627</sup>, <sup data-ref="627">627</sup>, <sup data-ref="629">629</sup> through a consistent mechanism: stabilizing microtubules, increasing excitatory synapse number, and enhancing myelin basic protein expression in the cerebral cortex. These studies consistently found reduced self-grooming times and increased social ability, with individual studies additionally demonstrating [improved restricted repetitive behaviors](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=Ap1IM-J3Ck0TLhWo7-vfcPXbQb7NiN-de2lYq5fZlrv-5h44hmYT2w8ACDeXe1t5yUsHXKGi97O-aTqF0NSt1qDP6P8g-5FUVaXFU7-Z-dJKBGoLBtD1QZolsQ7tIIOozMXyx7ze64udVCweIpBRCnc3rKZWFwtwh7XY8FAbuL8BVvXsfmNMBjf2FnhGosrB&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) in marble burying tests, normalized myelination and [increased dendritic spine density](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUo8JRbdbuQimhPQFIJRrIaP8Hzbma-oNJme0fZbBAZFEtkYfUmMObLw8ae6xEB9AxTN-O9Gh2Afs5RNYOIcQBCGThevh5dNOPrkfuMB6sXtCl1YP6wJfseVi3_dEzqQJdJ9Ra8yiAQ3BRSLMchwiAhbCGqSwUhu3JhM35ZdgDyWdfqOanZDG8O8jyfMXnQ59Mw=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN).
content.cn: 多项研究表明，依波替隆D（一种微管稳定剂）通过一致的作用机制改善了自闭症样重复行为：稳定微管、增加兴奋性突触数量，并增强大脑皮层中髓鞘基本蛋白的表达。 这些研究一致发现，自理行为时间减少且社交能力增强；其中部分研究还通过“埋珠试验”证实了刻板重复行为的改善，并观察到髓鞘化过程恢复正常以及树突棘密度增加。

content.en: Curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> repeatedly enhanced sociability, reduced repetitive behaviors, and restored hippocampal neurogenesis across multiple studies,<sup data-ref="630">630</sup>, <sup data-ref="631">631</sup>, <sup data-ref="632">632</sup>, <sup data-ref="633">633</sup> with consistent findings of increased hippocampal neuron counts and reduced excessive astrocytes (a key facet of the disease process), along with improved learning, memory, and social communication. Individual studies further showed curcumin <sup>⬖</sup> promoted neural progenitor cell proliferation, increased radial glial cells in the subgranular zone, and enhanced newborn neuron maturation.<sup data-ref="632">632</sup>
content.cn: 在多项研究中，姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 一再被证实能增强社交性、减少重复性行为并恢复海马神经发生， <sup data-ref="632">632</sup> <sup data-ref="631">631</sup> <sup data-ref="632">632</sup> <sup data-ref="633">633</sup> 研究结果一致显示：海马神经元数量增加、过量星形胶质细胞（该疾病进程的关键方面）减少，同时学习、记忆和社交沟通能力也得到改善。 个别研究进一步表明，姜黄素 <sup>⬖</sup> 能促进神经前体细胞增殖，增加亚颗粒区的放射状胶质细胞数量，并促进新生神经元的成熟。 <sup data-ref="632">632</sup>

content.en: Prenatal resveratrol <sup>⬖</sup> prevented embryonic valproic acid exposure from causing autism-like behavioral features, including deficits in nest-seeking behavior, social interaction, and over-excitation in the brain’s glutamate system.<sup data-ref="634">634</sup>, <sup data-ref="635">635</sup>
content.cn: 产前补充白藜芦醇 <sup>⬖</sup> 可防止胚胎期暴露于丙戊酸导致自闭症样行为特征，包括筑巢行为缺陷、社交互动障碍以及大脑谷氨酸系统过度兴奋。 <sup data-ref="634">634</sup> <sup data-ref="635">635</sup>

content.en: [Melatonin <sup>⬖</sup> and Wortmannin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=9r23aJBcv3bm1ff4rBsph3saltR0CkNPDAoH97FeYuU8tk9ES3x0A5VSGQEyr4uvuVz7Pe0qk2jOtfLuEkN3nUQf-WvFPfsWXPZwBuSxDGHETvJEwGso2O8K3pQu-SHdmurPSDD4YVUmu3-iYcrDyqkF6XX8UjnBfYIHjl7ErHVAFfTWcGAtR3658j8C_X8gJs2ZPW8cTtw=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (a PI3K inhibitor) improved autism-like behaviors, promoted synapse-associated protein synthesis, and improved dendritic spine development. Separately, [Wortmannin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=nRANE_nPmUrdOBHQJZ4rpiEHaw8JgQ3-HE98NTAI5-N7DR-jVVrzjBPOw-9gF4bKZOI8wo30Pkf9GJ9K9520tKdQ2uRl4gH8m9lpeBSNE6StT4ck4hO5XU1hwjInuDZjgRJ8x_73eYJ3eBmZqCB2YH0KZCyH37ouUmZOaXexmnLhU5IIKrtlXSfv_E0lY6vK&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) alone rescued dendritic spine density, upregulated postsynaptic density protein, and inhibited the same pathway rapamycin targets.
content.cn: 褪黑素 <sup>⬖</sup> 和沃特曼宁（一种PI3K抑制剂）改善了自闭症样行为，促进了突触相关蛋白的合成，并改善了树突棘的发育。此外，单独使用沃特曼宁可恢复树突棘密度，上调突触后密度蛋白的表达，并抑制雷帕霉素所作用的同一信号通路。

content.en: Additional agents improving autism-like behaviors in mouse models include [a 5-HT2A receptor antagonist](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0166432816304284) (which attenuated repetitive self-grooming), [a S1PR1 antagonist](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40769302/) (which improved learning and memory while preserving hippocampal neuronal density and microvascular integrity), [estradiol](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=r3g0b1Wd3tccONMchc23AjbFIIMt-lH4qy05ddSGlcFHzGzBtumZjFWRnbReabCmWwbMEwvVkknsicf2laKespI3LQscwB_0DkCag1yAbv-evU5NVB65dhtutVC5qVtwHHORfZ8dv3r1cSTSMjVvJiP5GpTxyyg29Z23ndEhmw9mgYo7bZWBu2vmhKgRYxW6lEMDRDFi4wQ=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) (which restored empathy and social affection in ovariectomized mice), and [baicalin](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=dKcr_PZ1zcsOFlyZncfqx2UlqbWtGgIpHx2Mo3ECQeHvSqG1ApMOSe5HV-REPZ_xiXkc5kvkHnOItBmRGGG_hEunNNY5orh8nEx7hR5DFuWy3evigmALJLv6NmhXZYzXULboFZHJZYiJFsjA6W1XV6bBmCjVRksWVOTN93Kida-scxtOjOaj0bho5ALwj0_ApBANpTVfrFs=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN) <sup>⬖</sup> (which dose-dependently improved recognition and spatial memory while increasing BDNF and healthy neuron counts in the hippocampus).
content.cn: 其他可改善小鼠模型中自闭症样行为的药物包括：5-HT2A受体拮抗剂（可减轻重复性自我梳理行为）、S1PR1受体拮抗剂（可在保持海马区神经元密度和微血管完整性的同时改善学习和记忆能力）、雌二醇（可恢复卵巢切除小鼠的共情能力和社交亲和力），以及黄芩苷 <sup>⬖</sup> （其以剂量依赖性方式改善了识别能力和空间记忆，同时增加了海马区的神经营养因子（BDNF）水平和健康神经元数量）。

content.en: Collectively, these studies using a diverse variety of therapies that share the common thread of DMSO suggest DMSO may also independently improve autism, but due to DMSO rarely, if ever, being compared to a saline placebo in these types of studies, it is impossible to know.
content.cn: 总体而言，这些采用多种不同疗法但都以二甲基亚砜（DMSO）为共同特征的研究表明，DMSO 可能也具有独立改善自闭症的作用，但由于在此类研究中，DMSO 极少（甚至从未）与生理盐水安慰剂进行对比，因此无法确定这一点。

content.en: *Note: complete summaries of each study can be found in my reference Substack [here](https://amidwestdoctor.substack.com/p/dmso-autism-studies).
content.cn: 注：每项研究的完整摘要可参见我在此处的Substack参考资料。*

content.en: Other Developmental Disorders
content.cn: 其他发育障碍

content.en: **Cerebral Palsy:** Given DMSO’s ability to heal central nervous system damage, particularly from temporary loss of blood flow (along with its ability to help muscle spasticity), it appears plausible DMSO could help with cerebral palsy. Unfortunately, this has not been studied and the only paper I’ve found [on this topic](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38937924/) noted that DMSO with verteporfin partially restored the ability of muscle satellite cells to correctly differentiate, potentially reducing their spasticity.
content.cn: 脑瘫：鉴于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）具有修复中枢神经系统损伤的能力——尤其是由暂时性血流中断所导致的损伤（同时它还能缓解肌肉痉挛）——因此DMSO似乎有可能对脑瘫起到治疗作用。 遗憾的是，目前尚未对此进行相关研究，而我找到的唯一一篇关于该主题的论文指出，二甲基亚砜与维特波芬联合使用，部分恢复了肌肉卫星细胞的正常分化能力，这可能有助于减轻肌肉痉挛。

content.en: However, in horses, [one paper](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Geraldo-Eleno-Alves/publication/268395682_Dimetilsulfoxido_DMSO/links/551d67700cf252bc3a87a882/Dimetilsulfoxido-DMSO.pdf) reviewing veterinary textbooks reported DMSO treats neonatal brain damage (e.g., hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy) and colic in foals, while [another book](https://archive.org/details/dmsotruestoryofr0000tars) reported that veterinarian Jack Metcalf had found horses developmentally disabled at birth (to the point they can’t nurse) once given IV DMSO three times daily regain the ability to nurse and that DMSO accelerates their overall development.
content.cn: 然而，在马的治疗方面，一篇综述兽医教科书的论文指出，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可治疗驹的新生儿脑损伤（例如缺氧缺血性脑病）和肠绞痛；而另一本著作则报道，兽医杰克·梅特卡夫发现，出生时即存在发育障碍（严重到无法吮乳）的马驹，在每天静脉注射三次二甲基亚砜后，能够恢复吮乳能力，且二甲基亚砜还能加速其整体发育。

content.en: Finally, one of the most common and disabling features of cerebral palsy is severe disabling muscle spasticity (to the point aggressive measures like botox are routinely used). In patients with severe muscle spasticity, Russian researchers reported success with ultrasound-facilitated topical applications to the affected muscles and applicable spinal segments of DMSO mixed with sodium oxybutyrate (GHB, [the potent sleep aid](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-fdas-disastrous-war-against-sleep) the FDA went to war against) and lidocaine. In the detailed patent (which I translated [here](https://amidwestdoctor.substack.com/p/russian-dmso-cerebral-palsy-patent)), they specifically discussed a case of a patient who developed debilitating spasticity from arachnoiditis, but implied it could be used to regain mobility in other conditions like poliomyelitis or cerebral palsy. In parallel, [one reader](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/132292967) with a cognitively intact nine-year-old girl with cerebral palsy that affects three limbs shared that her daughter told her topical DMSO relaxed her tight muscles and allows her to move more easily.
content.cn: 最后，脑瘫最常见且最具致残性的特征之一是严重的致残性肌肉痉挛（严重到通常需要采取肉毒杆菌毒素等激进措施）。针对患有严重肌肉痉挛的患者，俄罗斯研究人员报告称，将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）与氧丁酸钠（GHB，即美国食品药品监督管理局曾大力打击的强效助眠剂）及利多卡因混合，通过超声辅助方式局部涂抹于受累肌肉及相关脊髓节段，取得了成功。 在详细的专利文件中（我已在此处翻译），他们特别讨论了一例因蛛网膜炎导致严重痉挛的患者病例，但暗示该疗法也可用于恢复小儿麻痹症或脑瘫等其他疾病患者的活动能力。 与此同时，一位读者分享了她的经历：她的九岁女儿患有脑瘫，三肢受累，但认知功能完好。女儿告诉她，局部使用二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能放松她紧绷的肌肉，使她能够更轻松地活动。

content.en: *Note: [another Russian patent proposed](https://www.elibrary.ru/item.asp?id=48380782) DMSO as a transdermal enhancer for a botox patch to treat the spasticity associated with Parkinson’s, cerebral palsy, dystonia, and multiple sclerosis — potentially bypassing the need for the repeated injections botox currently requires. Outside of this patent, I have only seen DMSO botox formulations used for refractory idiopathic detrusor (bladder) overactivity (where they worked).
content.cn: 注：另一项俄罗斯专利提议将二甲基亚砜（DMSO）用作肉毒杆菌贴片的经皮吸收促进剂，用于治疗帕金森病、脑瘫、肌张力障碍和多发性硬化症相关的痉挛——这可能使患者无需像目前那样反复进行肉毒杆菌注射。除该专利外，我仅见过将DMSO肉毒杆菌制剂用于难治性特发性膀胱逼尿肌过度活动症的案例（且在该病症中疗效显著）。*

content.en: **Cleft Palate**: One of the original anti-seizure medications, phenytoin, was notorious for causing a pattern of birth defects, some of which (such as a flat nasal bridge and epicanthal folds) can resemble features seen in Down syndrome. [One study](https://www.dbpia.co.kr/Journal/articleDetail?nodeId=NODE00367614) found DMSO prevented some of the birth defects (e.g., cleft palate) phenytoin caused.
content.cn: 腭裂：苯妥英钠作为最早的抗癫痫药物之一，曾因会引发一系列先天性畸形而臭名昭著，其中一些畸形（如鼻梁扁平和内眦褶）与唐氏综合征的特征相似。一项研究发现，二甲基亚砜（DMSO）可预防苯妥英钠引起的部分先天性畸形（例如腭裂）。

content.en: **ACBD6-related neurodevelopmental syndrome:** this rare disease also causes cognitive impairment and birth defects resembling those seen in Down Syndrome. While DMSO has not been tested on patients with it, the disorder is caused by defective activity of N-myristoyltransferase, an enzyme [DMSO has been shown](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0006295202014120) in vitro to increase the activity of.
content.cn: ACBD6相关神经发育综合征：这种罕见疾病也会导致认知障碍，并伴有类似唐氏综合征的先天性畸形。虽然尚未对该病患者进行二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的临床试验，但该疾病是由N-肉豆蔻酰转移酶活性缺陷引起的，而体外研究表明，二甲基亚砜可增强该酶的活性。

content.en: **Krabbe disease:** this is a rare incurable genetic lysosomal storage disease that causes severe neurodegeneration and severe developmental delays at the start of life. [A 1999 paper](https://journals.lww.com/ajg/citation/1999/04000/Japanese_Electro_Acustim_in_the_Treatment_of.68.aspx) disclosed that Stanley Jacob had developed and implemented an oral DMSO protocol for this condition but it is unclear if it was successful.
content.cn: 克拉布病：这是一种罕见的、无法治愈的遗传性溶酶体贮积病，会导致严重的神经退行性变以及出生初期出现严重的发育迟缓。1999年的一篇论文披露，斯坦利·雅各布曾针对该病研发并实施了一套口服二甲基亚砜（DMSO）治疗方案，但该方案是否有效尚不明确。

content.en: **Tourette syndrome**: [in disease-model rats](https://oversea.cnki.net/kcms2/article/abstract?v=adNygMj_jVDBTYkbCFzLYtI5skCtH5BSKhACRYXEwNs5DcIlj2EaEg2Ze7n49OQiRf3r030HzEgNxYhhku1UiO-AqK46hG07LMk4s3v_KXJHgNHrR2aQDmQvNjtkeoIJU-ZoFma6dzXnh_AQXemnYSeqaNq8xgplgF8MfsQL4hj8D9hwEY68w2DHA86xDzGNZ-BRcurDsSo=&uniplatform=OVERSEA&language=EN), Vitamin D <sup>⬖</sup> (1.0 μg/kg/day) in DMSO significantly decreased locomotor behaviors (0.43–0.69 vs 0.92–1.33 scores) and reversed the decrease in striatal dopamine content (along with causing an expected vitamin D <sup>⬖</sup> induced increase in serum calcium).
content.cn: 图雷特综合征：在疾病模型大鼠中，溶于二甲基亚砜（DMSO）的维生素D <sup>⬖</sup> （1.0 μg/kg/天）显著降低了运动行为评分（0.43–0.69 对比 0.92–1.33），并逆转了纹状体多巴胺含量的下降（同时引起了预期中的维生素D <sup>⬖</sup> 诱导的血清钙水平升高）。

content.en: *Note: a lot of people have asked if DMSO could help muscular dystrophy. The only data I’ve found is [a study](https://dsm.inr.gob.mx/indiscap/index.php/INDISCAP/article/view/583) where (-)-epicatechin* <sup>⬖</sup> *in DMSO reduced dystrophic fiber pathology and promoted muscle regeneration in MD mice, but did not address the underlying disease mechanism — which unfortunately tells you very little. That said, [one reader reported](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-remarkable-history-and-safety/comment/273138763) it helped her dog with degenerative myopath* y.
content.cn: 注：很多人询问二甲基亚砜（DMSO）是否对肌营养不良症有帮助。我找到的唯一相关数据是一项研究，该研究表明，DMSO中的（-）-表儿茶素 <sup>⬖</sup> 可减轻肌营养不良小鼠的肌纤维病理变化并促进肌肉再生，但并未探讨其潜在的疾病机制——这遗憾地说明，该研究提供的信息非常有限。不过，有位读者反映，该方法对她患有退行性肌病的狗狗有所帮助。

content.en: A New Model of Neurology
content.cn: 神经学的新范式

content.en: Through reading this, my hope is that it has not only given you hope for treating many “incurable” neurological conditions, but also that you share my fascination in the new perspective it provides on what ultimately causes many of these diseases.
content.cn: 希望通过阅读本文，不仅能让您对治疗许多“不治之症”的神经系统疾病重燃希望，还能让您像我一样，对本文所提出的关于这些疾病根本成因的新视角感到着迷。

content.en: In turn, while this article was lengthy, you may have noticed many neurological conditions were omitted. This was due to the length of this article (due to all its links) crashing Substack and the article hence needing to split into multiple parts. So, in addition to previous articles I’ve written which show DMSO provides similar neurological benefits to each of the sensory organs (e.g., particularly the [eyes](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/dmso-heals-the-eyes-and-transforms) and [ears](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-dmso-cures-eye-ear-nose-throat)), in the upcoming parts of this series I will cover the remarkable effects DMSO has provided for:
content.cn: 不过，虽然这篇文章篇幅较长，但您可能已经注意到，其中遗漏了许多神经系统疾病。这是因为本文篇幅过长（主要是由于包含的链接太多），导致Substack平台崩溃，因此不得不将文章拆分为多个部分。 因此，除了我之前撰写的文章（这些文章表明二甲基亚砜（DMSO）能为各个感觉器官——尤其是眼睛和耳朵——带来类似的神经系统益处）之外，在本系列的后续篇章中，我将探讨DMSO在以下方面所产生的显著效果：

content.en: •Spinal issues (e.g., paralysis, spinal cord injuries, disc issues, radiculopathies, and arachnoiditis).
content.cn: •脊柱问题（例如：瘫痪、脊髓损伤、椎间盘问题、神经根病变和蛛网膜炎）。

content.en: •Peripheral nerve issues (e.g., nerve regeneration, palsies, neuropathies and neuropathic pain).
content.cn: •周围神经问题（例如：神经再生、麻痹、神经病变和神经病理性疼痛）。

content.en: •Strokes, brain bleeds, traumatic brain injuries, and concussions.
content.cn: •中风、脑出血、创伤性脑损伤和脑震荡。

content.en: In the final part of this article, I will share practical guidance for properly obtaining each grade of DMSO (including IV DMSO), provide specific protocols for the neurological conditions discussed here — including Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, strokes, chronic stress, neuropathies, cognitive impairment, brain fog, anesthesia toxicity, and neurodevelopmental disorders — along with highlighting complementary natural therapies we have found to further benefit these conditions.”
content.cn: 在本文的最后一部分，我将分享关于如何正确获取各等级二甲基亚砜（包括静脉注射用二甲基亚砜）的实用指南，针对本文讨论的神经系统疾病——包括帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病、中风、慢性压力、神经病变、认知障碍、脑雾、麻醉毒性及神经发育障碍——提供具体的治疗方案，并重点介绍我们发现的、对这些疾病有进一步疗效的辅助性天然疗法。”
